AI.tldr: 本文提出RLEA框架，将强化学习与LLM智能体结合，用于自动化复杂车辆路径问题（VRP）的建模。通过轻量级Planner（Soft Q-learning训练）、演化记忆模块和RAG机制，在48种VRP变体上实现62.50%的成功率，比现有最优方法DRoC提升16.67%。
AI.motivation: 复杂VRP变体的求解器建模需要大量领域专业知识，限制了高级优化技术的可及性。现有基于LLM的自动建模方法（如DRoC）依赖LLM逐步决策，导致推理延迟高且未能充分利用历史经验。
AI.method: 提出RLEA多智能体框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）轻量级神经网络Planner，采用Soft Q-learning训练，自适应选择动作（Refine、RAG、MLEM）；（2）基于LLM的Executor执行动作生成或修正代码；（3）记忆模块，包含Collector和Memory Distiller，通过RAG注入外部求解器知识，结合演化记忆复用历史成功/失败经验。状态由问题描述和当前代码的嵌入表示，动作空间为Refine（自校正）、RAG（检索增强生成）、MLEM（元学习演化记忆）三类。
AI.result: 在48种VRP变体上进行评估：OR-Tools上SR达62.50%（比DRoC提升16.67%），RER降至16.67%；Gurobi上SR为43.75%。消融实验表明Planner和Refine动作贡献最大，移除Refine使SR降至39.58%。Planner推理时间仅3.06秒（基于Prompt的Planner需153.30秒）。DeepSeek-r1作为Executor、GPT-4o作为记忆智能体的异构组合效果最优。
AI.conclusion: RLEA验证了强化学习与LLM推理融合在自动优化建模中的有效性，通过Planner高效编排、演化记忆与RAG互补，提升了复杂VRP建模的鲁棒性和效率。未来工作将扩展至多模态输入和动态实时路由场景。

title: Beyond the Clock: Measuring the Value of Adaptive Revision
summary: As agentic systems become compound systems, increasingly important decisions move above task execution itself: when should a higher-level controller preserve the strategy guiding another process, and when should it revise it? We study this meta-level control problem in a hierarchical latent reasoner whose manager can retain or replace a commitment governing lower-level computation. Across three precommitted training seeds, learned revision timing produces qualitatively different policies, ranging from an almost deterministic early clock to substantially more state conditioned schedule distributions, yet none outperforms the best forced timing policy evaluated on the same frozen checkpoint. This separates state dependence from decision value: a controller can vary its actions with internal state without turning that variation into a reproducible task-performance benefit. A deeper intervention study on the original checkpoint shows that timing itself is consequential and order-sensitive, while exhaustive enumeration reveals that a strong fixed schedule captures most of the measurable value available from timing at this decision budget. Counterfactual PERSIST/REPLAN diagnostics further show why score-level evidence can be misleading when predictability is dominated by decision position rather than within-position discrimination. Together, these results argue that learned meta-level control should be evaluated along three separate axes: whether its score depends on state, whether that dependence changes realized behavior, and whether those changes capture outcome value beyond a strong non-adaptive policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体系统中元层控制器应该何时保留（retain）还是替换（replace）下层计算策略的时机问题。在一个基于HRM的层级潜在推理器中，三个预提交训练种子产生的自适应修订时机策略在形态上差异很大（从近乎确定的早期时钟到高度状态条件化的调度分布），但没有任何一个能在同一冻结检查点上超越最佳强制时机策略。研究表明：一个强的固定调度已经捕获了该决策预算下绝大多数可测量的时机价值，留给逐episode自适应的剩余空间非常稀疏。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统演变为复合系统（如GEPA、AlphaEvolve、Meta-Harness），元层决策（保留还是修订策略）变得日益重要，但元层决策的信度分配问题尚未被系统研究。本文的核心动机是区分三个容易被混淆的概念：状态依赖（state dependence）、自适应行为（adaptation）、以及效用（utility），并指出"分数随状态变化"≠"行为随状态变化"≠"产生可复现的性能增益"。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 基于HRM构建一个两层级潜在推理器，slow manager发出方向性潜在承诺，fast worker执行任务条件化精炼；(2) 三个预提交种子的匹配预算（K=2）自适应审计；(3) 冻结检查点上的时机干预实验；(4) 在M=8、K=2条件下穷举枚举全部六个合法调度[1,k]；(5) 反事实PERSIST/REPLAN分支诊断，将局部预测信号与端点时机策略解耦。关键设计包括无泄露的阈值校准（仅匹配干预次数，不使用任务标签）、一次性消费的信用分配机制、以及固定计算预算下的序贯设计。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 三个自适应种子产生了形态截然不同的策略——seed 0近乎确定性收敛到[1,2]（99.19% episode），seed 1具有2.86 bits的高熵混合，seed 2在78.6% episode中仅保留初始承诺；(3) 三个种子均未超越各自检查点上的最佳强制调度（差距分别为-2.05、-0.34、-0.06百分点）；(3) seed 0穷举扫描发现最佳固定调度为[1,5]，微token准确率0.52121；(4) 反向调度对（[1,2] vs [1,7]等）显示出显著的顺序敏感性，较长驻留优先放置在更早位置一致获胜；(5) 最佳固定调度已捕获随机到oracle之间约71%的时机价值，剩余headroom仅0.00135（95% CI: [0.000858, 0.001943]），且高度集中于281/3686个episode（7.6%），其中8个episode贡献了一半残余增益；(6) 反事实诊断显示基于位置的预测器就能达到pooled AUROC 0.966，但位置内决策几乎没有状态信号支撑。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出三个核心结论：(1) 学习到的元层控制应该沿三个独立轴评估——分数是否依赖状态、这种依赖是否改变实际行为、以及这些变化是否超越强非自适应策略捕获了结果价值；(2) 局部预测性修订信号并不蕴涵正确的端点时机策略，单次消费信用分配实现正确性不等于该horizon与最终性能对齐；(3) 自适应监督控制有两个先决条件——决策价值的异质性，以及在条件于强非自适应基线后的残余异质性，后者在本设定中非常薄弱。建议的实验顺序是：先测量强固定规则，界定逐episode价值边界，再问状态能否预测残余。这提供了一个可迁移的诊断模板，而非断言固定监督普遍更优。

title: FractalNet-Based Heterogeneous Federated Learning for Orbital Edge Intelligence in Satellite Mega-Constellations: A Wildfire Case Study
summary: Satellite mega-constellations are emerging as large-scale sensing, communication, and computation fabrics, yet their learning architectures remain largely inherited from terrestrial federated learning and ground-centric mission operations--- ill-suited to satellites that differ by orders of magnitude in Size, Weight, Power, and Cost (SWAP-C), radiation tolerance, link availability, and propagation delay. We propose a heterogeneous federated learning method based on the FractalNet architecture for orbital edge intelligence. We formalize contact-window-constrained, depth-heterogeneous federated optimization and introduce a distributed path scheduler that assigns model depth as a function of SWAP-C constraints, predicted inter-satellite contacts, and training statistics. To reduce message overhead and energy consumption, each tier pools updates periodically rather than at every contact opportunity, and a three-tier agentic control plane governs in-space scheduling, anomaly escalation, and policy-governed autonomy. As a case study, we apply the framework to wildfire detection, where each orbital shell naturally learns a different semantic level of situational awareness: pixel-scale thermal anomalies at low Earth orbit (LEO), regional fire-front dynamics at medium Earth orbit (MEO), and larger-scale risk propagation at geostationary or high Earth orbit (GEO/HEO). Experiments on simulated mega-constellations validate the approach across convergence, communication efficiency, energy adaptation, scheduled-pooling savings, robustness, and latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FN-HFL，一种基于FractalNet的异构联邦学习架构，专为卫星巨型星座的轨道边缘智能设计。通过将模型深度、轨道层级和信息语义对齐，实现不同SWaP-C约束的卫星协同训练。以野火检测为案例，LEO/MEO/GEO各层学习不同语义级别的态势感知，并通过定时池化（scheduled pooling）显著降低通信能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有卫星联邦学习沿用地面同质化模型假设，忽略了不同轨道卫星在算力、功耗、辐射耐受、链路可用性等方面数量级的差异。需要一种将拓扑结构、模型深度和计算能力协同设计的架构，使算力受限的LEO与高算力的GEO/HEO都能贡献有意义的梯度。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 将FractalNet路径深度映射为模型训练深度（LEO训练dS=3层，MEO训练dM=6层，GEO训练完整L=10层）；(2) 形式化接触窗口约束下的深度异构联邦优化目标，定义层级参与掩码和过期性边界；(3) 分布式路径调度器根据SWaP-C状态、预测接触窗口和训练统计量分配深度与聚合器；(4) 三层代理控制平面（micro/meso/macro-agent）管理在轨调度、异常升级和策略自治；(5) 定时池化机制（LEO 30分钟/MEO 6小时/GEO 24小时）将传输频率与接触窗口解耦；(6) 层级鲁棒聚合与跨深度一致性检查防御深度定向投毒攻击。
AI.result: 在中等星座（540星）的野火检测任务上，FN-HFL达到AUROC 0.891±0.008（比Hierarchical FL高4.4个百分点），47轮达到80% AUROC（快1.7-1.9倍）；ISL字节开销降低53.5%，每轮能耗7.3 kJ（最低）；对抗深度定向投毒攻击成功率仅11.4%（基线41-44%）；高强度火灾自主升级率91.2%，50%链路稀疏下时间-检测仅5.1轮；定时池化进一步降低LEO 39.9%、MEO 39.7%、GEO 39.1%能耗，且不影响收敛精度。
AI.conclusion: FN-HFL通过将FractalNet路径深度与轨道层级、计算深度、信息深度三层对齐，实现了异构卫星星座的拓扑-学习协同设计。该架构在收敛速度、通信效率、能耗、鲁棒性和事件响应延迟方面均优于基线，定时池化机制在事件触发时可回退至逐次传输。论文承认尚未飞行验证、收敛证明严格性、故障注入保真度等局限，并将代理升级误报率阈值标定和火灾场景领域假设违背的鲁棒性评估列为未来工作。

title: Towards reliable multimodal disaster severity assessment through preference optimization and explainable vision-language reasoning
comment: Published in Reliability Engineering & System Safety
summary: Reliable disaster damage assessment requires models that provide both accurate predictions and transparent explanations. However, existing multimodal approaches are limited by scarce annotated data and insufficient evaluation of reasoning quality. This study proposes a two-stage training framework that integrates Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) within a unified data construction pipeline. From a single Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) annotation workflow, two complementary datasets are derived, namely ReasoningSet, which contains validated rationales for SFT, and PreferenceSet, which comprises paired rationales for DPO-based alignment. The framework evaluates both classification performance and explanation quality using automatic metrics, model-based scoring, and human ranking. Experimental results show that SFT improves accuracy from 73.64% to 78.29% and increases Macro-F1 by 29% compared to the baseline, while explanation quality improves by approximately 25%. Subsequent DPO alignment further enhances interpretability on the PreferenceSet. Cross-model validation on InternVL-3-8B and LLaVA-1.5-7B demonstrates the robustness and generalizability of the approach. The proposed framework improves detection of underrepresented mild damage cases, reduces high-risk misclassifications, and strengthens alignment between model reasoning and human judgment. Overall, it provides a reproducible pathway to develop reliable multimodal systems that deliver auditable, actionable disaster insights for emergency management.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合SFT和DPO的两阶段训练框架，通过HITL标注流程构建推理与偏好数据集，用于灾后损毁评估的多模态模型，提升分类准确性与解释质量。
AI.motivation: 灾后损毁评估需要准确且可解释的多模态模型，但现有方法受限于标注数据稀缺以及对推理质量评估不足。
AI.method: 两阶段训练框架：阶段一使用SFT在ReasoningSet上微调模型；阶段二使用DPO在PreferenceSet上进行偏好对齐。数据来源于统一的HITL标注流程，分别生成用于SFT的带验证推理链的数据集和用于DPO的成对偏好数据集。评估采用自动指标、模型评分与人工排序相结合的方式，并在InternVL-3-8B和LLaVA-1.5-7B上进行跨模型验证。
AI.result: SFT将准确率从73.64%提升至78.29%，Macro-F1提升29%，解释质量提升约25%；DPO进一步增强可解释性。框架改善了轻度损毁等少数类别的检测，降低了高风险误分类，并提升了模型推理与人类判断的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建可靠、可审计的多模态灾害管理系统提供了可复现的路径，能为应急管理提供可操作的洞察。

title: Denoising Diffusion Generative Models Secretly Calculate Attentions
comment: submitted to IEEE Trans on Pattern Recog. Machine Intellig
summary: Denoising diffusion models are the dominant architecture for image generation, whereas most natural language generation and modeling are primarily handled by well-known transformer architectures employing attention mechanism. Here, we show that diffusion models also inherently use an attention mechanism very similar to that of transformers. Therefore, attention emerges as a universal machine learning principle, based on a general training objective. We also show similarities in basic functional principle of auto-encoders and attention-based models. These equivalences allows us to interchange these designs based on practical requirements. As an example, we can reformulate the diffusion framework to reduce the lengthy training process and computation-intensive image generation. Using this approach, a simplified algorithm is proposed for image generation which is based on attention mechanism. Results show that the attention-based implementation achieves comparable performance with significantly less effort and computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了去噪扩散模型（DDPM）的最优解等价于注意力机制（Attention），并进一步揭示了自编码器（AE）、扩散模型和注意力机制三者在本质上都是将输入投影到数据流形上的操作。基于这一等价性，文章提出了一种无需训练去噪网络的轻量化图像生成算法，通过在潜空间中对查询的最近邻进行注意力插值来生成新图像。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成中占主导地位，但其训练和推理过程计算量极大。Transformer中的注意力机制被广泛用于NLP和视觉任务，但两者之间的理论联系尚不明确。本文旨在揭示扩散模型与注意力机制之间的数学等价性，并利用这一等价性设计更高效的生成方法。
AI.method: 1）从DDPM的MSE损失函数出发，将其转化为关于固定输入y的凸优化问题（加权最小二乘），推导出闭式解为基于高斯核的softmax加权组合，即注意力机制。2）证明该解与传统注意力公式（内积形式）一致，并揭示Softmax本质上是注意力的一种特殊形式。3）通过分析自编码器的编码-解码结构，利用微分扰动和线性依赖关系，证明AE将输入投影到k维数据流形上（局部零空间分析）。4）证明注意力机制同样执行流形投影操作。5）提出基于树结构的最近邻搜索（Tree Cross Attention）来降低注意力计算复杂度。6）提出完整的生成算法：在VAE潜空间中对查询的Top-K最近邻进行空间注意力插值，生成新图像。
AI.result: 1）理论上建立了扩散-注意力-AE三者统一框架。2）在MNIST上FID从19.30降至8.60，Fashion-MNIST上为14.60（vs 13.00），FFHQ上为16.58（vs 8.60），CelebA上为32.15（vs 30.49）。3）参数量显著减少（如FFHQ从130M降至64.8M）。4）推理速度提升约8.5倍（FFHQ上从0.17秒降至0.02秒）。5）消融实验表明较小的σ值和适当的Top-K选择可优化FID。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了去噪扩散模型、注意力机制和自编码器在数学上具有深层等价性，三者本质上都是将输入投影到学习到的数据流形上。这一理论发现不仅统一了当前主流的AI架构，还催生了一种高效的图像生成方法，无需训练耗时的去噪网络即可在潜空间通过注意力插值生成高质量图像，大幅降低计算开销。

title: CacheBridge: Efficient Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer
summary: Sharing context between LLMs in a multi-model system requires the receiving model to prefill the shared prefix because KV caches are model-specific. Recent closed-form cross-model KV transfer, hereafter Full-Head Mapping, avoids this replay by fitting a training-free affine mapper from source to target caches. However, its full-head design maps each target KV head from every source KV head in the selected layers, making transfer quality sensitive to architectural differences and causing mapper storage and application cost to grow with layer support. To this end, we introduce CacheBridge, which co-designs architecture-indexed mapper support, attention-aligned calibration, and bounded mapper construction while retaining a closed-form affine interface for online deployment. CacheBridge restricts each target head to a matched source head, weights reconstruction errors by causal attention sensitivity, and uses a fused GPU kernel to construct weighted sufficient statistics without materializing full observation tensors. Across three transfer directions, CacheBridge recovers the two Ministral 3 transfer directions where Full-Head Mapping loses substantial accuracy while preserving 99.83\% mean target retention on Qwen3. On Qwen3 $14\mathrm{B}\to32\mathrm{B}$, it reduces mapper storage by $8\times$, accelerates application by up to $3.0\times$, matches \fullhead with one tenth of the calibration data, and reduces 500-sequence construction from 92.63 to 8.63 seconds ($10.7\times$).

AI.tldr: CacheBridge提出一种高效的跨模型KV Cache传输方法，通过联合设计映射器支持结构、注意力对齐的校准目标和有界的映射器构建路径，在保持闭式仿射在线部署接口的同时，解决了Full-Head Mapping方法在架构差异敏感、映射器存储与应用成本随层数增长等方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 在多模型LLM系统中，跨模型共享上下文时接收方需重新预fill共享前缀，造成长上下文场景下的延迟问题。现有Full-Head Mapping方法通过无训练的仿射映射实现跨模型KV Cache传输，但其全头设计存在四个问题：模型敏感、KV拟合与续接质量不匹配、应用延迟随支持层数增长、Top-k层选择导致构建碎片化。
AI.method: CacheBridge包含三个互补组件：(1) Head-Local将每个目标KV头限制为架构索引的单一源头块，将系数数量减少H_s倍（本文中为8×）；(2) Attn-Repair根据因果注意力敏感度对缓存残差进行重新加权，通过有效样本量下界限制权重集中度，不改变在线接口；(3) Fused-Fit使用新的融合GPU核通过有界面板构建加权充分统计量，无需实例化完整观测张量。
AI.result: 在三个传输方向上，CacheBridge恢复了Full-Head Mapping失败的两个Ministral 3方向（HellaSwag分别提升20.4和31.6点），在Qwen3上保持99.83%的平均目标保持率。Qwen3 14B→32B上：映射器存储从4.296 GB降至0.538 GB（8×减少），应用加速最高3.0×，仅用1/10校准数据即可匹配Full-Head Mapping，500序列构建时间从92.63秒降至8.63秒（10.7×加速）。
AI.conclusion: CacheBridge通过协同设计映射器支持、校准目标和构建路径，在保持闭式仿射部署的同时显著改善了跨模型缓存传输的质量-成本权衡，无需引入额外的学习翻译器。

title: CARE: Contrastive Anchor-based Rubric Evolution for Large Language Model Post-Training
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes open-ended instructions into prompt-specific, flexible rubrics, making it better suited than reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for post-training LLMs on open-ended tasks. However, static rubrics are inevitably hacked as the policy evolves, and existing dynamic approaches introduce new problems: undirected rubric extraction, unreliable hack detection, and unbounded rubric proliferation. We propose $\textbf{CARE}$ ($\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{A}$nchor-based $\textbf{R}$ubric $\textbf{E}$volution), which grounds every rubric evolution step in a high-quality anchor response generated by a frontier model conditioned on the prompt and its rubrics. At each training step, CARE contrasts the highest-scoring rollout against the anchor, enabling two complementary mechanisms: an Adaptive branch that reactively repairs reward misspecification; and a Chase branch that proactively converts frontier-level quality gaps into sharper rubrics. Together, the two branches $\textbf{maintain discriminative accuracy in the high-reward region}$---the precise region where reward over-optimization mostly originates. Experiments on WildChecklist-9K with Qwen2.5-7B-Base and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance on Arena-Hard-2.0, InfoBench, and FollowBench, and is the $\textbf{only}$ method whose win rate against GPT-4.1 anchor responses shows sustained improvement throughout 300 training steps; additional results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B further indicate that CARE generalizes across model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE（Contrastive Anchor-based Rubric Evolution）框架，针对开放任务中基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习所面临的静态rubric被攻击利用问题，通过引入前沿模型生成的anchor（锚点）响应，在每个训练步对比最高分rollout与anchor，动态演化rubric，以维持在高分区域的判别精度。
AI.motivation: RLVR在客观可验证任务上表现优异但难以应用于开放式任务（如指令跟随、长文本生成）。基于rubric的RL虽提供细粒度奖励信号，但静态rubric在策略演化过程中必然被"hacking"（通过利用规则漏洞而非真正提升质量来获得高分），而现有的动态rubric方法又面临三大问题：rubric提取方向不明、hacking检测不可靠、rubric无限制增殖。因此需要一种可靠质量锚点来引导rubric的在线演化。
AI.method: CARE在每个GRPO训练步选取最高分rollout与由GPT-4.1基于prompt和rubric生成的anchor响应进行对比，提供两个互补分支：(1) Adaptive分支（反应式）：检测当前rubric被利用的漏洞，重写或追加[Resist]约束，并通过veto奖励强制执行（违反则归零）；(2) Chase分支（前瞻式）：在未检测到hacking时，提取top rollout与anchor之间的实质性质量差距，转化为更精确的rubric。两者共同维护高分区域的判别精度——reward过优化最易发生的区域。理论分析（附录A）通过KL正则化RL展开证明了在线维护高分区域准确性的必要性。
AI.result: 在WildChecklist-9K数据集（基于WildChecklist构建，9K样本均经Gemini 3 Pro和GPT-5.4双重验证及人工审计）上，对Qwen2.5-7B-Base/Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B训练：在Arena-Hard-2.0、InfoBench、FollowBench上取得SOTA；是唯一在300步训练中对抗GPT-4.1 anchor的胜率持续提升的方法；FollowBench Style分数近乎翻倍（48.0→94.7）；自适应决策在frontier judge和人类上的一致性分别从65.3%/67.1%提升到95.2%/99.1%；三随机种子训练均+21pp。
AI.conclusion: CARE通过anchor引导的rubric在线演化，有效提升开放式任务后训练中的抗reward hacking能力和最终响应质量。在WildChecklist-9K的跨模型实验验证了其通用性。局限性包括：每步激活rubric演化（可改为选择性门控）以及缺乏rubric质量的直接评估框架。

title: In-Context Neurofeedback: Can LLMs Control Their Internal Representations through Privileged Access?
summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) can control their own internal representations matters for both machine metacognition and AI safety. A recent study applied neurofeedback to LLMs and claimed that they can control their internal representations. However, the reported control may rely on superficial mechanisms rather than genuine internal access because the control targets in that study are not privileged, meaning that a third party can infer them from the prompt. We redesign the neurofeedback paradigm for LLMs so that the control target satisfies the privileged access requirement, which is closer to neurofeedback experiments in human cognitive neuroscience. Under this stricter setting, the models do not demonstrate reliable control over privileged internal representations, suggesting that previously reported control cannot exclude the possibility that it relies on superficial mechanisms. Our results indicate that rigorous assessments of metacognition in LLMs require evaluation methods that demand privileged access.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"上下文神经反馈"(ICN)范式,通过固定输出文本和隐藏评分规则,使控制目标满足"特权访问"要求(外部观察者无法从提示中推断)。在4个开源LLM和3个数据集上的实验显示,虽然部分设置达到统计显著,但效应量小且跨模型和数据集不一致,表明先前声称的LLM能控制内部表征的结果可能由表层机制驱动,无法排除浅层策略的解释。
AI.motivation: 近期研究(Ji-An et al., 2025)将神经反馈范式应用于LLM,声称模型可以控制其内部表征。但该研究的控制目标并非"特权"的——外部观察者可从提示中推断目标,因此观察到的控制可能依赖表层文本-标签关联而非真正的元认知内部访问。本研究旨在通过更严格的实验设计检验LLM是否真正拥有对内部表征的特权访问控制能力,这关系到机器元认知评估和AI安全(若LLM能控制内部表征则可能逃避基于激活的监控)。
AI.method: 提出"上下文神经反馈"(In-Context Neurofeedback, ICN):模型被要求在每一轮输出相同的固定句子,仅获得基于隐藏激活的探针输出的标量分数反馈(0-100),评分规则不公开。这使得:(1)输出文本恒定,排除了通过生成特定词汇(如"善良""帮助")来获得高分这种"平凡机制";(2)外部观察者无法从提示和输出推断控制目标,需特权访问。在4个模型(Llama-3.1-8B/70B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B/32B)、3个数据集(SST情感、ETHICS常识、True-False)、5个层深度(0/25/50/75/100百分位)上进行,每会话50轮反馈,共120个设置进行Benjamini-Hochberg校正后的假设检验(配对t检验/McNemar检验),并计算Cohen's d和h作为效应量。
AI.result: 120个设置中有45个达到统计显著(标签1奖励>标签0奖励),但显著结果集中在SST数据集(24/40)和Qwen3-8B模型(19/30),True-False(8/40)和Qwen3-32B(6/30)显著结果稀少。所有设置效应量均较小(Cohen's d<0.5, h<0.5)。附加实验表明,即使明确告知评分基于内部激活,结果(38/120显著)也未实质改善,说明隐藏评分规则并非LLM表现不佳的原因。结论是:先前研究所声称的控制效果可能由"平凡机制"(生成与目标标签表层相关的文本)解释,真正的特权内部访问控制证据不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在严格的特权访问条件下难以通过元认知可靠控制其内部表征,先前声称的成功无法排除表层策略的替代解释。对AI安全的意义:LLM通过控制潜在表征来逃避基于激活的监控的能力可能弱于此前的担忧。未来对LLM元认知的严格评估应要求特权访问,以区分真正的元认知与可由表层线索解释的"伪元认知"。

title: RPCBench: A Benchmark for Proactive Premise Critique in LLM-based Recommendation
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures. Code available at this https URL
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive recommender assistants. Their evaluation should therefore go beyond plausible item recommendation and test whether they can recognize flawed recommendation requests. Existing recommender benchmarks mainly assess ranking, generation, or preference satisfaction, while existing error-detection benchmarks are usually not grounded in recommendation-specific user and candidate evidence. To address this gap, we introduce RPCBench, a benchmark for evaluating Recommender-Premise Critique: the ability to detect, diagnose, and properly handle faulty premises in natural-language recommendation requests. RPCBench contains evidence-grounded test instances from five recommendation domains and covers ten types of premise failures. Each instance provides a visible recommendation context and a corrupted user query. We further design a fine-grained evaluation framework that measures proactive detection, error localization, post-detection handling strategy, and evidence faithfulness. Through a systematic evaluation of 11 LLMs, we find that proactive detection is the main bottleneck in Recommender-Premise Critique, and models perform worst on underspecified-premise errors. We also observe that target-critical information density matters more than redundant evidence, and that longer reasoning does not monotonically improve critique quality: performance peaks at intermediate reasoning length, while overly long reasoning is accompanied by an overthinking penalty. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RPCBench 是一个面向 LLM 推荐系统的基准测试，专门评估模型主动识别、诊断并处理用户请求中"前提错误"（premise failures）的能力，包含 4,623 个来自五个推荐领域、覆盖十种前提错误类型的样本，并通过细粒度评估框架测试 11 个主流 LLM。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统评估多关注排序质量或生成内容，但忽视了用户请求本身可能存在错误前提（如信息缺失、证据矛盾、超出系统能力边界）的情况。LLM 作为交互式推荐助手时，若不能主动识别并妥善处理这些错误前提，可能产生看似流畅但实际不可靠的推荐。因此需要专门评估模型的"主动前提批判能力"。
AI.method: 1. **任务形式化**：将每个实例定义为 I={H, C, Q}，其中 H 为用户侧证据、C 为候选侧证据（含 item/cand/state 三类）、Q 为用户查询；定义"必要前提"和"前提失败"概念。2. **错误类型分类**：四组十类——欠指定（U1/U2）、不一致（I1-I4）、不支持（X1/X2）、边界（B1/B2）。3. **基准构建**：从 MovieLens、MIND、Yelp、Amazon Sports、Goodreads 五个数据集采样，通过 GPT-5.5 和 Gemini 生成正确/损坏查询对，经跨模型审核、人工去重后保留 4,623 个样本。4. **评估框架**：五个内容级变量（检测 D、定位 L、策略 S、证据忠实 F 等），主指标 CPCC = PDR × (2·CLA·CSQ)/(CLA+CSQ)；证据忠实度指标 EFI、FFR、F1R；由三个独立 LLM judge 评分，辅以 500 条人工标注验证（一致性 82.60%）。
AI.result: 1. **检测是主要瓶颈**：11 个模型的平均 PDR 仅 51.5%，平均 CPCC 为 0.4376；一旦检测成功，定位（CLA）和策略（CSQ）通常尚可。2. **欠指定类错误最难**：U 组 PDR 仅 10.0%，CPCC 0.0595；不支持类（X）最易检测（PDR 76.8%）。3. **模型表现**：Qwen3.5-Plus 综合能力最高（CPCC 0.5261），GPT-5.5 证据忠实度最高（EFI 87.9%，FFR 仅 3.9%），Llama 系列严重落后（FFR >46%）。4. **证据密度比数量更重要**：最小有效证据消融显示，去除冗余字段后 CPCC 提升 0.1384、FFR 下降 1.5%。5. **推理长度非单调**：检测率在 Q7 达峰，但 CPCC 和严格成功在 Q3-Q4 达峰后下降；最长五分位存在显著的"过度思考惩罚"（CPCC 惩罚 0.18，EFI 惩罚 0.17，均具统计显著性）。6. **内部批判抑制**：26.91% 的推理中检测到前提错误但最终回答未呈现，欠指定类抑制率高达 73.18%。
AI.conclusion: RPCBench 揭示了当前 LLM 在推荐场景中主动前提批判能力的不足——核心瓶颈在于主动检测而非下游定位或策略。证据的"目标相关结构化密度"比原始证据量更有效，且更长的推理链并不能单调提升批判质量，反而在长尾区段产生"过度思考惩罚"，同时削弱证据忠实度。未来推荐型 LLM 应更重视主动前提批判能力与对可见证据的忠实使用，而非单纯追求更长推理或更吸引人的推荐。

title: VIBE-Bench: Evaluating Personalized Large Language Models When Profiles Don't Mean Preferences
summary: Personalized Large Language Models (PLLMs) aim to tailor responses to individual users, where a central challenge is preference reasoning: inferring query-relevant preferences from user-related history. Existing benchmarks, however, largely assume that such preference can be retrieved from semantically related history. We study an underexplored but practically important regime, profile-preference conceptual misalignment (PRCM), where observable profile cues and query-specific preferences lie in different concept spaces, making semantic retrieval inconsistent for personalization. We introduce VIBE-Bench, a benchmark with two psychology-grounded tasks, 3,504 personas and 12,239 dialogues, including a manually verified gold test set, and requires cross-concept preference reasoning beyond surface semantic overlap. Experiments with several personalization methods show that current PLLMs largely rely on shallow semantic correlations and fail to acquire robust cross-concept mappings. These findings establish PRCM as a distinct failure regime in PLLMs and position VIBE-Bench as a focused testbed for advancing preference reasoning beyond semantic matching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIBE-Bench基准测试，揭示个性化大语言模型(PLLMs)在"用户档案-偏好概念空间错位(PRCM)"场景下的系统性失败：现有方法依赖语义匹配，无法跨越概念空间进行偏好推理。
AI.motivation: 现有PLLM个性化评估基准普遍假设用户偏好可通过语义检索从历史中获取，但现实中用户档案线索与查询所需的偏好往往处于不同概念空间（如从体育话题推断大五人格以指导情绪调节策略），这一"档案-偏好概念错位(PRCM)"问题尚未被系统性研究。
AI.method: 基于大五人格理论与Holland RIASEC职业兴趣理论构建两个心理学驱动的任务：1) 情绪调节生成（从对话历史推断人格→映射至调节策略→生成支持性回复）；2) 职业兴趣分类（推断职业→映射RIASEC→判断职业-兴趣匹配）。通过GPT-5合成3504个人设、12239段多轮对话（测试集含128个人工验证样本），并设计五种信息注入变体进行消融实验，评估四类个性化方法（Base-LLM、FHP-LLM、PAP-LLM、RAP-BM25/BERT、P-SFT）。
AI.result: P-SFT在Task 2（F1=83.15）显著优于非参数方法，但在Task 1策略层面表现差（Acc=17.97），仅学会表层文本拟合；消融实验显示PRCM下性能骤降58%（Task 1）和10%（Task 2），证实跨概念映射是核心瓶颈；显式CoT概念推理可提升Task 1准确率44%；历史-标签打乱后模型降至随机水平，证明数据无伪相关捷径。
AI.conclusion: PRCM是PLLM中独立于语义检索的失败模式，跨概念映射能力是核心瓶颈；当前方法主要依赖浅层语义关联而非稳健的概念间映射；VIBE-Bench为推进超越语义匹配的偏好推理提供了标准化测试平台；未来需开发能自动发现并内化档案-偏好映射的训练框架。

title: Few-Shot Out of Domain Intent Detection with Covariance Corrected Mahalanobis Distance
comment: 1st AAAI Workshop on Uncertainty Reasoning and Quantification in Decision Making
summary: Conversational agents like chatbots and voice assistants are trained to understand and respond to user intents. On encountering an utterance with an intent different from the ones they have been trained on, these agents are expected to classify the intent as `unknown' or `out of domain'. This problem is known as out of domain (OOD) intent detection. Podolskiy et al. (2021), showed that Mahalanobis distance can be used effectively for identifying OOD intents, outperforming competing approaches. However, their method fails to outperform the baselines in the practically important few-shot setting. In this paper we analyze the reason for low performance and propose a covariance corrected Mahalanobis distance for detecting out-of-domain intents.

AI.tldr: 针对少样本场景下基于马氏距离的OOD意图检测方法，通过将协方差矩阵的最大似然估计替换为更鲁棒的估计器（Shrinkage、Ledoit-Wolf、Van Ness），显著提升了少样本设置下的OOD检测性能。
AI.motivation: 在工业场景中（如Amazon Lex、Google Dialogflow等对话代理服务），用户上传的自定义意图数据往往十分稀缺（少样本），且无法获取大量额外的OOD数据或无标注语料。Podolskiy等人(2021)表明马氏距离在OOD检测上表现优异，但在少样本设置下性能急剧下降。因此需要一种不依赖额外数据、适用于少样本场景的OOD检测方法。
AI.method: 1. 分析马氏距离在少样本下性能下降的原因：当样本数n远小于特征维度d时，MLE估计的协方差矩阵奇异（秩受限于min(n-1, d)），导致其逆矩阵（或伪逆）估计不准。2. 将MLE替换为三种鲁棒协方差估计器：Shrinkage估计器、Ledoit-Wolf估计器、Van Ness估计器。3. 使用RoBERTa-base提取768维特征，在5-shot和10-shot设置下，基于四个数据集（CLINC150、ROSTD、ROSTD-COARSE、SNIPS）进行实验对比。4. 使用AUC、PR ROC、FPR@95%TPR作为评测指标。
AI.result: 1. 诊断实验证实：即使只用5样本/类训练，特征仍有足够表征能力，问题根源在于协方差估计不准（用30K样本估计协方差时性能恢复至接近全数据水平）。2. 在5-shot设置下，三种协方差校正方法在3/4数据集上所有指标均优于MLE及其他基线（MSP、Energy、Grad Norm）。3. Shrinkage估计器在5-shot和10-shot设置下均表现最佳，如ROSTD 5-shot下AUC从85.13提升至94.39，FPR@95%从36.16降至19.25。4. 当样本数增加（如CLINC150 10-shot: 1500样本）时，MLE与鲁棒估计器性能趋同。5. 随IND类别数增加，OOD检测性能整体下降。
AI.conclusion: 1. 在少样本设置下，使用鲁棒协方差估计器（尤其是Shrinkage）的马氏距离能一致性地优于MLE及其他基线。2. 方法计算开销极低（仅每类多一次矩阵-向量乘法），无需额外数据，不改变训练流程，易于工业部署。3. 贡献了首个专门针对少样本OOD意图检测的基于分数的方法。

title: CoBRA: Learning Tool-Use Boundaries via Counterfactual Margins
summary: As large language models increasingly act through external tools, deciding when to call a tool has become a central problem alongside deciding how to use it. Unnecessary tool calls introduce latency, cost, retrieval noise, and error propagation, while missed calls hurt knowledge-intensive queries or questions requiring up-to-date evidence. Existing methods typically trigger tools from absolute query or generation signals, such as difficulty, confidence, or final task reward, and therefore lack an explicit estimate of the instance-level marginal benefit of tool use. We propose CoBRA, a counterfactual boundary-learning framework for tool-augmented language models. CoBRA first constructs internal and external experts from the same base model, collects paired trajectories, and estimates the reward margin between answering with and without tools. This margin partitions data into internal-favored, external-favored, and ambiguous cases. CoBRA then uses clear-margin samples for Boundary-Aware Cold-Start SFT, followed by MARS-RL with reference-split rollouts and counterfactual marginal advantages to optimize boundary decisions. Experiments with retrieval as the main tool on Qwen3-4B show that CoBRA improves tool-use efficiency and boundary-sensitive answer accuracy while maintaining strong performance on tool-dependent out-of-distribution questions.

AI.tldr: CoBRA is a counterfactual boundary-learning framework that trains tool-augmented LLMs to decide *when* to call external tools (e.g., retrieval) by estimating the instance-level marginal utility of tool use, rather than relying on absolute signals like difficulty or confidence. It constructs paired internal/external experts, estimates reward margins, partitions data into internal-favored, external-favored, and ambiguous subsets, then trains via Boundary-Aware Cold-Start SFT followed by MARS-RL (Marginal Advantage from Reference-Split Rollouts) with counterfactual marginal advantages.
AI.motivation: Existing tool-augmented LLM methods trigger tool use based on absolute signals (difficulty, confidence, final reward) and lack an explicit estimate of *instance-level marginal benefit* of tool use. This leads to unnecessary calls (latency, cost, retrieval noise, error propagation) or missed calls on knowledge-intensive/fresh queries. The paper argues tool routing should be framed as a counterfactual decision: "Would calling the tool improve expected utility for *this specific query*?"
AI.method:
The framework has two modules:
1. **Counterfactual Boundary Discovery**: Build internal expert M_int (no tool) and external expert M_ext (must use tool) from the same base model via rejection-sampling SFT. Run paired rollouts on the same queries, compute utility R(τ) = S(τ) − λC(τ), and estimate counterfactual margin Δ̂(q) = R(τ_ext|q) − R(τ_int|q). Partition into D_int (Δ̂ < −ε), D_ext (Δ̂ > ε), and D_amb (rest, including both-wrong).
2. **Boundary-Aware Policy Optimization**: 
   - **Stage 3 (S3)**: Boundary-Aware Cold-Start SFT on D_int ∪ D_ext (clear-margin samples only) to teach routing format.
   - **Stage 4 (S4)**: MARS-RL with three components: (a) Reference-Split (RS) rollouts that force internal vs. external branches; (b) Per-Branch Normalization (PBN) for within-branch group-relative advantages; (c) Branch Margin (BM) term that symmetrically adds sign(T_i)·Δ̃_B(q) to the advantage, directly rewarding the higher-utility branch per query.
AI.result:
Experiments on Qwen3-4B with Wikipedia retrieval (TriviaQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHop, NQ, PopQA) show:
- CoBRA achieves highest overall jEM (0.5733) and utility (0.4493), beating Search-R1-3B by +0.0759 in-domain and +0.0866 OOD utility while using 20-22% fewer tool calls.
- On Boundary-Eval (ambiguous subset), CoBRA improves D_amb jEM by 6.14pp over Search-R1-3B and 3.66pp over M_warm, with low over-call (16.4%) and under-call (1.2%) rates.
- Ablations confirm all three MARS components (RS, PBN, BM) are necessary; Vanilla GRPO collapses to no-tool behavior.
- Warm initialization from S3 outperforms base initialization by 9.5-16.5pp.
- Generalizes to a vertical music-domain agent: hybrid reward 2.428→2.680 while tool-call rate drops 39.3%→25.1%, achieving 0.93 Hit@5 vs. 0.85 for a tool-using baseline.
AI.conclusion: CoBRA successfully reframes tool-use routing as a counterfactual decision problem grounded in marginal utility. By combining clear-margin cold-start alignment with branch-aware RL (MARS-RL), it achieves a better accuracy-cost trade-off, makes more precise boundary decisions, and transfers to vertical-domain agents. The work demonstrates that explicit modeling of *when* to use tools—rather than just *how*—is a valuable, under-explored axis for tool-augmented LLM optimization, and provides a general framework (RS + PBN + BM) that extends GRPO/RLOO to multi-branch routing settings.

title: Figures as Programs: Recursive Generation of Editable Scientific Figures
summary: Scientific methodology figures are essential for communicating complex methods clearly, yet creating them remains labor-intensive and typically requires multiple rounds of refinement. Recent image-generation models can synthesize visually appealing raster figures, but producing a human-satisfactory result in a single generation step remains difficult. Moreover, precise edits to raster figures are challenging for both humans and models. We formulate scientific figure generation as recursive SVG program construction and propose \textsc{FigTree}, a \textit{multi-agent} system that automatically transforms a scientific paper into a structured vector figure. \textsc{FigTree} grounds figure content in the source paper, decomposes a figure into a hierarchy of local regions, generates each region as a short SVG program, and assembles the resulting fragments. A render-critic refinement loop jointly inspects the rendered figure and its underlying program, enabling visual defects to be traced to specific statements and accurately repaired. We conduct extensive evaluations of \textsc{FigTree} on figure quality and editability, showing that \textsc{FigTree} produces high-quality figures, while also enabling more effective editing than existing raster-based methods.

AI.tldr: FigTree 是一个多智能体系统，将科学论文自动转换为可编辑的 SVG 矢量方法图，通过递归分解、片段合并和渲染-评论家迭代修复实现高质量生成和高效编辑。
AI.motivation: 科学论文中的方法示意图对清晰传达复杂研究方法至关重要，但人工制作耗时且需多轮修改。现有的光栅图像生成模型虽能合成视觉上好看的图，但一次性生成质量难以令人满意，且对光栅图进行精确编辑对人和模型都很困难。因此需要一种更具可编辑性和可控性的表示方式来生成科学示意图。
AI.method: FigTree 将科学图生成问题重新定义为递归 SVG 程序构造，采用三阶段流程：1) 论文接地（Paper Grounding）——从论文中提取方法内容计划和全局样式规范；2) 递归图构建——将图按布局树自顶向下展开，每个节点由生成器智能体决定是作为叶节点直接绘制还是分解为 2-4 个子节点递归生成，子节点通过命名端口（port）向父节点报告自身边界框和暴露端口，由父节点统一放置并绘制跨边界连接；3) 渲染-评论家精修——评论家同时检查 SVG 代码和渲染图像（双空间审查），将视觉缺陷精确定位到具体代码语句并通过局部修复循环就地修改；同时利用基于 AutoFigure-Edit Bench 离线自演化得到的（缺陷-修复）规则集作为验证记忆。
AI.result: 在 PaperBananaBench（292 个 NeurIPS 2025 方法图案例）上：1) 参考基评估中 FigTree 在忠实性、简洁性、可读性、美学四个维度均最优，总体分 59.59%，较最强基线 Crafter 提升 9.59 分；2) 八维细粒度诊断评估中总体 8.39 分，在幻觉控制、视觉精致度、学术风格三个维度排名第一，语义覆盖与最优方法持平；3) 消融实验表明验证记忆影响最大（移除后下降 3.95 分），其次是论文接地（-2.47）和递归分解（-2.11）；4) 迭代编辑评估显示在 8 轮编辑中矢量分支质量持续优于光栅分支，验证了矢量表示在迭代精修中的优势。成本-质量分析表明 FigTree 在保持最高视觉质量的同时单图成本低于 GPT-Image-2 和 Crafter。
AI.conclusion: FigTree 通过将科学图生成为可编辑的 SVG 程序而非光栅图像，有效解决了科学方法示意图中内容保真度低、不可编辑的难题。递归分解将长程序生成问题分解为短片段生成，父节点拥有的跨边界连接避免了重复边，双空间审查机制使视觉缺陷可追溯到具体代码元素进行精确修复。实验证明该方法在生成质量和迭代编辑效率两方面均显著优于现有光栅方法，为自动化科学图生成提供了新范式。

title: Spawn Freely, Act Sparingly: Progressive Risk Vesting for Recursive LLM-Agent Trees
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Theory and synthetic numerical studies; no deployed-agent evaluation
summary: Recursive LLM agents can broaden their search by spawning specialists. Some branches later request tools that send data or deploy code. When should a branch receive authority to act? We distinguish sandbox spawning, in which external controls prevent the specified harm, from capability activation, in which a selected branch crosses an irreversible-action boundary. Progressive Risk Vesting (PRV) holds a trajectory-level risk budget in escrow and debits it as branches are activated. We prove an anytime harm bound for adaptively generated trees. Branch outcomes may be dependent, but each local certificate needs to remain valid conditional on the full pre-activation history, including the information used to select the request. When activation gates, branch charges, and compute constraints are held fixed, delayed vesting preserves every policy available under irrevocable spawn charging. Marginal risk estimates can still fail after branch selection. In a stylized branching model, trajectory harm changes as the authority reproduction number $\mathcal{R}_A$ crosses one. As local risk $p$ approaches zero, trajectory harm is proportional to $p$ below criticality, proportional to $\sqrt{p}$ at criticality, and retains a positive floor above it. A finite-type occupancy model yields risk and compute shadow prices. For nested fanout modes with decreasing marginal value per unit risk, these prices produce a threshold rule. Branching calculations and a split-sample experiment illustrate the results. These synthetic studies do not estimate safety in deployed agents. The analysis suggests a design rule: search broadly in the sandbox and grant recursive authority sparingly, with an explicit risk charge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"渐进式风险授予"（Progressive Risk Vesting, PRV）机制，用于管理递归LLM智能体树中不可逆操作的授权风险。核心思想是将"沙箱中生成候选分支"与"授予实际执行权限"分开：根节点持有共享风险预算δ，仅在分支被激活（即将执行不可逆操作）时才从预算中扣减风险额度。作者证明在条件证书有效的假设下，该托管机制可在任意自适应生成的树上提供概率安全保证，并发现"权威再生数"存在相变现象。
AI.motivation: 递归LLM智能体通过生成子分支扩展搜索能力，但每个获得权限的后代会增加不可逆伤害（如数据泄露、恶意代码执行）的风险路径。现有的两种控制方式——硬性限制分支数量和对每个子分支预收风险费——都会抑制有用探索。前者浪费了沙箱计算的选项价值，后者则在分支被丢弃前就消耗了风险预算。核心问题在于：宽泛的递归搜索如何与受控的不可逆授权共存？
AI.method: 1. 形式化模型：区分沙箱树（消耗算力）和权威树（消耗风险预算），引入"激活边界"概念。2. 风险托管机制：根节点持有δ∈(0,1)的风险预算，管理者在批准每次激活时条件性地扣减额度a_i，要求P(H_i|F_{i-1})≤a_i。3. 全时保证定理（Theorem 1）：利用布尔不等式和塔性质证明，路径无关地适用于自适应生成的树。4. 分支过程分析：定义权威再生数R_A=ms，推导三种渐近相变行为（次临界、临界、超临界）。5. 多类型占用线性规划及其对偶推导风险和算力的影子价格，给出阈值式fanout规则。6. 两项合成数值实验验证相变和延迟授予的选项价值。
AI.result: 1. 证明在条件证书假设下，自适应递归树的灾难性激活概率被δ约束，允许分支依赖。2. 延迟授予（PRV）在相同条件下弱优于生成时收费（spawn charging），实验显示PRV选择14个候选vs生成收费的5个，净效用提升5.75%（CI [3.91%, 4.11%]）。3. 分支过程存在相变：R_A<1时轨迹伤害∝p，R_A=1时∝√p，R_A>1时存在正下界。数值示例：p=0.005时，R_A=0.6对应1.23%伤害，R_A=1.4对应51.86%伤害且p降至10⁻⁵时下界仍为51.10%。4. LP对偶产生风险影子价格λ和算力价格ν，在递减边际价值条件下导出阈值式fanout策略。
AI.conclusion: PRV提供了一种原则性机制来调和递归智能体的广泛搜索与受控授权：允许在沙箱中自由探索，仅在分支即将执行不可逆操作时收取明确的风险费用。核心设计规则是"自由生成，谨慎行动"。论文明确指出：(1) 安全保障依赖于条件证书在部署中的有效性；(2) 合成研究不估计已部署智能体的安全性；(3) 沙箱执行需要外部控制强制；(4) 需要进一步的实际部署研究，使用临时编码环境和AgentDojo等基准。分支过程相变为理解权威传播提供了诊断工具，但不能替代路径级的托管执行。

title: Data-Driven Persona-Conditioned Agents for A/B Test Simulation
comment: Work accepted at EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: A/B testing is the gold standard for evaluating product changes, but each experiment requires real user traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of measurement. We propose a simulation framework that predicts A/B test outcomes using LLM-powered agents conditioned on data-driven personas grounded in real user behavioral signals. Unlike prior work that relies on synthetic or rule-based personas, our agents are constructed from anonymized behavioral data-activity patterns, engagement signals, and inferred demographics-enabling more faithful population modeling. We frame A/B test simulation as a structured question task and systematically study (i) question design formats, (ii) the impact of persona data source and domain alignment, (iii) the trade-off between per-persona behavioral depth and population diversity, and (iv) efficient population subsampling. On a benchmark of 40 A/B tests spanning two metric types, our best configuration achieves 0.75-0.90 directional accuracy depending on the test metric, demonstrating that data-driven personas are a viable path toward fast, low-cost experiment pre-screening.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个以真实、匿名行为数据构造的数据驱动 persona 为条件的大语言模型代理框架，用于离线模拟 A/B 测试并预判版本方向。最佳配置采用 1–10 分的成对比较，在 40 个电商测试（CTR 与订阅各 20 个）上取得 0.75–0.80 的定向准确率；公开电商 persona 在订阅任务达到 0.90。结论是：行为数据的领域匹配、同时具备行为深度与人口多样性、采用成对评分，并配合子采样，可在较低成本下获得稳定的方向预测。但该方法预测的是效应方向而非效应大小，不能替代真实实验，更适合候选方案预筛和优先级排序。
AI.motivation: 在线 A/B 测试虽然可靠，但需要真实流量、工程投入和数周数据收集。论文希望利用由真实匿名行为信号构造的 persona 驱动 LLM 代理，先在离线环境中预测哪个产品变体表现更好，从而提前淘汰明显较差的方案并降低流量与时间成本。作者特别针对既有工作中 synthetic persona、真实会话轨迹依赖以及 persona 构成因素缺乏系统分析的问题开展研究。
AI.method: 框架包含三阶段：（1）persona 构造：从数月匿名、聚合行为数据中提取活动、购买、参与度和人口统计信息，并经 LLM 合成结构化 persona；（2）模拟：让 persona 条件代理通过四种结构化问题评估界面截图——独立/成对展示 × 二元/1–10 分评分；（3）聚合：汇总各 persona 的参照版与处理版评分，构造预测相对效应分布，并用 Accuracy、Sign Overlap 和 Sign Bhattacharyya Coefficient 评估方向一致性。研究比较不同 persona 来源、深度型与代表性 persona 池，以及从 935 个 persona 中抽取子集的 Random、Kernel Herding 和 Greedy Farthest 策略。实验覆盖 40 个历史电商 A/B 测试（CTR、订阅各 20 个），主模型为 Claude Sonnet 4.5，另用 Haiku、Opus 验证。
AI.result: 成对评分格式最佳：CTR Accuracy 0.75，订阅 0.80；独立格式大多仅 0.40–0.45。平台行为 persona 与公开电商 persona 表现突出；公开电商 persona 在订阅测试达到 0.90，平台 persona 在 CTR/订阅上为 0.75/0.80。深度 persona 相比代表性 persona，在 CTR 上为 0.75 对 0.60，但两者在订阅上均为 0.80，说明人口多样性可补偿单 persona 行为稀疏性。仅人口统计 persona 在订阅任务仅 0.30；完整行为 persona 为 0.80。删去推理主要损害 CTR（0.75 降至 0.60），订阅基本不变。500-persona 子采样将推理成本约减半，CTR 与完整池均约 0.75，订阅约 0.80，且随机采样也已很强；100-persona 仍保持较高结果。消融显示，多样且有行为依据的 persona 条件显著优于无 persona、单一通用 persona 或仅人口统计条件。公共推荐数据集上的结果随真实效应增大而单调提高，说明更可能可靠地区分差异较大的方案。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动 persona 条件代理可作为线上 A/B 测试的低成本预筛和排序工具，尤其是用于剔除明显劣势版本，而不是最终发布决策。核心设计原则是：采用成对评分、优先使用与目标领域和行为指标匹配的真实或公开行为数据，并在 persona 深度与总体代表性之间做平衡；用约 500 个多样 persona 即可在质量损失很小的情况下将成本减半。预测对较大效应更可靠，因而其最佳用途是候选方案优先级排序，而非替代正式显著性检验。

title: AgentFactory: Towards Automated Agentic System Design and Optimization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities as powerful components in agentic systems, enabling sophisticated reasoning and complex task execution. However, current approaches to manually designing and optimizing agentic systems heavily rely on manual effort, limiting their adaptability and scalability. Recent work has explored the automated optimization of workflow designs. However, these approaches often overlook the crucial role of model capabilities and focus on single performance metrics, failing to address real-world deployment constraints. In this paper, we present AgentFactory, a framework that jointly optimizes both foundation models and workflow structures in agentic systems while considering multiple objectives including performance, cost, and efficiency. AgentFactory leverages advanced LLMs as optimizers to navigate the vast search space of possible configurations, employing a three-stage optimization pipeline to automatically discover effective combinations of fine-tuned models and optimized workflows. Through an iterative optimization process, our framework systematically explores and evaluates different agentic system designs, adapting to task-specific requirements while maintaining operational efficiency. We evaluate AgentFactory across eight benchmarks spanning five domains, including general reasoning, coding, mathematics, medicine, and finance. Our experiments demonstrate that AgentFactory consistently outperforms both manually designed methods and existing automated approaches, achieving an average improvement of 9.1% across all benchmarks, with particularly significant gains in domain-specific tasks (19.6% on MedQA and 18.7% on FinEval). These results establish AgentFactory as a promising approach for developing more capable and efficient agentic systems through automated optimization.

AI.tldr: AgentFactory是一个自动化智能体系统设计与优化框架，将智能体系统构建形式化为多目标优化问题，在模型参数和工作流结构的联合空间中，利用LLM作为优化器，通过三阶段流水线（规划、调优、工作流设计）自动发现有效的模型微调与工作流组合，在8个基准上平均提升9.1%，并在专业领域提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统设计依赖人工调优，劳动密集且难以探索最优配置；已有的自动化方法（如ADAS、AFlow）仅优化工作流结构而忽略模型能力，且通常只优化单一性能指标，无法满足实际部署中成本与效率的约束。
AI.method: 1）将智能体系统优化形式化为多目标优化问题，搜索空间S = {(m, w)}，其中m ∈ M（基础模型空间）、w ∈ W（工作流空间）；2）采用LLM作为优化器L_θ，通过元提示I_meta和优化轨迹O_{k-1}迭代生成新方案；3）设计三阶段优化流水线：Planning（生成包含Insights、Model、Workflow三部分的优化计划）、Tuning（执行数据集选择、LoRA/QLoRA/全参数微调及超参数配置）、Workflow Design（生成基于代码的图灵完备可执行工作流）；4）支持多目标（性能、成本、延迟）标量化函数F进行Pareto最优选择；5）使用4块A6000 GPU，基于OpenRLHF进行微调，缓存机制避免冗余训练。
AI.result: 在8个基准（5个领域：通用推理MMLU/DROP、编程HumanEval/MBPP、数学GSM8K/MATH、医学MedQA、金融FinEval）上的实验：1）以Llama-3.1-8B为基座时，平均得分68.9%，比最佳基线AFlow（59.8%）提升9.1%，MedQA提升19.6%，FinEval提升18.7%；2）以GPT-4o-mini为基座时，平均得分83.9%，同时推理成本降低68%；3）优化器消融显示GPT-4o效果最佳（68.7%），Claude-3.5-sonnet次之（67.1%），验证了框架对优化器选择的鲁棒性；4）消融研究表明完整流水线比仅微调提升12.7%，比仅工作流设计提升8.2%；5）FinEval优化案例展示了从初始IO（62.3%）经工作流优化→领域微调（72.5%）→跨域增强（74.6%）→多目标收敛（17轮达目标）的完整过程。
AI.conclusion: AgentFactory通过将基础模型微调引入自动化智能体设计并实现多目标优化，显著扩展了智能体系统的解空间，在保持更低推理成本的同时实现了性能突破，为构建更强大、高效的智能体系统提供了新范式，是迈向自动化智能体工程的重要一步。

title: QILP-0: Constructing Observational Declarative Twins of Quantum Circuits
comment: 39 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
summary: This paper introduces QXymb, a general framework for constructing observational declarative twins of quantum circuits, and develops QILP-0, its first complete order-0 specialization. QILP-0 constructs a finite multi-valued propositional logic program from observed circuit behaviour within a declared observational scope. The pipeline traverses a declared family of quantum observables incrementally according to a reproducible structural grading and a declared observational reference horizon. Progress is quantified through reference-relative coverage against a fixed target-independent reference. Observable responses are organized through target-independent geometry, while retained latent structure is mapped deterministically back to original observable columns before symbolic processing, preserving observational semantics and provenance. Selected observable profiles are converted into a finite relation through admissible target-independent discretization. The target is used only afterwards to audit twin-admissibility and induce the declarative theory. A theory is certified as an exact observational declarative twin when it completely and correctly reconstructs the resulting finite task-conditioned discrete relation. Logical exactness is therefore separated from numerical, backend, provider, and discretization uncertainty, which is retained as audit metadata. Validation uses two complementary QML settings. Exhaustive Bars & Stripes experiments compare product and grid-CZ embeddings from 16 to 100 qubits and exercise the native-discrete branch. Low-Depth MNIST analyses all 14,708 digit-0/1 instances before and after a trained variational quantum transformation and exercises continuous discretization. In every reported relation, the induced QILP-0 theory achieves complete, conflict-free reconstruction with strict accuracy equal to one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QXymb框架及其首个完整order-0特例QILP-0，用于从量子电路的观测行为构建有限多值命题逻辑程序。QILP-0通过目标无关的几何分析和参考相对的覆盖度量，从观测的量子电路行为中构造"观测声明孪生"（observational declarative twin），并在Bars & Stripes（16-100量子比特）和Low-Depth MNIST（14,708个样本）两个实验中均实现了严格重构精度为1.0的完整无冲突重构。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习（QML）结合了量子信息处理和学习过程，引入了解释性问题。当经典输入经过量子嵌入和参数化量子电路处理后，仅通过最终预测无法回答"量子管道部分实际产生了什么观测关系"这一根本问题。现有可解释性方法主要关注特征归因、门相关性或经典代理模型，缺乏专门针对量子表示本身的声明式描述方法。
AI.method: QXymb框架包含两层：连续观测层和声明推理层。连续层通过Pauli观测算子构建观测矩阵，按精确支撑（exact support）进行结构分级，使用SVD进行目标无关的几何分析，通过参考相对覆盖度量（C_ref(k)）追踪增量进展，并将潜在几何确定性地映射回原始可观测列。声明层采用可接受的目标无关离散化（包括Freedman-Diacis宽度、可区分水平和SNR约束），审计孪生可接受性，并使用LFIT/PRIDE归纳引擎诱导有限多值命题逻辑程序。方法严格分离逻辑精确性与数值/后端/离散化不确定性，后者保留为审计元数据。
AI.result: 在Bars & Stripes实验中，产品嵌入（16-100量子比特）和grid-CZ嵌入均产生完整无冲突重构，严格重构精度均为1.0。发现相似的累积覆盖度可与不同的保留几何维度共存，几何精化不一定导致声明理论的改变。在Low-Depth MNIST实验中，d4制备和d4+VQC两种表示在所有14,708个0/1数字样本上均实现严格精度1.0。训练后的变分表示在低支撑处累积更多覆盖度（支撑1：0.667 vs 0.355），同时支撑3处保留几何维度更大（2092 vs 1819），尽管最终规则体仍仅使用q0和q10的可观测变量。跨实验证书确认所有报告关系均为精确观测声明孪生。
AI.conclusion: QILP-0证明量子电路的观测行为可被转化为有限声明对象，同时保持目标无关性和语义可追溯性。关键结论包括：（1）连续潜在几何可指导可观测选择，但最终声明词汇仍与原始可观测变量绑定；（2）几何精化与声明精化是不同现象；（3）只要明确声明观测参考、离散化和有限关系，符号层面的精确性才有意义。局限性包括order-0结构、有限数据集范围、组合爆炸问题（完整Pauli族呈指数增长），以及当前仅使用精确观测评估。QILP-0是更广泛的QXymb框架的首个具体实现，为未来更丰富的变体奠定了方法论基础。

title: WorldBench: Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multilingual Agents
summary: Despite the growing use of LLM-powered agents to solve multi-step tasks in complex environments, existing benchmarks rarely test state preservation, performance across languages, and application to realistic, grounded scenarios. To address these concerns, we present WorldBench: a comprehensive, multilingual benchmark of genuine, persona-grounded everyday workflows, where agents can act in a sandbox via structured actions. WorldBench comprises 1,600 tasks across seven languages and eight cultures, filtered and refined through feedback from human annotators with language- and culture-specific expertise. For evaluation, we extend metrics from previous works and introduce Constrained Task Success (CTS), which combines natural language instructions and testbeds to score task completion, minimal modification, and other complementary metrics through deterministic and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments show that frontier models reach only 49.2% CTS, with all models demonstrating large gaps between correctness and environment preservation. We thereby show that current agents remain brittle in multilingual, agentic scenarios, especially for long-horizon tasks and under state-preservation constraints

AI.tldr: WorldBench 是一个多语言、面向多文化情境的智能体基准测试，包含 1,600 个任务、覆盖 7 种语言与 8 种文化场景；提出新指标 Constrained Task Success (CTS) 同时衡量任务完成度与工作区状态保持；实验表明即使是前沿模型 CTS 也不足 50%，且存在显著的"保持性差距"和语言梯度。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准在三个方面存在不足：(1) 任务缺乏真实文化与角色的情境化；(2) 仅评估任务完成而忽略工作区状态保持（如误改、删除非目标文件）；(3) 多语言覆盖往往通过英语翻译生成，难以反映本土文化与文件惯例。因此需要构建一个面向真实多语言、多文化日常工作流的智能体评测基准。
AI.method: 构建流程：人工撰写 persona / 场景 / 应用约束种子 → 自动化生成候选任务 → 自动化构建测试床（含 15-20 个干扰文件）→ 由具备目标语言与文化背景的母语标注员审计与修订。任务以转换系统 W=(S,A,O,δ) 形式化，智能体在沙箱中通过结构化动作接口（电子表格、文档、PDF、邮件、日历、Shell）执行。评估引入新指标 CTS = pass(t) ∧ preserve(t)，其中 pass 需所有任务特定的确定性或 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估函数通过，preserve 要求所有非目标文件字节级保持不变。
AI.result: 评测 9 个前沿 LLM 智能体（Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5, Qwen-3-32B, GPT-4o 等）：最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro CTS 仅 49.2%，最弱 EuroLLM-9B 仅 10.8%；所有模型 Pass Rate 显著高于 CTS（差距 10.1–16.8 分），表明普遍存在"附带修改"问题；英语场景最佳、中文最差（Qwen 系列除外）；失败模式以"错误输出"和"附带编辑"为主，弱模型还出现大量迭代上限触发。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 智能体在多语言、文化情境化的长程任务中仍很脆弱，主要存在三大缺陷：(1) 缺乏对工作区安全的可靠感知；(2) 长程执行易累积错误；(3) 多语言性能不稳定且受本地化惯例影响大。CTS 作为同时衡量正确性与保持性的指标，揭示了仅看 Pass Rate 所掩盖的失败，对未来智能体的状态追踪、保持性目标与本地化能力提出明确要求。

title: User Representation via Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-training for Mobile Games
comment: Accepted by IEEE ICDM 2026, regular paper, 10 pages
summary: User representation pre-training has become a fundamental paradigm for alleviating data sparsity in downstream personalization tasks. However, existing studies predominantly focus on single-app or app-level behaviors, overlooking the inherently cross-source and multi-granular nature of user activities on mobile devices. At the device level, user intent emerges from complex interactions among heterogeneous behavior sources and hierarchical action structures, posing challenges that cannot be addressed by conventional app-centric modeling. To tackle this issue, we propose CM-PTM, a novel Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-Training Model tailored for mobile game user representation learning on device-level behavioral logs. CM-PTM employs hierarchical cascaded mask-then-predict proxy tasks that first infer the source of the next behavior and then progressively refine predictions at the app-action level. This design enables unified modeling of cross-source dependencies and fine-grained behavioral dynamics within a single pre-training paradigm. Extensive experiments on large-scale real-world mobile datasets demonstrate that CM-PTM effectively captures users' endogenous interests and consistently delivers significant performance gains on downstream mobile game recommendation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM-PTM（Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-Training Model），一种面向移动游戏用户表示学习的跨多源行为预训练模型。该模型针对移动设备层面多源、多粒度行为数据（如第三方游戏App的粗粒度安装/启动事件与应用商店、游戏中心的细粒度搜索/点击事件）之间的跨源依赖建模问题，设计了层级级联掩码预测代理任务，先预测下一行为的来源，再逐步细化到App类别、App ID和操作类型，从而在统一预训练范式中同时建模跨源关联与细粒度行为动态。
AI.motivation: 现有用户表示预训练研究主要聚焦于单App或单源行为序列建模，忽略了移动设备上用户活动的跨源、多粒度本质。设备层面的用户意图来自异构行为源之间的复杂交互，隐私与权限约束导致系统级应用（细粒度）和第三方应用（粗粒度）之间存在严重的"行为量-粒度"失配，简单的单源扩展或按时间顺序拼接所有行为无法有效捕捉跨源意图关联。
AI.method: CM-PTM包含两大组件：(1) 多粒度用户编码器，采用粒度感知自注意力（GASA）建模单源内行为相关性，以及跨粒度融合注意力（CGFA）通过跨注意力机制融合细粒度与粗粒度行为表示；(2) 跨源级联预测模块，将下一行为预测解耦为两个阶段：源间阶段预测下一行为的来源（行为源预测T1），源内阶段在所选来源内通过级联子任务逐步预测App类别（T2）、App ID（T3）和操作类型（T4，仅第三方游戏App），各阶段通过可微任务状态向量z进行信息传递与条件化。整体损失为源间与源内损失的加权和（λ=1/2）。预训练采用mask-then-predict策略，下游任务中用户表示被拼接后输入LightGBM用于游戏推荐。
AI.result: 在OPPO大规模真实工业数据集（约195万用户、8.3万应用）上，针对6个下游移动游戏推荐任务进行评估，CM-PTM在G1-G5上相比最佳基线取得1.05%~2.85%的AUC提升和0.73%~2.55%的R@P0.95提升，G6上AUC略低但R@P0.95仍最优。消融实验验证了多粒度数据、多序列建模和级联任务设计的必要性。OPPO在线A/B测试（289万活跃用户，两周实验）显示相比DeepFM基线AUC提升1.28%、R@P0.95提升1.07%。训练时间5.74小时（2块A100），低于MAFN基线，推理开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: CM-PTM通过层级级联预训练范式有效捕捉了移动设备层面跨源、多粒度用户行为之间的意图关联，在离线评估和OPPO真实工业在线A/B测试中均取得稳定性能提升，验证了其在工业大规模部署中的实用性与有效性。未来工作方向包括引入时间感知机制（如绝对时间间隔的时序编码）以更充分地建模行为序列的时间动态。

title: ARISE-RL: Agentic Rubric-Grounded Iterative Self-Evolution with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Training open-ended agents via reinforcement learning (RL) is hindered by the lack of verifiable gold answers and scalable rubrics. Moreover, even near the model's capability boundary, long-horizon open-ended agentic tasks often yield brittle and unstable rewards, resulting in weak or noisy rollout contrast that obscures fine-grained optimization signals for group-based policy learning. To address these challenges, we propose ARISE-RL, a novel full-cycle self-evolution framework that couples a task/rubric Generator and a reasoning Solver through rubric-mediated co-evolution. The Generator grounds tool-related rubric criteria in real tool observations and is rewarded for producing valid, intermediate-difficulty tasks aligned with the Solver's evolving capability boundary. The Solver, in turn, learns from fine-grained rubric satisfaction signals through multi-step reasoning and tool use. We further introduce Reward-Gated Self-Evolution Distillation (RG-SED), which selectively distills a memory-augmented variant of the same policy back into itself only when the memory yields empirical reward improvement, thereby reducing distribution mismatch and avoiding blind imitation of noisy guidance. Finally, to support rigorous evaluation, we present ECR-Bench, an expert-calibrated rubric benchmark suite covering single-tool deep research and multi-tool travel planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARISE-RL consistently achieves robust and stable overall state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated benchmarks.

AI.tldr: ARISE-RL提出了一种面向开放性智能体任务的强化学习自进化框架，通过Generator-Solver协同进化、工具接地的rubric构建、难度塑形奖励以及Reward-Gated Self-Evolution Distillation（RG-SED）机制，在无需大规模人工标注数据的情况下，将9B开源基座模型的开放性agent能力提升至全面SOTA水平。同时发布ECR-Bench专家校准基准套件。
AI.motivation: 开放性长程智能体任务（如深度研究、行程规划）缺乏可验证的黄金答案和可扩展的rubric，且在模型能力边界附近采样得到的rollout对比度弱、奖励信号脆性大，导致：(1) 数据-评估瓶颈：高质量开放性训练数据与专家rubric难以规模化；(2) 优化瓶颈：基于组（group-based）的RL出现advantage collapse，细粒度优化信号被噪声掩盖；(3) 固定teacher蒸馏在多轮agent场景中分布失配累积，且不可靠的teacher指导可能产生负迁移。
AI.method: 1) Rubric介导的Generator-Solver协同进化：Generator生成查询和工具接地rubric（必须先调用工具再写rubric，避免幻觉），由三部分奖励驱动：工具接地门R_tool、格式门R_fmt、难度塑形奖励R_diff（当Solver成功率约K/2时最大，鼓励生成处于能力边界的任务）。Solver获得rubric满足率s_i构成的细粒度奖励r^S = α·s_i + (1-α)·𝕀[s_i=1]。2) Reward-Gated Self-Evolution Distillation（RG-SED）：角色条件化的组级自蒸馏——同一策略在原始prompt与注入role-specific coach memory的prompt下分别采样得到标准轨迹和记忆增强轨迹，仅当Δr > τ_a时才通过token级reverse KL进行蒸馏，蒸馏强度受warm-up与decay调度。3) ECR-Bench：包含ECR-DeepResearch（100条单工具研究查询）和ECR-Travel（500条多工具行程规划查询，分Direction/Compare/Search/1-Day/M-Day五类），由6位领域专家校准rubric，并评估最终响应质量与过程级工具调用正确性。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B基座上：ECR-DeepResearch 0.781、ResearchRubrics 0.479、VitaBench 0.417、ECR-Travel 0.599，平均0.569，全面超越GPT-5/5.2、Claude-4.5/4.6-Sonnet、Gemini3-Pro等闭源模型以及Qwen3.5-397B等大型开源模型。在Qwen3-8B基座上同样稳定优于Dr. Zero和Absolute Zero等自进化基线。消融实验表明RG-SED贡献最大（去掉后多工具任务下降显著），奖励门控本身也是必要设计（去掉后多工具性能大幅下降），工具接地rubric与难度塑形奖励均为互补设计。三轮协同进化迭代每轮均带来单调提升，Generator生成任务的难度随周期持续上升。RG-SED相对OPCD/GKD在11个基准轴上均取得最佳分数，分布散度（KL≈0.2-0.35）显著低于GKD（≈0.4-0.55）。LLM judge与人类标注一致性在ECR-DeepResearch上为82.3%、ECR-Travel上为77.9%。ECR-Travel上RG-SED门控分布显示72.1%的组Δr>τ_a、19.6%在模糊区、8.3%为负向，验证了门控选择性。
AI.conclusion: ARISE-RL是首个面向开放性智能体任务的完整闭环自进化RL框架，通过rubric介导的协同进化与reward-gated自蒸馏，可在无需外部teacher和大规模人工数据的情况下将9B开源模型训练到全面SOTA。ECR-Bench为开放性agent提供了专家校准、过程感知的细粒度评估平台。局限性：实验均在8B/9B基座上完成，向更大规模基座的扩展有待验证。

title: Space Generative AI with Solar Energy Harvesting
summary: Satellites are emerging as promising platforms to extend generative \emph{artificial intelligence} (AI) services to remote areas lacking terrestrial infrastructure. However, deploying space generative AI is fundamentally constrained by the limited, time-varying onboard energy supplied by solar \emph{energy harvesting} (EH). This paper presents a framework for solar-powered space generative AI in which a satellite receives a user prompt, executes a diffusion-based image-generation model, and downlinks the compressed result within a strict time window. We identify the fundamental \emph{computation--communication} (C$^2$) trade-offs governed by the shared harvested-energy budgets. Specifically, increasing the number of generation steps improves intrinsic image quality but depletes energy and time available for downlink transmission, whereas prioritizing communication guarantees reliable delivery but sacrifices semantic quality. To balance these trade-offs and maximize \emph{end-to-end} (E2E) generative performance, we exploit the predictable solar-EH dynamics induced by deterministic orbital motion and develop a joint C$^2$ resource-optimization framework using a tractable two-step approach. First, we characterize the maximum downlink throughput for a fixed generation depth under continuous solar EH. This establishes a separation principle that decouples waiting-time selection from optimal transmit-power control. Next, we formulate a joint C$^2$ utility-maximization problem and derive a closed-form, low-complexity step-selection policy in the dominant constant-power regime. Extensive experiments under realistic orbital dynamics demonstrate that the proposed policy dynamically balances generation quality and transmission reliability. This yields significant E2E performance gains over static computation- and communication-centric baselines across diverse solar-EH states.

AI.tldr: 本文针对太阳能供电的卫星执行扩散模型图像生成任务，提出了一种联合计算-通信（C²）资源优化框架，以解决共享采集能量预算下生成质量与下行传输可靠性之间的权衡问题。核心贡献包括：建立了基于轨道几何的太阳能采集模型；证明了等待时间选择与发射功率控制的分离原理；通过下凸包络（LCE）导出最优能量可行发射功率策略；并在恒定功率主导区间下，利用Lambert W函数推导出扩散步数选择的闭式低复杂度策略。实验表明，该方案在低/高能量区分别趋近于通信中心或计算中心策略，在中等能量区显著优于两个极端基线。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏地面基础设施的偏远地区，卫星作为有源AI服务提供方具有重要价值。但星载生成式AI受限于太阳能采集的时间变化特性，计算（扩散步数）与通信（下行传输）共享同一能量缓冲，存在根本性的C²权衡：增加去噪步数提升语义质量但挤占下行能量与时间，优先保障传输又会牺牲生成质量。现有EH通信与星载C²研究未同时考虑扩散步数可调性与太阳能采集的预测特性。
AI.method: 1) 基于轨道参考系与卫星本体坐标系建立太阳能采集模型（瞬时功率与累积能量闭式表达）；2) 建模LDM+DDIM推理的计算时间与能耗，以及可预测星地信道；3) 证明分离原理——最优等待时间最小化，功率控制由累积能量的LCE决定；4) 在轨道正午（EH曲线凹）与轨道黎明（EH曲线凸）两种典型情形下推导闭式最优策略，后者出现"余弦功率跟踪"；5) 联合C²效用U=S+λR，以CLIP分数线性近似S(n)，固定n求解吞吐量后外层离散搜索；6) 在恒定功率主导区间，利用Lambert W函数给出闭式最优扩散步数n*，分支W0/W−1由ΔE≷0区分。
AI.result: 1) 通信吞吐量方面：所提策略在不同面板面积A与太阳高度角β下均优于固定等待/固定功率基线；2) 闭式解：n*随吞吐权重λ与带宽B增大而减小（向通信倾斜），随初始能量E0增大而增大，随截止时间T呈非单调（紧T下倾向计算，T宽松后倾向通信）；3) E2E CLIP分数：低能量下趋近通信中心策略，高能量下趋近计算中心策略，中等能量区显著优于两极端；4) 轨道位置影响：计算中心策略在星食期因高DDIM步数耗尽能量导致传输失败、CLIP骤降为0；联合策略全轨道保持最高E2E CLIP；5) 太阳能价值：低E0时太阳能显著提升CLIP，高E0时增益趋同。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为太阳能供电的星载生成式AI建立了系统化设计框架，揭示了C²阶段共享时间因果能量缓冲的根本耦合瓶颈。三个关键发现：(1) 计算应在最早能量可行时刻启动；(2) 恒定发射功率在多数轨道状态下最优，仅在黎明段需太阳跟踪控制；(3) 自适应生成深度在中等能量区间收益最大，规避了计算或通信单极化的不足。推动了卫星边缘智能从通用计算卸载设计向物理轨道约束下任务导向的生成式服务供给演进。未来工作将拓展至多用户多任务、有限电池与峰值功率约束，以及更精细的E2E质量模型。

title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning unfolds in discrete token space: each step is committed as text, errors propagate, and eliciting good traces presupposes traces to imitate. Reasoning instead in a model's continuous representation space - where intermediate states are vectors rather than words - sidesteps these constraints, but leaves open how those latent states should be computed. We approach this along two axes. First, we keep a large language model (LLM) frozen and use it for what it is already good at - modeling and decoding sequences - while a small auxiliary network supplies continuous latent thoughts as input. Second, we produce those latents by recurrence: a tiny recurrent reasoner refines them over many steps, decoupling the depth of computation from the size of the model, so that the latents are a product of iterative processing rather than a single forward pass. We instantiate this as Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT): a task-dedicated proposer supplies base latents, a recurrent reasoner refines them through bounded residual corrections, and the frozen LLM decodes the answer. On symbolic reasoning with answer supervision but no reasoning traces (Countdown-4, Sudoku) and on natural-language reasoning (HumanEval, MBPP, StrategyQA), LRT substantially outperforms prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods under an identical decoder, prompt, data, and training budget, and outperforms non-thinking-mode chain-of-thought prompting on the same backbone at a small fraction of its inference compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LRT（Latent Recurrent Thoughts）方法，在冻结的大语言模型（如Qwen3-8B）上，通过一个任务专用的小型提议器（约4.2M参数）和一个基于TRM的循环细化器（约7M参数）来生成并迭代精炼连续潜变量，再注入冻结LLM进行解码。在仅训练11.2M参数（占总量0.14%）的情况下，LRT在符号推理（Countdown-4从5.9%/8.4%提升至56.7%，Sudoku从10.4%/17.2%提升至49.2%）和自然语言推理（HumanEval、MBPP、StrategyQA）任务上均大幅超越SoftCoT和EBM-CoT等先前的冻结解码器连续空间推理方法，并在推理计算量仅为零样本CoT一小部分的情况下超越后者。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理在离散token空间展开，存在错误传播、依赖推理轨迹模仿等局限；连续空间推理虽有研究，但现有冻结解码器方法（如SoftCoT、EBM-CoT）使用通用助手的proposer在符号任务上反而损害性能，能量场refiner仅做标量校准而非真正计算。本文旨在解决：（1）通用proposer在偏离自然语言的任务上会主动误导解码器；（2）能量refiner缺乏真正的迭代计算能力。
AI.method: LRT由三部分组成：（1）任务专用proposer：双向Transformer编码器（约4.2M参数），将问题x映射为K个基础潜变量L⁽⁰⁾；（2）循环refiner：基于TRM的递归网络（约7M参数），维护快状态z_L和慢状态z_H，在S×H个高层循环中进行有界残差修正Δ，输出L* = L⁽⁰⁾ + Δ；（3）冻结LLM（如Qwen3-8B）：仅用其解码能力，不更新参数。训练分两阶段：第一阶段训练proposer，第二阶段冻结proposer训练refiner，使用截断梯度反传。推理时只保留K_infer=4个潜变量。
AI.result: 在控制相同解码器、提示、数据和预算的严格对比中，LRT在5个基准上的平均准确率为54.1%，远高于EBM-CoT（33.5%）和零样本CoT（35.0%）。Countdown-4上从5.9%/8.4%跃升至56.7%，Sudoku上从10.4%/17.2%跃升至49.2%。人类评估/MBPP/StrategyQA上分别达到37.8%/51.5%/75.1%。扩展refiner到28M参数还能进一步提升（CD4 69.1%，HumanEval 46.1%）。思考模式Qwen3在3/5基准上更强，但推理计算量是LRT的9–450倍。因子分解消融证实proposer和refiner缺一不可：通用proposer无论搭配哪种refiner在CD4上都低于直接基线。
AI.conclusion: LRT通过将任务专用proposer与循环refiner相结合，使小型循环模块承担迭代计算、冻结LLM承担序列建模，分工明确，在显著降低推理计算成本的同时大幅提升推理质量。然而该方法是逐任务训练的，不是一个零样本通用模型；其优势在于以小参数量激活冻结LLM的潜在推理能力。

title: Jailbreaking Text-to-Image Models Through Cracks: Navigating Heterogeneous Safety Filters via Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, despite increasingly being guarded by heterogeneous, multi-layer safety stacks combining text filters, image classifiers, and cross-modal detectors. Existing jailbreak studies either optimize against individual filters or query the complete pipeline with aggregate feedback, making it difficult to identify the active constraint and adapt to conflicts across safety this http URL this paper, we introduce the \emph{Detection Surface}, a unified geometric framework that characterizes the decision boundaries induced by heterogeneous T2I safety filters and their joint effect on the jailbreak search space. This formulation reveals that successful evasion is governed by a sparse and non-convex region shaped by cross-layer conflicts, where mutations that bypass one filter may increase exposure to another. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \emph{CRACK}, a multi-agent debate framework for adaptive jailbreak search that decomposes jailbreak search into exploration, diagnosis, and arbitration. CRACK coordinates an Attack Agent, a Defense Agent, and a Judge Agent to iteratively generate prompt mutations, obtain layer-specific diagnostic feedback, and optimize mutation strategies through reward-guided refinement. Through repeated rounds of debate, CRACK adapts its search direction to the evolving cross-layer constraints while preserving the original harmful intent. Extensive experiments across multiple T2I models, datasets, and safety configurations show that CRACK achieves Attack Success Rates (ASR) of up to 99.63\% under composite defenses, while requiring fewer queries than existing methods and maintaining semantic fidelity.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对文生图（T2I）模型多层异构安全防护栈难以被越狱的问题，提出"检测曲面"理论框架和基于多智能体辩论的自适应越狱方法 CRACK，在多种 T2I 模型与组合防御下实现高达 99.63% 的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现代商用 T2I 模型部署了由文本关键词过滤、LLM 语义分类、图像 NSFW 分类器、跨模态对齐检测器等组成的多层异构安全栈。现有越狱方法要么针对单层过滤器优化，要么仅以聚合的二元反馈查询整条管线，无法识别当前起作用的约束层，也无法处理跨层冲突——即绕过某一层反而会增强另一层检测风险。论文旨在从几何与多智能体协作角度系统解决多层组合防御下的越狱难题。
AI.method: 方法包含两大核心贡献：(1) **Detection Surface（检测曲面）**——将各层过滤器的判定函数抽象为连续表征空间中的代理评分函数，定义复合安全区为各层安全区与语义保真区的交集，并证明其具有三项结构性性质：跨层梯度冲突（Gradient Conflict）、稀疏性（指数级收缩）以及非凸性（ReLU 网络分段线性导致的组合非凸）。这三项性质将越狱搜索形式化为稀疏非凸区域上的约束搜索问题，并自然分解为探索（exploration）、诊断（diagnosis）与仲裁（arbitration）三项子任务。(2) **CRACK 多智能体辩论框架**——在严格黑盒设置下，由三个 LLM 智能体协作完成：① Attack Agent 基于策略网络 π_φ 从五类互补变异策略（词法/语义/场景/结构等）中依概率选择，对当前提示进行变异；② Defense Agent 模拟多层异构过滤管线（文本、图像、跨模态），输出每层的结构化诊断风险报告 R_t；③ Judge Agent 仲裁跨层冲突信号，结合二元绕过结果与连续评分给出综合奖励，用于通过强化学习（策略梯度）迭代精炼 Attack Agent 的策略选择。每轮辩论中三方交互一次，经多轮迭代逐步逼近联合逃逸区域 ℰ*。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4、SDXL、DALL·E 3、Midjourney 等多种 T2I 模型与多种组合防御配置下进行系统实验，CRACK 在 SD 1.4 复合过滤器上达到 99.63% 的攻击成功率（ASR），显著优于 Ring-A-Bell、MMA-Diffusion、SneakyPrompt、DACA、JailFuzzer、PGJ、JANUS、MacPrompt 等基线方法；同时所需查询次数更少，并能保持较高的语义保真度。论文以 Detection Surface 框架解释了为何层感知、诊断引导的自适应搜索能够有效穿透异构防御栈。
AI.conclusion: 论文从几何层面统一刻画了 T2I 多层异构安全过滤器的联合决策边界，揭示了跨层冲突、稀疏性与非凸性是阻碍越狱的根本结构性质。基于此提出的 CRACK 框架，通过多智能体辩论将搜索、诊断、仲裁解耦，并以强化学习精炼策略选择，在黑盒设置下实现高效、查询高效且语义保真的越狱。该工作既为 T2I 模型安全评估提供了可解释的分析工具，也凸显了当前商用组合防御的脆弱性，提示未来防御需设计具备跨层感知与对抗自适应变异能力的新机制。

title: FinLifeBench: Exhaustive Life-Event History and Financial-State Reconstruction from Longitudinal Banking Dialogue
summary: Repeated banking interactions require assistants to maintain complete, current, and traceable customer records as life changes emerge incidentally in routine requests. Existing benchmarks emphasize question answering, bounded episodes, or targeted recall rather than exhaustive longitudinal reconstruction. We introduce FinLifeBench, which evaluates two tasks over the same cumulative dialogue: reconstructing every life-event instance with its first-establishing session and reconstructing a complete 34-path financial state at consecutive checkpoints. The benchmark contains 6,000 eight-turn Korean banking sessions from 20 independent synthetic trajectories, with deterministic, exhaustive gold for 24 event types and 34 state paths and consensus quality assurance. Across eleven LLMs under a full-context condition, event-anchor recall falls from 0.591 at 15 sessions to 0.445 at 300. Errors are driven primarily by omitted events rather than poor anchor localization, while financial-state reconstruction frequently treats superseded or potentially outdated information as current; the best GCA@15 reaches 0.470. Performance on the two reconstruction tasks is only weakly associated. These results show that models can localize evidence for recovered events while still failing to maintain complete and temporally valid longitudinal records.

AI.tldr: FinLifeBench 是一个韩语纵向银行对话基准，包含 6,000 个会话（20 条独立轨迹），用于评估大语言模型的两项穷尽式重建任务：生活事件历史重建（24 类事件及其首次确立会话）和完整 34 路径金融状态重建。评估显示，随着对话加深，事件锚点召回率从 0.591 降至 0.445，错误主要源于事件遗漏而非锚点定位不准；金融状态重建常将过时信息视为当前状态，最佳 GCA@15 仅 0.470。两项任务间仅弱相关，表明纵向记录维护需要独立评估完整性与时间有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有长对话基准主要关注问答、有界情节或针对性回忆，缺乏对穷尽式纵向重建的测试。在银行业务中，助手需要维护完整、当前且可追溯的客户记录，因为生活变化会在常规请求中偶然出现。失败的纵向记录会导致错过相关支持或基于过时信息给出不当建议。
AI.method: 构建合成数据集：20 个人格条件轨迹，每条 300 个会话（20 个窗口×15 会话），每个窗口含一个锚点会话。使用有限状态转移图生成一致的事件轨迹，采用 Claude Sonnet 5 生成八轮韩语银行对话，Claude Opus 5 按七项标准进行标注，经三人（两位博士研究员和一位银行从业者）人工审核。设计两项任务：任务 1 重建事件-锚点对，任务 2 在每个检查点重建完整金融状态。评估 11 个 LLM 在完整上下文条件下的表现，使用 EA-F1、EHM、GCA@15、CSA、ESM、ER、SV 等指标。
AI.result: Gemini 3.1 Pro 任务 1 EA-F1 最高（0.748），Claude Opus 4.8 任务 2 GCA@15 最高（0.470）和 CSA 最高（0.801）。事件-锚点召回率从检查点 15 的 0.591 降至 300 的 0.445；46.7% 的黄金实例完全遗漏，条件锚点准确率达 0.866。金融状态重建中，historical 和 stale 召回率仅 6.2% 和 10.4%，分别有 70.9% 和 67.1% 被误判为 current。两任务 Spearman ρ 仅 0.291，关联很弱。
AI.conclusion: 纵向重建失败不能由单一准确性概念捕捉：生活事件历史的不完整性、证据定位能力与时间状态维护在两个目标上表现各异。模型能定位已恢复事件的证据，但仍无法维护完整且时间有效的纵向记录。即使输出正确锚定，仍需完整性和有效性检查才能用作客户记录。基准为评估对话式金融助手的纵向可靠性提供了分离完整性、可溯性和时间有效性的框架。

title: H2Table: Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Large Language Models for Complex Table Reasoning
summary: Tables are ubiquitous across diverse domains, yet reasoning over them remains a significant challenge for modern large language models (LLMs). Current approaches typically linearize tables into sequences, inherently overlooking their intrinsic two-dimensional and hierarchical structure. To address this, we propose H2Table (Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Table Reasoning), a novel framework that represents complex tables as hierarchical nested hypergraphs. To process this representation, we design a tailored hypergraph encoder to facilitate message passing between hyperedges (headers) and nodes (cells), thereby perceiving the semantic entailment relationships between them within complex tables. Furthermore, we introduce a set of learnable query vectors acting as a lightweight bridge to extract representative structural embeddings from the encoder into the LLM. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively handles complex table question answering tasks with hierarchical nested headers. Notably, on the HiTab dataset, H2Table achieves an average improvement of 22.88% over state-of-the-art baselines on highly complex tables with a nesting depth of four. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出H2Table框架，将复杂层次表格建模为分层嵌套超图，通过四阶段消息传递编码器与可学习查询向量实现与LLM的高效结构-语义对齐，显著提升复杂表格问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在三个关键局限：1) 一维序列化会破坏表格的二维和层次结构；2) 传统图结构无法捕捉表头与单元格之间的一对多关系；3) 现有超图方法（如HYTREL、TAMO）将复杂表头展平为单层，忽略了表头间的多级层次依赖关系。此外，全参数微调成本高昂。
AI.method: 1) **层次嵌套超图建模**：将复杂表格表示为H=(V,E,R,I)，其中V为数据单元格，E为表头（含虚拟全局根节点），R定义表头间的父子层次关系，I连接单元格与叶级表头，形成递归嵌套作用域。2) **层次感知超图编码器**：采用四阶段消息传递机制——V2E（通过集合注意力将单元格聚合至叶表头）、C2P（通过GAT自底向上在表头间传播）、P2C（GAT自顶向下传递全局上下文）、E2V（将表头特征返回单元格）。3) **基于查询的轻量对齐**：借鉴Q-Former，引入可学习查询向量，通过自注意力和跨注意力从编码器输出中提取代表性结构嵌入，作为软结构提示前置到序列化文本前输入LLM，仅用LoRA微调约1%参数。
AI.result: 在HiTab和TATQA数据集上，基于Llama2-7B、Llama3.1-8B和Gemma2-9B的实验表明，H2Table在所有嵌套深度上一致优于纯文本和TAMO基线。在HiTab深度为4的表格上相对SOTA平均提升22.88%。Gemma2-9B+H2Table在HiTab上以仅约1%参数量微调，平均准确率0.7596超越GPT-4o(0.7011)和DeepseekV3(0.6659)。消融实验验证了层次超图编码器、GAT消息传递和查询对齐模块的必要性。跨域实验（引入AITQA）证明其良好的OOD泛化能力。McNemar检验在深度表格上的p<0.01，统计显著。
AI.conclusion: H2Table通过层次嵌套超图建模和四阶段消息传递机制，有效捕捉了复杂表格的多级层次语义依赖；基于查询向量的轻量对齐模块以极少参数实现了结构表示与LLM语义空间的高效桥接。该框架在多个基准上表现优异，对结构复杂度具有强鲁棒性，并能赋予中等规模模型超越百亿参数模型的复杂表格推理能力。未来工作将探索集成端到端表格结构提取器以及使结构嵌入同时承载丰富语义信息。

title: Prompt-Robust Language Models: Which Training Strategies Work?
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Camera-ready version; Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Prior work addresses this through refined data construction or through dedicated robustness objectives. We reproduce and compare these strategies under controlled conditions, and measure how effective they are in addressing models' prompt sensitivity. We find the current robustness fine-tuning methods improve over standard fine-tuning and in-context learning, but the best-to-worst prompt gap remains as high as 40-57% of performance. Moreover, the recent robustness-enhancing methods we test - CoIN for contrastive alignment and PPCL for consistency regularization - often fail to outperform the simplest data construction strategy: training on one template per batch. Our diagnostics explain these results. The auxiliary objectives move the quantity they penalize, but do not generalize beyond it. Additionally, data construction strategies differ due to the conflicting signs of per-template gradients on 57-64% of parameters. Thus, batches that mix formulations force the optimizer to reconcile competing updates instead of finding a shared, prompt-agnostic one.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了提升LLM提示鲁棒性的三类训练策略（数据构建、一致性正则化、对比对齐），发现简单数据构建方法优于复杂辅助损失目标，且当前所有方法均无法消除40-57%的提示性能差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对提示措辞高度敏感，性能因语义等价的提示模板不同而大幅波动。现有研究分别从数据构建和鲁棒性目标损失两个方向改进，但缺乏受控条件下的系统比较，研究者和工程师难以判断哪些方法值得优先采用。
AI.method: 在T0基准上（48个训练任务，11个未见测试任务），对四个模型（Llama3.2-1B/3.1-8B、Qwen3-0.6B/8B）比较三类方法的受控实验：数据构建策略（Single、All shuffled、All-in-One-Batch、One-at-a-Time）、一致性正则化（PPCL）、对比对齐（CoIN）。通过分析训练目标的实际优化量（隐藏状态对比度、输出分布JS散度）和梯度空间的模板间干扰来诊断失败原因。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 最优与最差提示间的性能差距仍达40-57%，无法被任何方法消除；(2) One-at-a-Time数据构建策略提供最可靠的最差情况提升，优于CoIN和PPCL；(3) CoIN在训练目标位置（标签读出）成功最大化对比差异（0.74-0.79），但在生成起始位置（提示读出）优势消失甚至低于简单方法；(4) PPCL在验证集上降低JS散度但在测试集上优势消失，泛化失败；(5) All-in-One-Batch中57-64%的参数存在模板间梯度符号冲突，迫使优化器在单一更新中协调冲突方向。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议优先采用简单的数据构建策略（特别是One-at-a-Time），而非复杂的辅助损失目标。CoIN和PPCL的额外复杂度难以证明其合理性，因为它们未能泛化到训练目标直接优化范围之外。当前训练时鲁棒性方法仍有显著改进空间，最优方法仍遗留大量提示敏感性。

title: Measuring the Behavioral Fidelity of Long-Horizon Human Activity Simulations
summary: As LLM-based human simulators are increasingly used for policy, evaluation, and training, they must faithfully reproduce real behavioral patterns. While prior work has examined behavioral fidelity in survey responses and dialogue, longer-horizon real-world activity remains largely unexplored. We introduce a framework for evaluating behavioral fidelity in long-horizon activity simulations across temporal granularities and levels of analysis. As a case study, we collect a 43-hour multi-camera dataset of in-the-wild office activity and compare trace-derived conditioning mechanisms: persona descriptors, few-shot exemplars, and statistical transition and time-of-day priors. We find that behavioral fidelity is not uniform across metrics: statistical priors bring activity and sequence distributions closest to real behavior, yet over-fragment routines and suppress within-person variability. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation that spans multiple metrics, temporal granularities, and levels of analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估LLM长时段人类活动模拟器行为保真度的框架，沿时间粒度（局部、时段、日）和分析层面（个体、群体）两个维度展开。研究者收集了43小时多摄像头办公室活动数据，并比较了六种基于轨迹的条件化方法。核心发现是：统计先验（C4-C5）在活动分布和序列分布上偏差最小，但会导致日常活动过度碎片化并抑制个体内部变异性；不同persona方法之间差异较小且依赖评估指标；群体层面的一致性可能掩盖个体层面的误差。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于模拟人类行为（用于政策评估、AI助手测试等），需要确保模拟行为真实反映人类行为模式。现有工作主要关注问卷调查和对话中的行为保真度，而长时段真实世界活动模拟的保真度评估基本空白，亟需系统化评估框架。
AI.method: 1. 提出二维评估框架：时间粒度（局部episode结构、时段分布、日级活动分配与变异性）和分析层面（个体vs群体）。2. 收集43小时多摄像头（11台）办公室数据集，55人参与，其中5人每人被观察4±1天、每天7±1小时。3. 定义活动词汇表（6类：使用电脑、交谈、就餐、休息、使用手机、离开房间）并手动标注。4. 构建LLM智能体架构（感知-记忆-规划-行动循环），比较六种条件化方法：无persona对照（B0）、作者撰写persona（C1）、轨迹推断persona（C2）、persona+少样本示例（C3）、统计先验（C4）、混合先验（C5）。5. 使用三个LLM骨干（Llama 3.3 70B、GPT-5.4-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash），每种条件化方法进行K=3次独立运行。6. 使用TV/JS/KL散度（L1距离）量化真实与模拟行为分布之间的差异。
AI.result: 1. 统计先验方法（C4-C5）在活动分布上的JS散度降至0.010-0.107，而persona方法（C1-C3）和对照组（B0）为0.14-0.36，差异显著。2. 然而，统计先验方法生成的模拟日活动切换次数比真实多32-38次（实际平均26.7次），而persona方法少10-15次。3. 统计先验产生的个体内部日间变异性最低（V_sim=0.018-0.026，真实为0.097），过度碎片化日常活动。4. persona方法之间的差异较小（|ΔJS|=0.008-0.056），远小于persona与统计先验之间的差异（|ΔJS|=0.179-0.235）。5. 群体层面的JS散度在所有13个分布指标上均显著低于个体层面（如转换分布相差+0.069），表明群体一致性可能掩盖个体误差。6. 留一session评估中各方法的定性结论保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了行为保真度评估中单一指标的局限性。统计先验虽能精确复制活动分布，但牺牲了日常活动的自然完整性和个体内部变异。群体层面的评估可能掩盖个体层面的模拟误差。建议未来采用多指标、多时间粒度、多分析层面的整体性评估方法，以全面刻画LLM长时段活动模拟器的优势与局限。

title: Dual Process Motion Planning
summary: Robotic systems are deeply embedded in both industry and everyday life, where they are expected to act with speed, precision, and reliability. Classical control and planning methods have long delivered strong guarantees, but often at the cost of computational efficiency and adaptability. More recently, learning-based approaches have shown promise in overcoming these limitations, enabling agents to leverage experience to accelerate decision-making and address previously intractable problems. In this work, we bridge these two approaches through a neuro-symbolic perspective on nonlinear motion planning. Inspired by the Thinking Fast and Slow paradigm, we introduce a dual-process architecture that combines the strengths of robust reasoning and learning. Our framework integrates state-of-the-art symbolic solvers as a ``System-2'' component with experience-driven ``System-1'' modules. A metacognitive controller dynamically orchestrates their interaction, selecting when to rely on fast intuition versus slower, more precise reasoning. By evaluating the framework across diverse nonlinear benchmark environments, we demonstrate that this architecture yields consistent gains in planning efficiency, accuracy, and generalization, while promoting reuse across tasks. The results suggest that tightly coupling learning with structured reasoning offers a scalable path toward more capable and adaptive robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dual-MP，一种受Kahneman"快思考与慢思考"启发的双过程神经符号运动规划框架，通过元认知控制器动态协调快速神经策略（S1）与基于MPC/CBF的符号求解器（S2），在非线性运动规划任务中实现效率、精度与泛化性的平衡提升。
AI.motivation: 经典运动规划方法（如MPC、CBF）虽能提供强可靠性保证，但计算开销大、难以满足实时性需求；学习型方法虽推理速度快，但缺乏安全性与可解释性保证。如何在两者之间实现高效且自适应的协作，是当前机器人运动规划面临的核心挑战。
AI.method: 1) S1组件：基于1D CNN+MLP的轻量级反应式神经策略，输入为局部状态窗口、障碍信息、动力学特征与目标向量，输出控制量；通过行为克隆（含可微分rollout损失）从S2成功轨迹中训练。2) S2组件：两种在线求解器——基于CBF的安全滤波器（safe_control）与基于非线性MPC的规划器（acados）。3) 元认知（MC）控制器：先调用S1，仅当S1 rollout通过碰撞与目标验证才接受；否则在时间预算允许下降级至S2，并对S2成功解进行DAgger式在线回标以持续改进S1。4) 难度评估基于障碍占有率、中点间隙、规划时域与安全裕度等轻量特征。5) 评估覆盖六类非线性基准环境（大型稀疏/密集杂乱/串行墙/迷宫分叉/长回旋/虫陷阱），共3000个实例。
AI.result: 1) Q1（效率）：DMP-MPC取得最高成功率（85.1%）且平均运行时间（4979ms）远低于纯MPC（5708ms），在大型稀疏和密集杂乱环境中增益最大；DMP-CBF略慢于纯CBF（983ms vs 657ms），因S1开销超过了本就廉价的S2节省。2) Q2（可靠性）：两种Dual-MP变体均匹配或超过对应S2的成功率，但轨迹质量（Q）略低于纯MPC（0.780 vs 0.844），因S1解优先追求快速可行性。3) Q3（持续学习）：在500实例probe集上，CBF教师使S1成功率从36.3%提升至49.5%（+13.2），主要提升覆盖率；MPC教师从25.8%提升至30.3%（+4.5），主要提升轨迹质量；MPC的全局长程行为对反应式策略而言难以在闭环中可靠复现。4) Q4（热启动）：用被拒绝的S1轨迹做MPC热启动无稳定收益，甚至在最难的虫陷阱与迷宫分叉环境中导致S2成功率下降与时间增加。
AI.conclusion: Dual-MP证明了基于验证门控的双过程仲裁是一种实用机制，能在保持S2可靠性的同时显著降低在线规划时间；其有效性高度依赖于S1与S2之间的运行时差异。持续学习效果取决于教师行为与学生策略类的兼容性，CBF的局部修正比MPC的长程全局路线更适合反应式策略模仿。朴素的热启动策略无效，未来工作可探索组合S2规划器组合、元认知控制置信度估计优化以及跨任务知识迁移。

title: Making Prospective Memory SLM-Shaped: Typed Intention Stores for Small-Model Agents
summary: Prospective memory means carrying out a deferred intention at the right future cue while other work continues. Benchmarks now isolate it as an agent skill, yet frontier LLMs still struggle: the best published PM-Bench scaffold reaches only 65.1% Set-F1. We argue that this loop is schema-constrained state tracking rather than open-ended reasoning, and that small models can execute it when the action space is typed. We propose the Prospective Intention Store (PIS) that puts lifecycle logic in code and scoped language work on the model. The scaffold is agentic and training-free: no selector fine-tuning and no trajectory distillation. On PM-Bench, DeepSeek-Chat with PIS reaches 82.9% Set-F1. On Gemma-E2B, Set-F1 is only 4.2% without a store and at most 6.6% under seven retrospective memories, while PIS reaches 66.2%. PIS further reaches 70.1% Set-F1, where retrospective memory methods stay at most 54.4%. PIS sets a new state of the art on this benchmark and enables small models to surpass the published large-model scaffold.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prospective Intention Store (PIS) 框架，将前摄记忆任务视为受模式约束的状态跟踪问题，通过类型化动作空间让代码管理意图生命周期，从而无需微调即可显著提升 LLM 在 PM-Bench 上的表现。
AI.motivation: 前摄记忆（Prospective Memory）是代理智能体的一项关键能力，但当前前沿 LLM 在 PM-Bench 上的最佳表现仅为 65.1% Set-F1。作者认为现有方法将这一任务过度复杂化为开放性推理问题，实际上其本质是受模式约束的状态跟踪，小模型在动作空间被类型化后也能有效执行。
AI.method: 提出 Prospective Intention Store (PIS) 框架：1）将意图的生命周期管理（创建、状态查询、延迟执行、完成等）交由代码处理；2）将语言推理工作限定在明确作用域内交给模型；3）完全智能体化且无需训练，不需要选择器微调或轨迹蒸馏。
AI.result: 在 PM-Bench 上：DeepSeek-Chat 配合 PIS 达到 82.9% Set-F1；Gemma-E2B 不使用存储时仅 4.2%，使用七种回顾性记忆方法最高 6.6%，而使用 PIS 达到 66.2%；PIS 进一步达到 70.1% Set-F1，超越回顾性记忆方法的最高水平 54.4%。
AI.conclusion: PIS 在 PM-Bench 基准上创造了新的最优成绩，无需任何训练即可让小模型超越已发布的大模型脚手架方案，验证了将前摄记忆视为类型化状态跟踪问题这一思路的有效性。

title: Analog-DB: An Agent-First Analog Integrated Circuit Database, From Blocks to Systems
summary: Sharing analog integrated circuit designs remains difficult: foundry non-disclosure agreements restrict the process details a design depends on, and the testbenches behind published results are rarely released. We present analog-db, an open-source, versioned database built on a shareable design representation. A domain-specific language captures each design as a process-neutral topology, reusable testbenches, and a machine-readable datasheet under one schema, so a design is shared in full and re-simulates on the process kits it is bound to. A parameterization scheme exposes functional sub-blocks and device sizes as named parameters that carry their matching constraints, making circuits composable and retargetable; a schema-governed contract and queryable catalog let AI design agents discover and reuse them directly. Across the regulator corpus, all 23 circuit-kit bindings on three open kits meet their own recorded specification bands (typical corner, matched devices, no layout) and 10 of 23 meet a common class band. Seventeen of the 23 imported sizings failed their testbenches and closed under a gm/ID sizing loop driven by the annotated sub-block roles, typically within one to three iterations. In a supervised case study, a coding agent working from the released artifacts sized the op-amp cores of a chopper instrumentation amplifier on an open 130nm kit, locating four hand-entry defects and a missing common-mode feedback loop that the sizing-only baseline did not repair. The database holds 68 circuits across sixteen classes, verifiable at schematic level under a tiered harness and tracked on a power/performance scoreboard, released at this https URL .
