AI.tldr: analog-db是一个面向AI Agent的开源、版本化模拟集成电路设计数据库。其核心是一种与工艺无关的领域特定语言(DSL)，将每个设计表示为统一模式下的拓扑、可复用测试平台和机器可读数据表。通过参数化方案暴露功能子模块和带匹配约束的命名参数，使电路可组合、可重定位。数据库收录68个电路、覆盖16个类别，绑定于三个开源PDK(ihp-sg13g2、gf180mcu、sky130)，并在分层验证体系和功率/性能记分牌上可追溯。
AI.motivation: 模拟集成电路设计在共享上存在两大结构性障碍：一是表征层面，网表只承载连接性而非设计意图，已发表结果背后的测试平台很少发布；二是合约层面，代工厂NDA限制了工艺细节的发布。该工作旨在通过一种可分享的设计表征，在开放PDK和语言模型Agent兴起的背景下，同时解决这两大障碍，使模拟电路可被完整发布、再仿真和被AI Agent发现与重用。
AI.method: 提出一种形式化设计条目 E=(T,Θ,C,B)，其中T为与工艺无关的拓扑，Θ为带匹配约束(绑定组、比例关系、冻结)的参数空间，C为行为合约(每项指标绑定分析+提取+规格带)，B为逐工艺绑定集合。通过标签子图同态匹配(Algorithm 1)从扁平网表中检测出功能子模块(电流镜、差分对等31个模板)并赋以结构角色。分层验证体系(T0-T4)从模式有效性到指标通过性逐步校验。组合(Algorithm 2)通过清单(manifest)将已验证子块实例化为系统级条目，闭包于同一种设计条目形式。文件契约+目录提供无服务、模式治理的Agent接口，规格表按(分析、提取、规格带)三元组定义可执行数据表。
AI.result: 在归档修订版中，数据库包含68个可验证电路、16个类别。1574个器件中参数化覆盖100%(3819个符号)，子模块检测覆盖51%(807个器件，321个块实例)。在三个开源PDK(ihp-sg13g2、gf180mcu、sky130)上，23个LDO电路-工艺绑定全部通过其各自的规格带；按统一类别参考带评判时为10/23。23个导入尺寸中有17个在测试台上失败，由基于子模块角色的gm/ID尺寸循环闭合，通常1-3次迭代内完成。受监督的Agent案例研究中，编码Agent(Claude Opus 4.8)将LDO和斩波仪表放大器(CCIA)分别闭合至两个PDK的全部数据表规范，发现手输入的四个缺陷和缺失的共模反馈环路，而纯尺寸优化基线未能修复该拓扑缺陷。记分牌记录457个设计点，127个电路-工艺单元含≥2个点。发现并修复了测量方法缺陷(相位裕度参考点导致6个高增益多级单元误判)。
AI.conclusion: 障碍在于表征方式而非不可逾越。一旦设计以统一的模式治理对象分发(包含拓扑、参数空间、合约、绑定)，则可重现性、可移植性和机器可操作性由表征本身承载，而非由作者发布实践承载。已发表结果背后的设计知识从论文中不可重建的表格转变为可重新运行、重新尺寸、扩展的制品，每次使用可在该条目上留下新的设计点。验证深度受限于：(1)结构覆盖率51%(无CMFB模板)；(2)语料库以放大器为主(33/68)；(3)Agent证据为两个受监督的案例研究而非受控实验；(4)不建模器件失配；(5)单典型角点验证；(6)时钟电路受限于开源仿真器缺乏周期稳态分析；(7)全部为原理图级前布局验证，无版图或寄生提取关联。未来工作包括扩展模板库(特别是CMFB)、LLM注释层补充子模块以上抽象、以及扩展到数据转换器等薄弱类别。analog-db以v1.1.2版本在GitHub发布。

title: A Composable Evaluation System for Reproducible Omni-Modal Foundation Model Evaluation
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Building an omni-modal foundation model means evaluating it across text, image, video, and audio. Excellent evaluation toolkits exist for each modality, but their inference engines, prompt conventions, and metric implementations are mutually incompatible, so practitioners end up maintaining separate environments for every toolchain and still struggle to compare results across them. OmniEvaluator grew out of this need in our own model development: rather than reimplementing benchmarks, it connects existing inference engines and curated evaluation libraries at a higher level, exposing four inference backends, four evaluation frameworks, and over a thousand benchmarks through a single interface. Every run is recorded as an artifact capturing the full configuration for exact reproduction, and results flow into a shared dashboard for cross-model comparison. A federated mode shares GPU inference servers across concurrent evaluations, and a built-in verifier, small enough to run on CPU, keeps its score stable across engines and prompts where rule-based scoring fluctuates under configuration mismatch, matching cost-efficient commercial LLM judges without their recurring API cost. The system, demo video, and dashboard are publicly available. ( this https URL )

AI.tldr: OmniEvaluator 是一个可组合的全模态基础模型评估系统，通过统一中间模式连接多种推理引擎与评估框架，解决跨模态评估中环境碎片化、结果不可复现及分数不可比的问题，并内置一个轻量级 CPU 可运行的验证器以提升跨引擎/跨提示的评分稳定性。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型向文本、图像、视频、音频全模态发展，评估工具链却呈现严重碎片化：各模态的推理引擎、提示规范和指标实现互不兼容，导致：(1) 实践者需维护多套环境，难以覆盖所有模态；(2) 同名基准在不同框架下分数不可比（提示模板、解码参数、归一化规则各异）；(3) 跨论文甚至同团队内复现困难，GPU 资源被分散而非池化。论文目标不是再造评测套件，而是以系统层方式整合社区已有工具。
AI.method:
核心方法包括四点：
1. **统一中间模式（Intermediate Schema）**：将评估解耦为数据迭代、推理、后处理、指标计算四阶段，通过结构化 Record 对象（含 messages、label、output、metrics）连接各阶段，将 N×M 的集成成本降至 N+M。
2. **可复现制品（Artifact）**：每次运行记录完整配置（提示模板、生成参数、模型版本、基准版本、指标设置），作为复现单元，支持训练阶段基线锚定与回归测试。
3. **联邦评估（Federated Mode）**：推理服务器与评估客户端形成多对多池，通过连续批处理聚合并发请求，提升 GPU 利用率，实现 1.3–2.8× 加速（图像模态收益最大）。
4. **内置验证器 OmniEval Verifier**：基于 Qwen3-0.6B + LoRA（约 5M 可训练参数）微调，输入 (question, reference, prediction) 三元组，输出二值判定与解释；量化为 Q8 GGUF 格式，可通过 llama.cpp 在纯 CPU 环境运行，提供跨引擎/跨提示稳定的 [0,100] 归一化分数。
AI.result:
主要实验结果：
- **基准覆盖**：4 个推理后端（HuggingFace、vLLM、SGLang、API 客户端）+ 4 个评估框架（built-in 182、lm-eval-harness 1986、lmms-eval 416、VLMEvalKit 375），覆盖超 1000 个基准；对 HyperCLOVAX-SEED-Omni-8B 报告的 28/28 基准全覆盖，对 Qwen3-Omni 覆盖 50/65。
- **跨引擎/跨提示差异（表 3）**：原生规则评分在 GQA、OCRBench、POPE 等任务上跨框架波动达 40–88 分（[0,100] 量表），而验证器分数波动仅 0–4 分。
- **验证器准确率（表 4）**：在 1566 条人工标注测试集上达到 85.0%，超过 GPT-5.4-mini（82.8）、Claude-Haiku-4.5（84.3）、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite（83.5），逼近 GPT-5.5（90.2）、Claude-Opus-4.8（90.4）、Gemini-3.1-Pro（89.8）等顶级 API 法官。
- **成本对比（表 5）**：单次全评估 32 个基准 129,626 样本，GPT-5.4-mini 需 $48.67，Claude-Opus-4.8 需 $278.60，验证器近零边际成本；50 轮迭代评估累计可省 $12K–$70K。
- **联邦加速（表 7）**：相对传统每进程评估，文本 1.51×、图像 2.53×、视频 1.59× 平均加速。
AI.conclusion: OmniEvaluator 将碎片化的全模态评估整合为统一工作流：通过单一中间模式组合现有引擎与框架，每次运行产出可复现制品并汇入统一仪表板；其内置轻量级验证器在跨引擎/跨提示条件下保持分数稳定，匹配商业 LLM 法官准确率但无 API 成本；系统已在 HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 开发中实际使用并开源。局限包括：(1) 包装上游评估器，上游 bug 可能流入；(2) 验证器仅评估文本三元组，无法评估视觉定位、音频质量、生成质量等；(3) 当前聚焦全模态理解，多模态输出（图像/语音生成）评估是未来工作。

title: Automated Event Log Generation from Unstructured Text Using Finetuned LLMs
summary: Process mining (PM) provides a powerful framework for discovering and optimizing operational processes from event data. However, the efficacy of PM techniques is strictly predicated on the availability of structured event logs. Thus far, event logs have often been laboriously created by domain and process mining experts. This costly effort causes large portions of organizational knowledge, including incident tickets, manuals, and textual reports, to remain underutilized. We address this bottleneck by investigating the efficacy of Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated data translators. We propose a scalable framework that leverages LLMs as data translators to bridge the gap between unstructured textual resources and structured event data. We finetune LLMs on a newly created text-to-log dataset, demonstrating that the resulting models can extract high-fidelity event logs from unstructured resources. Our results show that this finetuning approach outperforms few-shot or zero-shot prompting by a large amount, highlighting finetuning as a necessary pre-condition for generating reliable event data. We conclude that our method provides a promising pipeline for making previously unused data available to process mining ecosystems, effectively expanding the possibilities of using PM to further investigate organizational workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用开源小型大语言模型(LLM)通过监督微调(SFT)将非结构化文本(如警察报告、医疗出院小结)自动转换为符合XES标准的事件日志的框架,旨在解决过程挖掘(PM)中事件日志构建成本高昂的瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 过程挖掘技术的应用严重依赖结构化事件日志,而传统的事件日志主要由领域专家手工创建,成本高昂,导致大量组织知识(如事件工单、手册、文本报告)未被充分利用。需要一种自动化方法将这些非结构化文本资源转换为结构化事件数据。
AI.method: 1) 使用前沿基础模型(GPT-5.1、Qwen3-max、Mistral-medium)从真实事件日志(Road Traffic Fine Management和Sepsis Cases)生成合成文本-日志配对数据集;2) 采用LoRA(秩为16)对三个开源指令微调LLM(Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct)进行监督微调;3) 在推理阶段采用zero-shot、one-shot和SFT三种策略;4) 从追踪层面(格式良好率、变体数量、幻觉率、Levenshtein距离、Kendall's Tau)和流程层面(使用Inductive Miner和Heuristics Miner发现流程模型,计算fitness、precision和F1分数)进行综合评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明:1) 监督微调显著优于zero-shot和few-shot提示策略;2) 微调后的Llama3.1-8B-Instruct在434个测试追踪中生成了430个有效XES格式追踪;3) 微调后的事件日志变体数量更接近原始日志(Llama:46 vs 原始43,Mistral:43);4) 微调后Llama和Ministral的追踪级Levenshtein距离和Kendall's Tau均接近0.99;5) 使用Heuristics Miner发现流程模型时,微调后F1分数接近原始日志(0.90);6) 跨域泛化能力良好(从警察报告迁移到医疗出院小结仍有效);7) 跨生成器泛化实验中,微调后F1分数提升显著(Heuristics Miner下Llama提升36pp,Mistral提升40pp)。
AI.conclusion: 监督微调是将LLM用作非结构化文本到结构化事件日志转换器的必要前提条件,相比提示工程方法能产生更可靠、高保真度的事件数据。该方法为过程挖掘生态系统提供了可扩展的数据生成管道,有效扩展了PM的应用范围。未来研究方向包括:跨领域统一LLM训练、利用带可验证奖励的强化学习提升分布外泛化能力、支持对象中心事件日志(OCEL)以及在真实非合成报告上验证。

title: LEAP: Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for LLM-based Probabilistic Forecasting
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026). 20 pages, 3 figures, and 15 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: LLM-based forecasting systems have improved on real-world tasks such as financial markets and sports outcomes, largely through stronger search and tool use. Many systems still ask an LLM to read all collected evidence together and produce the final forecast. We call this design Monolithic Prediction. It can obscure how individual evidence items affect the result and collapse uncertainty across competing outcomes. We propose LEAP (Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for Probabilistic forecasting), which reorganizes how collected evidence is used in the prediction stage. LEAP examines each evidence item separately and elicits likelihood parameters that describe its implications for the target. An explicit prior and a deterministic probabilistic model then combine these likelihoods into a posterior distribution. This procedure supports continuous, single-choice, and multi-choice forecasts while preserving reproducible evidence contributions. We build a benchmark covering forecasting, information-seeking, and browsing tasks, and evaluate LEAP on our own agent loop and several agent CLI frameworks. Given the same evidence, LEAP improves most prediction and calibration metrics across models and remains stronger under controlled comparisons of prior access, inference budget, and aggregation.

AI.tldr: LEAP提出了一种基于贝叶斯聚合的LLM预测框架，将预测阶段从整体式（Monolithic）改为逐条证据解读+显式概率模型聚合，输出可审计的后验分布而非单点预测，在多个基模型和智能体框架上提升了预测准确性与校准性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM预测系统在证据收集后仍采用整体式预测（Monolithic Prediction）：让LLM一次性阅读所有证据并输出最终答案。这导致两个问题：（1）不透明——无法判断单条证据如何影响结果；（2）长上下文下易产生遗忘与幻觉，将竞争选项的不确定性坍缩为单一答案。
AI.method: LEAP将预测阶段拆分为两步：(1) 局部参数提取——LLM逐条独立地解读每条证据，输出似然参数（连续目标用高斯似然均值σ；单选用类别似然；多选用独立Bernoulli对数似然比），同时构造先验；(2) 确定性聚合——通过共轭贝叶斯更新（高斯-高斯、狄利克雷-多项、Bernoulli-Bernoulli）以闭式解合并先验与所有似然，得到后验分布。包含三项保护机制：依赖聚类（合并同源证据）、可靠性采样（多次局部查询取一致度）、离群值剔除（先验4σ外则排除）。预测可逐条审计（leave-one-out贡献Δj）。
AI.result: 在347题的基准（FutureX+GAIA+BrowseComp）上，LEAP在5个基模型（DeepSeek-V3.2, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite, Claude-Haiku-4.5, GPT-5.4-mini, Grok-4.20-Fast）上FutureX提升3.6-18.1点，Spherical提升2.5-15.1点；在4个外部智能体CLI框架（DeerFlow/Hermes/OpenClaw/MiroFlow）上宏平均全面超越Monolithic。ECE与Overconfidence约减半；预测时间越长，LEAP优势越大。消融表明先验最重要，去掉后性能低于Monolithic。token消耗约为Monolithic的2倍（中位延迟10.4s vs 6.2s），是主要代价。
AI.conclusion: LEAP将预测阶段重新设计为"逐条证据局部解读+显式概率聚合"，在保持上游证据收集不变的前提下，显著提升预测准确性、概率校准与可审计性。其优势随预测时间延长而扩大，主要代价是推理调用数增加。该方法可作为即插即用模块附加到现有智能体框架上。

title: Cheap Verifiers, Large Blind Spots: Measuring the Reliability Cost of Cost-Saving Cascades
summary: Inference cascades cut cost by answering most queries with a cheap model and escalating a hard tail to a frontier model that acts as verifier. A natural extension closes the loop: fine-tune the cheap student on the verifier's rejections so the escalation rate, and cost, fall each round. We measure this loop on real LLMs and report four findings. First, the verifier's blind spot, the fraction of the student's wrong answers it accepts, is large and moves adversarially: it grows with student capability ($\beta$ from 0.12 to 0.55 as the student scales 0.5B to 32B) and shrinks with verifier capability, so it is worst in the cheap-student, cheap-verifier regime cascades exist to create. Second, buying it away returns the saving: a frontier verifier drives $\beta$ to about 0.05 but then escalates on 46% of hard-MATH queries against a 39% true error rate, paying the frontier price on nearly half of all traffic. Third, naive corrective fine-tuning on the verifier-rejected tail does not improve the small student but degrades and ultimately collapses it, across every teacher we tried (cross-family and same-family), so at this scale the self-improving loop is self-defeating. Fourth, through all of this the cascade's own dashboard, every metric computed through the verifier, reads a flat 3% error while true delivered error swings up to 32%: the system is blind to its own degradation by construction. We then give the theory that explains the blindness, a two-population conservation law, $\epsilon_\infty \lesssim q_0 \beta_0$, under which every in-loop metric improves while true quality does not, and a synthetic study that validates the mechanism. The practical conclusion: the reliability of a self-improving cascade cannot be read from any metric computed through its own verifier.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实测和理论分析揭示了成本节约型推理级联中"验证器盲点"的系统性风险:廉价验证器会放行学生模型的大量错误,盲目点随学生能力增强而恶化、随验证器能力增强而缩小;朴素纠错式自改进微调会退化乃至崩溃小模型;而级联自身所有基于验证器的指标都会读出虚假健康(≈3% 错误率),真实交付错误率却可飙至 32%,系统在结构上对自身退化不可见。作者提出双群体守恒律 ε_∞ ≲ q₀β₀ 解释这种盲目性,并在合成实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 推理级联(廉价模型 + 前沿验证器)是降低 LLM 推理成本的主流方案,自然延伸是闭环地用验证器拒绝样本微调学生模型以进一步降本。然而该闭环隐含一个未经检验的假设:验证器是接近完美的"近似真值"。若验证器存在盲点(放行学生错误),则用其信号训练学生等同于针对有缺陷的代理做优化——经典的 Goodhart / 奖励过度优化场景。本文动机即:实证测量并解释这种闭环级联在真实 LLM 上的可靠性代价。
AI.method: 1. 风洞方法:在带廉价金标准(GSM8K 精确匹配、hard MATH 符号等价)的任务上运行级联,但将前沿验证器对金标准"致盲",使其只能基于问题与推理链做模糊判断,从而可独立测量验证器盲点率 β(学生错误中被验证器放行的比例)。2. 真实模型实验:学生为 Qwen2.5-Instruct 0.5B–32B(LoRA 微调,单 H100),验证器与教师为 gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4.1 / gpt-5-mini,分别做学生规模扫描、固定学生扫描验证器、闭环纠错式微调。3. 理论:两群体(可检测错误 d_t、盲区错误 b_t)线性更新模型,推导出守恒律 ε_∞ ≲ q₀β₀ 与两个推论(相关性缩放、仪表盘盲目)。4. 合成验证:K=10 分类任务,验证器盲区为固定的随机半空间,运行 5 种变体(纠错式、自训练、oracle-in-loop、冻结、匹配对照)8 轮 × 20 种子,验证 H1–H5 假设。5. 仪表盘指标:通过验证器估计的交付流错误率,与金标准真实错误率对比。
AI.result: 四大实测发现:(1) 盲点率 β 随学生规模从 0.5B 的 0.12 升至 14B 的 0.55(更强学生犯更"可信"的错),随验证器能力增强而降至 ≈0.05;最危险区恰是廉价学生 + 廉价验证器这一级联最经济的配置。(2) 用前沿验证器买低盲点(β≈0.05)的代价是其在 hard MATH 上对 46% 查询升级,真实错误率仅 39%——为召回率而过度拒绝,前沿价格花在近半流量上,级联节省化为乌有。(3) 对 1.5B 与 7B 学生跨多个教师(跨族 gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4.0,同族 Qwen2.5-32B)的朴素 LoRA 纠错式微调全部使学生退化乃至崩溃(原始错误率升至 1),从未实例化出能改善学生的闭环。(4) 仪表盘读出稳定的 ≈3% 错误率,而真实交付错误率在 14%–32% 间波动,5–11× 差距,95% Wilson 区间从第 1 轮起即不重叠——系统对自身退化结构性不可见。理论:双群体守恒律 ε_∞ ≲ q₀β₀ 解释了盲目性,推论 1 指出 β₀ 在学生与验证器共享失效模式时更大,推论 2 指出所有验证器内生指标会随盲区集中而改善或持平。合成实验:H1(正下界)、H2(下界随 β₀ 单调递增,0.09→0.36)、H4(仪表盘 4.6% vs 金标准 24.9% 大差距)得到验证;H3 在修正形式下成立(自训练下界 0.30 高于纠错式 0.25,但未越过 q₀β₀=0.33 锚点);H5 显示去相关验证器集成(m=4 时 β₀ 从 0.76 降至 0.40,下界从 0.25 降至 0.14)与 40% 随机 oracle 审计(下界仅降至 0.22)为不同代价-可靠性取舍。
AI.conclusion: 成本节约级联中的"自改进"闭环在结构上即对其自身可靠性盲目:廉价验证器对学生错误的盲点随学生变强而恶化、随验证器变强而缩小;闭环纠错式微调在此规模上不仅不能改善小模型反而使其崩溃;所有经由验证器计算的指标(升级率、接受流估计准确率)都会读出虚假健康,与真实交付错误率严重脱钩。守恒律 ε_∞ ≲ q₀β₀ 给出理论下界。实践结论:自改进级联的可靠性不能从其自身验证器所计算的指标读出,必须由独立的金标准审计通道(小规模周期性标注样本)来度量;验证器选型是可靠性决策而非单纯成本决策;纠错式与自训练的选择是安全决策——后者将被动盲点转化为主动强化。代码与数据已开源。

title: SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding
summary: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug this http URL methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream this http URL to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence this http URL extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.

AI.tldr: SymFold提出对称双路径架构，并行融合PLM的进化先验与MPLM的结构先验用于蛋白质逆折叠，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有PLM-based方法采用串行流程，PLM仅对结构编码器输出进行后处理修正，缺乏对原始3D结构信息的访问，当上游预测已违反结构约束时，PLM的编辑可能进一步损害结构兼容性；而直接使用MPLM进行逆折叠又因预训练与任务间的结构分布差异及序列建模能力不足而效果不佳。
AI.method: 1) 采用冻结的预训练结构编码器（如PiFold）生成粗略序列；2) 引入PLM（ESM-C, 600M）提供序列进化先验，并行引入MPLM（ESM-3, 1.4B）提供结构先验；3) 设计自适应协同融合（ASF）模块，通过残基级门控系数α(x)动态加权融合两路logit；4) 提出自校正（Self-Correction）迭代训练策略，将训练时的单步优化与推理时的多步迭代对齐；5) 使用LoRA（r=8, α=32）高效微调PLM和MPLM，仅约0.1%参数可训练。
AI.result: 在CATH4.2上达到63.11%序列恢复率（超越Knowledge-Design 2.34%），CATH4.3上达62.23%，TS50/TS500上分别达66.02%/70.48%，CASP15/CASP16上达56.57%/52.18%，均创SOTA；AlphaFold3折回验证显示生成序列具有更高的pLDDT和TM-score，生物可信度良好；消融实验验证PLM与MPLM双路径的互补性以及ASF和SC模块的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 对称双路径架构通过协同融合进化与结构先验有效突破了串行细化管线的性能上限；ASF的残基级自适应加权优于全局/序列级融合；自校正策略缓解了训练-测试不一致问题；该框架对结构编码器具有模型无关性，并揭示了MPLM直接用于逆折叠存在"模态悖论"，需精心设计融合机制。

title: EDGE: Error Dependency Graph-Guided Multi-Error Attribution in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM) agent failures often contain multiple related errors rather than a single mistake. Existing attribution methods usually identify a responsible agent, step, or root cause, but do not explicitly model dependency between errors. We introduce EDGE, an Error Dependency Graph-guided multi-Error attribution framework. EDGE constructs an error dependency graph from observed error events and validates a reliable causal subset through counterfactual rollout. The inference graph guides a two-stage LLM-as-judge detector for error attribution, and the intervention-validated subgraph provides a more reliable basis for explanation and repair analysis. Experiments on TRAIL and MAST show that EDGE improves category-level multi-error attribution across most evaluated models and settings. Experiments with adapted Who&When-style prompts show that the graph helps across prompting strategies. These results suggest that dependency structure is a useful diagnostic prior for agent failures beyond isolated root-cause prediction.

AI.tldr: EDGE 提出了一个面向多智能体 LLM 系统的多错误归因框架，通过构建错误依赖图（Error Dependency Graph）显式建模错误之间的因果级联关系，并将其作为诊断先验注入两阶段 LLM-as-judge 检测器中，以解决现有单根因归因方法无法处理多错误传播的问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统的失败通常包含多个相互关联的错误（上游触发器、下游效应、并行症状），而现有归因方法（Who&When、AgentRx、CHIEF、CDC-MAS 等）主要定位单一根因/步骤/错误类别，缺乏对错误间依赖关系的显式建模，导致多错误场景下诊断不完整、修复优先级不清。
AI.method: EDGE 框架包含四步：(1) 观测图构建——基于 Suppes 时间优先与概率提升准则从标注语料构建观测相关图 G_S，再经 CAPRI 风格 AIC 评分剪枝得到因果候选图 G_C（DAG）；(2) 反事实验证——对 G_C 每条候选边，通过 LLM 修复模块对源 span 做 do(A=0) 干预并重rollout，工具输出固定以估计受控直接效应 Δ(A→B)，超过阈值 τ_val 则纳入验证图 G_V；(3) 推理图选择——G_τ = G_V ∪ {G_S 中权重 w_S≥τ 的边}，用于检测；G_V 保留用于解释与修复排序；(4) 两阶段图引导检测——Stage 1 用完整 G_τ 做初始错误集预测；Stage 2 根据 Stage-1 命中类别 D(T) 检索其下游未检出边 R_τ(T)，以目标化 prompt 验证这些下游假设，最终合并两阶段输出。关键设计：观测边增广检测覆盖度，验证边保障因果可解释性。
AI.result: 在 TRAIL（span 级多错误归因，148 条 trace，19 类层级标签）和 MAST（trace 级 13 类多标签，393 条 AG2 trace）上，使用 8 个开放/闭源 backbone 评估：主结果中 EDGE 在绝大多数 backbone × benchmark 组合上提升 weighted-F1（GPT-oss-120B GAIA +11.44、Gemini-2.5-Pro SWE-Bench +12.31 F1，开放模型 SWE-Bench 最高 +20.58），但 MAST 准确率普遍下降 0.3-3.7 点（recall 大幅上升，因为 13 类中仅 30.5% 正例，"全否"基线即达 69.5% 准确率）；消融上：随机边数匹配对照在 5 个开放模型中 4 个劣于 G_τ；静态单阶段注入 (+CG) 在 15 个单元格中 14 个劣于两阶段动态注入；80/20 留出图重建在 4/4 单元格均提升 F1 证明非数据泄漏；适配 Who&When 的 All-at-once / Step-by-step prompt 在两种策略下均受益于图引导；干预验证图 G_V 揭示出如 "Formatting Errors → Context Handling Failures"、"Action-Reasoning Mismatch → Premature Termination" 等可解释传播链，可指导上游修复优先级。错误归因分析显示增益集中在 Planning & Coordination（+EDGE only 桶主导，GPT-oss-120B 9.0%→46.6%）和 Reasoning 类别，符合 G_V 拓扑中 Planning 为下游目标、Reasoning 为中间节点的定位。
AI.conclusion: 错误依赖结构（而非孤立标签预测）是多智能体 LLM agent 失败诊断的有效先验；EDGE 通过观测+干预双轨图构建与两阶段图引导检测，实现 taxonomy-agnostic 的多错误归因改善，并产出可信因果子图 G_V 用于系统级修复排序与传播分析。局限性：定位增益在长上下文 SWE-Bench 上接近持平（依赖图帮助类别判定而非轨迹定位）；干预验证受协同 trace 样本量限制；MAST 事件标注为 LLM 自动生成未经充分人工校验；图为语料级固定，未做按迹或按模型置信度的门控注入。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction (NeuSOGA): From Observations to Symbolic Mathematical Representations
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Code repository: this https URL
summary: A fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence is the transformation of observations into explicit symbolic representations suitable for abstraction, interpretation, and reasoning. While modern AI systems achieve remarkable perceptual capabilities through large-scale statistical learning, the resulting knowledge is typically encoded within latent parameters that are difficult to inspect or manipulate analytically. Inspired by Neuro-Symbolic AI and theories of human abstraction, this paper investigates the formation of symbolic mathematical representations from geometric observations. We propose NeuSOGA (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction), a framework that progressively transforms observations into topological abstractions, geometric abstractions, and ultimately symbolic mathematical representations. The architecture combines topology-guided structural discovery using Euclidean Distance Transforms, foundation-model perception using Segment Anything, adaptive multi-scale geometric abstraction, and symbolic synthesis through Implicit Area Splines. The resulting representation is an analytical implicit model supporting arbitrary-order smoothness, additive composition, and closed-form evaluation. Unlike neural latent encodings, the generated representation remains interpretable, editable, and mathematically explicit. Experiments on ModelNet40 point clouds, arbitrary-view projections, and segmented optical observations demonstrate that NeuSOGA transforms diverse observations into compact symbolic representations while preserving essential geometric and topological structure across sensing modalities and viewing directions. NeuSOGA provides an interpretable and explainable pathway from observation to symbol and establishes

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuSOGA框架，将观测数据通过拓扑抽象、几何抽象和符号化数学表示三个阶段，转化为可解释的隐式面积样条（Implicit Area Splines）解析表示，无需任务特定的几何训练。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统通过大规模统计学习获得感知能力，但知识通常编码在难以解释和操作的潜层参数中。人类数学认知能够从少量观测中提取几何不变性并构建抽象符号表示，这启发了将神经感知与符号推理结合的神经符号AI方法。
AI.method: NeuSOGA实现O→T→G→S的转换层次：(1)通过欧几里得距离变换(EDT)提取拓扑感知的结构核心；(2)利用Segment Anything(SAM)以拓扑核心为提示进行目标分割；(3)基于尺度空间理论的自适应多尺度几何抽象（高斯平滑+Douglas-Peucker简化）；(4)通过隐式面积样条合成解析的符号数学表示F(x,y)=0。面积样条具有严格可加性、任意阶C^n光滑性和闭式求值能力。
AI.result: 在ModelNet40点云数据（飞机、椅子、灯）、任意视角投影以及COCO分割图像上的实验表明，NeuSOGA无需类别特定训练即可将多样化观测转化为紧凑的符号表示，控制点多边形仅需97-132个点，同时保持跨模态和跨视角的拓扑与几何结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: NeuSOGA建立了从观测到符号的计算桥梁，提供了一种通过构造实现可解释性的路径。隐式面积样条作为符号表示层，能够直接进行解析操作和符号组合，为未来可解释推理、概念形成和机器辅助数学发现奠定了符号基础。

title: EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in generating scientific figures from text or images. However, producing publication-ready figures requires iterative refinement, making scientific figure editing an important yet largely unexplored task. Existing approaches rely on costly proprietary agentic systems, focus primarily on evaluation, or construct training supervision from synthetically generated edits. Instead, we leverage naturally occurring scientific revision and development trajectories as a scalable source of supervision. To this end, we introduce DaEdiTikZ, the first large-scale dataset of revision-derived scientific figure edits, constructed by mining 391K plausible TikZ edit pairs from arXiv, GitHub, and TeX SE and inferring 781K directed edit instructions with a VLM conditioned on rendered figures and TikZ code. We further introduce DaEdiTikZ-Bench, a human-refined benchmark with 790 instances, and train two compact Qwen3.5-based EdiTikZ models (4B and 9B) by jointly learning reconstruction and editing, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) with complementary rewards for rendered fidelity and edit application. Automatic evaluation places our 9B model above all tested baselines, while human evaluation with 9 annotators and 4,320 ratings places it above GPT-5.6-Sol and on par with Gemini-3.1-Pro. Under severe out-of-distribution shifts, it remains competitive with GPT-5.6-Sol near its 2K training sequence-length regime. Models and datasets will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EdiTikZ，首个基于自然科学图表修订轨迹的大规模TikZ科学图表编辑框架。构建了DaEdiTikZ数据集（391K编辑对/781K有向编辑实例）和DaEdiTikZ-Bench基准（790实例），并训练了4B/9B的Qwen3.5-based模型，通过联合重建-编辑SFT与多奖励RL（SelfSim+指令跟随）实现编辑。9B-RL模型在自动评估中超越所有基线，人工评估优于GPT-5.6-Sol、与Gemini-3.1-Pro持平。
AI.motivation: 科学图表通常需经多轮迭代修订才能达到发表质量，但现有VLM在"按指令编辑现有图表"这一任务上探索不足：现有方法要么依赖昂贵的专有agent系统、要么仅做评估、要么使用合成编辑构建监督。本文旨在利用自然产生的科学修订轨迹作为可扩展监督源。
AI.method: 1) 从arXiv、GitHub、TeX SE挖掘TikZ修订对（跨版本、相关子图、TeX SE讨论），通过DeTikZify-V2图像编码器计算余弦相似度并过滤；2) 用Qwen3.6-27B基于渲染图+TikZ代码双向推断编辑指令（添加/删除/修改意图×6种操作类型）；3) 联合重建（DaTikZ-V4的752K样本）与编辑（DaEdiTikZ的752K样本）进行SFT；4) 使用GDPO（组奖励解耦归一化策略优化）结合两个互补奖励：SelfSim（基于SFT模型冻结视觉编码器的patch级EMD相似度）和Instruction Following（VLM裁判对每个原子编辑的二元判断），并以编译/格式有效性门控。
AI.result: EdiTikZ-9B-RL在DaEdiTikZ-Bench上取得最高Avg=0.726（DSim=0.893, EA=0.734, SP=0.815, VQ=0.865, CR=96.8%）。人工评估（9标注者、4,320评分）显示其综合得分17.43，优于GPT-5.6-Sol（16.75），接近Gemini-3.1-Pro（17.72）。消融表明：联合训练优于仅编辑训练（+0.040 Avg）；GDPO优于GRPO（+0.038 Avg）；两奖励互补。OOD测试（SPIQA/CharXiv，TikZ之外的图表）显示在2K训练长度范围内与GPT-5.6-Sol差距<0.1，且RL增益随难度提升而增大。
AI.conclusion: 自然产生的科学修订轨迹为小规模开源图表编辑模型提供了有效监督，可与远大于自身的专有系统竞争。该框架可扩展至其他可视化语言（Matplotlib/LaTeX表格），并支持更细粒度的局部编辑。局限性包括推断指令的噪声（遗漏、误释）、长序列OOD生成性能下降，以及评估本身的合成指令噪声。

title: Parsing the Stream: A Live Trace Model for Long-Horizon Agents and Their Observers
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL ; dataset: this https URL
summary: A long-horizon agent's trace outgrows both of its consumers: the human observer monitoring the run, and the agent itself, whose bounded context the trace must be folded back into. We present a live trace model, an append-only event ledger folded incrementally into typed run state and compiled into per-consumer views, and evaluate it for both consumers against deterministic ground truth. For the observer side, evaluated with an LLM reader as proxy, the compiled view answers monitoring questions using approximately 14x and 15x fewer input tokens (by reader) and at 5-7x lower cost than a budget-capped single-call reading of the raw trace, with higher accuracy (0.85-0.87 versus 0.48). Because the questions were co-designed with the view schema, we treat the token and cost reduction, conditional on schema coverage, as the transferable result. For the agent, on 120-link sequential-dependency tasks, mechanisms that maintain the task's running statistic in per-step state succeed where full-context prompting fails (30/30 versus 8/30 under a clean protocol, n=30, labeled descriptive owing to benchmark-system co-development); a prompt-level scratchpad matches the fold's accuracy at lower cost, and a two-arm decomposition attributes the fold's accuracy to its deterministic aggregate and its cost advantage to its compactness. The fold's remaining value over cheaper alternatives is deterministic auditability and serving the observer from the same state. We derive eleven candidate requirements for trace folding from observed failures and delimit them with an order-sensitive task family on which the fold ceases to help. Code, benchmarks, a regenerable synthetic corpus, and all workbench traces are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"实时追踪模型"（live trace model），通过将长周期智能体的原始事件流增量折叠为有类型的运行状态，并为人类观察者和智能体本身各自编译定制视图。核心发现是：在COMPREHEND基准上，编译视图以约14-15倍更少的输入token和5-7倍更低的成本帮助LLM读者回答监控问题（准确率0.85-0.87 vs 0.48）；在CONTINUE工作台的120链顺序依赖任务上，维护运行统计量的机制全部成功（30/30），而全上下文提示则失败（8/30）。作者提炼出11条折叠需求，并明确划定了模型适用与失效的边界。
AI.motivation: 长周期智能体产生的原始追踪（trace）同时超出了两类消费者的能力：(1) 人类观察者需要在运行中理解智能体在做什么、什么已确定、什么待定，但原始追踪动辄数十MB；(2) 智能体本身需要将追踪折回有界上下文窗口，但随着上下文增长，准确率会急剧下降。目前两类消费者由两套独立系统服务，缺乏统一的中间表示。论文的核心问题是：能否用单一折叠模型同时服务两类消费者？
AI.method: tracelab实现了一个四层架构：(1) 追加式类型化事件账本（JSONL，含字节偏移量恢复令牌和SHA-256指纹）；(2) 单遍折叠（fold）将事件流增量归约为RunState（目标、前沿、待处理调用、计数器、文件、事实——按file:key索引，带出现次数身份和确定性聚合）；(3) 版本化派生节点（带显式有效性生命周期，支持事后重解析）；(4) 每消费者编译视图（观察者HTML页面 + 工人紧凑文本视图）。策展循环每5步从工人自身记录中重新生成工人视图。配套设计了四个基准，全部基于确定性真值而非LLM评判：DETECT（规则检测器）、FIDELITY（独立oracle对照）、COMPREHEND（监控问答，LLM读者作代理）、CONTINUE（智能体工作台，预提交错误调度，多种上下文策略对比）。
AI.result: 观察者侧：12个真实会话（112MB）的COMPREHEND测试中，编译视图用约57K输入token和$0.42成本达到0.871准确率（Sonnet 5），而原始尾部用779K token和$2.37仅得0.479，扁平日志居中。智能体侧：120链顺序依赖任务下，策展视图30/30成功（$1.59/次，缓存命中），全上下文仅8/30（$7.13/次，无缓存），缓存版scratchpad同样30/30但更便宜（$0.97）。开发期网格显示，所有在每步状态中携带运行统计量的机制均成功（策展视图25/30、scratchpad 26/30、掩码+笔记混合10/10、计算器工具10/10），而检索（0/10）、400词封顶摘要（0/3）等失败。需求11（聚合声明自身覆盖范围）的修复使5/5失败种子全部恢复。作者提炼出11条折叠需求，并在altchain（交替符号链）任务族上界定了模型失效的边界。
AI.conclusion: 智能体工作台上的成功追踪的是需求是否被满足，而非具体机制选择。论文将追踪解析为单一确定性操作，使理解工作从所有下游消费者中卸载——小模型在编译视图上的表现优于前沿模型在原始尾部上的表现，紧凑上下文能支撑长上下文失败的任务（前提是折叠保留的统计量与任务所需的计算相匹配）。需要权衡的是：工人管理的笔记灵活但未经验证，harness管理的状态确定可审计但泛化能力受限于其聚合词汇表。论文的限定结论是：在累积任务上，确定性有界折叠在测试样本量下与保留全历史的方案准确率无差异，成本约为其四分之一，并提供审计追踪和共享的观察者视图。

title: Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement
comment: Github: this https URL Project Page: this https URL
summary: This paper studies autonomous software development, in which LLM-based coding agents transform high-level requirements into complete, functional, and usable software systems without human intervention. We introduce Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development. HoH operates on existing coding-agent harnesses, and organizes their executions into iterative planning-coding-testing loops. To sustain improvement across loops, HoH balances repair with capability growth, scopes development into small and verifiable increments, separates implementation-time testing from independent evaluation, and constrains verifiable outputs rather than prescribing agent workflows. It progressively exposes deliverables, role-specific tools, and skills, encourages reuse rather than recreation, and maintains versioned project histories. On GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE, and ProgramBench, three harness-model pairs (Codex with GPT-5.5, OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Pi with MiniMax-M3), HoH consistently outperforms the corresponding standalone harnesses, achieving an average relative gain of 52.25 percent and a maximum gain of 82.86 percent after three iterations. In a multi-day deployment with more than 70 iterations, HoH autonomously develops a first-person-shooter game, featuring a coherent storyline, fully implemented core mechanics, human-playable experience, polished visuals and integrated audio. Github: this https URL Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Harness-of-Harness (HoH) 框架，通过在现有编码智能体之上构建规划-开发-测试循环，使 LLM 编码智能体能够在多日长时间跨度内自主完成从零开始的软件开发。在三个基准和长时间游戏开发案例中均显著优于对应的独立基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的编码智能体大多依赖人机协作，难以从高层需求出发独立完成完整软件的端到端开发。随着开发轨迹变长，智能体容易遗忘早期需求、积累失败尝试、陷入重复检查-修复循环，无法维持连贯有效的进展。核心挑战不是执行更长，而是如何在一段时间内持续地实现一致性改进。
AI.method: HoH 将一个固定的编码智能体（harness+model）封装为三个角色：Project Planner（只读，根据规约和上一轮证据生成有界开发文档 D_t）、Developer（唯一可写工件的角色，基于 A_{t-1} 和 D_t 实现增量，并嵌入 shift-left 自测）、QA Tester（对冻结的 A_t 进行独立白盒+黑盒评估，生成结构化证据束 E_t）。状态在循环之间通过工件状态 A_t 和证据状态 E_t 两条通道传递；不规定工作流而只约束可验证产出；采用渐进式披露、版本化项目历史，鼓励复用而非重建。
AI.result: 在 GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE、ProgramBench 三个基准上，使用 Codex+GPT-5.5、OpenCode+DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Pi+MiniMax-M3 三种 harness-model 组合，HoH@3 相对 Vanilla 平均提升 52.25%（最大 82.86%），GameCraft-Bench 总体得分分别提升 21.93/22.08/16.62 分；FrontierSWE 上 Codex 配置的 Dominance 经 10 轮迭代从 22% 提升至 72.67%。在预算控制对比中，HoH 用更少 token 即超过三次 Vanilla Continuation。消融实验表明计划更新、证据反馈和工件热启动均不可或缺。在多日部署中，HoH 经 70 余次循环自主开发出一款具备完整剧情、核心战斗机制、关卡流程、视听打磨的可玩第一人称射击游戏 Fusepoint，开发轨迹和素材均公开在 GitHub。
AI.conclusion: HoH 通过将规划-开发-测试循环与跨迭代证据反馈相结合，使固定 harness-model 组合在长周期软件自主开发中保持能力增长与修复的平衡，为从零开始的端到端自主软件开发提供了一条实证可行的路径。局限在于依赖底层 harness 能力，尚未广泛覆盖真实工程场景；未来工作将拓展到更多类型的游戏和软件系统，朝通用自主软件开发框架迈进。

title: When Guardrails Look Effective: Construct Validity Failures in LLM Agent Commerce Evaluation
comment: Submitted to the NeurIPS 2026 Trust-AI-Eval Workshop. 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. The accompanying artifact is available at this https URL
summary: Interactive simulations increasingly evaluate policies in markets populated by language-model agents. Their outputs can look economic---prices, profits, consumer surplus, and welfare---without instantiating the behavior named in the claim. We audit this risk in a multi-turn buyer--seller testbed for configurable hotel transactions. An initial implementation reported welfare gains from two marketplace guardrails of +87.4, +35.0, and +28.8 across a Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B ladder. It also gave guarded and unguarded agents different offer schemas and choice procedures. Holding the schema and buyer chooser fixed changes the paired contrasts to +7.2, -13.9, and +23.8. The four largest 14B single-generation effects averaged +229; after three generations per profile-condition, they averaged +37.6 (95% bootstrap interval [-34.2, 109.3]), while generation residuals account for 49.9% of variation in this post-hoc probe. A seller-incentive check is non-monotone: increasing profit pressure produces less profit than the default seller prompt. Scripted positive controls show why this matters. A profit-maximizing seller already attains first-best welfare, so guardrails mostly redistribute and reduce welfare; they create welfare only when the seller is explicitly programmed to force inefficient bundles. We contribute a construct-validity contract separating incentive validity, protocol isolation, stochastic stability, and welfare accounting, and returning INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE before substantive policy claims. In our case, the original estimate is INVALID under protocol isolation, while the controlled study remains INCONCLUSIVE under incentive validity and stochastic stability. The case does not show that guardrails are ineffective; it shows their apparent value is unidentified until the simulated agents and protocol pass these checks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过审计一个多轮买卖方酒店交易测试平台，揭示了LLM智能体市场评估中常见的构念效度（construct validity）问题：看似有效的"护栏"（guardrails）效果可能源于方案架构（schema）、选择程序、采样噪声等混杂因素而非政策本身。作者提出四项验证契约（激励有效性、协议隔离、随机稳定性、福利核算），并据此将原始估计标记为Invalid，将控制后研究标记为Inconclusive。
AI.motivation: 当前以LLM智能体为市场参与者的交互式模拟日益普遍，但其输出（价格、利润、福利）可能并不反映声明中的经济行为。本文旨在审计此类评估中构念效度失败的风险，即模拟可能"看起来经济"但未真正实例化所声称的策略性行为。
AI.method: 四项审计实验：(E1)脚手架控制——统一非对称的报价方案和买方选择规则；(E2)重复生成取证——对14B模型中四个最大单次生成效应做三次重复并进行自举分析；(E3)激励操作检查——比较合规型、标准自利型、强化逐利型三种卖方提示；(E4)脚本化正向控制——用确定性策略（利润最大化、低效捆绑压力）替代LLM卖方。提出四项验证契约C1-C4（激励有效性、协议隔离、随机稳定性、核算完整性），并采用三向决策（通过/Invalid/Inconclusive）。
AI.result: 原始实现的护栏福利增益为+87.4、+35.0、+28.8（1.5B/3B/14B）；统一方案和选择器后变为+7.2、-13.9、+23.8（1.5B处缩小92%，3B处符号反转）。四个最大14B单次生成效应均值为+229，三次重复后均值降至+37.6（95% CI [-34.2, 109.3]），生成残差占49.9%方差。卖方激励检查非单调：更强逐利提示反而利润更低。脚本化控制显示：利润最大化卖方已实现一阶最优福利，护栏只能再分配并降低福利；只有低效捆绑压力卖方下护栏才创造福利。
AI.conclusion: 原始估计在协议隔离下为Invalid；控制后研究在激励有效性和随机稳定性下为Inconclusive。本文不证明护栏无效，只证明其表面价值在被充分验证之前是"未被识别的"。LLM市场模拟应在政策声明前通过C1-C4契约，Invalid和Inconclusive应被视为评估结果而非免责声明。

title: EvoSCM: Scientific Belief Revision Through Causal Model Evolution and Experimentation
comment: This is a preliminary version, with further details and results to follow
summary: Scientific agents must learn not only how to reason, but also what to believe. However, existing LLM agents typically express scientific hypotheses in free-form text, leaving their beliefs implicit and difficult to test or revise. We introduce EvoSCM, which equips scientific agents with explicit structural causal models that evolve as new experimental evidence is collected. EvoSCM maintains a population of competing SCM hypotheses, each encoding a candidate causal explanation of the environment, and evolves them through a closed discovery loop. In each round, the agent abduces latent mechanisms from accumulated evidence, designs discriminative interventions, and commits to falsifiable predictions that it tests through experimentation. Discrepancies between prediction and observation are inductively distilled into correction rules that revise the causal structures and mechanisms of each hypothesis, and the agent then deductively validates the revised population against accumulated evidence and structural consistency to guide the next round. We evaluate EvoSCM on DiscoverPhysics, a benchmark requiring agents to uncover the hidden dynamics of noncanonical physical worlds through experimentation. EvoSCM consistently improves scientific discovery over baselines, yielding more accurate explanations and predictions while making more effective use of experimental interactions.

AI.tldr: EvoSCM是一个科学发现框架，通过将结构因果模型(SCM)作为显式、可演化、可转移的认知状态，解决LLM科学智能体中"如何推理"（程序性知识）与"相信什么"（认知性知识）的脱节问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的科学假设通常以自由形式文本表达，导致信念隐式、难以测试和修正。程序性自我进化方法（如提示优化、记忆蒸馏）只能改善推理方式，无法有效更新智能体对外部世界的认知性知识（epistemic knowledge），即对世界运作方式的解释。当新观察与既有结论矛盾时，智能体难以识别哪个假设导致预测失败、如何修正该假设，以及修正后是否仍与先前观察一致。
AI.method: 框架：EvoSCM将SCM作为显式、持久的认知状态，通过闭合发现循环演化SCM假设群体。具体包括两大互补阶段：（1）因果实验设计（每个假设内运作）：从累积证据中归纳推断潜在机制状态→设计最大区分性的干预→做出可证伪预测→通过实验验证；（2）SCM假设修正（群体层面转变）：将预测-观察差异归纳提炼为修正规则（correction rules），通过四种修订算子（增删边、增删潜变量、更新机制、更新参数）对因果结构和机制进行有针对性编辑，再对修正后的假设进行演绎验证（证据验证+结构一致性检查），保留有效假设形成下一轮群体。核心要素：群体基础认知状态避免过早收敛；修正规则作为经验证据与结构模型编辑的接口；最小修订原则（优先参数/机制更新，后结构编辑）。
AI.result: 在DiscoverPhysics基准测试上的主要结果：（1）科学发现性能大幅提升——以GPT-5.5为骨干，机制解释分数从0.5164提升至0.7509，归一化MSE降低两个数量级（从2.83×10⁻²降至2.77×10⁻⁴），pass@5从27.27%提升至63.64%，同时所需实验轮次更少；（2）跨模型可转移性显著——在原始DiscoverPhysics上0%通过率的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型，注入GPT-5.6-Sol演化出的SCM后，pass@5达到63.64%，解释分数达0.740，可与前沿模型零样本发现能力相媲美，证明SCM作为可移植、可组合的认知产物区别于程序性改进。
AI.conclusion: EvoSCM将结构因果模型作为科学智能体的显式、持久认知状态，弥补了程序性自我进化方法的关键缺口——后者只改善推理方式，不改变智能体对世界的信念。通过维护竞争性SCM假设群体并通过归纳-行动-演绎-诱导的闭合循环进行演化，EvoSCM将自由形式的科学推理转变为结构化、可证伪、可累积修正的过程。在DiscoverPhysics上的实证表明，EvoSCM不仅以显著更少的实验轮次实现了更优的前向预测和机制对齐，还产出了能够在不同基础架构间零样本迁移的可移植因果模型。

title: Can LLMs Discover Scientific Laws in Real and Parallel Worlds?
comment: 42 pages, 16 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Scientific equation discovery has long been central to scientific progress, proceeding through iterative cycles of hypothesis generation, observational testing, and refinement under scientific constraints. As LLM capabilities advance and their role in AI for Science expands, it remains an open problem whether they can genuinely discover scientific laws and how this ability should be evaluated. Existing evaluations, however, often either simplify discovery through synthetic settings or reuse published targets that may already be familiar to LLMs. We therefore introduce SCILAWS-BENCH, a benchmark for scientific law discovery built from published research and real scientific data. It comprises 118 problems drawn from 381 scientific papers, covering 291 candidate laws and roughly 8M real data points across six scientific disciplines. Each problem is instantiated in two complementary settings: (1) SCILAWS-REAL asks models to propose laws from fixed real observations and evaluates held-out predictive fit and scientific validity derived from the source literature, and (2) SCILAWS-PARALLEL asks models to actively query residual-calibrated worlds and recover synthesized hidden laws derived from published forms. This two-setting task design preserves each problem's scientific context while separately evaluating fixed-record law discovery and active recovery of a newly synthesized hidden law. We find that predictive fit can diverge from scientific validity, memorization shapes whether models reproduce or move beyond published formulas, and our best-of-N study reveals a selection bottleneck. Our work provides a paper-grounded benchmark and new empirical perspectives for evaluating AI for scientific discovery. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SciLaws-Bench，一个基于已发表科学论文与真实科学数据的科学定律发现基准，涵盖 118 个问题、291 个候选定律、约 800 万真实数据点，横跨 6 个学科，并设置两种互补评估场景（SciLaws-Real 与 SciLaws-Parallel），用以系统评估大语言模型发现科学定律的能力及其在记忆化与新颖结构发现之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 科学定律发现评估存在根本矛盾：要么依赖教科书式经典公式（易受记忆化影响），要么使用反事实或人工构造环境（脱离真实科学测量）。SciLaws-Bench 旨在填补这一空白，在真实科学数据、论文上下文与可验证的有效性约束下，评估 LLM 能否进行真正开放的定律发现。
AI.method: （1）从 381 篇科学论文中以论文-数据集配对方式构建 118 个问题（含 66 个单组、52 个多组任务）；（2）SciLaws-Real：给定固定真实观测与论文派生有效性量规，分别评估保持性预测拟合（S_N）和科学有效性（S_V），后者通过代码可执行判定代理执行行为与结构探针；（3）SciLaws-Parallel：在保留科学上下文的同时，将每个问题转化为带有合成隐藏定律（基于已发表公式的合理结构变体）和残差校准模拟器的可查询世界，要求模型通过主动查询与实验设计恢复隐藏结构（S_S）；（4）冷回忆审计：在无数据条件下让模型写出 Python 公式，以结构等价性判定是否依赖记忆化；（5）最佳 N 选择研究：固定每次轨迹预算，生成 20 个候选并由同一模型进行淘汰赛式选择；（6）基于统一 ReAct 智能体框架，9 个前沿模型在 30 轮交互预算下进行评测，并采用专家标注验证的 LLM 判定器。
AI.result: （1）GPT-5.5 在三项聚合指标中均领先（S_N=50.77%、S_V=81.84%、S_S=58.26%），但 S_N 与 S_V 之间的对齐一致性在零裕度下仅 54.9%，需 ΔS_N≥0.4 才升至 69.5%，表明预测拟合并不必然蕴含科学有效性；（2）冷回忆审计显示 47.5% 任务未被任何模型回忆（"发现鸿沟"），14 任务被全部回忆（"通用经典"），最强模型仅能冷回忆 34.7% 任务；在"发现鸿沟"任务上模型超越已发表基线的比例显著高于经典任务，但全定律恢复率在所有回忆层级均接近 8%；（3）最佳 N 实验中候选池从 5 增至 20 时，预言机最优在 S_N 和 S_V 上分别提升 4.5 和 5.3 个百分点，而自选择仅提升不到 2 个百分点，60% 的组别赢家在帕累托意义上被其他候选支配；（4）领域分布上材料与工程冷回忆率最低（20.5%），生态与水文最高（43.4%），GPT-5.5 在生物学跌出前三；（5）LLM 判定器与五位领域专家的一致性（κ 0.77/0.82/0.84）落在人-人一致性区间内。
AI.conclusion: SciLaws-Bench 揭示当前 LLM 已展现初步科学定律发现能力，但远未达到可靠水平：预测拟合与科学有效性可显著背离；记忆化使模型倾向复现已发表公式而非发现新结构；推理时扩展产生更强的候选定律，但模型自选择成为关键瓶颈。论文主张未来工作应聚焦于设计信息性实验、超越记忆定律推理以及可靠识别科学有效假设。

title: Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables in the main text, 27 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables including Appendix
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.

AI.tldr: SAGE提出了一种基于策略熵门控的框架，让轻量级RL智能体仅在自身策略高熵（不确定）时向昂贵的VLM教师请求动作建议，并通过环境优势加权的策略克隆将指导蒸馏到学生策略中，使最终部署的策略完全自主且无需VLM调用。
AI.motivation: 直接使用VLM作为决策策略成本高、无法通过环境交互改进且可能重复系统错误；而标准RL在稀疏奖励视觉任务中探索效率极低。因此需要一种方法将VLM作为训练时的不完美教师，转化为部署时无需VLM的轻量自主策略。
AI.method: （1）熵门控选择性指导：以归一化策略熵作为不确定性代理，超过阈值ν时查询VLM教师，否则使用学生自身策略；（2）缓存机制减少重复状态的VLM调用；（3）分区损失：将教师指导动作从PPO策略更新中分离，避免off-policy重要性比率失配，教师动作通过BC（可选AWBC，用环境优势加权w=exp(A/τ)）蒸馏；（4）价值函数在所有转换上训练，使用环境奖励作为目标。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake、MiniGrid（LavaGap/GoToDoor/Fetch）、EZPoints、新提出的CardMaze和ALFWorld等稀疏奖励视觉任务上，SAGE在多个环境（CardMaze达到1.000最优、FrozenLake、GoToDoor、Fetch、ALFWorld）显著优于PPO基线，并在CardMaze上超越VLM教师本身（VLM-as-policy为0.000）；SAGE仅在1.2%–13.3%的训练步中查询VLM，部署时完全无需VLM调用。消融实验表明：BC蒸馏是不可或缺的（移除BC导致性能崩溃），而AWBC相对标准BC无一致优势；随机教师和差VLM教师会产生负面引导。Oracle引导实验在5M步长周期训练中验证了高质量指导可改变整体策略发现能力。
AI.conclusion: SAGE证明选择性的VLM指导能将不完美但具有任务相关性的教师转化为有用的训练信号；学到的自主策略可在评估时超越VLM教师；VLM的闭环策略表现不能完全预测其作为教师的有效性；最佳使用方式是将VLM作为临时的探索先验而非固定策略。局限：熵作为不确定性代理可能混淆真实不确定性与动作多模态性；目前仅适用于离散动作空间；依赖教师具备一定任务相关性，对系统性误导或完全无信息教师不具鲁棒性。

title: Behaviorally Grounded User Profiles from the Wild for Personalized Alignment and Multi-Perspective Reasoning
summary: Persona-driven techniques increasingly adapt large language models (LLMs) to diverse contexts. However, existing methods predominantly rely on rigid, synthetic personas that flatten individual variation, rely on stereotypes, and miss the nuanced signals driving actual human preferences. We introduce profile behavioral grounding, a framework for extracting open-ended, high-fidelity user profiles directly from authentic, anonymized social media posts. We evaluate these profiles across two paradigms: train-time personalization via supervised finetuning (SFT) and non-parametric test-time multi-perspective reasoning. Across complex recommendation and open-ended query benchmarks, behaviorally grounded profiles consistently improve base models and outperform synthetic profile baselines, driving stronger parametric alignment and enabling richer, multifaceted reasoning. Our findings establish open-ended, behavior-derived profiles as a highly diverse and effective foundation for the next generation of personalized language systems. Our code base is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出"profile behavioral grounding"框架，通过从真实社交媒体内容中提取开放式的用户行为画像，替代传统的合成persona方法，在SFT训练和测试时多视角推理两种范式下均显著提升了个性化效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法主要依赖僵化的合成persona，存在扁平化个体差异、依赖刻板印象、无法捕捉驱动真实人类偏好的细微信号等问题，需要更真实、开放式的用户画像表征方式。
AI.method: 提出profile behavioral grounding框架：1）从匿名化的真实社交媒体帖子中直接提取开放式、高保真度的用户profile；2）在两种范式下评估——训练时通过监督微调(SFT)实现参数化个性化；3）测试时通过非参数化的多视角推理利用profile。
AI.result: 在复杂推荐和开放式查询基准测试中，行为grounded的profile持续提升基础模型性能，并在多个维度上优于合成profile基线，实现更强的参数化对齐，并支持更丰富、多面的推理。
AI.conclusion: 开放式、行为衍生的profile为下一代个性化语言系统提供了高度多样化和有效的基石，验证了从真实用户行为中提取profile相比合成persona的优越性。

title: trajectory-judge: What Outcome-Only LLM Judges Miss on Agent Trajectories
comment: 16 pages (8-page main text). Under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. Code, data, and raw verdicts: this https URL
summary: Outcome-only evaluation is the production default for LLM agents: show a judge the request and the final reply and ask whether it was handled well. The metric is structurally blind to an agent that reaches the right answer the wrong way. We measure that blind spot where ground truth is known by construction: a deterministic tool-using support-desk environment, a scripted oracle policy that always solves it, and a fault injector that breaks exactly one thing at a known step, stratifying faults by whether the customer-visible outcome survived (silent) or not (loud). Five judges (programmatic rules, outcome-only, step-rubric at two model sizes, and a self-consistency ensemble) are scored on detection, step localisation, fault typing, calibration, and cost over 400 trajectories. The outcome-only judge catches 84% of loud faults but 45% of silent ones while flagging 33% of correct trajectories; a step-rubric judge reaches 77% silent recall with zero false alarms at 3x the cost. No judge reads the final reply: an invented promise appended to an otherwise perfect trajectory evades the rules entirely and the step judge 82% of the time, and self-consistency triples cost while improving nothing. We argue that judge evaluations must stratify recall by outcome survival, and release the environment, the injector, all raw verdicts, and an analysis pipeline that rebuilds every number offline.

AI.tldr: 本文指出LLM智能体评估中常用的"仅看结果(outcome-only)"评判方法存在结构性盲区：通过构建一个支持台客服测试环境，对比5种评判器在400条轨迹上的检测、定位、分类、校准和成本表现。结果显示纯结果评判器对"静默故障"(结果正确但过程错误)的召回率仅45%，且对33%的正确轨迹误报；而引入逐步审视的评判器可将静默召回率提升至77%且零误报，但仍无法识别最终回复中无中生有的承诺。作者强调必须按"结果是否被破坏"分层报告召回率，并发布完整可复现的测试环境与评判结果。
AI.motivation: 工业界默认采用"仅看请求和最终回复"的结果级评判来评估工具调用型LLM智能体，但该指标对"以错误方式得到正确答案"的故障结构性失明。这类静默故障会逃过上线门禁进入生产环境，而评估评估者本身通常依赖人工标注，形成了循环依赖。
AI.method: 构建一个"构造即正确"的测试台：(1) 确定性客服支持环境，7个工具，宽松执行+严格规则检查器；(2) 脚本化oracle策略，由测试套件断言其正确性；(3) 6种单点故障注入器，每种破坏恰好一处并在已知步骤注入，按"客户可见结果是否存活"分为静默/响亮两类；(4) 5种评判器对比——规则引擎、仅结果(14B)、逐步(14B)、逐步(8B)、自一致性集成(14B×3)；(5) 在400条轨迹上评估检测/定位/分类/校准/成本五个维度，采用分层配对bootstrap(10,000次)给出95%置信区间；(6) 释放完整环境、注入器、原始裁决及离线分析流水线。
AI.result: (1) 静默盲区量化：仅结果评判器对响亮故障召回84%，对静默故障仅45%，同时33%正确轨迹被误报；(2) 逐步评判器(同模型)将静默召回率提升至77%，且对100条干净轨迹零误报(F1=0.923)，代价为3倍成本；(3) 规则引擎免费、零误报、定位完美，但漏掉全部静默故障中的57%(对工具意图和回复文本结构性失明)；(4) unsupported_claim类故障所有评判器均表现极差：规则0%、逐步14B仅18%、集成16%，因为没有任何评判器真正"读"最终回复；(5) 8B逐步评判器退化为"恒报故障"基线(397/400)，F1=0.852仅反映故障基率；(6) 自一致性集成(成本3倍)在所有质量轴上与单次贪心解码差异不显著，校准反而变差(ECE +0.051)，是明确负面结果；(7) 逐步评判器检测几乎完美但分类macro-F1仅0.606(将35/50 hallucinated_argument错判为wrong_tool)，检测与归因是两个不同问题。
AI.conclusion: 必须按"结果是否存活"分层报告评判器召回率，否则静默故障会被池化指标掩盖。评判器看到的视图(view)决定其能力上限而非模型强度——同模型仅改变输入视图，静默召回从45%跃升至77%。应将最终回复的事实核查作为独立任务而非寄希望于轨迹评判器覆盖。在部署前应以"恒报故障"基线做能力底检查，并将检测与归因分别评估。注入故障衡量的是评判器的能力(capability)而非部署中各类故障的频率，两者是不同问题。

title: RAPIDMap: Rapid Multi-Agent Pipeline for Interpretable Disaster Mapping from Satellite and Street-view Imagery
summary: Rapid and reliable disaster mapping of impacted areas, damaged infrastructure, and affected populations is essential for emergency response and recovery. However, existing AI-based approaches often require extensive manual annotation, lack cross-hazard generalization, and rely on single-modal observations. To address these challenges, this paper proposes RAPIDMap, a rapid multi-agent pipeline for zero-shot interpretable disaster mapping from satellite and street-view imagery. The framework integrates four intelligent agents: Disaster Perception Agent (DPA), Image Restoration Agent (IRA), Damage Recognition Agent (DRA), and Disaster Mapping Agent (DMA). By combining remote sensing and street-view data, RAPIDMap eliminates the need for manual fine-tuning, generalizes across multiple disaster categories, and generates structured, map-ready disaster intelligence with recovery recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAPIDMap，一种基于多智能体的零样本可解释灾害制图流水线，通过融合卫星和街景图像实现快速灾害感知、修复、识别与制图，无需人工微调，跨灾种泛化能力强。
AI.motivation: 现有AI灾害制图方法依赖大量人工标注、缺乏跨灾害泛化能力、且多基于单一模态观测，难以满足应急响应对快速、可靠制图的需求。
AI.method: RAPIDMap框架集成四个智能体：灾害感知智能体（DPA）、图像修复智能体（IRA）、损伤识别智能体（DRA）和灾害制图智能体（DMA），结合遥感与街景数据进行多模态协同处理。
AI.result: 该框架消除了对人工微调的依赖，能够跨多种灾害类别泛化，并生成结构化、可制图的灾害情报及恢复建议。
AI.conclusion: RAPIDMap为零样本、可解释的多灾种灾害快速制图提供了一种有效的多智能体解决方案。

title: Task-Specific Prompt with Global Context for Multi-Task Graph Pre-Training
summary: Graph prompt learning is an effective paradigm to adapt pre-trained graph models to downstream tasks in low-resource scenarios. However, existing multi-task graph pre-training frameworks generally use randomly initialized prompts, leading to poor alignment between the prompt space, pretext objectives and graph structural characteristics. This greatly weakens the task relevance, structural awareness and transferability of prompt representations. To address this challenge, we propose TPGC, a dual-prior prompt initialization solution that explicitly models the synergy between task prior and structural prior. Specifically, the Task-Prior Injection Module first conducts a short homologous multi-task pre-training on an auxiliary graph, enabling prompt initialization to inherit optimization preferences associated with multiple pretext tasks. Built on the task-aware representations, the Structure-Prior Injection Module further extracts transferable global structural context from the auxiliary graph, converting it into layer-wise prompt vectors by aggregating structurally informative node embeddings. Extensive experiments on 6 mainstream benchmarks covering node and graph classification show that TPGC achieves consistently better performance under few-shot settings than state-of-the-art baselines, with fewer downstream tunable parameters and lower runtime. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: TPGC提出了一种用于多任务图预训练的双先验提示初始化方法，通过任务先验注入模块(TPIM)和结构先验注入模块(SPIM)显式地将任务相关先验和图结构上下文注入提示初始化过程，在少样本场景下取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图提示学习方法在预训练阶段通常使用随机初始化的提示，导致提示空间与预训练目标及图结构特征之间对齐性差，削弱了提示表示的任务相关性、结构感知能力和可迁移性。论文受NLP和视觉领域关于提示初始化重要性的研究启发，首次从提示初始化角度重新审视多任务图预训练。
AI.method: TPGC包含三个阶段：(1)提示初始化阶段——TPIM在同源辅助图上进行一轮多任务预训练以注入任务先验，SPIM从辅助图提取可迁移的全局结构上下文，通过计算节点与任务相关全局嵌入的余弦相似度选取top-k节点，聚合生成层级提示向量；(2)目标域多任务预训练阶段——将初始化提示注入共享图编码器进行多任务联合优化；(3)下游提示适配阶段——冻结预训练提示作为先验，与下游任务特定提示融合进行预测。提示初始化过程可离线完成，不增加目标域预训练的计算开销。
AI.result: 在6个主流基准数据集（涵盖节点分类和图分类任务）上的少样本（1-shot和5-shot）实验中，TPGC在大多数数据集上一致优于包括GCN、GAT、DGI、GraphCL、GraphPrompt、MultiGPrompt、ProNoG在内的强基线。消融实验验证了TPIM和SPIM的互补性。t-SNE可视化显示TPGC初始化的提示向量更接近高密度语义区域，损失收敛更快。下游阶段参数量(522)与MultiGPrompt相同但远少于ProNoG(2564)，运行时间也显著低于ProNoG。
AI.conclusion: TPGC通过任务先验和结构先验的双重注入，有效提升了多任务图预训练中提示初始化的质量和下游少样本性能，同时保持了轻量级的下游适配开销。未来工作将探索该方法在异质图（连接节点具有不同标签或语义）场景下的有效提示初始化。

title: GUI-CC: Benchmarking Contextual Consistency of GUI World Models as Agent Environments
summary: GUI world models are increasingly evaluated as one-step next-screen predictors, yet their intended use is often as multi-step environments for GUI agents. This mismatch leaves a key requirement under-tested: generated states must remain contextually consistent when they are repeatedly reused for future interaction. We introduce GUI-CC, a benchmark that evaluates contextual consistency of GUI world models as agent environments rather than isolated next-screen predictors. GUI-CC contains two complementary tracks: an offline reference-action track that rolls models along real mobile GUI trajectories, and an online agent-loop track that lets fixed probing agents interact with model-generated UIs. We construct 500 offline trajectory tasks from GUIOdyssey and 200 emulator-verified online tasks across 30 mobile apps. GUI-CC evaluates transition fidelity, transition plausibility, contextual consistency, and task progress. Experiments show that plausible single-step generation does not guarantee reliable environment simulation: current models often produce usable-looking screens while failing to preserve task-relevant context or support executable multi-step rollouts.

AI.tldr: GUI-CC 是一个用于评估 GUI 世界模型作为智能体环境时上下文一致性的基准测试，包含离线参考动作轨迹和在线智能体循环两条互补评估轨道，揭示了当前模型在多步交互中虽能生成视觉合理的屏幕但难以维持任务相关上下文的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 GUI 世界模型评估主要将其视为单步下一屏幕预测器，但这些模型的实际用途是作为多步骤的智能体交互环境。单步生成的视觉合理性并不能保证生成状态在反复回用时仍能保持上下文一致性，这一关键需求在现有评估中未被充分测试。
AI.method: 提出 GUI-CC 基准，包含两条互补评估轨道：(1) 离线参考动作轨道——沿真实移动 GUI 轨迹滚动模型，包含 500 个基于 GUIOdyssey 构建的任务；(2) 在线智能体循环轨道——让固定的探测智能体与模型生成的 UI 交互，包含 200 个跨 30 个移动应用的模拟器验证任务。评估涵盖四个维度：转换保真度、转换合理性、上下文一致性和任务进度。评估了 12 个 GUI 世界模型（包括代码/HTML 输出型和直接图像生成型），共 18 种配置。
AI.result: 实验显示当前 GUI 世界模型在任务进度维度表现最差：离线轨道中最佳模型的参考动作进度仅为 16.7；全局视觉相似度较高但细粒度 UI 元素对齐和布局完整性仍然很低（最佳得分低于 20）；许多模型能生成可用外观的界面但无法正确建模动作效果；添加历史信息能改善一致性指标但对任务进度的提升有限。错误分析表明 42% 失败源于缺乏世界知识，33% 源于错误累积，25% 源于上下文不一致。
AI.conclusion: 视觉合理且上下文一致性得分高的屏幕并不一定支持任务执行，这暴露了"令人信服的屏幕"与"可执行环境"之间的差距。短程历史带来的有限增益表明未来模型需要持久化的状态表示和更强的动作效果知识，而非仅依赖视觉记忆。缩小这一差距对于可扩展的 GUI 智能体训练和评估至关重要。

title: REAL-Q: E2E LLM Quantization via Dynamic Gradient Descent
comment: Proposes a highly efficient end-to-end LLM quantization paradigm that significantly outperforms most existing state-of-the-art baselines
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) under strict resource constraints. State-of-the-art PTQ methods quantize each layer with a single closed-form second-order solver: to remain analytically tractable, they heavily approximate the global loss (dropping cross-channel coupling, pooling output rows into groups), and they then freeze the resulting Hessian across the entire layer, with no way to refresh it as the loss landscape shifts column by column--a phenomenon we call information misalignment. We propose REAL-Q (Real-time E2E-loss Aligned LLM Quantization), a novel PTQ paradigm that breaks this compromise: instead of diluting the objective for the sake of analytic tractability, REAL-Q targets an end-to-end-aligned surrogate of the global loss and refines it via fine-grained, dynamic Block-wise Gradient Descent applied after every column block (128 columns). By coupling this fine-grained correction with a sliding window mechanism for smooth cross-layer transitions, REAL-Q effectively mitigates error propagation across the network. On LLaMA-3.1 (8B and 70B) and Qwen3 (0.6B-32B) at W4A16, REAL-Q reduces end-to-end KL divergence by up to ~49% relative to state-of-the-art globally-guided methods.

AI.tldr: REAL-Q提出了一种新的LLM训练后量化(PTQ)范式，通过在GPTQ列扫描过程中每隔128列插入一次基于Adam的动态块梯度下降(Block-GD)步骤，并使用聚合Fisher MSE作为端到端对齐的代理损失，以解决现有静态二阶求解器因Hessian冻结导致的"信息失准"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA PTQ方法（如GPTQ、GPTAQ、GuidedQuant）依赖单次闭式二阶求解器，需对全局损失做大量近似（丢弃跨通道耦合、对输出行分组池化），且将所得Hessian在整个层内冻结，无法在逐列量化过程中随损失景观变化而刷新，导致误差在列间累积（作者称为"信息失准"）。
AI.method: 三核心组件：(1) 聚合Fisher MSE损失——对KL散度在transformer块输出处做二阶Taylor展开，用完整的Fisher矩阵（保留跨通道耦合）作为代理目标，反向传播限制在至多两个相邻块内；(2) 动态块梯度下降(Block-GD)——在GPTQ列扫描的每128列后插入一步Adam更新，对剩余未量化列做在线一阶修正，将修正粒度从层级提升约两个数量级；(3) 损失滑动窗口——在相邻transformer块边界处线性插值两块Fisher损失，平滑目标不连续。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1 (8B/70B)与Qwen3 (0.6B-32B)的W4A16上端到端KL散度最多比GuidedQuant降低约49%（Qwen3-1.7B）；在W3A16/W2A16低比特权重量化及W4A4KV4、W3A4KV4、W2A4KV4权重-激活量化设置上均一致优于RTN/GPTQ/GPTAQ/GuidedQuant；消融实验显示块大小B=128（更细粒度）对性能影响最大；余弦相似度实验证实其代理梯度与真实端到端梯度保持高对齐度，而基线接近零对齐。
AI.conclusion: REAL-Q通过用动态一阶优化替代静态闭式二阶求解器，打破了PTQ中"精度-可分析求解"的权衡，在端到端KL散度上取得SOTA；理论分析证明静态求解器在结构漂移假设下累积Ω(n)的不可补偿误差，并给出了保证真实全局损失下降的余弦相似度条件。代价是校准阶段需额外计算与显存开销（F, O(d²)每块），未来可通过系统级内存优化与跨模块优化器状态传递进一步改进。

title: Towards Agentic Cloud Engineering: Graph and Loop Engineering with a Zero-Trust Agent Harness
summary: Agentic AI is enabling cloud-based workflows in which autonomous agents reason over operational state, invoke authorized tools, modify software and infrastructure, deploy services, verify execution outcomes, and adapt across long-horizon, multistep tasks. Engineering such workflows requires explicit mechanisms for workflow progression, constrained execution, failure recovery, and verifiable completion. We present Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering, an agentic AI framework that transforms natural-language agentic cloud-engineering tasks into validated code repositories and verified operational cloud deployments for automating cloud-based agentic workflows. The framework separates three complementary concerns: graph engineering specifies long-horizon workflow progression and verification-dependent transitions; loop engineering provides bounded diagnosis, repair or re-planning, retry, and re-verification; and agent harness engineering enforces zero-trust execution through identity, authorization, policy-scoped capabilities, isolation, and runtime safeguards. Workflow progression and completion require machine-checkable repository, deployment, and runtime evidence, with recovery constrained by explicit operational bounds and termination criteria. We instantiate the framework on Google Cloud and evaluate repository completeness, controlled execution, evidence-gated progression, operational deployment, and bounded recovery. Experimental results show that executions terminate with either a verified operational cloud deployment or an auditable terminal failure under bounded recovery. The framework provides a unified engineering architecture for cloud-based workflows spanning Agentic DevOps, Agentic CloudOps, Agentic SRE/AIOps, Agentic SecOps, Agentic DataOps, Agentic MLOps/LLMOps, AgentOps, Agentic RAG/GraphRAG, and related cloud-engineering domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体云工作流工程"(Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering)框架,通过图工程、循环工程和零信任智能体承载工程三大抽象,将自然语言云工程任务转化为经验证的代码仓库和云部署。基于Google Cloud实现并构建140任务基准测试,跨14个领域评估4个模型。
AI.motivation: 随着云架构规模和复杂度提升,自主智能体被越来越多地用于云工程工作流。然而,长时域、多步骤的智能体云工作流需要明确的工作流推进机制、受约束的执行、失败恢复和可验证的完成判定。现有研究缺乏将工作流控制、恢复约束和零信任执行统一结合的工程框架。
AI.method: 框架分离三个互补关注点:(1)图工程——通过Graph Orchestrator(基于Google ADK)管理工作流状态、转换、分支、依赖、恢复路径和验证依赖的转换;(2)循环工程——通过Reflection/Diagnosis和Repair/Re-plan智能体提供有界诊断、修复/重规划、重试和重新验证,受重试次数、时间、token、工具调用和成本预算约束;(3)智能体承载工程——通过零信任执行边界执行身份认证(IAM/WIF)、授权(RBAC/ABAC)、策略(OPA Gatekeeper)、批准门、凭证管理(Secret Manager),通过MCP提供策略作用域工具访问,通过VS Code/Chrome/gVisor沙箱隔离执行,通过Cilium/Service Mesh/Falco保障网络安全。完成条件要求机器可验证的仓库、部署和运行时证据三者全部满足。
AI.result: 构建包含140个任务(14领域×10)的基准测试,每任务在6种受控条件下执行(正常执行、仓库/部署/运行时验证扰动、授权策略违反、恢复预算耗尽),共840任务-条件对,4个模型共3360次执行。关键结果:VTCR从Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite的56.4%递增至GPT-5.6 Sol的95.0%;EGER、UCDR、BTR在所有模型上均为100%;ACPR为99.3%;RSR从51.0%到93.1%。恢复成功率随验证类型递降(仓库>部署>运行时)。消融实验显示移除恢复循环使VTCR从95.0%降至12.9%,将机器验证门控替换为模型判定使EGER从100%降至99.0%。跨14领域分析表明框架强制机制(EGER/UCDR/BTR)保持稳定,而任务完成和恢复性能具有模型和领域依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 框架通过将模型无关的验证强制与模型依赖的恢复能力解耦,实现了可靠的端到端云工程自动化。实验支持验证任务完成、受控推进和恢复、授权和策略执行、有界终止以及跨领域适用性。该工作为生产级自主云工程提供了统一的工程架构,涵盖DevOps、CloudOps、SRE/AIOps、SecOps、DataOps、MLOps/LLMOps、AgentOps、RAG/GraphRAG等14个领域。未来工作将扩展至多云验证、生产长时运行评估、自适应恢复、强化验证和对抗鲁棒性。

title: From Detection to Refusal: Safer LLMs via Circuit-Guided Weight Scaling
comment: Accepted to Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Despite extensive alignment efforts, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to generating unsafe content under adversarial prompting, yet the internal mechanisms by which safety behaviors are implemented remain poorly understood. We study LLM safety from a mechanistic interpretability perspective and characterize a multi-stage *safety circuit* that organizes refusal behavior, consisting of (i) $\textbf{Harmful Detection Heads}$ that respond to harmful inputs, (ii) $\textbf{Safety Neurons}$ that mediate and stabilize safety signals in the residual stream, and (iii) $\textbf{Refusal Heads}$ that translate these signals into safe response generation. Using targeted attention-head and neuron-level interventions, we provide causal evidence consistent with this circuit organization, showing that suppressing upstream Harmful Detection Heads disrupts downstream refusal behavior and that safety neurons mediate this interaction. We validate that this decomposition recurs across multiple LLM architectures and adversarial attack settings, and use simple, architecture-preserving weight scaling as a mechanistic probe to test its functional relevance. Across six LLMs, circuit-guided scaling improves safety rates under attacks by 26.5%, while incurring only a 1.7% accuracy drop across four standard benchmarks. Overall, our results support a circuit-level interpretation of LLM safety and suggest that mechanistic abstractions can reveal stable and transferable patterns underlying aligned behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文从机制可解释性角度揭示了LLM内部安全行为的多阶段"检测-拒绝"电路,并提出一种无需训练的电路引导权重缩放方法(CBSE),可在大幅提升对抗攻击下安全率的同时仅损失极小的通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐方法(如RLHF、 adversarial training等)多在行为或语义层面操作,缺乏对模型内部如何实现安全检测与拒绝的理解,无法回答"安全行为在网络内部如何组织"这一根本问题。已有可解释性工作多关注单一组件的归因,未能刻画多组件协同的安全机制。
AI.method: 提出三阶段安全电路:(1) Harmful Detection Heads——通过配对的harmful/neutral提示,识别选择性关注有害token差异的注意力头;(2) Safety Neurons——MLP神经元,在残差流中中介和稳定安全信号;(3) Refusal Heads——将安全信号转化为拒绝/安全回复的注意力头。通过targeted ablation和activation patching验证因果路径。在此基础上,提出Circuit-Based Safety Editing (CBSE),通过对这些组件的输出投影权重(W^O和W^down)进行简单的乘法缩放,无需训练即可强化安全通路。
AI.result: 在6个LLM(LLaMA-3-8B、LLaMA-2-7B、Mistral-7B、Guanaco-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B)上,CBSE在GCG攻击下平均安全率从43.2%提升至69.7%(+26.5%),在4个标准基准(MMLU、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande)上仅平均下降1.7%准确率。联合缩放检测头+拒绝头(+安全神经元)效果最佳;在PAIR、AutoDAN-HGA、ADV-LLM等自适应攻击下也表现稳健。消融实验显示仅移除1-5%的电路组件即可使安全率崩塌至接近0%,证明该电路是安全对齐的结构性支柱。CBSE优于CircuitBreakers,与LAT持平,且优于SmoothLLM和Activation-Steering,同时不引入推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: LLM的安全拒绝行为可被分解为跨层组织的多组件电路(detection→safety neurons→refusal),该结构在多种架构中稳定重现。基于机制理解的简单权重缩放即可在最小效用代价下大幅增强对抗鲁棒性,表明机制可解释性不仅能理解LLM行为,还能为对齐提供实用工具。局限在于电路基于静态快照识别,未考虑持续训练下的动态演化。

title: Zero-Shot Respiratory Sound Classification through LLM-Augmented Audio-Text Alignment
summary: Self-supervised respiratory encoders lack semantic grounding in clinical domain needed for zero-shot inference, limiting their utility without task-specific labeled data. We propose a framework that aligns these encoders with medical terminology in a shared latent space turning them into a zero-shot-capable foundation model. To address paired data scarcity, we use a medical LLM to synthesize structured reports from metadata, creating dense semantic anchors for contrastive learning. Our training combines a sigmoid-based contrastive loss with encoder's native SSL objective and similarity-aware negative sampling to sharpen pathological boundaries. Across 9 tasks on 6 datasets, our method achieves a 61.3% mean zero-shot AUC, surpassing CLAP (51.4%) and Qwen2-Audio (54.9%) while reaching the highest linear probing AUC (71.6%) with only 43% of data used by full-scale baselines, showing that structured semantic alignment outperforms large-scale, general-purpose models in clinical diagnostics.

AI.tldr: REACH是一种语义对齐框架，通过LLM增强的对比学习将预训练的单模态呼吸音编码器与医学文本表示对齐，实现零样本呼吸音分类，无需配对的音频-报告数据。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督呼吸音编码器虽能捕获声学特征但缺乏临床语义锚定，导致零样本推理能力受限；通用音频-文本模型因缺乏临床语言基础，在呼吸诊断任务上表现不佳。核心问题不是表征学习，而是表征对齐。
AI.method: 1) 使用医学LLM(GPT-4)将离散元数据合成为结构化临床报告作为语义锚点；2) 采用SigLIP-based sigmoid对比损失对齐音频-文本空间；3) 保留编码器原生SSL重构损失作为结构正则化器；4) 基于FAISS的相似性感知负采样(取第k=10远端负样本)以锐化病理边界；5) 文本编码器(MedSigLIP文本分支)冻结作为固定语义参考。
AI.result: 在6个数据集9个任务上：零样本平均AUC达61.3%，超越CLAP(51.4%)和Qwen2-Audio 7B(54.9%)；线性探测平均AUC达71.6%(最高)，仅使用全规模基线43%的训练数据(+6.2 over OGT†)。消融实验验证了各组件必要性：去除MSE正则化使零样本AUC下降7.2点，用BERT替换MedSigLIP下降11.4点。
AI.conclusion: 呼吸零样本诊断的主要障碍不是声学表征质量，而是其与临床语义的脱节。通过将LLM作为元数据-报告翻译器，成熟的单模态模型之间的定向语义桥接比扩大预训练规模或从头构建多模态架构更具样本效率，这一原则可推广至其他具有结构化元数据的临床领域。

title: ValueGraph: Value-Signal Guided Graph Pre-training for Contextualized User Representation
summary: Value signals are aggregated user-level moral representations that capture users' inferred value-related tendencies from their online discourse. User behavior on social media is shaped not only by what users say or whom they interact with, but also by the value signal through which they express attitudes. Existing user representation methods largely miss this value-relevant dimension. We propose ValueGraph, a graph pre-training framework that uses automatically inferred moral-value signals as noisy auxiliary signals for contextualized user representation. From post-reply graphs, ValueGraph learns semantic and structural representations and further aligns users through relative value similarity with contrastive and clustering objectives. Rather than treating inferred values as gold psychological labels, ValueGraph uses them as soft constraints for representation learning. Experiments on stance detection and twitter bot detection show consistent gains over strong text-based, graph-based, and text-only LLM baselines, highlighting value-signal guidance as a useful inductive bias for socially informed user modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ValueGraph，一种以道德价值信号作为辅助监督的图预训练框架，用于学习融合语义、结构与价值相关线索的社交媒体用户表示，并在立场检测与Twitter机器人检测任务上取得了一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有用户表示方法主要依赖文本内容或交互网络结构，假设交互相似的用户应具有相似嵌入，但忽视了驱动行为的潜在因素（如价值倾向）。在争议性话题中，交互相似可能源于共同曝光或争议本身而非真实价值一致，导致推荐与建模中的伪关联和回音室问题。论文引入道德基础理论（MFT）作为价值维度，以弥补用户行为建模中对价值信号的忽略。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 基础GNN预训练阶段——在post-reply对话图上基于GraphMAE2进行掩码图自编码，节点特征用ModernBERT编码，学习抗噪的post表示；(2) 价值引导预训练阶段——利用MoralBERT对每个post在10个MFT道德维度上打分，聚合得到10维用户价值向量h(u)，并以此作为"软约束"而非"金标准"标签：基于百分位采样构建正负用户对，使用InfoNCE对比损失L_user对齐价值相似用户；同时周期性执行K-means聚类，结合紧凑性损失与边界损失形成L_cls正则化全局结构；总损失为L = L_user + λ·L_cls。理论上证明L_user可保持价值信号相似度排序、L_cls可促进簇内紧凑与簇间分离。
AI.result: 在MT_CSD与RumourEval19立场检测任务上，ValueGraph在准确率和宏F1上均优于GraphCL、GraphMAE2、BERTweet、SimCSE、ModernBERT、GCN/GAT/GTN、GPT-5.4等基线（MT_CSD acc 63% vs 最强基线60%；RumourEval19 macF1 71% vs 最强PLM 59%、最强图方法45%）。在TwiBot-22机器人检测任务上，将ValueGraph嵌入替换RoBERTa、BotRGCN、BotGAT、BotGCN的T/G特征后，多个配置取得统计显著的提升（如BotGAT-TG macF1 66% vs 64.3%）。消融实验表明，仅L_user或仅L_cls均无法带来稳定提升，二者联合才获得一致增益。t-SNE可视化显示ValueGraph的bot-human分离更清晰。
AI.conclusion: ValueGraph验证了从MFT自动推断的"噪声"价值信号可作为有价值的归纳偏置，提升用户表示的社交感知能力；语义/结构图预训练与价值引导对比+聚类的层次化目标互为正则，可在立场检测与机器人检测上获得稳定增益；该方法不预测用户真实心理价值，仅用作相对软约束，并强调结果应理解为数据集层面而非个体层面。

title: CUDA-Harness: Harnessing Agentic CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization from Natural Language
summary: Developing high-performance CUDA kernels demands specialized knowledge in algorithm implementation, correctness validation, and hardware-aware parallel optimization, creating a substantial expertise barrier and making generating CUDA kernels directly from natural language (Text2CUDA) essential. Meanwhile, the general-purpose code generation capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) prompts a series of works exploring LLM-based CUDA kernel generation. They mainly focus on transpilation from high-level frameworks such as PyTorch to CUDA (Torch2CUDA) rather than Text2CUDA, where models must understand the high-level input semantics and handle low-level kernel implementation and validation. Additionally, these methods are vulnerable to reward hacking due to reliance on predefined test inputs. In this paper, we propose CUDA-Harness, a framework for harnessing agentic CUDA kernel generation and optimization from natural language. Specifically, we introduce Intermediate-Structured Generation to connect high-level semantic understanding with low-level kernel generation. To dilute reward hacking in Text2CUDA, we construct Synthesis-Based Verification to provide isolated test data and progressive validation. Furthermore, we propose Feedback-Adaptive Evolution, a kernel evolution strategy that prioritizes correctness while optimizing performance. Finally, through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of CUDA-Harness, with further evaluations illustrating generalization across LLMs, hardware platforms, and to C-to-CUDA transpilation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUDA-Harness框架，用于从自然语言自动生成并优化CUDA内核（Text2CUDA），通过中间结构化生成、基于合成的验证和反馈自适应进化三个组件解决语义理解、测试数据缺失和奖励欺骗等问题。
AI.motivation: 高性能CUDA内核开发门槛极高，需要算法实现、正确性验证和硬件并行优化等专业知识。现有LLM方法主要关注Torch2CUDA转译而非Text2CUDA，且依赖预定义测试输入易遭受奖励欺骗（reward hacking），导致对错误实现进行错误方向的优化。
AI.method: CUDA-Harness包含三个核心组件：(1) Intermediate-Structured Generation——通过"内核实现清单"（kernel implementation manifest）和"自包含CUDA脚手架"（self-contained CUDA scaffold）两个中间蓝图，将高层语义理解与底层内核实现解耦；(2) Synthesis-Based Verification——在隔离环境中通过标准数值库（如NumPy、PyTorch）解耦合成测试数据，并采用渐进式多阶段验证（编译→功能正确性→性能分析），通过MCP工具包暴露统一接口；(3) Feedback-Adaptive Evolution——结合"正确性优先的精炼"（编译失败则修复，功能失败则回退到保守实现）和"奖励驱动的优化"（使用RLVR，通过Diff和奖励变化提取优化洞见进行迭代优化，N=3轮，每轮G=3个候选）。
AI.result: 在CUDABench上的实验表明，CUDA-Harness在编译成功率、功能正确率和运行时性能分数（RScore）上均显著优于基线（Baseline）、OpenCode、Codex、KernelSkill和CudaForge。在Level 3最难级别上，Func.从baseline的47.6%提升至70.4%，RScore从66.6提升至100.4。消融实验验证了三个组件的必要性。合成验证与基准验证的一致性达到84.4%。在跨LLM（DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-5.1）、跨硬件（A40、GTX 1660 SUPER、Jetson AGX Orin）以及C-to-CUDA转译（BabelTower）场景下均表现出良好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: CUDA-Harness验证了自然语言作为CUDA内核开发接口的可行性，通过系统的中间结构化生成、解耦验证和正确性优先的进化策略，有效弥合了高层意图与底层实现之间的鸿沟，并能跨LLM、跨硬件及跨任务范式泛化。

title: DISTAL: Distillation and Self-Supervised Pretraining for Structure-Agnostic Materials Property Prediction
summary: Materials property prediction remains difficult in low-data settings, where many target properties are supported by only a limited number of labeled samples. Models with the strongest predictive accuracy often depend on crystal structures, which restricts their use in early-stage screening when structural information is limited or unavailable. To address this challenge, we propose DISTAL, a dual-prior framework for structure-agnostic materials property prediction that combines self-supervised compositional pretraining with structure-aware knowledge distillation. DISTAL first learns transferable compositional representations from a large virtual composition space using 145 composition-derived descriptors. It then distills structural knowledge from a pretrained ALIGNN teacher into a composition-conditioned student. This setting allows structural priors to be used during training without requiring structural inputs at inference. By integrating explicit compositional descriptors, pretrained latent features, and distilled structural features within a unified prediction pipeline, DISTAL captures complementary signals that are difficult to recover from any single representation alone. Across 39 benchmark tasks, the best-performing multimodal configuration combines all three signals, and improves over the reference benchmark on 37 tasks. DISTAL achieves the strongest overall performance among all evaluated feature combinations. These results indicate that compositional pretraining and structural distillation provide complementary priors and offer a practical route to robust composition-only prediction in small-data materials informatics. The source code and the pre-trained models are anonymously available at: this https URL and will be released at the official link after acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DISTAL框架，一种用于结构无关（structure-agnostic）材料属性预测的双先验方法，结合自监督组合预训练与结构感知知识蒸馏，在低数据条件下实现无需晶体结构输入的准确属性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有材料属性预测模型依赖晶体结构输入，限制了在早期筛选阶段（结构信息缺失或不完整时）的应用；同时许多目标属性仅有少量标注样本，传统监督学习难以获得高精度。亟需一种无需结构输入、适用于低数据场景的预测方法。
AI.method: 1. 组合表征预训练：基于145个组合衍生描述符，在大规模虚拟组合空间上学习可迁移的组合表征；2. 结构感知知识蒸馏：从预训练的ALIGNN教师模型中蒸馏结构知识到组合条件化的学生模型，使训练时利用结构先验、推理时无需结构输入；3. 多模态融合预测：将显式组合描述符、预训练潜特征与蒸馏结构特征统一整合于预测流程，捕获互补信号。
AI.result: 在39个基准任务上，最佳多模态配置融合全部三种信号，在37个任务上超越参考基准；DISTAL在所有评估特征组合中取得最优综合性能。
AI.conclusion: 组合预训练与结构蒸馏提供互补先验，为小数据材料信息学中的稳健组合-only预测提供了可行路径；DISTAL在低数据、无结构输入条件下实现SOTA性能。

title: ReNFT: Repairing Mode Collapse in Reward Post-Training via Internal Probability-Mass Recalibration
summary: Reward post-training of diffusion generators inevitably concentrates probability mass on a few reward-favored modes, a mode collapse that erases within-prompt diversity. Existing methods for mitigating collapse rely on external signals or interfaces, augmenting the reward with perceptual objectives, adjusting reference regularization, or modifying the text encoder, but none repairs an adapter that has already collapsed while preserving the acquired reward. We observe that online post-training primarily reallocates probability mass over capabilities inherited from pretraining rather than learning new visual content. Collapse is therefore suppression, not deletion, and can be reversed from within the generator. We propose ReNFT, which repairs a high-reward, low-diversity adapter through internal probability-mass recalibration. Unconditional probes first prioritize "anti-hub" prompts where the prompt-independent bias is easiest to expose. Two policy-dominated mixed routes then generate matched counterfactual proposals from the same prompt and initial noise, one probing the frozen base direction for suppressed alternatives and the other exposing the post-trained unconditional tendency. Reward ranking with an adaptive flipping guard assigns pull and push roles, and a joint-and-paired NFT update realizes the repair. On PickScore and GenEval, ReNFT retains 98.9% and 99.0% of NFT's reward while improving DreamSim-Div by 58.8% and 55.0%, respectively, offering a complementary alternative to external interventions.

AI.tldr: ReNFT 提出一种"内部概率质量重标定"方法，用于修复扩散生成器奖励后训练中已坍缩的高奖励适配器，无需外部多样性目标或文本编码器修改，在保留 98.9–99.0% 奖励的同时将 DreamSim-Div 提升 55–58.8%。
AI.motivation: 奖励后训练（特别是 NFT 这类高效优化器）会引发模式坍缩——同一提示下不同初始噪声映射到相似输出，导致提示内多样性丧失。现有缓解方法（奖励重塑、参考正则化、接口修改）均依赖外部信号或改动，且难以修复已坍缩适配器。本文旨在回答：能否仅利用生成器内部分布修复已坍缩适配器，同时保留已获得的奖励？
AI.method: 核心观察：在线后训练是对预训练继承能力进行概率质量重分配，坍缩是"抑制而非删除"，可通过生成器内部路径恢复。方法包含三阶段：① 无条件探针识别"反枢纽"提示（与无条件 hub 相似度最低）；② 两种策略主导的混合路由（bθθ 与 θθu）从相同提示和初始噪声生成匹配的反事实样本，分别探测被抑制的备选方案和暴露后训练偏差；③ 奖励排序分配 pull/push 角色，配合自适应翻转守卫（保持路由 A 占比 ≥0.5），通过原生噪声联合更新（σ_t=1）与新噪声配对更新（σ_t<1）的 NFT 式损失实现修复。训练时使用混合路由，推理时使用标准条件前向传播。
AI.result: 在 SD3.5-M 上：PickScore 协议保留 NFT 奖励的 98.9%（23.26 vs 23.51），DreamSim-Div 提升 58.8%（0.189 vs 0.119）；GenEval 协议保留 99.0% 奖励（0.937 vs 0.946），DreamSim-Div 提升 55.0%（0.231 vs 0.149）。三种多样性指标（LPIPS-Div、DreamSim-Div、DINOv3-Div）均优于 Flow-GRPO、DiffusionNFT、DiverseGRPO 和 E²PO 等基线。在 FLUX.2-klein-base 4B/9B 上无需重调即迁移成功，奖励保留 98.7–98.9%，DreamSim-Div 提升 33–35%。消融验证了反枢纽提示选择、混合路由模式（bθθ/θθu）以及 EMA 衰减（0.25）的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 奖励诱导的模式坍缩是内部概率质量压缩而非删除，可通过生成器自身的内部路径（冻结基座 + 无条件路由）反向校准。ReNFT 作为外部干预的补充范式，证实了"从内部修复"是可行的，无需牺牲奖励即可恢复被抑制的多样性。

title: RePro: Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Mathematical Problem Solving
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Data contamination undermines the reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on mathematical problem solving. While rewriting-based evaluation mitigates memorization, existing methods lack guarantees of problem validity and answer correctness. We propose Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting (RePro), the first framework to integrate Lean-oriented neural automated theorem provers (ATPs) into benchmark rewriting, which rewrites problems and regenerates answers with correctness ensured by Lean-verified proofs. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH show that RePro's retained rewritten instances achieve 100% well-definedness, feasibility, and answer correctness, while existing methods still produce invalid or incorrect instances. Moreover, several models exhibit accuracy drops on proof-verified rewritten benchmarks, suggesting that their performance is sensitive to surface-level and structural variations and may partly reflect memorization effects. Our source code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RePro提出了一种基于Lean形式化证明验证的数学基准重写框架，通过整合神经自动定理证明器(ATP)和Lean内核验证，确保重写后的问题具有良好的定义性、可行性和答案正确性，解决了现有重写方法无法保证问题有效性和答案正确性的问题。
AI.motivation: 数据污染问题使得LLM在数学问题上的评估结果不可靠。现有基于重写的评估方法（如Auto-Dataset、ITD、VarBench）依赖启发式验证（LLM-as-a-Judge或规则检查），无法提供关于问题有效性和答案正确性的确定性保证，从而削弱了基准测试的可靠性。
AI.method: RePro采用渐进式验证流程：(1) LLM生成重写问题并执行可行性筛选（数值重参数化、逻辑重构、约束修改、上下文重建）；(2) 将重写问题转化为Lean 4可执行形式化语句，进行格式检查和语义一致性筛选（三次一致性判断全通过策略）；(3) 使用Lean导向的神经ATP（如Goedel-Prover-V2-8B）生成候选证明，经Lean内核验证；(4) 从已验证证明中提取答案并进行目标-答案匹配。组件包括Qwen3-MAX（重写）、Goedel-Formalizer-V2-8B（形式化）、Goedel-Prover-V2-8B（证明生成）。
AI.result: 在GSM8K和MATH上，RePro保留的重写实例在良好定义性、可行性和答案正确性上均达到100%，而现有方法在MATH上的正确率仅为79.99%-87.36%。人类对2400个实例的独立审计与自动判断完全一致。多个模型在重写后准确率下降（如Qwen2-1.5B在Level 1-3下降10-21个百分点），表明性能受表面和结构变化影响，可能部分反映记忆效应。生成率受ATP能力限制（GSM8K为88.31%，MATH为59.16%），在AIME等高难度基准上当前ATP能力不足。
AI.conclusion: RePro是首个将神经ATP和Lean证明助手验证整合到基准重写流程中的框架，提供了形式化验证保证的问题有效性和答案正确性。实验证明该方法在保留实例上实现了100%的可靠性保证，优于现有启发式重写方法，同时能揭示模型对基准重写的敏感性及潜在的依赖记忆或基准特定模式的现象。局限性在于对ATP能力的依赖以及Lean形式化约束。

title: Medical Causal Hypothesis Verification with Large Language Models
summary: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for search and information retrieval underscores the need to evaluate their reliability in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. Although LLMs can effectively answer questions about diseases, symptoms, and treatments, their ability to accurately assess causal relationships and ground their conclusions in verified scientific evidence remains unclear. Here, we present a preliminary, small-scale study that investigates the accuracy of LLMs in evaluating causal medical claims and supporting them with peer-reviewed research. We propose an evaluation framework for causal hypothesis verification that can be used to systematically track the performance of existing and future LLMs. We assess the performance of eight LLMs on 17 medical causal hypotheses to evaluate whether they can reliably verify these hypotheses using scientific evidence from the literature. We systematically annotate the scientific evidence they provide according to six criteria (a total of 1,067 annotation points) and assess them with nine evaluation metrics. Our analysis shows that while LLMs exhibit strong recall, they often perform poorly at providing valid scientific articles and evidence for support and at rejecting unsupported hypotheses. These findings highlight a critical limitation of current LLMs, as they cannot yet be trusted fully to verify causal relationships from the biomedical literature. This work underscores the need for rigorous evaluation before using LLMs for search and retrieval in healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了8个大语言模型在医学因果假设验证任务中的表现，发现LLM虽然能较好地识别真实的因果关系，但在拒绝不成立的假设以及提供可验证的科学文献证据方面表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在医疗等高风险领域的信息检索中应用日益广泛，评估其因果推理能力和提供可验证科学证据的可靠性至关重要。此前研究未系统评估LLM在验证因果声明时的证据检索能力。
AI.method: 提出因果假设验证评估框架，使用标准化提示模板，对8个LLM（Mistral、Deepseek-R1/V3、Gemini Flash/Pro、Qwen、GPT-4o、Llama-4-Maverick）在17个由临床医生验证过的医学因果假设上进行测试，通过Label Studio进行人工标注（共1,067个标注点），从6个维度和9个评估指标进行系统评估。
AI.result: LLM的假设分类准确率为0.53-0.82，F1分数为0.64-0.88，大多数模型召回率接近1.0但特异性较低（0.17-0.50），存在大量假阳性。有效文献比例仅11%-58%，正确URL比例为0%-44%，几乎所有模型都无法准确提取原文摘要，直接引文的准确率也极低（0-4%，仅GPT-4o达到41%）。Gemini Pro和DeepSeek-R1在提供真实文献方面表现较好，Llama-4-Maverick在分类准确性上最优。模型规模、RAG架构和内部推理能力均影响表现。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM尚不能完全信赖用于生物医学文献中的因果关系验证，在因果推理与科学证据可靠性之间存在明显差距。LLM在拒绝不成立假设和提供可追溯的真实文献证据方面能力有限，常产生幻觉引用，在医疗等高风险场景中应谨慎使用。

title: Attention Sensitivity Is Not Enough: Dissociating Attention-Level and Behavioural In-Context Learning under Fine-Tuning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets large language models adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, and fine-tuning can erode this behaviour. Many preservation diagnostics inspect attention: if attention changes when demonstrations change, the model is treated as context-sensitive. This paper asks how far that proxy can be trusted once it is optimised. We formalise \emph{In-Context Sensitivity} (ICS), the average row distance between last-token attention on matched and mismatched demonstration prefixes, and pair it with \emph{ICL-GAP}, the behavioural accuracy gap between the same prefixes. In a controlled four-arm ablation on Llama-2-7B, an ICS-maximising regulariser ($\armKL$) drives ICS to $1.413$, within $0.5\%$ of its geometric ceiling. The behavioural readout tells a different story: ICL-GAP stays near zero and MMLU accuracy moves from $0.371$ to $0.279$, a Goodhart dissociation of the bounded attention proxy. Endpoint statistics locate the mechanism: attention grows sharp and near-disjoint across prefixes yet routes to formatting and demonstration-body tokens rather than labels.
