AI.result: 在WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR三个基准（Qwen3-32B分类器）上：Macro F1相比检索基线最高提升10.0pp（Flipkart L3 +4.4pp绝对），所有列均最优；关键提升在统计学上显著（p<0.05，paired bootstrap）。错误分解表明：混淆伙伴将候选集Recall从86%提升至98.1%（Flipkart L3），而知识注入将LLM miss率从21.9%降至17.1%——两种机制互补。**跨模型迁移**：Qwen3-235B生成的规则可迁移到2B–20B模型，小模型（2–4B）最高+11.5pp，中模型（8–20B）最高+11.1pp，且固定知识库不重训也能提升6.6–10.3pp。**鲁棒性对比**：相比ModernBERT/RoBERTa微调，干净数据下微调领先（80.0/81.7 vs 76.7），但在20%标签噪声（72.1 vs 60.0/61.0）、10%数据稀缺（70.2 vs 23.2/31.8）、测试扰动平均下降（-5.0 vs -17.0/-9.0）等场景下本文方法显著更稳健。**人类评估**：50条随机规则中87.3%被三位作者独立判定为正确且有用。**对比试验**：混淆伙伴优于单纯增大K（K=10+伙伴 vs K=20检索：74.2 vs 72.2 F1），成对规则格式优于逐标签格式。**成本**：离线生成一次性消耗3.26M–15.52M tokens，推理时中位延迟从379–429ms升至879–1238ms。**剩余错误分析**：737个Flipkart L3错误中，9.9%为检索遗漏、20.8%为标签体系本身的不一致、31.2%为真正的语义重叠（如Western/Ethnic/Fusion Wear）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将LLM分类错误转化为有针对性的消歧规则，无需微调即可提升准确率。两机制协同：混淆伙伴保证正确标签在候选集中，成对规则帮助模型在相似候选间做选择。在三个基准上Macro F1最高提升10.0pp，大模型生成的规则可向小模型迁移（最高+11.5pp）。框架仅需一次性离线错误分析，跨层级与扁平标签体系均适用。局限：依赖带标签训练数据；离线阶段可能需随标签体系或模型混淆模式变化而重跑；规则未经自动验证（虽87.3%经人类判定合格，高风险场景仍需领域专家审核）；尚未测试多语言输入、极大标签体系及时间漂移场景。

title: Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs
summary: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal region, the set of allocations within a specified tolerance of peak performance. Empirically, this region is wide even for small tolerances (2-10%), widens with model scale, and transfers reliably from small proxy models to large target models. This yields a practical strategy: small proxy-model experiments suffice to identify a transferable near-optimal region, eliminating the need for exhaustive large-scale search. Our results hold consistently across tasks, model families, and both preference-based off-policy and reward-supervision on-policy RL methods. We further analyze how the asymmetry in annotation costs between SFT and RL data shifts the near-optimal region.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM后训练中SFT与RL阶段之间固定标注预算的分配问题，提出以"近最优区域"代替单一最优比率的概念，实证证明该区域在小容差（2-10%）下已较宽，且随模型规模扩大而增宽，并可从小型代理模型可靠迁移到大型目标模型，从而避免大规模网格搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅刻画了SFT-RL预算分配的粗略趋势（如低数据下SFT占优），缺乏原则性的分配框架，且未考察最优比率在不同尺度模型间是否可迁移。后训练任一阶段的调整都需从头重训，全规模网格搜索代价高昂。
AI.method: 将问题重新定义为寻找ε-近最优区域而非单一点最优r*；在Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、Qwen 3模型族（最大14B）上，覆盖数学、指令跟随、摘要、有用性四项任务，在5点分配网格和不同预算下进行后训练扫描，分别使用DPO（离策略）和GRPO（在策略）两种RL方法；定义网格受限的近最优区域宽度估计量（范围宽度与计数宽度），测量跨尺度迁移率T_ε，并分析SFT与RL标注成本非对称（ρ∈{1,2,5,10}）下的区域变化；最终提出"代理扫描-选择容差-选择比率"三步实用流程。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 即使在2-10%的小容差下，近最优区域已覆盖55-75%的可行分配空间；(2) 固定容差下，近最优区域随模型规模N系统地增宽；(3) 区域比点最优更可靠地在跨尺度间迁移，代理方法在94.3%（ε=5%）和97.1%（ε=10%）的案例中满足容差；(4) 结果在任务、模型族、离策略/在策略RL方法中一致；(5) SFT相对成本越高（ρ越大），区域越宽，分配灵活性越大。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了"近最优区域"作为后训练SFT-RL预算分配的实用目标，证明小型代理模型足以识别可迁移的近最优区域，避免昂贵的大规模搜索；该结论在多种设置下稳健。局限性在于分析限于两阶段SFT→RL流水线、最大14B模型、在分布训练设置以及DPO/GRPO两种RL方法；未来工作可扩展到多阶段或交错调度以及标注成本不确定的自适应设置。

title: The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统性地提出"语言强化学习"（Verbal Reinforcement Learning, VRL）这一范式，即智能体通过自然语言反馈（自生成、人类提供或外部工具产生）来改进行为与决策。文章围绕"语言何时介入智能体生命周期"这一核心轴线，提出三支柱分类体系：(1) 语言作为基础信号——在问题定义阶段指定MDP的目标、状态、动作与奖励；(2) 语言作为审议反馈——在推理时通过批判、记忆、辩论或搜索来优化输出，不更新参数；(3) 语言作为学习信号——在训练时将语言反馈蒸馏为梯度更新以持续重塑策略。同时讨论了横跨各支柱的关键挑战，包括反馈模型质量、工具接口设计、对抗性鲁棒性与理论基础的缺乏。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习依赖精心设计的环境、动作空间和奖励函数，在任务模糊、上下文依赖的开放场景中难以直接编码。大语言模型的出现使自然语言成为新的监督通道——可以传达意图、偏好和因果结构。但现有研究缺乏统一框架来整合使用语言反馈的各种方法（自修正、RLHF、奖励代码生成等），因此需要一个系统性的分类体系来揭示其内在联系并指导未来研究。
AI.method: 提出以"语言何时介入智能体生命周期及修改什么"为轴线的三支柱分类法：(1) 语言作为基础信号（Grounding Signal）——在问题定义阶段映射到MDP各组件，分为目标基础、状态基础、动作基础、奖励代码生成四个子类；(2) 语言作为审议反馈（Deliberative Feedback）——在推理时运行，分为自我批判、外部基础批判、多智能体辩论、经验记忆、搜索引导审议五个子类；(3) 语言作为学习信号（Learning Signal）——在训练时使用，按语言压缩程度分为反馈条件建模、自我改进、过程监督、偏好塑形四个子类。通过统一的编程智能体工作示例展示三支柱的协同运作。
AI.result: 本文贡献包括：首次全面综述VRL，提出三支柱分类体系；在每个支柱下综合代表性方法、识别子类别、概述语言塑造智能体行为的独特作用；总结四大横跨性挑战——反馈模型质量（专用反馈模型优于生成-评判共用模型）、工具接口设计（需面向智能体可消费性重构）、对抗鲁棒性（攻击可绕过所有现有防御）、理论基础缺失（需用PAC学习、POMDP、率失真理论等建立形式化保证）。该分类法揭示了语言反馈正成为定义、更新和改进智能体的主要媒介，未来瓶颈将从"生成反馈"转向"验证反馈"。
AI.conclusion: 语言反馈正迅速成为智能体架构中的一流设计原语。三支柱之间的界限将日益模糊，智能体将在统一循环中同时跨越基础、审议与学习。未来的关键基础设施需求包括反馈溯源机制、质量基准、对抗鲁棒性评估，以及为智能体可消费性而非人类可读性重新设计的工具接口。语言反馈与标量奖励的取舍将取决于具体的场景与理论基础的发展。

title: CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: this https URL ; Data: this https URL
summary: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.

AI.tldr: CordisBench 是一个包含 1,200 道题目的基准测试，用于评估语言模型在动态代理环境中对组件生命周期（依赖管理与清理）的推理能力。研究发现，模型在小型系统中表现良好，但随着交互数量增加，最终状态预测和跨拆卸顺序的推理可靠性显著下降，且增加的推理开销会带来实质性的成本。
AI.motivation: 随着 DeepSeek Harness 等系统允许语言模型在运行时动态修改其执行环境（插件、服务等），模型需要承担新的推理负担：局部的插件变更可能通过依赖关系和清理机制传播。然而，当模型必须独立预测这些后果（无符号辅助或执行反馈）时，其推理能力的可扩展性是一个尚未充分研究的开放问题。
AI.method: 论文提出了 CordisBench 基准测试，结合受控的形式化设置和基于 Cordis 运行时的可执行程序。任务涵盖：定位受影响组件（Localization）、预测指定拆卸顺序后的状态（Schedule prediction）、判断在所有/部分顺序下成立的条件（Guaranteed/Reachable conditions）以及选择可成功执行的重配置方案（Reconfiguration）。通过在 2、4、8、16、24、32 个相关交互的不同规模下扩展，测试 Gemini 3.7 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna 和 DeepSeek V4 Flash 三款高效模型的低推理努力表现，并使用确定性的任务特定评分。
AI.result:
1. 模型通常能处理小型系统，但随着相关交互增加（尤其是最终状态预测和跨拆卸顺序推理），可靠性会下降。例如 GPT-5.6 Luna 的形式化可达条件 Jaccard 从 91.7% 降至 14.1%，Cordis-native 重配置执行成功率从 62.5% 降至 25.0%。
2. 增加推理努力可显著提升部分模型的可靠性，但成本不菲：在 16 交互子集上，GPT-5.6 Luna 在中等努力下每题平均使用近 3,000 个推理 token。
3. 短路径控制实验显示最佳基线仅达 7.3% 的整体精确匹配率，验证了基准的必要性。
4. 独立的有限参考语义在所有 528 个可执行问题上与 Cordis 执行结果完全一致，表明这些受控实例的机械后果可以被精确计算。
AI.conclusion: CordisBench 揭示了生命周期变更的"识别影响"与"预测后果"之间的能力差距。论文建议代理框架应显式表示依赖关系和清理效果，直接计算或验证其机械后果，让语言模型专注于更高层次的目标及无法形式化的推理，从而同时提高可靠性和推理效率。

title: Adaptive Critical Token-Aware Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
summary: The repository-level code generation task requires synthesizing code that satisfies task requirements while remaining consistent with the target repository context. Since real-world repositories often exceed the input length limits of LLMs, existing approaches commonly adopt retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide repository-specific context. Despite improving repository-context retrieval, existing methods typically provide context as task-level support, without explicitly identifying the critical tokens that require fine-grained repository context during generation. During the autoregressive generation process of LLMs, errors often concentrate at a small number of decisive positions: once such tokens are generated incorrectly, subsequent code may follow an incorrect semantic path and eventually lead to functional failure. We refer to these positions as "critical tokens". In this paper, we propose ACToR, an adaptive critical token-aware retrieval framework for repository-level code generation. ACToR identifies critical tokens during generation and triggers targeted retrieval on demand to provide repository context at these decisive positions. In addition, we design a position-aware weighting method for dense retrievers to prioritize context that is more informative for generation. We evaluate ACToR on two representative repository-level benchmarks, RepoExec and CoderEval. Experimental results show that ACToR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving relative improvements of 8.4% on RepoExec and 15.4% on CoderEval. Beyond performance gains, we systematically quantify the impact of critical tokens, revealing their central role in major generation failures and highlighting the necessity of targeted retrieval strategies. We provide the code and data at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ACToR提出"关键令牌"概念，在代码生成自回归过程中实时识别易引发级联错误的决策性位置，按需触发针对性检索，并在RepoExec和CoderEval基准上相对SOTA提升8.4%-15.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级代码生成的RAG方法以任务级粒度提供上下文，将检索视为生成前的预处理步骤，忽略了自回归生成中错误集中于少数"关键令牌"的特性。单个API名、变量引用、索引或控制流令牌的错误会引导后续代码沿错误语义路径生成，最终导致函数级失败。
AI.method: 框架包含离线训练和在线推理两阶段。离线阶段：基于RepoST-Train构建训练数据，通过三项准则——Token Mismatch（top-1预测与真值不符）、Uncertainty（预测熵）、Subsequent Attention Influence（后续Top-5注意力均值）——用teacher-forcing方式为每个位置标注是否为关键令牌，再以自信息排序平衡正负样本，训练3层MLP集成分类器（仅约4-10M参数）以LLM最终层隐藏状态为输入。在线推理：采用双端点高斯加权池化替代平均池化（提升序列头尾权重），每个生成步将隐藏状态送入分类器，若被判为关键令牌则用（任务提示+已生成代码+当前令牌）构建新查询触发二次检索，重新解码当前步并保留更新后的上下文指导后续生成。
AI.result: 在RepoExec和CoderEval上，使用DeepSeekCoder（1.3B/6.7B）和CodeLlama（7B/13B）四个模型，ACToR均一致超越RawPrompt/RawRAG/RepoCoder/RLCoder基线，相对提升最高达15.4%（CoderEval, CodeLlama-7B Pass@5）。消融实验显示三项标注准则和两个运行时模块均不可缺，位置感知加权检索与动态关键令牌纠正互补。关键令牌仅占总令牌5%-11%，但承担了大部分模型错误与不确定性，语法上错误与不确定性集中于关键字，注意力则偏向结构性的定界符与操作符。端到端推理时间2.66s/样本，低于RepoCoder的4.50s。
AI.conclusion: ACToR首次系统量化了"关键令牌"对仓库级代码生成的决定性影响，并提出按需触发的令牌级检索框架与位置感知加权池化方法，在精度、效率和多样性上均达到SOTA，为令牌级RAG提供了新范式。

title: Efficient SWE Agent Benchmarking via Trajectory-Aware Evaluation
summary: Evaluating software engineering agents on realistic benchmarks is costly, since each task may require multi-step code exploration, modification, and test execution. Existing efficient evaluation methods select representative subsets to estimate full-benchmark performance, but are largely result-only: they fit historical pass/fail response matrices or static task semantics, discarding how agents solve problems. We propose PTA-IRT, a Privileged Trajectory-Aware Item Response Theory framework that fuses process and outcome signals. Historical execution trajectories supply process-level evidence beyond pass/fail, such as explored context, attempted edits, and solving paths, which PTA-IRT uses as privileged information for calibration subset selection and ability estimation. Under low calibration budgets, PTA-IRT consistently outperforms prior IRT baselines on score and ranking recovery across four SWE benchmarks. Code and data are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出PTA-IRT框架，将历史执行轨迹作为特权信息融入项目反应理论（IRT），以低校准预算实现SWE智能体基准测试的分数与排名恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有高效基准评估方法仅利用历史通过/失败的二值响应矩阵，丢弃了智能体如何解决问题的过程级信号（如探索上下文、尝试编辑、求解路径），导致在低校准预算下分数与排名恢复不准确。
AI.method: PTA-IRT包含三阶段：(1) 将异构执行轨迹解析并通过LLM压缩为含Task Goal、Context Explored、Edits Executed、Path Overview四字段的结构化过程摘要；(2) 拟合轨迹感知的四参数logistic(4PL)IRT模型，利用Fisher信息与有效样本量(ESS)加权的Info分数进行难度分层校准子集选择；(3) 通过教师-学生LUPI框架，将特权过程知识蒸馏到仅依赖共享参数的学生模型，测试时通过L-BFGS在小子集上拟合标量能力并外推到全基准。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Lite/Verified/Full/Pro四个基准、10%校准预算下，PTA-IRT在所有指标上均优于MLE、MCMC、VI、VIBO、Deep-IRT、PSN-IRT、AutoJudger等基线（平均MAE 0.041，Kendall τ 0.888，Spearman ρ 0.973）；消融实验证实轨迹打分器、LUPI和分层选择均贡献增益；summary dropout实验表明过程摘要的内容是收益来源而非冗余通道，ESS机制能有效保护低质量摘要下的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体执行轨迹作为特权信息融入IRT，可显著提升低预算SWE基准评估的效率与可靠性，为agentic基准的成本控制提供了一种数据驱动的新范式。

title: BlockMGARD: Accelerating Adaptive Scientific Data Reduction with Region-of-Interest Error Control on GPUs
summary: The growing scale of scientific data makes lossy compression essential for reducing data volume under controllable error. Transformation-based compressors using multilevel decomposition, such as MGARD, achieve strong compression ratios but map poorly to GPU architectures. We propose BlockMGARD, an adaptive, Region-of-Interest (ROI)-supported GPU lossy compressor, with four contributions: (1) an In-cache Block decomposition leveraging GPU on-chip memory and constant lookup tables to accelerate decomposition; (2) a hybrid hierarchy combining In-cache Block and global decomposition to balance speed and compression ratio; (3) an end-to-end pipeline with fine-grained ROI error control for feature preservation; and (4) an evaluation against state-of-the-art methods on five real-world datasets. Compared to MGARD-X, BlockMGARD achieves up to 4.2x and 9.1x higher compression and decompression throughput, and up to 8.63x higher compression ratio than uniform-tolerance baselines under ROI-aware error control. Across four GPUs, BlockMGARD achieves near-ideal linear scaling and up to 1.58x I/O cost reduction over MGARD-X.

AI.tldr: BlockMGARD是一个面向GPU的自适应、支持感兴趣区域(ROI)误差控制的科学数据有损压缩器，通过In-cache Block分解、混合层次结构和内核融合等技术，解决了MGARD等多级分解变换压缩器与GPU架构不匹配的问题，在压缩/解压吞吐量和ROI压缩比方面均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 科学数据量持续快速增长（TB至PB级），远超存储和I/O子系统的带宽增长能力，导致数据移动和存储成为关键瓶颈。现有基于变换的有损压缩器（如MGARD、ZFP）虽能实现高压缩比，但其多级分解的复杂计算模式和数据依赖与GPU架构（需要规则、高并行工作负载）匹配度差，导致：1）内存访问密集、计算效率低；2）线程间同步开销大；3）并行性受数据维度限制；4）分解层次结构与GPU内存层次不匹配；5）不支持细粒度的ROI误差控制。因此需要重新设计数据分解方法以适配GPU架构。
AI.method: BlockMGARD采用标准"变换-量化-无损编码"流水线，包含四项核心技术创新：(1) **In-cache Block分解**：使用8×8×8的固定块大小，整个工作集（约9.3KB双精度）完全驻留在GPU共享内存中，仅需两次全局内存事务（初始加载和最终存储）；通过constexpr查找表将索引计算移至编译期，消除运行时分支和分歧，保证warp执行一致性。(2) **混合层次架构**：结合L层In-cache Block局部分解和M层MGARD全局分解（L+M为总层次深度），用户可通过参数L在速度和压缩比之间权衡；提出基于排队理论和小定律(Little's Law)的解析吞吐量模型TP(N)=N/(1/Slope+N/TP_peak)，识别性能拐点（FP32约8012块，FP64约5073块），并基于时间预算的自动参数选择算法。(3) **ROI误差控制**：在块粒度上分配多级容差（严格τ₂<正常τ₁<背景τ₀），通过保守的容差传播策略（粗层块继承最严格容差）保证跨容差边界的L∞误差界；用户可通过值域、梯度阈值或显式空间掩码指定ROI。(4) **内核融合**：将量化直接融合到In-cache Block分解核中，387个线程在共享内存中直接量化并写出量化符号，避免全精度系数的全局内存往返。
AI.result: 在5个真实科学数据集（NYX、Hurricane ISABEL、SCALE-LETKF、Miranda、S3D）上的实验评估表明：(1) **In-cache Block分解**：单层分解吞吐量为233-381 GB/s（vs全局分解44-120 GB/s），加速比3.16×-5.26×（平均4.1×）；重构加速比2.79×-4.40×（平均3.5×），在窄维度数据集上效果尤为显著。(2) **混合层次**：在3层分解深度下，L=2/M=1相比Full Global实现1.72×-2.96×加速；纯局部配置（L=5/3/1）实现2.18×-8.10×加速；但压缩比可能下降（纯局部配置在S3D上降至0.15×），需至少保留一层全局分解以保证质量。(3) **端到端流水线**：BlockMGARD-Fused相对MGARD-X实现压缩吞吐量2.04×-4.17×（平均2.7×）、解压吞吐量1.69×-9.13×（平均4.6×）的加速。(4) **ROI感知压缩**：在REL 1e-4下，相对最优统一容差基线，在Miranda上实现8.63×压缩比提升（34.78×），S3D上提升1.84×（42.75×）；视觉质量评估显示BlockMGARD在ROI内保持高保真度的同时，在匹配压缩比下优于VGC（严重质量退化）和cuZFP（块边界伪影）。(5) **并行I/O与可扩展性**：相对未压缩I/O实现最高14.8×的I/O成本降低；在4个H100 GPU上实现近线性扩展（平均效率99.3%压缩、99.8%解压），峰值聚合吞吐461.9 GB/s压缩、391.9 GB/s解压。
AI.conclusion: BlockMGARD通过将分解工作集限制在共享内存、结合局部与全局分解的混合层次、以及块粒度的ROI误差控制，成功解决了变换基有损压缩器与GPU架构的不匹配问题。In-cache Block分解通过消除冗余全局内存访问实现高达5.26×的单层吞吐量提升；混合层次在用户指定时间预算下自动平衡速度与压缩比；保守容差传播策略在保证L∞误差界的前提下实现最高8.63×的压缩比提升（在ROI感知模式下）；内核融合进一步提升吞吐量且无压缩比损失。在5个真实科学数据集和4个H100 GPU上的评估表明，BlockMGARD在吞吐量和压缩效率方面均显著优于当前最先进的MGARD-X，展示了其在高性能科学计算中作为GPU加速有损压缩解决方案的有效性。

title: Operation-Type-Aware Client Routing for Leader-Based Consensus Datastores
summary: Leader-based consensus datastores (etcd, ZooKeeper) face two competing routing goals: spread load evenly across members, and route operations to the member whose protocol role matches the operation. Writes must commit through the leader, so sending them elsewhere adds a forwarding hop. Linearizable reads need only a lightweight leader confirmation before any member can serve them locally. The upstream etcd client uses gRPC's round_robin balancer, distributing reads and writes uniformly across cluster members. An operation-aware client resolves this by pinning writes to the leader and distributing reads across the healthy read pool. In steady state on a 3-node etcd cluster (80/20 read/write mix, 5 trials), this lowers write P50 by 29% and raises throughput by 9%. When a follower degrades silently, the operation-aware client detects the latency shift and removes it from the read pool, cutting read P99 by 64%, write P99 by 74%, and raising throughput by 89%. The same routing rule applied to ZooKeeper (ZAB protocol, different implementation) points in the same direction, showing that the result follows from leader-based consensus structure rather than one system's implementation. The key obstacle to discovering this policy adaptively is that the leader confirmation round-trip occurs between cluster members, so the client sees only a blended latency signal rather than the decisive coordination cost directly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种操作类型感知的混合路由策略(hybrid)，将写入操作定向到领导者、读操作分布到健康成员池，并在成员退化时将其移出读池。在3节点etcd集群上(80/20读写比)将写P50降低29%，在同可用区follower退化场景下将读P99降低64%、写P99降低74%、吞吐量提升89%。
AI.motivation: 领导型共识数据存储(如etcd、ZooKeeper)的默认客户端(etcd使用gRPC的round_robin)将读写请求均匀分配给所有成员，但这违反了共识协议的角色不对称性：写入必须经领导者提交，发往follower只会增加转发跳；而可线性化读仅需领导者的轻量确认即可由任何成员本地服务。因此论文挑战"将成员视为可互换端点"的传统负载均衡假设。
AI.method: 在自定义Go基准客户端中实现三种路由策略：(1) round_robin基线策略；(2) Boltzmann基于EWMA延迟的softmax自适应策略；(3) 混合策略hybrid——写入绑定到领导者，读操作分布到健康读池(若某成员读延迟EWMA超过集群中位数ρ=2倍则剔除)。领导者通过后台每250ms的Status()轮询刷新，写入失败时清除缓存并回退到round_robin。实验在3节点和5节点跨AZ的etcd v3.5.17集群上进行，跨系统验证使用ZooKeeper 3.9.2(ZAB协议)，端到端验证通过修改kube-apiserver的etcd客户端完成。
AI.result: 核心结果：(1) 健康稳态3节点(80/20混合)：hybrid相对round_robin，写P50从6.22ms降至4.39ms(-29.4%)，读P50几乎不变，吞吐量从14536升至15809 ops/s(+8.8%)；(2) 同AZ follower注入8ms延迟(灰色故障)：hybrid将对该节点的读流量从约33%降至0.5%，读P99从47.02ms降至16.84ms(-64.2%)，写P99从34.31ms降至8.97ms(-73.9%)，吞吐量从8377升至15841 ops/s(+89.1%)；(3) 5节点集群：写P50降低36.7%，并随并发增加差距扩大；(4) 纯读扫描：分布式读在所有响应大小下均优于纯领导者读，500键范围查询差距达178%；(5) ZooKeeper实验呈现一致方向；(6) 领导者选举：启动时单次检测会失效，hybrid配合活动刷新和回退可在约3秒内恢复，接近stock表现。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出"共识成本不可见性(consensus-cost invisibility)"原则：客户端观察到的延迟是读服务的快速信号与写转发的隐藏成本混合后的混合信号，因此纯延迟自适应无法恢复正确的稳态路由规则。正确的客户端路由应基于操作语义(读分布式、写至领导者)而非仅基于观察延迟；延迟信号仅应用于检测退化成员(充当渐进式熔断器)。该原则源自领导型共识的结构而非具体实现，并已促成etcd项目issue #22268提议的两阶段客户端设计。

title: Client-side transparent caching for remote ROOT data analysis
summary: High-energy physics analyses often process the same data as physicists refine algorithms and test new ideas. With data increasingly read from remote storage, each iteration is subject to network latency and depends on network bandwidth and shared-storage throughput, which can vary substantially under load. We present uCache (xrd-ucache), a transparent client-side cache implemented as an XRootD client plugin that requires neither server-side deployment nor changes to analysis code. It uses local storage on the analysis machine as a cache layer between the network and memory. The cache stores only the data actually read by an analysis. It can also rebuild cached data into a branch-aligned, recompressed form, eliminating most of the input/output and decompression costs of subsequent passes. We benchmark the cache using the Analysis Grand Challenge top quark pair analysis on public CMS Open Data compressed with zlib and LZMA. Filling the cache adds essentially no overhead compared with a direct read. Subsequent passes are 1.6-8.8 times faster from the byte cache and 2.1-15.7 times faster from the recompressed cache. For a typical analysis, a 1 TB cache suffices for datasets of 10-20 TB. The largest improvements occur when the remote data source is heavily loaded or geographically distant.

AI.tldr: uCache（xrd-ucache）是一个透明客户端缓存，以XRootD客户端插件形式实现，将分析机器的本地存储作为网络与内存之间的缓存层，仅存储分析实际读取的数据；其可选的副本层（replica tier）可将缓存数据重排为分支对齐、可重新压缩（如LZMA-9→ZSTD-1）的形式。对CMS Open Data上的AGC 𝑡𝑡̄分析基准测试显示：首次填充几乎无额外开销（0.1–1.2%），后续pass在字节缓存上提速1.6–8.8倍，在副本层上进一步提速至2.1–15.7倍。1 TB缓存可支持10–20 TB数据集；在远距离或高负载远程数据源上收益最大。
AI.motivation: 高能物理分析是迭代过程，物理学家反复读取同一远程数据集，每次迭代都受网络延迟、带宽和共享存储吞吐量的影响，而共享远程源性能可能在小时级波动数倍。需要一种透明、低开销的客户端缓存机制，使重复分析pass在本地高速存储上完成，减少对远程源的依赖。
AI.method: 设计为XRootD客户端插件（libXrdClUCache.so），无需服务器端部署或分析代码修改。两层结构：（1）字节层以4 KiB页粒度稀疏缓存，仅存储分析请求的数据范围，配CRC32C校验和原子元数据更新，LRU淘汰，默认7天有效期，自动fail-open回退；（2）副本层从字节层本地构建，将basket重排为分支主序（branch-major），并可将LZMA-9转码为ZSTD-1，背景构建并支持sweep模式。在6台机器（桌面/工作站/设施节点/云VM/Mac mini）上用AGC 𝑡𝑡̄分析（9个RDataFrame图，读15个NanoAOD分支）对两个数据集（zlib-1 AGC 2015 1.8 TB / LZMA-9 UL2016 2.4 TB）做端到端基准，每pass仅读取约6%字节；与XCache、与RNTuple格式、对4个ROOT版本做对比；识别四种限制资源（远程延迟、存储请求率、存储带宽、解压CPU）并匹配相应优化。
AI.result: 字节缓存填充开销0.1–1.2%（最快源达3.1%），均在≤10%设计目标内。热pass相对直接读取提速1.6–8.8×（字节层）和2.1–15.7×（副本层），LZMA-9收益最大。副本层将用户态指令数降低1.31×（zlib-1）和3.20×（LZMA-9）。文件打开节省约20 s固定+3 ms/文件。缓存仅存数据集6–9%，1 TB缓存支撑10–20 TB工作集。vs 调优XCache：填充快14.2–22.6×，磁盘占用约1/3，副本层快1.18–2.44×。RNTuple降低字节层增益（本地源1.15× vs TTree 1.58×），但远距离仍获益。冷填时背景构建在有空余核时几乎无开销（总成本1.00–1.09×纯填充），全占用工作站需~7次重复pass回本。云卷（IOPS限制~1000）下字节层慢6.9×，副本层慢3.0×——缓存存储性能必须匹配工作负载。
AI.conclusion: uCache将分析机器的NVMe转化为持久缓存层，置于页缓存与站点基础设施之间。重复分析pass运行速度由本地存储和算力决定而非远程源，且热时间在约1%内可复现，远比远程读取基线稳定。最大收益出现在远距离/高负载远程源、重压缩格式（LZMA-9）和TTree数据集上。即使在RNTuple+快速压缩、邻近源的极限情况下，本地性单独仍可在当前一代设施节点上获得3.5×加速。分析机器的本地存储在结构上快于其公平份额的网络层，因此应将缓存置于分析机本身而非站点代理。

title: DRLM: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based LLM Query Orchestration in Edge Environments
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, 1 table, accepted for publication in Globecom 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) services increasingly process heterogeneous queries with diverse latency, accuracy, and resource requirements. While edge deployment reduces response time, the heterogeneity of devices and the diversity of model families, parameter scales, and quantization levels make efficient LLM query orchestration challenging. This paper introduces DRLM, a Deep Reinforcement Learning-based LLM query orchestration framework in edge environments. DRLM integrates two lightweight predictors: (i) a class-conditioned quality estimator that maps queries to semantic categories and infers model performance, and (ii) a feature-driven latency predictor that estimates inference time across model-device configurations. These predictions, combined with system state, feed a factorized Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent that performs state-aware orchestration decisions. To enable data-driven orchestration, we construct a large-scale benchmarking dataset with 223 835 measurements spanning 1258 queries, 6 query classes, 8 model families (32 deployed instances), 5 quantization levels, and heterogeneous edge devices. Evaluation on a 64-node edge cluster and comparison with three baselines and two state-of-the-art methods show that DRLM reduces inference latency by up to 51% and queuing delay by up to 67 %, while incurring at most 8% accuracy loss. It improves latency under increasing workloads up to 61.4%, demonstrating robust and stable orchestration.

AI.tldr: DRLM是一种基于深度强化学习的框架，用于在异构边缘集群中实现细粒度的LLM查询编排。它通过集成类别条件质量估计器、延迟预测器和因子化PPO代理，联合建模查询语义、模型配置和动态系统状态，以做出每查询的模型-设备分配决策。在64节点边缘集群上的评估显示，推理延迟降低高达51%，排队延迟降低高达67%，准确率损失最多仅8%。
AI.motivation: 边缘部署LLM服务时面临设备异构性和模型多样性（不同家族、参数规模和量化级别）的挑战。现有方法要么针对固定模型优化执行，要么执行简化的模型选择，将延迟和质量视为静态，无法联合捕捉查询语义、模型配置和动态系统状态，导致在异构边缘环境中无法进行细粒度的每查询编排。需要一种状态感知的、联合建模查询-模型-系统动态的编排框架。
AI.method: DRLM框架包含五个模块：(1)查询分析器提取结构化和语义特征；(2)基于MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入和随机森林的查询分类器将查询映射到6个语义类别；(3)性能预测器包括类别条件质量估计（基于类的查找表）和基于LightGBM的延迟预测器（R²=0.75）；(4)运行时监控器跟踪设备利用率和队列状态；(5)编排代理采用因子化PPO，将动作空间分解为模型家族/参数、量化级别和设备选择三个阶段，使用128单元的两层MLP编码器。奖励函数结合归一化预测质量和指数惩罚的端到端延迟。构建了包含223,835条测量记录的大规模基准数据集。
AI.result: 在64节点异构边缘集群（5类设备：Raspberry Pi 3/4、Jetson Nano、Jetson Orin Nano、Jetson Orin AGX、KVM虚拟机）上部署32个LLM实例（8个模型家族，11个参数规模，5个量化级别），使用1258个查询（MMLU、GSM8K、CommonsenseQA、TruthfulQA）评估。与3个基线（Random、High-Acc、Fastest）和2个SOTA方法（RouteLLM风格、OptLLM风格）比较：推理延迟降低高达51%，排队延迟降低高达67%，准确率损失最多8%，编排开销约35ms/查询（比OptLLM风格降低60%）。在高负载（100请求，λ=2）下，推理时间比OptLLM和RouteLLM分别降低19.2%和38%，等待时间分别降低52%和62%。PPO训练在200个episode内快速收敛。
AI.conclusion: DRLM是首个在异构边缘集群中实现细粒度LLM查询编排的DRL框架，通过联合建模查询语义、模型-设备配置和动态系统状态，实现了状态感知的编排决策。实验证明其在延迟和排队性能上的显著优势，同时保持可接受的质量水平。未来工作将扩展到多目标优化，整合成本和能耗考量。

title: Comparison of Algebraic Block Multi-Coloring and Leiden Methods for Parallel Preconditioning in the ICCG Method
summary: In the application of incomplete Cholesky preconditioning to the incomplete Cholesky-conjugate gradient (ICCG) method, forward and backward substitutions exhibit sequential dependencies that constitute a major bottleneck for parallelization in multicore environments. To alleviate this bottleneck, the algebraic block multi-coloring (ABMC) method achieves both parallelism and data locality through block-wise coloring. However, ABMC requires the number of blocks to be specified as an input parameter in advance. This study evaluates the Leiden method as an alternative blocking approach for parallel preconditioning in the ICCG method. As a community detection technique that maximizes a quality function for graph partitioning, the Leiden method automatically generates blocks that reflect the matrix structure without requiring the number of blocks a priori. We partition the adjacency graphs of sparse matrices using the Leiden method and utilize the resulting blocks for parallel preconditioning. We implement the Leiden method using modularity and the constant Potts model as quality functions and compare its performance with that of the ABMC method in terms of the number of iterations, execution time, and L2 cache efficiency across eight symmetric positive definite matrices. The experimental results demonstrate that the Leiden method with the constant Potts model achieves performance comparable to that of the ABMC method configured with an optimized number of blocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用Leiden社区检测算法替代ABMC方法进行ICCG并行预条件处理的分块策略，通过CPM质量函数自动生成均衡块结构，在32核环境下实现与手工调优的ABMC方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: ICCG方法中不完全Cholesky预条件的前向/后向替换具有顺序依赖性，限制了多核并行效率。传统ABMC方法通过块级着色实现并行化和数据局部性，但需要预先指定块数量作为输入参数，且最优值因矩阵而异，需要问题相关的经验调优，存在实际应用瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 构建稀疏矩阵的邻接图；2) 应用Leiden方法进行社区检测，使用modularity（LeidenMD）和constant Potts model（LeidenCP）两种质量函数进行图分割；3) 对生成的块应用贪心着色算法进行块级着色；4) 按块大小降序排列以优化数据局部性；5) 将块结构应用于ICCG方法的并行预条件中。在AMD EPYC 7543（32核）平台上对8个对称正定矩阵进行测试，比较迭代次数、执行时间、L2缓存效率以及块大小分布的Gini系数等指标。同时对分辨率参数γMD和γCP进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 1) LeidenCP在大多数测试矩阵上的执行时间与调优后的ABMC方法相当，且无需预设块数量；2) LeidenMD在thermal2等矩阵上产生极端块大小不平衡（Gini系数0.89，最大块/平均块比13.7），导致并行效率显著下降；3) LeidenCP有效抑制巨型块形成，将 thermal2下降至Gini系数0.25，比值降至2.13；4) LeidenMD的L2命中率较高（0.78-0.90），而LeidenCP的L2命中率较低（0.71-0.83）但执行时间更优，说明缓存效率并非唯一决定因素；5) Leiden的块生成时间高于ABMC（约2-3倍），但在多右端向量或时步仿真场景中可被摊销；6) γCP在5.0×10⁻⁴至2.0×10⁻³范围内具有较好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Leiden方法与CPM质量函数相结合（LeidenCP）能够自动从矩阵非零结构中提取适合并行预条件的块结构，无需预先指定块数量，且性能与精心调优的ABMC方法相当。该方法在多右端向量问题和时步仿真等可重用预条件器的应用中具有优势。未来工作将探索其他质量函数、并行化质量函数最大化过程，以及集成Rabbit Ordering等快速结构重排序方法。

title: Characterizing the Scalability and Performance of Large-Scale AI Training Under Multi-Tenancy
summary: Characterising AI workload performance on modern HPC systems requires understanding both their scalability in isolation and their behaviour under concurrent execution. However, the interplay among parallelisation strategies, network congestion, compute capability, and interconnect technologies remains poorly understood. This work investigates the performance and scalability of AI models up to 2400 GPUs. We quantify the communication overheads and their impact across different interconnects by evaluating scale-up, scale-out, and rack-scale configurations under multiple allocation schemes. Finally, we study how multiple concurrent training jobs interfere with each other by designing a realistic noise model. We design a benchmark suite of AI models to evaluate the performance of five distinct parallelisation strategies across different supercomputing clusters, including Alps, Leonardo, LUMI, JUPITER, NVL72 GB300, and DGX A100. Our work provides a systematic characterization of the scalability and execution efficiency of distributed AI training, while offering key insights into performance behavior under realistic multi-tenant scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文对大规模分布式AI训练在节点级、机架级和超算级系统上的可扩展性及多租户场景下的性能进行了系统性表征。研究提出了DLNetBench基准测试框架，覆盖五种并行化策略（DP、FSDP、DP+PP、DP+PP+TP、DP+PP+EP），在六个平台（DGX A100、NVL72 GB300、Alps、JUPITER、Leonardo、LUMI）上进行超过2400 GPU规模实验，量化通信开销、拓扑放置和并发干扰对性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型（如GPT-3、LLaMA）规模扩展到数千GPU，分布式训练性能越来越受通信和网络瓶颈制约。现有研究通常只考察单一因素（通信开销、拓扑感知优化或拥塞效应），且多在单系统或简化条件下进行，缺少对并行化策略、网络拓扑、互联技术和多租户并发执行交互影响的系统性理解。生产环境中AI工作负载呈现明显的偏斜分布（少量大规模预训练任务占用绝大部分资源），使得传统aggressor-victim评测方法难以反映真实场景。
AI.method: 作者开发了DLNetBench基准测试框架，直接发起各并行化策略产生的集合通信操作（不执行真实张量运算），计算阶段使用基于roofline模型的硬件感知时序估计，以保持计算-通信平衡并实现跨系统的可复现性。方法显式建模三个交互因素：通信结构（按策略派生的集合操作）、计算时间（roofline模型）、网络干扰（基于生产集群偏斜分布的并发作业配置）。实验涵盖五种并行化策略和六类系统（含Dragonfly与Dragonfly+拓扑），采用均匀与分层采样（small/medium/large）分配模式，并通过混合熵评分和局部性评分分层采样策略分配与作业放置配置。在预留节点和生产SLURM队列两种设置下分别进行基线和并发实验，共运行超过450个实验、约5300节点小时。
AI.result: 主要观察包括：(1) 通信开销在节点内可忽略（DGX A100低于10%），但跨越节点后占运行时30%-70%以上；(2) FSDP通信占比始终低于10%，并行效率最高；纯DP因依赖全局IAllReduce，效率随规模下降至50%以下；混合策略效率介于两者之间；(3) 网络放置对隔离运行的吞吐量扩展趋势影响很小，但在并发场景下拓扑感知放置（如固定每交换机节点数）可将平均减速降低数倍；(4) DGX A100基本不受并发影响，NVL72完全消除拥塞；但超算上跨组放置可导致高达23.6×甚至106×的极端减速；(5) NCCL/RCCL集合库未收敛本身也会导致高方差减速（与拥塞无关）。总体而言，可扩展性需综合考虑并行化策略、通信模式、互联特性与拓扑感知放置的联合作用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，没有单一因素可预测隔离或多租户条件下的大规模训练性能。节点级/机架级系统基本不受拥塞影响，但超算规模上拥塞和系统噪声会严重影响性能，且影响因通信模式和规模而异。FSDP是扩展性最优的策略，纯DP在超大规模下表现最差。拓扑感知放置对缓解拥塞有效但有限，不能解决集合库不稳定带来的方差问题。未来工作将扩展模型与规模范围，研究集合库收敛行为以区分噪声与真实拥塞，并在更大规模上实施完全可控的分配以刻画最坏情况拥塞。

title: Breaking Cycles for Scalable Fair Ordering in Blockchain Systems
summary: In blockchain systems, transaction order directly determines financial outcomes: unfair ordering enables front-running and sandwich attacks that have extracted over \$686M from Ethereum users. Current fair-ordering protocols aggregate pairwise receive-order evidence from replicas. Under contention or adversarial manipulation, however, Condorcet cycles force them into global strongly connected component (SCC) condensation, causing delays, coarse batches, and scaling failures. We present FlashOrder, a deterministic fair-ordering engine that localizes cyclic ambiguity before it propagates across the batch. FlashOrder embeds pairwise preferences into one-dimensional canonical positions, clusters nearby transactions with a partition hypergraph, and performs hierarchical inter- and intra-cluster serialization, replacing batch-wide SCC condensation with localized sorting and aggregation. Evaluated against Themis (CCS '23) and Rashnu (VLDB '24) on a libhotstuff-based prototype, FlashOrder achieves up to 10.5$\times$ higher throughput than Themis and 4.8$\times$ higher than Rashnu, with the latency gap widening as network scales. In controlled adversarial simulation, it reduces maximum rank displacement by 88.7\%, and under Condorcet attacks it sustains 12.0$\times$ and 9.7$\times$ higher throughput than Themis and Rashnu on average. These results show that localizing cyclic ambiguity yields stronger fairness at substantially higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlashOrder，一种确定性的公平排序引擎，通过将成对接收顺序证据嵌入一维规范位置、构建划分超图进行聚类、并执行层次化的簇间/簇内序列化，替代了基于全局强连通分量（SCC）凝聚的传统做法，在高争用和 Condorcet 攻击场景下显著提升吞吐量、降低延迟并改善公平性质量。
AI.motivation: 在区块链系统中，交易排序直接决定金融结果，不公平排序（如 front-running 和三明治攻击）在以太坊上已造成超过 6.86 亿美元损失。现有的公平排序协议（Themis、Rashnu 等）依赖全局 SCC 凝聚来解析 Condorcet 循环，导致批处理粒度过粗、延迟不可预测、扩展性差，尤其在 DeFi 高频交易和对抗性攻击场景下成为瓶颈。
AI.method: FlashOrder 采用三阶段流水线：(1) 鲁棒规范嵌入（RCE）：通过阈值 τ 过滤成对偏好矩阵，计算每笔交易的规范位置 CP 并按 CP 升序排列为一维线性基线序列；(2) 自适应超图建模（AHM）：基于 CP 差异阈值 δ 进行几何聚类，将相邻交易划分为不相交的簇，构建划分超图，再投影为商图 G_HG，必要时通过 SCC 合并消除宏观循环；(3) 层次化顺序解析（HOR）：对商图执行字典序拓扑排序确定簇间顺序，再在每个簇内按净偏好分数 Score(tx_i)=Σ(P_ij−P_ji) 降序排序，相同分数时按 CP 和交易标识符确定性打破平局。系统参数 λ（簇间优势边际）被严格限制在由 γ-公平性推导出的可行区间内。
AI.result: 在基于 libhotstuff 的原型上对比 Themis 和 Rashnu：n=9 时吞吐量达 30,680 txs/s（比 Themis 高 10.5×，比 Rashnu 高 4.8×）；n=101 时延迟为 180ms（Themis 为 779ms，Rashnu 为 401ms）；50ms WAN 下批量大小 800 时保持 2,373 TPS（Themis 仅 480 TPS）。在控制对抗模拟中（γ=0.8），最大排名位移从 Themis 的 301 和 Rashnu 的 287 降至 34（降低 88.7%）；RPS 从 0.813/0.790 提升至 0.873；在 γ=0.51 严格设置下 RPS 达 0.996，MaxDisp 仅为 10。在 Condorcet 攻击下（50ms WAN，γ=0.6），FlashOrder 平均吞吐量比 Themis 高 12.0×、比 Rashnu 高 9.7×。
AI.conclusion: FlashOrder 证明了通过将循环歧义局部化在判定性聚类内而非依赖全局 SCC 凝聚，可以在不改变成对证据模型或共识底层的前提下，显著提升公平排序的吞吐量、延迟和公平性质量；为 DAG 架构、可组合公平性框架和共享排序场景的集成提供了新方向。

title: Shared-Memory Range-Tiled CDF Sort for Small-Range Integer Keys on GPUs
summary: We study unstable integer sorting on GPUs for arrays whose elements lie in a known integer range. Focusing on counting-sort-based methods that determine the output interval of each value from its frequency and the prefix sums of the frequencies, we propose and evaluate Range-Tiled CDF sort (RT-CDF), which partitions the possible value range into small intervals, called tiles, that fit in shared memory. For each tile, RT-CDF constructs a histogram, computes its prefix sum as a local CDF, and directly generates the output array from the local CDF. We compare RT-CDF against three baselines: CUB DeviceRadixSort, whose processed bit range is restricted to $[0,\lceil\log_2 R\rceil)$ to exploit the known range size $R$; Ref-H-P sort; and an implementation based on the algorithm of Kolonias et al. Experiments on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 with range sizes from $R=2^7$ to $2^{18}$, input sizes from $n=10^6$ to $10^9$, and uniformly distributed, normally distributed, and all-equal inputs show that RT-CDF outperforms the baselines over a broad set of conditions for small to medium ranges, achieving a maximum speedup of 4.39 over the fastest baseline. For $R=2^{18}$, however, at least one baseline outperforms RT-CDF for every evaluated input size and input distribution, showing that the cost of histogram construction limits the applicability of RT-CDF to larger ranges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了 RT-CDF（Range-Tiled CDF Sort），一种基于 GPU 的小范围整数排序算法。该方法将值域划分为可放入共享内存的"瓦片"（tile），为每个瓦片构建直方图与局部 CDF（累积分布函数），并据此直接生成输出数组，无需对整个输出数组做前缀最大值计算，也无需重新扫描输入数组。
AI.motivation: 现有基于计数排序的 GPU 整数排序方法（如 Kolonias 等、H-P sort 和 RefHP）在范围 R 较小时因原子操作竞争和工作负载不均而存在瓶颈。当范围超出共享内存容量时，方法的有效性受限。本文旨在通过值域分块（tiling）策略，在保持局部 CDF 计算优势的同时扩展可处理的范围大小。
AI.method: RT-CDF 将值域划分为 m = ⌈R/T⌉ 个宽度为 T 的瓦片，每个瓦片可放入共享内存。算法包含四个阶段：（1）为每个瓦片构建直方图（通过共享内存原子操作）；（2）对瓦片内直方图做前缀和得到局部 CDF；（3）顺序计算各瓦片的全局偏移量；（4）输出生成阶段，将局部 CDF 加载至共享内存，对每个输出位置通过二分查找确定对应值。实现采用 CUDA，包含四种内核：直方图构建、局部 CDF 构建、瓦片偏移计算、输出生成。直方图构建阶段对每个瓦片扫描一次完整输入数组，故总输入引用为 O(mn)。输出生成阶段不再扫描输入数组，对每个输出位置执行 O(log T) 的二分查找。
AI.result: 实验在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 上进行，范围 R 从 2⁷ 到 2¹⁸，输入规模 n 从 10 到 10，测试了均匀分布、正态分布和全相等输入。对比基线包括 CUB DeviceRadixSort（限制处理位数）、RefHP 和基于 Kolonias 等算法的实现。结果显示：在 R ≤ 2¹⁷ 范围内，RT-CDF 在大多数条件下优于所有基线；最大加速比为 4.39（出现在 R=2⁹、全相等输入、n=10⁶ 时）。在 R=2¹⁰ 时 RT-CDF 在所有 84 个条件下均为最快。在 R=2¹ 时表现为临界状态：小输入时基线更快，大输入时 RT-CDF 更优。在 R=2¹⁸ 时，所有测试条件下均至少有某个基线优于 RT-CDF，主要原因是直方图构建成本（O(mn) 输入扫描）随瓦片数 m 和瓦片宽度 T 增加而急剧上升，且大瓦片占用更多共享内存导致占用率降低。RT-CDF 性能受输入分布影响较小，主要取决于范围大小。
AI.conclusion: RT-CDF 在小到中等值域范围（R ≤ 2¹）的小范围整数排序中显著优于现有基线方法，但在 R=2¹ 时因直方图构建成本主导而失去优势。性能边界位于 R=2¹ 与 R=2¹⁸ 之间。未来工作需要降低直方图构建成本以扩展到大范围场景，包括自适应选择输出生成方法以及在其他 GPU 架构上评估最优瓦片宽度。

title: Prediction-Robust Service Deployment with Capacity-Aware Edge Admission
summary: Edge platforms instantiate executable services close to users to reduce request-serving cost, but each instance incurs a one-time deployment cost and remains useful only for a finite time-to-live (TTL). The resulting online decision is both prediction-sensitive and capacity-coupled: an optimistic forecast can waste deployment cost, whereas a delayed decision misses the burst it is intended to serve. We study this problem under a common TTL cost model and propose CAPSUM, a capacity-aware admission policy with an elastic specialization, CAPSUM-E. In the local elastic setting, every node-service trace is exactly a variable-price Bahncard instance. This reduction lets CAPSUM-E inherit PFSUM's tight prediction-error-dependent ratio, including $2/(1+\beta)$ consistency and $1/\beta$ robustness for $\beta>0$. A redirect-aware variant preserves the same local deployment schedule. For finite-capacity nodes, CAPSUM combines size-scaled break-even tests, a utilization-dependent shadow price, and evidence-density eviction; we prove capacity feasibility, scale invariance, and exact agreement with CAPSUM-E under an elastic configuration. We implement an exact local offline dynamic program and compare against direct common-model baselines and documented source-derived adapters for EDP-A, OREO, and uEDC-L. Experiments cover controlled prediction error, three synthetic demand regimes, a causal predictor on a public Globus Compute trace, and joint scaling to 1,024 nodes and 10,000 services. Under the common model, CAPSUM reduces normalized cost by 33.7-42.9% relative to the best source-derived adapter across the synthetic regimes and by 45.5% on the sampled trace.

AI.tldr: 本文针对边缘平台中具有固定TTL的一次性部署成本服务部署问题，提出CAPSUM策略。其核心弹性版本CAPSUM-E将每条节点-服务流量精确归约为变价Bahncard实例，继承PFSUM的紧致预测误差相关竞争比κ(η)（一致性2/(1+β)，鲁棒性1/β）。有限容量版本CAPSUM通过尺寸缩放的盈亏平衡测试、利用率相关的影子价格和证据密度驱逐实现容量可行性，并在弹性配置下与CAPSUM-E完全一致。实验在895次运行中，相比最佳源派生适配器，在合成需求下降低33.7–42.9%成本，在Globus真实轨迹上降低45.5%。
AI.motivation: 边缘部署是一次性实例化成本与有限TTL有效期之间的"租或买"决策，具有预测敏感性和容量耦合特性。乐观预测会浪费部署成本，延迟决策则会错过突发流量。需要一种既能利用预测又对预测错误具有鲁棒性的去中心化在线策略。
AI.method: 方法分两层：(1) CAPSUM-E在每个节点-服务对上独立运行PFSUM规则，仅当历史TTL窗口负载H和预测TTL窗口负载F̂均达到盈亏平衡阈值γ=C/(1-β)时才部署。证明该策略可精确归约为独立Bahncard实例，并通过局部轨迹等价性定理实现完全去中心化。容量感知扩展CAPSUM加入尺寸缩放门控、利用率平方形式的影子价格λ_n(t)=γ(u_n/B_n)²和证据密度驱逐策略。(2) 转发感知变体CAPSUM-E+在本地不部署时查询最近活跃实例，保持本地部署调度不变。
AI.result: 定理8证明CAPSUM-E达到紧致的κ(η)竞争比：一致性2/(1+β)，鲁棒性1/β。定理14证明CAPSUM-E+对可转发基准达到κ(η)/β竞争比。在合成三种需求模式（稳态、闪群、移动热点）和Globus真实轨迹上共895次运行：稳态成本0.895、闪群0.765、移动热点0.726、Globus 0.725，显著优于EDP-A、OREO、uEDC-L等源派生适配器。消融实验证实历史守卫和影子价格的必要性，预测压力测试验证了一致性-鲁棒性权衡。可扩展至1024节点和10000服务。
AI.conclusion: CAPSUM-E通过精确归约继承了PFSUM的紧致竞争比保证，其转发扩展保持本地调度并获得对可转发基准的竞争比。有限容量CAPSUM证明了可行性、规模不变性和弹性配置一致性，但不主张继承PFSUM竞争比。广泛的实验验证了策略在合成和真实轨迹上的优越性。未来工作应将容量与路由耦合到离线基准中，并在容器部署中测量传输、冷启动和目录查询成本。

title: AInfer-PD: Communication-Safe In-Place Prefill-Decode Multiplexing for Distributed MoE Rollouts
summary: Rollout inference often dominates the wall-clock time of large-scale reinforcement learning (RL). In agentic RL, each trajectory alternates between model generation and environment interaction over multiple turns. Asynchronous trajectories consequently introduce new prefill (P) work while other trajectories remain in decode (D), making P/D coexistence a persistent property of the rollout rather than a one-time prompt-ingestion event. On shared accelerators, persistent P/D coexistence can make prefill interfere with latency-sensitive decode and prolong rollout completion. P/D disaggregation avoids this co-location but requires separate device pools and KV-cache transfers. In-place multiplexing retains shared devices and KV state, but existing designs lack the communication isolation needed for large MoE deployments that combine attention TP/DP with distributed expert execution. In practical implementations, P and D can issue intersecting collectives in inconsistent cross-rank orders; DeepEP's P and D paths also share mutable protocol state. We present AInfer-PD, which extends in-place P/D multiplexing to distributed MoE rollouts. AInfer-PD coordinates P/D collective order across ranks and gives the two DeepEP paths independent communication state, making crossed ADP/ATP and DeepEP paths safe for concurrent P/D execution. The design retains shared model weights and KV storage while coordinating P and D on the same devices. Across repeated single-node prefill-intensive workloads, AInfer-PD reduces fixed-workload rollout completion time by 7.1-22.5% relative to the same AInfer engine with P/D multiplexing disabled and by 24.8-32.9% relative to SGLang. On two nodes, the reductions are 18.0-35.3% and 18.3-31.8%, respectively. In a same-engine ablation, fine-grained boundaries reduce completion time by a further 8.6-19.8% over whole-epoch asynchronous enqueue.

AI.tldr: AInfer-PD是蚂蚁集团提出的通信安全原地P/D（Prefill/Decode）多路复用系统，扩展至分布式MoE（Mixture of Experts，混合专家）强化学习rollout推理场景。它解决了两个核心问题：跨注意力数据并行（ADP）与注意力张量并行（ATP）路径中相位倾斜副本产生冲突的集合通信顺序，以及DeepEP（DeepSeek开源的MoE专家并行通信库）正常路径与低延迟路径共享可变协议状态的问题。系统保留共享模型权重与KV（Key-Value，注意力机制的键值缓存）存储，通过秩对齐的分段旋转门（segment turnstile）协调P/D集合通信顺序，并为DeepEP两条路径分配独立的通信状态。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习（agentic RL）中的多轮轨迹会导致prefill与decode持续共存，而非一次性的提示输入。共享加速器上P/D的持续共存会使prefill干扰延迟敏感的decode，延长rollout完成时间。P/D解聚合（disaggregation）虽然避免共置但需要独立设备池和KV缓存传输；原地多路复用（in-place multiplexing）虽保留共享设备和KV状态，但现有设计缺乏大型MoE部署（结合注意力TP/DP（张量并行/数据并行）与分布式专家执行）所需的通信隔离。实际实现中，P和D可能以不一致的跨秩顺序发起相交的集合通信，DeepEP的P和D路径还共享可变协议状态。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心机制：(1) 识别相位倾斜注意力副本在相交P/D集体路径上的分布式排序问题，定义消除观察到的进度环所需的排序；(2) 设计秩对齐的分段旋转门（rank-aligned segment turnstile），并扩展DeepEP为各阶段拥有独立可变状态（缓冲区、计数器、工作区、事件、QP（Queue Pair，队列对）范围），使正常P和低延迟D通信可在同一运行时中共存；(3) 将这些机制集成到MoE rollout引擎中，跨并行拓扑、精度、MTP（Multi-Token Prediction，多token预测）模式、rollout压力和单/双节点部署进行评估。系统还引入了选择性流路由（selective stream route）来实现设备级排序，并通过分段策略控制每个旋转门轮次允许的P工作量。
AI.result: 在重复的单节点prefill密集工作负载上，AInfer-PD将固定工作负载的rollout完成时间相对于禁用P/D多路复用的同一AInfer引擎减少7.1-22.5%，相对于SGLang减少24.8-32.9%。在两节点上，减少分别为18.0-35.3%和18.3-31.8%。在同引擎消融实验中，细粒度边界比整个epoch异步入队额外减少完成时间8.6-19.8%。在EP8/ADP8 DeepEP FP8配置中，请求速率达到9.18-14.74 requests/s，比Normal高26.6-50.4%，比SGLang高36.0-62.8%。两节点16-GPU验证中，跨四种工作负载规模，AInfer-PD端到端时间比Normal减少18.0-35.3%，比SGLang减少18.3-31.8%。32步实时RL运行中，总rollout时间从17.14小时降至14.12小时（减少17.6%）。代价是p99 TTFT（Time To First Token，首token生成时间）增加13.2-37.9%，暴露了完成时间与TTFT之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: AInfer-PD通过为注册的集合通信排序并为DeepEP提供阶段拥有的状态，在保留单一模型和KV副本的同时，缩短了rollout关键路径，无需第二个模型实例或KV传输。系统针对的是在同一设备上保持一个模型和KV状态的rollout工作节点；解聚合在可接受单独阶段容量和KV传输时仍然更优。原地集合通信排序仅在P/D路径相交且秩可能以不同顺序暴露时需要。该方法假设健康秩和传输、匹配参与以及公平的CUDA/NCCL（NVIDIA集合通信库）进度。DeepEP扩展隔离可变协议状态而非NIC带宽、缓存或未预留的SM容量；准入和通信SM预算管理这些资源。评估涵盖一/两节点H20-3E部署、BF16/FP8、两种MoE后端和MTP开/关，更大规模和硬件仍待探索。

title: MakoXC: Rearchitecting DFT Exchange-Correlation with Matrix-Aligned and Knowledge-Organized Sparsity
comment: Accepted in the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis (SC'26)
summary: Density Functional Theory (DFT) is indispensable for materials science and drug discovery, yet the exchange--correlation (XC) evaluation remains a major bottleneck due to its cubic scaling. Although linear-scaling methods exploit electronic nearsightedness to reduce asymptotic complexity, they produce irregular sparse workloads that hide implicit sparsity and prevent efficient use of modern AI accelerators. We present MakoXC, a modular matrix-aligned XC evaluation engine that rearchitects nearsightedness-induced sparsity into regular, accelerator-friendly computations. MakoXC co-designs three key techniques: (1) Matrix-Aligned Cells reorganize nearsightedness-induced interactions into dense, accelerator-aligned data clusters; (2) Sparsity-Guided Activation translates deeper implicit sparsity into numerically correct structured execution for practical linear scaling; and (3) Kernel-Fused Pipeline consolidates fragmented workloads into a unified, compute-intensive execution path that fully unleashes accelerator throughput. Extensive evaluations show that MakoXC achieves average speedups of 67.8$\times$ speedup over standard XC evaluation and 4.7$\times$ over state-of-the-art linear-scaling methods. When integrated into a production-grade commercial DFT package, MakoXC scales XC evaluation to ubiquitin (1,231 atoms, def2-SVP) on 64 GPUs, enabling the end-to-end DFT calculation to complete in under five minutes. By restructuring XC evaluation into a unified, structured computation, MakoXC demonstrates how scientific workloads can achieve genuine low complexity while maximizing parallel efficiency on AI accelerators.

AI.tldr: MakoXC是一个面向密度泛函理论(DFT)中交换-相关(XC)计算的模块化GPU加速引擎，通过将电子近视性(nearsightedness)引起的稀疏性重构为矩阵对齐的规则计算单元，解决了线性缩放XC评估中不规则稀疏工作负载与AI加速器(Tensor Core)不匹配的难题。在A100 GPU上实现平均67.8×加速(相对于标准XC)和4.7×加速(相对于当前最优线性缩放方法)，并能在64块GPU上5分钟内完成1231原子蛋白质泛素的端到端DFT计算。
AI.motivation: DFT中XC评估是计算瓶颈，传统方法呈立方缩放O(N³)，线性缩放方法利用电子近视性可降至近线性O(N)，但产生的不规则稀疏工作负载与GPU Tensor Core的固定tile结构不匹配，导致硬件利用率低下。核心矛盾在于：算法稀疏性与硬件规则性之间的鸿沟，使得线性缩放的理论优势无法在实际GPU执行中兑现。
AI.method: MakoXC通过三项协同设计技术解决上述矛盾：(1) **矩阵对齐单元(MAC)**：将电子近视性诱导的局部密集簇重组织为固定形状(如16×16、32×32)且与Tensor Core MMA tile对齐的微矩阵，并设计MAC-based稀疏存储格式(类似CSR)；(2) **稀疏引导激活(SGA)**：通过基于值的过滤(阈值10⁻¹²)消除显式稀疏，再通过对应性激活利用shellpair筛选和Schwarz界严格对应AO乘积的隐式稀疏，将密度矩阵中对应的MAC提前激活；(3) **核融合流水线(KFP)**：将GEMM和DOT操作融合为单一流水线，在片上SRAM中完成数据复用，并集成对称折叠(利用密度矩阵对称性)和normcache门控(在线过滤数值可忽略的MAC)两种冗余消除机制。
AI.result: 在单个A100 GPU上：def2-SVP基组下平均加速87.1×(vs DenseXC)、3.6×(vs GauXC)、6.7×(vs GPU4PySCF)；def2-TZVP基组下加速48.4×、2.9×、3.6×。首次实现实际线性缩放(图6验证)。消融研究显示各组件贡献：值过滤9.0×，完整SGA额外1.71×，KFP额外4.1×。SGA预计算开销<3%。端到端在1231原子泛素(def2-SVP)上64块GPU(8节点)保持>74%并行效率，5分钟内完成单点能计算。数值精度在1 mHartree/atom阈值内(化学精度)。
AI.conclusion: MakoXC通过将不规则科学稀疏性转化为加速器原生执行的矩阵对齐形式，弥合了算法低复杂度与硬件高并行性之间的鸿沟，实现了实用线性缩放与Tensor Core高利用率的统一。该工作不仅为大规模准确DFT模拟提供了实用方案，更为HPC中不规则科学工作负载的加速器原生执行提供了通用设计范式。

title: Update for Decisions, Not Freshness: Goal-Oriented Status Updating and Selective Offloading at the Network Edge
summary: In an edge--cloud collaborative edge-computing environment, an edge node (EN) must decide whether each user task should be executed locally, forwarded to a remote service (or cloud) node (SN), or rejected. The EN observes its local state directly but receives the SN state only through an intermittently refreshed cache. Status updating and task control therefore form an asynchronous closed loop under partial observability. Freshness-driven schemes, including those based on Age of Information (AoI), do not directly value an update by its effect on subsequent task decisions. We propose CoSMO (Co-design of Semantic-state Management and Offloading), a cooperative event-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework that coordinates semantic status management and selective offloading through realized task utility. CoSMO learns a compact representation of the heterogeneous SN service state. At the SN, a recurrent semi-Markov double deep Q-network (Double DQN) agent jointly selects send/no-send and the next decision interval. At the EN, a task-terminal off-policy value-learning agent makes hierarchical gate--route decisions from local observations and stale remote semantics. The agents maintain separate observations and value targets but share the same realized task-utility stream, without centralized execution. Across the evaluated workload families, CoSMO's reported relative improvement in on-time completion rate over the best-performing competing method averages 18.6%--21.2%. For capacity-aware decision accuracy across the three strict-overload points, the corresponding reported gains average 17.6%--$17.9%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoSMO框架，将边缘计算中的语义状态更新与任务卸载决策进行联合优化，通过基于任务效用的协同强化学习，在远程状态过期条件下实现更高的按时完成率和更优的容量感知决策精度。
AI.motivation: 在边云协同计算环境中，边缘节点(EN)基于过期的远程服务节点(SN)缓存状态做任务卸载决策，传统基于信息新鲜度(如AoI)的更新策略并未直接衡量更新对后续任务决策的价值，导致更新可能无益于甚至干扰任务决策。
AI.method: 提出CoSMO（语义状态管理与卸载协同设计）框架，包含两个事件驱动的强化学习智能体：(1) SN端采用基于GRU的循环半马尔可夫Double DQN，联合选择是否发送语义更新及下一决策间隔；(2) EN端采用任务终止的离策略值学习智能体，通过双分支状态编码和分层gate-route网络进行接受/拒绝与本地/卸载决策。两智能体共享任务效用流但保持独立观测和价值目标，语义编码器通过区间条件前向动力学预测进行预训练后冻结。
AI.result: 在ns-3仿真中，CoSMO在确定性到达下按时完成率相对最优基线平均提升18.6%，在泊松到达下平均提升21.2%；在三个严格过载点(λ=240/280/320)上的容量感知决策精度分别提升17.6%和17.9%；分层gate-route消融实验表明在深度过载下该结构带来8.8%-13.4%的成功率提升和2.6%-9.9%的决策精度提升。
AI.conclusion: CoSMO通过将状态更新价值与下游任务效用直接关联，在过期远程状态条件下实现了高容量感知决策精度和最优的按时完成率，同时在轻负载下保持低更新开销、在过载下增加更新以换取更好的任务性能，验证了决策导向的协同设计框架的优越性。

title: Just Talk Once: Communication-Efficient Split Federated LLM Fine-Tuning on Edge Devices
summary: Large language model (LLM) fine-tuning is increasingly shifting toward data generated on edge devices, where memory, computation, bandwidth, and connectivity constraints make conventional federated learning difficult to sustain. Split federated fine-tuning (SFT) improves client-side efficiency by offloading most model parameters and computation to the server but requires step-by-step bidirectional communication loop across the split interface and forces continuous client involvement throughout training. In this paper, we present L-shaped SFT, a split fine-tuning framework that removes this bidirectional bottleneck. Our key insight is that weight tying in modern LLMs enables server-side hidden activations to be directly supervised using target embeddings, allowing the training loss to be computed on the server without returning server outputs to the client. To further eliminate the need for continuous client participation, based on L-shaped SFT, we introduce one-shot SFT, in which clients upload activations once and then go offline while the server continues optimization over cached representations. We implement our design in a real system testbed with heterogeneous edge clients, including commercial smartphones and NVIDIA developer boards. Experiments demonstrate that our schemes significantly reduce communication costs and client online time compared with existing SFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 L-shaped SFT 框架，通过利用现代 LLM 的权重共享特性，将监督信号从客户端转移到服务器端，从而消除了 U-shaped SFT 中的双向通信瓶颈。在此基础上进一步提出 one-shot SFT，允许客户端只上传一次激活后即可离线，由服务器基于缓存表示完成剩余优化，显著降低通信开销和客户端在线时间。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上 LLM 微调面临内存、算力、带宽和连接性的多重约束。标准联邦学习需要客户端持有完整模型，不适用于资源受限设备。分裂联邦微调（SFT）虽然能将大部分参数和计算卸载到服务器，但 U-shaped SFT 需要每步双向通信且要求客户端全程在线，难以应对不稳定移动环境。
AI.method: 核心方法包含两个层面：(1) L-shaped SFT 利用权重共享（W_head = E^T），客户端上传切层激活 h_c 和目标嵌入 e_y，服务器直接在激活空间以对比损失 A-Loss（公式3）进行监督，避免了服务端输出返回和梯度回传的双向环路；(2) one-shot SFT 让客户端仅做一次前向传播后上传 (h_c, e_y) 对并离线，服务器在缓存表示上多轮迭代完成训练。理论分析证明在全词表缓存、τ=1、权重共享条件下，A-Loss 的梯度与标准交叉熵损失完全一致（定理4.1），有限缓存下的近似误差被分解为重整化误差和缺失负样本误差。
AI.result: 在包含 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 和华为 nova 9 Pro 的真实异构边缘测试平台上，与 U-shaped SFT 相比：全量微调下通信量降低 25%–66%、时延降低 34%–70%；LoRA 微调下通信量最高降低 87%、时延最高降低 89%。One-shot SFT 将客户端活跃时间从 95%–96% 压缩至 11%–13%，且对客户端掉线最为鲁棒。多个模型（GPT-2、Qwen2.5、Llama3.x、Gemma3 等）在 MMLU 和 WikiText-2 任务上微调精度与 U-shaped SFT 相当。
AI.conclusion: L-shaped SFT 通过将监督迁移至服务器端并消除 U-shaped SFT 的双向瓶颈，在保持微调质量的同时显著降低了通信开销和端到端时延；one-shot SFT 进一步将客户端参与压缩为单次上传，使分裂式 LLM 微调在带宽受限和间歇连接的边缘场景下更加实用。该框架正交于现有辅助优化模块，可与差分隐私、同态加密等激活级隐私保护方法结合。

title: Faster Convergence of Multidimensional Approximate Agreement via Smallest Enclosing Balls
summary: This work considers the multidimensional approximate agreement problem. In this problem, $n$ parties in a distributed system, up to $t$ of which may be corrupted by a Byzantine adversary, need to output vectors that are close to each other and that lie inside the convex hull of all non-corrupted input vectors. We assume that nodes communicate in a fully-connected authenticated network and analyze synchronous and asynchronous communication models. The focus of this work is on the contraction factor of approximate agreement protocols. The first multidimensional approximate agreement protocols had a contraction rate of $1-1/n$(VG, PODC'13) and $\sqrt[d]{1/2}$(MH, STOC'13). While a rate below $1$ is sufficient for convergence, it is not sufficient for practical applications. To date, the best known convergence rate of approximate agreement algorithms is $\sqrt{7/8}\approx0.935$ (FN, DISC'18), which is achieved through the MidExtremes protocol. This stands in contrast to the lower bound on the convergence rate in the $1$-dimensional setting, which is $1/2$. In this work, we propose BallMidpoint - a novel approximate agreement protocol with a contraction rate of $1/\sqrt{2}\approx 0.707$ in the synchronous and the asynchronous communication models. This algorithm satisfies the optimal resilience under convex validity. The presented contraction rate is achieved by choosing the midpoint of the smallest enclosing ball of the so-called local safe areas, and it is tight for the presented algorithms. Similar to (FN, DISC'18), our algorithm is coordinate-free, and the point inside the safe area can be computed efficiently. This work presents the first multidimensional approximate agreement protocol where the convergence rate is closer to the best known lower bound rather than the upper bound of $1$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多维拜占庭近似一致（MBAA）协议 BallMidpoint，通过在安全区域（safe area）的最小包含球中点进行选择，在同步和异步通信模型下均实现了 1/√2 ≈ 0.707 的收敛率，显著优于此前最佳的 √(7/8) ≈ 0.935，且该收敛率被证明对所提算法是渐近紧的。
AI.motivation: 现有多维近似一致协议在满足凸有效性（convex validity）时，收敛率仍接近 1（如 0.935），导致收敛所需轮数过大，难以实用化。需要一种更接近一维情形下已知最优下界 1/2 的算法，以提升其实用性。
AI.method: 提出 BallMidpoint 算法：每个节点在本地接收向量后计算"安全区域"（n-t 个向量凸包的交集），然后选择该安全区域最小包含球（Smallest Enclosing Ball, SEB）的中点作为下一轮输入。关键技术包括：(1) 利用 Helly 定理保证安全区域非空；(2) 证明所有正确节点的安全区域存在公共交点（同步情形基于可靠广播的全局视图，异步情形基于 Gather 原语的公共核）；(3) 通过球半径而非直径来度量收敛，证明每轮 SEB 半径以因子 1/√2 收缩；(4) 通过证人技术（witness technique）实现本地轮数估计。同步模型容错 n > max(3, d+1)t，异步模型容错 n > max(3, d+2)t。
AI.result: 1) 同步模型：BallMidpoint 协议在 n > max(3, d+1)t 时实现 1/√2 的收敛率；2) 异步模型：在 n > max(3, d+2)t 时同样实现 1/√2 收敛率；3) 紧性证明：构造了 2 维反例表明该收敛率对所提算法渐近紧；4) 在 d=1 时退化为 MidExtremes，最优收敛率 1/2；5) 与之前工作对比，BallMidpoint 是首个收敛率更接近已知下界 1/2 而非上界 1 的多维协议。
AI.conclusion: BallMidpoint 通过引入安全区域最小包含球中点的策略，将满足凸有效性的多维近似一致收敛率从 0.935 提升至 0.707，显著缩小了与一维最优下界 1/2 之间的差距，使多维近似一致算法更接近实用化。未来工作包括：进一步缩小 1/2 与 1/√2 之间的差距，并将算法推广到动态网络和网络无关模型。

title: Audit-First Rollback Semantics for Safety-Critical Deployment Pipelines
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Reference implementation and reproduction harness: this https URL
summary: Distributed deployment runtimes carry a coherence obligation that classical fault-tolerance frameworks do not name directly: the live state a component is configured to run and the audit chain that records how it got there must agree at every terminal configuration. Prior works mainly focus on individual aspects of the deploy-time fault surface (canary controllers, configuration rollback, signed attestations), leaving the cross-cutting question of audit/live coherence under fail-stop crash only loosely specified. Yet a key systems question remains unresolved: how can a deployment runtime guarantee that the audit chain answers truthfully about live state even when a transition crashes mid-flight? We present audit-first rollback semantics, a fault-tolerance mechanism that guarantees audit/live coherence at every committed terminal under fail-stop crashes during transition phases. The mechanism pairs with provisional state machines, pipelines whose "active but not yet promoted" states carry an explicit rollback contract and a bounded deadline. We instantiate both in a runtime deployment system and run a dependability evaluation against a fail-open variant of the same pipeline across twelve fault-injection points spanning three structural failure classes. Across 1,200 injected-failure trials, audit-first rollback achieves 100% audit/live-state coherence (600/600, Wilson 95% CI [0.994,1.000]) with per-cell p95 recovery latency below 500 ms (SLO PASS in 12/12 cells); the fail-open variant preserves coherence on only 33% of trials (200/600, Wilson 95% CI [0.297,0.372]). We further lift the construction to a cross-bridge coordination protocol with a safety argument for fleets of fail-stop bridges, leaving fleet-scale empirical evaluation to follow-on work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"审计优先回滚语义"(Audit-First Rollback Semantics),一种针对安全关键分布式部署流水线的容错机制。其核心思想是:当部署流水线在临时(provisional)转换阶段遭遇 fail-stop 崩溃时,审计链(audit chain)成为真相之源——实时状态(live state)必须回滚至与审计链最近一致记录匹配的状态,而非反过来。通过"临时状态机"(provisional state machines,显式划分已提交/临时状态并附带回滚闭包与有界期限)与 try/except 守卫的实现模式,该机制在 1,200 次故障注入试验中实现 100% 审计/实时状态一致性(600/600,Wilson 95% CI [0.994,1.000]),所有 12 个注入单元的 p95 恢复延迟均低于 500 ms;相比之下,失败开放(fail-open)变体仅保持 33% 一致性。作者进一步将该构造提升为多桥(multi-bridge)协调协议,给出安全性论证(每桥真实性与车队最终收敛),但车队规模实证留待后续工作。
AI.motivation: 云部署社区默认采用"失败开放"姿态——当实时状态与审计链分歧时,信任实时状态以维持可用性。但对安全关键具身智能体(如机器人、临床流水线)而言,这种姿态结构性地错误,因为审计链是追溯性安全分析的脊柱。论文以两种真实失效模式(指标提供者中间抛出异常导致 live state 已翻转但审计未记录;回滚闭包自身因竞态抛出异常)说明 live/audit 窗口非原子性引发的分歧问题,并论证对受监管机器人而言必须反转默认:失败时 live state 必须回滚以匹配审计链。
AI.method: 方法包含三个层面:(1) 临时状态机(provisional state machines):将流水线状态划分为已提交(committed,实时与审计一致)与临时(provisional,实时已变但审计未记录终态)两类,每个临时状态附带 rollback(p) 回滚闭包与 deadline(p) 有界期限,履行启动、有限持续、无泄漏三项义务。(2) 审计优先回滚:try/except 守卫包裹临时区域;异常时同步执行回滚闭包(尽力而为、可超时、可自身抛出),随后才写入审计链;回滚成功记 ROLLED_BACK,失败记 FAILED(显式标记需人工调和)。(3) 状态机规范:形式化标记迁移系统 (V,V_P,V_T,Σ,→),Σ 分三类(progress/rollback/failure),给出三条命题(终止性、终态一致性、守卫内崩溃安全性),并附加细化义务。评估方法:12 个故障注入点 ×2 种姿态 ×50 次试验 = 1,200 次,采用谱系驱动的设计实验而非随机压力测试,覆盖三类结构性失效面(metric 侧、rollback 内部、审计写侧)。多桥协议采用分层两阶段:Phase 0 各自本地审计优先,Phase 1 投票 PREPARE/ABORT-VOTE,Phase 2 协调器广播 COMMIT/ABORT,各桥仅响应 PREPARE 桥的终态写入。
AI.result: 在 1,200 次故障注入试验中:审计优先姿态实现 100% 审计/实时状态一致性(600/600,Wilson 95% CI [0.994,1.000]);失败开放姿态仅 33% 一致性(200/600,CI [0.297,0.372]),其中恰好保持一致的 200 次全部来自 Class B(rollback 闭包本身抛出)——因失败开放变体省略 rollback 而该路径的审计优先理想结果恰为 FAILED,故一致。延迟方面,审计优先 p50=63 ms、p95=335 ms,失败开放 p50=60 ms、p95=325 ms;两类姿态在所有 12 个单元均满足 p95 ≤ 500 ms 与 p99 ≤ 1 s 的 SLO(12/12 PASS),审计优先仅多 3–10 ms 闭包开销。时延呈三模态(≈67% ≈57 ms 快速簇、≈170 ms 中簇、≈325 ms 饱和窗)。多桥协议在 Propositions 4-5 中得到安全性论证(无需加强单桥故障模型),但车队规模实证为后续工作。
AI.conclusion: 论文论证并实现了一种命名明确、可机化验证的故障容错机制——审计优先回滚语义——将分布式部署运行时的安全属性(live state 与 audit chain 在每个已提交终态保持一致)从论证层面落到属性层面。其贡献:(1) 将"以审计链为真相之源"的源-真-选择命名为可执行的故障容错机制;(2) 提出临时状态机模式(显式回滚契约 + 有界期限);(3) 在 1,200 次故障注入下给出可重复的依赖性度量;(4) 将单桥构造升格为多桥协议并给出安全性论证。核心权衡:少量实现开销与回滚自身失败时诚实的 FAILED 信号,换取受监管智能体可作为单一权威叙事的审计链。限制包括:单进程评估范围、不可捕获信号(如 kill -9)不在故障模型内、基线限于单故障开放变体而非外部 canary 控制器、混沌网格为合成而非生产衍生、多桥协议为设计而非实现。未来工作指向车队规模实证、写前日志、机器化精化检查与生产衍生注入分布。

title: mzCache: On-Device LLM Memory Management under Multitasking
summary: On-device mobile Large Language Model (LLM) inference is gaining significant attention. However, mobile devices operate in highly dynamic multitasking environments where users frequently switch between applications. This creates memory pressure, forcing LLM memory (model weights and KV cache) to be evicted by the operating system. When a new inference request arrives, the inference system must restore the evicted memory through slow storage reads or recompute the entire KV cache, severely degrading responsiveness. To address this, we present mzCache, an on-device LLM inference system with specialized memory management for multitasking environments. Under unpredictable memory pressure, mzCache elastically evicts LLM memory and leverages the unified memory of mobile SoCs to enable zero-wait inference on the GPU with concurrent CPU-side restoration. mzCache realizes this through restoration-oriented memory management: LLM memory is partitioned into fine-grained shared buffers to enable partial eviction and restoration with concurrent cross-processor access, while hybrid swap and backward-out eviction policies ensure low-latency restoration from any eviction state. Implemented on this http URL and deployed as an Android application, mzCache achieves 2.1-5.5$\times$ reduction in Time-to-First-Token compared to storage-backed partial offload and demonstrates its effectiveness in real multitasking scenarios.

AI.tldr: mzCache 是一个面向多任务移动环境的端侧 LLM 推理系统，通过面向恢复的内存管理（细粒度共享缓冲、混合交换、回向淘汰/前向恢复策略）利用移动 SoC 的统一内存，实现 GPU 零等待推理与 CPU 并发恢复，相比存储型部分卸载基线将 TTFT 降低 2.1–5.5×。
AI.motivation: 移动设备在多任务场景下面临不可预测的内存压力，OS 的通用分页与 zRAM 对 KV cache 压缩效果极差（仅 0.2–9.3% 空间节省），导致 LLM 进程被 LMK 终止或恢复时产生 18–20× 的 TTFT 退化，严重损害用户体验。现有移动 LLM 推理系统缺乏专门处理外部内存压力的内存管理机制。
AI.method: 核心方法是面向恢复的驱逐（Restoration-oriented Eviction），包含三个关键设计：(1) 移动端 LLM 内存管理——将权重按层、KV cache 按固定 256 token 粒度划分为细粒度单元，并使用 OpenCL SVM 分配为 CPU-GPU 共享缓冲，支持跨处理器零拷贝并发访问；(2) 混合交换（Hybrid Swap）——通过一次性离线剖析获得解压与存储读取的吞吐量，按 KVonly→KVandW→Wonly→CompKV 四阶段驱逐策略将 KV 块在内存解压与存储读取两条恢复路径间平衡分配；(3) 回向淘汰/前向恢复（Backward-out, Forward-in）——从最后一层开始驱逐以保留早期层，配合 LIFO 栈式内存交换空间，使 GPU 能在 CPU 恢复被驱逐层的同时立即开始 prefill。三阶段（分配-重载-prefill）完全重叠。
AI.result: 在 Galaxy S25+ 与 OnePlus 12 上使用 Qwen3-0.6B 与 EXAONE-4.0-1.2B 评测，mzCache 在 0%–75% 剩余内存条件下相比 Partial Offload 实现 2.1–5.5× TTFT 加速；在 50% 剩余内存代表性场景下，分配加速 1.37×、重载加速 2.15×、prefill 加速 2.33×；三阶段完全重叠相比无重叠获得 1.61× 加速；峰值功耗 19.2W 略高于基线 14.6W，但因 TTFT 大幅缩短，总能耗更低；在真实多任务会话（~45 分钟、10 轮应用切换）中，mzCache (25 pp) 全程存活且每次返回无需冷启动，而 OS Paging 在每轮均被 LMK 终止。
AI.conclusion: 专用内存管理（而非依赖 OS 机制）对于多任务移动环境下的响应式端侧 LLM 推理至关重要；mzCache 通过细粒度共享缓冲、混合交换与回向淘汰策略在任意驱逐状态下实现低延迟恢复，其设计可推广至任何统一内存 SoC 平台；未来工作包括多上下文管理、热调节适应、MoE/稀疏注意力等选择性激活模型的恢复顺序优化。

title: Contribution-Aware Bandwidth Allocation for Multimodal Split Learning
summary: Multimodal models are increasingly the default option for perception at the network edge, yet they are trained almost entirely in the datacenter, because a client holding several sensor streams cannot host an encoder per modality. Split Learning makes such training feasible by keeping only the first layers on the device, at the cost of an uplink that must carry smashed activations for every modality at every step. Existing compression schemes give each modality the same keep-ratio, so the shared budget is divided in proportion to smashed-activation dimension, a quantity unrelated to how much each modality contributes to the fused prediction. We make that division an explicit decision and call it inter-modality allocation: under a fixed uplink budget, every policy transmits the same expected payload and differs only in how that payload is split across modalities. Our allocator, ModalShare, sets each modality's keep-ratio from a Shapley contribution score that the server computes over coalitions of activations it has already received. Measuring this score adds no uplink traffic and no client-side computation, and needs no prior knowledge of which stream is which. ModalShare improves accuracy over equal keep-ratios by 15.4 and 12.4 percentage points on CREMA-D and MVSA at matched payload in 5x compression, with strong performance across three compressors, three datasets, and four budgets. We show that existing compressors underperform in multimodal settings, with ModalShare recovering what gains are left behind.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多模态切分学习中的“模态间带宽分配”新问题：固定总上传负载后，不同模态间如何分配预算与压缩后准确率高度相关。ModalShare依据服务器端Shapley贡献分数动态调整各模态的keep-ratio，无需额外上行流量或客户端计算。实验显示，在5×压缩下，CREMA-D和MVSA相对均匀keep-ratio分别提升15.4和12.4个百分点；该优势在不同压缩器、数据集、预算和切分深度上大体成立。
AI.motivation: 多模态切分学习使客户端能够仅运行各模态的浅层编码器，但必须在每一步上传所有模态的smashed activations，上行带宽成为主要瓶颈。现有压缩方法通常给各模态采用相同keep-ratio，导致实际传输负载按各模态的切分层维度分配，而维度大小与模态对融合预测的任务贡献并无必然关系。因而，在总负载固定时，模态间预算分配被错误地隐式决定，并可能浪费带宽在不关键或冗余的模态上。
AI.method: 论文将固定总上行预算下的模态间分配形式化为iso-budget问题：所有策略满足ΣD_m r_m=βΣD_m，只改变各模态的r_m。ModalShare在服务器端使用融合模型计算仅含不同模态子集时的真实标签对数概率，并以Shapley值估计各模态的边际贡献；负贡献被截断，贡献经归一化与EMA平滑，再通过带温度的映射为各模态keep-ratio，同时保留最小keep-ratio。探测只对服务器已经收到的激活进行masking，因此不产生额外上行通信；达到置信条件后冻结分配，以减少服务器探测开销。实验比较统一keep-ratio、Equal-payload及多种代理信号，并使用SplitFC、Top-S和RandTop-S在三个数据集和多个预算下进行12个随机种子的验证。
AI.result: 在5×压缩下，SplitFC上的ModalShare相对Uniform将CREMA-D准确率从32.2%提高到47.6%，提升15.4个百分点；将MVSA从48.0%提高到60.4%，提升12.4个百分点。MVSA中，Equal-payload消除维度偏置后获得5.17个百分点，而从Equal-payload到贡献驱动分配再获得7.23个百分点，表明主要收益来自贡献感知而非维度纠偏。UCI HAR贡献差距较小，ModalShare保持近似均匀分配，收益仅0.3至1.1个百分点，40×时差异接近零。跨SplitFC、Top-S、RandTop-S的36个配置中，ModalShare在29个配置优于Uniform；大多数失败发生在贡献近乎均衡的UCI HAR，CREMA-D在5×且使用硬选择压缩器时出现两个明显负值。探测在早期切分最有效；晚切分中可分配载荷很小，优势趋近于零。置信冻结在CREMA-D和MVSA上分别比持续在线探测高5.7和3.5个百分点，同时消除后续探测开销。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，固定总上行预算时，仅降低总压缩率并不足以描述多模态切分学习的通信效率；模态间如何分配有限载荷本身是关键决策。服务器端融合级Shapley贡献能够有效驱动该分配，ModalShare在多种压缩器、数据集与预算上总体优于均匀keep-ratio，尤其在预算受限但仍包含可用信号时效果最明显。方法主要适用于早期切分和模态贡献明显不均衡的场景；当模态贡献均衡或切分过晚、载荷接近平凡下限时，应退化为近似均匀分配。未来需要研究三模态及以上、模态缺失、客户端模态集合不同，以及更强且更高效的融合级贡献评分。

title: Harness Engineering: Anatomy, Architecture, and Evolution of Coding Agents -- A Source-Code Study of Eleven Systems
comment: 83 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables. Second, substantially expanded edition of an April 2026 study: corpus grown from eight to eleven systems plus a meta-harness contrast point; the retained April snapshots provide a controlled longitudinal comparison
summary: An agent is a model plus a harness -- the runtime that couples an LLM to the world through a loop, tools, context management, safety controls, orchestration, and extension surfaces. Harness engineering, named as a discipline in early 2026, is the design and evolution of that runtime. This paper gives the young discipline its most comprehensive empirical foundation to date: a source-code anatomy of eleven production coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Mistral Vibe, OpenHands, Aider, Mini-SWE-Agent, Hermes, Pi, OpenCode, OpenClaw), plus Omnigent, the first meta-harness, analyzed as a contrast point. We define what a harness is, map its seven canonical subsystems with the minimal and maximal implementation of each, and dissect all eleven systems along those subsystems. The audit yields 13 cross-cutting observations and a catalog of 29 recurring design patterns. Two absences survive a threefold corpus expansion: across roughly four million lines of Python, TypeScript, and Rust, no agent runtime imports a general-purpose agentic framework, and none retrieves code with vector embeddings; the field runs on hand-rolled async loops and deterministic retrieval. this http URL skills lead MCP in adoption (9/11 vs. 8/11), and ACP ships in six systems with a new third role: harness hosting. Because the original eight systems were re-pinned rather than replaced, the study also contains a controlled longitudinal sample -- the same harnesses source-diffed across one quarter -- showing convergence becoming imitation and behavioral policy migrating from prompt prose to configuration. These threads converge on the paper's thesis: in the first half of 2026 the coding harness completed a turn from tool to platform. The paper closes with 18 design recommendations and a 90-line minimum-viable-harness scaffold.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对11个生产级编码agent harness的源代码进行系统解剖（涵盖Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Mistral Vibe、OpenHands、Aider、Mini-SWE-Agent、Hermes、Pi、OpenCode、OpenClaw，以及作为对照点的元harness Omnigent），从七个规范子系统（agent循环、LLM集成、工具与动作、记忆与上下文、安全与权限、多agent编排、扩展性）维度进行实证比较；定义了harness工程学科，提出核心论点——2026年上半年编码harness完成了从工具到平台的转变，并给出18条设计建议与一个90行最小可行harness脚手架。
AI.motivation: 随着harness工程在2026年初成为一门新兴学科，业界已涌现出大量生产级编码agent harness，但缺乏一份基于源代码的、跨多个主流实现的系统性比较与参考架构。本文旨在为该年轻学科奠定最全面的经验基础，填补现有文献在benchmark评分（不触及架构）、概念分类（描述模式但不涉实现）、以及源代码层分类（排除了provider-native系统）方面的空白，并通过纵向差异分析揭示该领域的演化趋势与平台化转型。
AI.method: 采用源代码解剖学方法：对11个harness系统（每个系统的代码规模跨三个数量级，使用Python/TypeScript/Rust三种语言）按照七个规范子系统维度进行结构化分析；通过对四月版本的系统进行re-pin构建纵向样本，进行源diff对比；对依赖清单和导入进行全面grep建立"双重缺失"的统计学判定；通过29个重复出现的设计模式目录和13个跨切面观察提炼模式；最后以最少90行Python代码实现一个最小可行harness作为综合示范。
AI.result: 研究发现包括：（1）跨约400万行Python/TypeScript/Rust代码，无一agent运行时使用通用agentic框架（LangChain/LangGraph/AutoGen/CrewAI等），亦无一对代码使用向量嵌入检索（双重缺失）；（2）7/11系统采用阈值触发的LLM压缩作为生产级上下文管理的事实标准；（3）Skills（9/11）在采用率上反超MCP（8/11），OpenCode自动读取Claude Code技能目录实现跨厂商互操作；（4）ACP协议演化出第三种角色"harness hosting"——OpenHands通过ACP将Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI作为可互换的后端运行；（5）四月版本与七月版本对比显示"趋同变为模仿"（Codex原样采纳Claude Code的hook词汇，OpenHands读取Claude Code的插件格式），行为策略从prompt正文迁移到配置；（6）差异化最大化体现在持久记忆的治理模型（agent自主/人工审批/模型直接/逐轮智能回忆四型）；（7）platform turn现象已被源代码证据支持：harness成为可导入SDK，框架厂商反向发布harness（融合），元harness Omnigent通过统一API编排11个厂商harness。
AI.conclusion: 论文的总体论点是：在2026年上半年，编码harness完成了从工具到平台的转变。开发者不再"使用"框架，而是"置身于其中"，通过Markdown文件（CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md/SKILL.md）以自然语言为载体配置agent行为。Harness工程应坚持：手写异步循环+确定性检索的简约架构、按部署环境分级构建安全机制、采用SKILL.md技能包+渐进式披露的扩展范式、在子agent层保留进程内原语、向外发布ACP服务器以同时获取编辑器/宿主/元编排器三类受众；不应构建代码RAG层、使用通用agentic框架、用行号包装API、不要过度设计卡住检测。90行的最小可行脚手架在同等任务上与生产级系统具有可比的benchmark表现，scaffold复杂性主要服务于安全/UX/扩展性而非任务完成率。

title: Structure-Behavior Coalescence and the Limits of Traditional Systems Theory
summary: This paper examines a foundational assumption in traditional systems theory, namely that structure (the organization of components) and behavior (the evolution of system activity over time) can be treated as separable analytical dimensions. It argues that this separation contributes to persistent difficulties in explaining system identity, particularly in cases involving change, emergence, and boundary specification. To address this issue, the paper introduces Structure-Behavior Coalescence (SBC) as a reframing principle. SBC proposes that structure and behavior should not be understood as independently existing entities that are subsequently related through modeling constructs, but as mutually constitutive aspects of a single systemic process. From this perspective, system identity is understood as arising from the sustained co-determination of structural organization and behavioral dynamics, rather than from their external correspondence or alignment. This reframing provides a unified way of understanding system identity, emergence, and boundary formation within a cybernetically informed systems perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战传统系统理论中将"结构"与"行为"作为可分离分析维度的基本假设，提出"结构-行为融合"(SBC) 作为新的重构原则，主张二者是单一系统过程中相互构成的方面，而非通过建模构建相关联的独立实体。
AI.motivation: 传统系统理论将结构（组件的组织）与行为（系统活动随时间的演变）视为可分离的分析维度，这种分离导致在解释系统身份（尤其涉及变化、涌现和边界界定的情况）时存在持续的困难。作者认为根本原因在于这一概念分离本身。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究方法：1）批判性审视传统系统理论中结构与行为的可分离性假设；2）引入"结构-行为融合"(Structure-Behavior Coalescence, SBC) 作为重构原则；3）从控制论(cybernetically)视角重新阐释系统身份、涌现和边界形成。SBC 将结构和行为视为单一系统过程的相互构成(mutually constitutive)方面，而非独立存在后通过外部建模关联的实体。
AI.result: 提出了一个统一的概念框架——SBC，将系统身份理解为源于结构组织与行为动力学的持续共同决定(sustained co-determination)，而非其外部对应或对齐。该框架在控制论启发的系统视角下，为理解系统身份、涌现和边界形成提供了统一的方式。
AI.conclusion: SBC 作为重构原则，通过消除结构与行为之间的概念分离，为系统理论中的核心难题（系统身份、涌现、边界界定）提供了一种统一的理解路径，植根于控制论传统但超越了传统的结构-行为二分法。

title: What Is a System? An Interaction-Based Account of Structure-Behavior Coalescence in General Systems Theory
summary: The question of what constitutes a system remains fundamental to General Systems Theory. Existing definitions commonly characterize a system in terms of elements, relationships, boundaries, functions, or interactions, but these perspectives do not always provide a unified account of how system structure and system behavior constitute one another. This paper proposes Structure-Behavior Coalescence (SBC) as an interaction-based account of what a system is. From the SBC perspective, a system is not merely a collection of elements or relationships, nor is it adequately characterized by behavior considered independently of structure. Rather, a system is a structured entity whose behavior arises through interactions among its constituent entities, with those interactions simultaneously contributing to both its structural organization and behavioral realization. The paper develops this perspective by distinguishing system structure, interaction, and behavior while treating them as inseparable aspects of a unified system representation. It argues that interactions provide the essential link through which structural relationships become behavioral processes and through which behavioral processes reveal and instantiate system structure. This perspective provides a basis for representing systems in a manner that maintains consistency between what a system is and what a system does. The paper further considers the implications of SBC for General Systems Theory, particularly for system identity, system boundaries, behavioral emergence, and the representation of complex systems. SBC is presented as a general conceptual foundation that complements existing systems theories by placing the coalescence of structure and behavior through interaction at the center of the definition of a system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构-行为融合"（Structure-Behavior Coalescence, SBC）概念，作为一种基于交互的系统定义，旨在解决一般系统理论中长期存在的"系统本质"问题，强调系统的结构与行为通过交互不可分割地统一在一起。
AI.motivation: 现有系统定义多从元素、关系、边界、功能或交互等单一视角出发，无法统一解释系统结构与系统行为如何相互构成。该论文旨在弥补这一理论缺口，提供一个更具整合性的系统本体论基础。
AI.method: 论文采用概念分析与理论构建的方法，通过区分系统结构、交互与行为三个维度，提出 SBC 框架，将交互视为连接结构与行为的核心纽带，强调三者在统一系统表征中的不可分离性，并探讨其对系统识别、系统边界、行为涌现及复杂系统表征的影响。
AI.result: 论文构建了 SBC 理论框架，论证了交互在系统中的核心中介作用——既是结构关系转化为行为过程的通道，也是行为过程揭示并实例化系统结构的途径，从而为"系统是什么"与"系统做什么"之间的一致性表征提供了概念基础。
AI.conclusion: SBC 为一般系统理论提供了一个以结构-行为融合为核心的一般概念基础，补充了现有系统理论，并在系统身份识别、边界界定、行为涌现与复杂系统表征等方面具有重要理论意义。

title: Can MCP Clients Decide What to Do After Failure? A Result-Only Actionability Audit
summary: A client that receives isError:true knows that something went wrong. It may still have no machine-readable basis for deciding whether to fix an argument, authenticate, wait, choose another tool, or stop. This paper studies what deterministic software can learn from a completed MCP failure result alone; request arguments, schemas, discovery history, authen- tication state, transport metadata, host policy, and ap- plication state are outside that boundary. We introduce a six-part actionability profile and apply it with record- level evidence. In a small illustrative study of 21 safely induced failures from ten reachable sampled servers, typed fields expose failure in 18 cases and a broad policy in 8, yet expose no specific cause, target, executable repair, or replay constraint. Prose often carries more cause and target information, at the price of making semantic interpretation part of the recovery path. A lexical source audit finds the same text-centered pat- tern. Finally, a fail-closed prototype demonstrates how a separate experimental control plane could support deterministic branching. The result is deliberately nar- rower than an ecosystem survey or an agent benchmark: completed MCP results often make failure observable, sometimes make a broad response possible, and rarely make concrete recovery or safe replay self-contained in this sample.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了 MCP（Model Context Protocol）客户端在仅收到完成的失败结果时，能从结果本身学到多少用于确定下一步安全动作的信息。作者提出六维可操作性画像（失败检测、粗粒度策略、原因/子类型、修复目标、可执行修复、重放约束），对 21 例安全诱导的失败进行记录级编码，并展示一个失败闭合的确定性原型。结果表明：类型化字段常能暴露失败（18/21），偶能暴露粗粒度策略（8/21），但极少在不含语义解读的情况下提供具体原因、目标、可执行修复或重放约束；散文文本往往携带更多信息，但代价是把语义解读推入恢复路径。
AI.motivation: MCP 标准化了工具调用失败的"可观察性"（如 isError:true），但缺乏通用的恢复语义字段。客户端收到失败结果后，无法机器化地区分应修复参数、认证、延迟重试、换工具还是停止，盲目重试可能造成资源浪费甚至副作用。已有协议（HTTP Problem Details、gRPC 状态码）已分离机器控制与人可读解释，但 MCP 在普通完成的工具错误上尚未做此分离。作者意图用可审计方法量化"仅凭完成结果"能走多远。
AI.method: 1. 提出非累积的六维可操作性画像 a(o)=(D,P,C,T,E,R)，分别编码失败检测、粗粒度策略、原因/子类型、修复目标、可执行修复、重放约束，并定义分量序偏序。2. 区分"控制视图"（字符串不透明）与"内容辅助视图"（可解读模型可见文本）。3. 固定 2026-07-28 规范与 8 月 19 日注册表快照，对 54 个种子仓库做分层采样，得到 16,699 唯一仓库；用窄义词典扫描器定位错误构造路径并人工裁决。4. 对 15 个远程端点做低负载探针（不存在工具名、错误类型、域外哨兵），得到 10 端点、21 个验证失败。5. 用两个小模型（Llama 3.2 3B、Qwen 0.8B）×4 条件（规范化、仅代码、结构化动作、散文动作）×5 重复 = 840 决策做策略选择压力测试。6. 实现失败闭合确定性原型作为控制平面基线。
AI.result: 画像编码：控制视图下 D=18/21、P=8/21、C=T=E=R=0；内容辅助视图下 D=21/21、P=C=19/21、T=18/21、E=R=0。控制视图剖面呈链 110000(8)、100000(10)、000000(3)；内容视图呈链 111100(18)、111000(1)、100000(2)。静态代码审计：12 条生产错误构造路径均组合 isError+文本，7 条仅散文，5 条文本内嵌 JSON，无标准码或动作字段。模型测试：在唯一不含答案的"代码 vs 规范化"对比中，加符号化原因码未带来提升（Llama 严格匹配 42→39，Qwen 6→5）；含答案的条件主要衡量是否遵循指令而非独立推理。确定性原型在 21 个反事实控制与 17 个畸形/不安全输入（含 code–target 不匹配、不可安全即时重放）上按设计失败闭合。
AI.conclusion: 在"仅完成结果"边界内，MCP 标准化了失败可观察性多于恢复语义。确定性软件常能识别失败、偶能识别粗粒度策略类，但在本样本中，自治的具体恢复仍依赖散文或结果之外的信息。提出的双平面候选（控制平面给主机，解释留在 content）作为审计驱动的执行性目标，需稳定原因码、策略兼容性、可选目标、对重放与副作用的显式断言；互操作性与对抗条件仍未验证。后续工作需独立人工编码、跨 SDK 原始报文捕获、缺失的失败类（限流、上游、超时、部分提交、幂等性）、端到端恢复实验与对抗试验。

title: Framework and Benchmark for Code-Driven Agentic Testing in Web Development
summary: End-to-end GUI testing is essential for verifying web applications, yet existing evaluations rely on predefined checklists and are confined to the data and frameworks of web generation benchmarks, leaving the bug-discovery ability of vision-language models (VLMs) systematically untested. We introduce \textbf{C}ode-driven \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{T}esting (CAT), a paradigm in which the agent writes Playwright code to drive the browser, gathers feedback, and autonomously explores web applications to uncover bugs. We instantiate CAT with CATJudge, an agentic framework that unifies Browser-Use and Computer-Use tools within a single environment and CATTest, a benchmark of 102 AI-generated web applications with carefully annotated bugs, built through close human-AI collaboration to feature complex interactions and subtle defects. Experiments with mainstream VLMs show that all evaluated models perform poorly, revealing a clear gap between current VLM capabilities and the demands of real-world testing in AI web development. We release our code and data at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CAT（Code-driven Agentic Testing）范式及配套的 CATJudge 框架与 CATTest 基准，评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在 AI 生成 Web 应用中作为自主 QA 工程师的代码驱动端到端 GUI 测试能力。实验表明当前主流 VLM 在该任务上表现均不佳，最高 R-score 仅 42.57，揭示了现有 VLM 能力与真实 Web 测试需求间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有 Web GUI 测试评估依赖预定义检查清单，且受限于 Web 生成基准的数据与框架，未能系统性地测试 VLM 的真实缺陷发现能力。作者旨在填补这一空白，建立一种不依赖清单、由智能体自主探索并发现 Bug 的测试范式，并提供相应框架与基准。
AI.method: 1. 提出 CAT 范式：智能体直接编写 Playwright 代码驱动浏览器，收集反馈并自主探索 Web 应用以发现 Bug（Hybrid-Side 测试）。2. 构建 CATJudge 框架：在统一环境中融合 Browser-Use（BUA，基于 Playwright）与 Computer-Use（CUA，基于 PyAutoGUI）工具，通过 Xvfb 虚拟显示器实现两类自动化共存。3. 构建 CATTest 基准：包含 102 个 AI 生成的复杂 Web 应用及人工-AI 协作标注的 190 个真实 Bug（平均 1.86 个/项目），通过提升生成提示复杂度促使前沿编码模型自然产生细微缺陷。4. 设计双层评估指标：细粒度 R-score（召回）与 P-score（精确率）用于衡量 Bug 发现能力；粗粒度 Accuracy/Recall/Precision/F1 用于 pass/not_pass 二分类判定。5. 在 16 个主流 VLM 上进行实验，并通过 Hybrid-Side vs. User-Side vs. Developer-Side 对比、工具集消融等分析验证设计选择。
AI.result: 1. 全部 16 个受测 VLM 表现欠佳：最高 R-score 为 Claude-Opus-4.7 的 42.57，最高 P-score 为 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 48.56；Claude-Sonnet-4.6 召回率达 98.65 但 R-score 仅 37.68，表明仅能笼统判断"项目有问题"而无法定位具体缺陷。2. 模型能力分层明显：Claude-Opus-4.7/4.6、GPT-5.5、Claude-Sonnet-4.6、Gemini-3.1-Pro 组成领先梯队（R-score>36），Qwen3.6-27B 与 Kimi-K2.6 居中（30–34），其余模型均低于 25。3. Hybrid-Side 显著优于 User-Side（R 42.57 vs. 32.94）且更廉价（每项目 9.1 分钟 vs. 13.9 分钟，成本仅为 58%）；Developer-Side 静态代码审查 R-score 尚可（35.87）但 P-score 严重崩塌（10.60），存在大量误报。4. 强模型更偏好灵活的脚本执行工具而非原子化操作；工具集消融显示加入 Playwright 原子操作反而降低 R-score（42.57→35.07）。5. 典型失败模式包括：Mirage Reasoning（智能体自洽地为异常观测编造合理解释而忽视视觉证据）、Interaction Coverage 不足（依赖高层 click/press 而未构造复杂手势）、Spec Hallucination（套用通用先验作为隐含规范导致误报）。6. 移除 QA 项目文档后 R-score 从 40.64 骤降至 27.17，表明最简文档指引对测试效果至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了代码驱动智能体测试（CAT）这一新范式，将 Playwright 代码作为智能体与浏览器交互的主要接口，并证明了该范式在准确性与成本上均优于纯用户侧 GUI 操作。CATJudge 框架与 CATTest 基准为评估 VLM 在真实 AI 编程场景下的端到端 GUI 测试能力提供了系统化方案。实验结果揭示了当前 VLM 能力与实际 Web 测试需求间的实质性鸿沟，指出 Bug 发现是比传统代码生成基准更强的大模型编码智能探针。基准、代码与数据均已开源。

title: Empirical Software Engineering in Practice: Insights from Google
comment: Published in ACM SIGSOFT Software Engineering Notes (SEN), Volume 51, Issue 4, 2026
summary: While it is fairly well known how empirical software engineering (ESE) is used in the academic world, we have limited knowledge of how ESE is practiced in industry. As part of our regular column on empirical software engineering (ACM SIGSOFT SEN-ESE), we want to dedicate a series of articles to interviewing ESE practitioners from various companies. Among other things, we want to understand how ESE processes are implemented in industry, e.g., different research methods, how practitioners decide on what to study, how research results are used within companies and beyond, and if they face recurrent impediments to using ESE methods in industrial contexts. In the first edition of "ESE in Practice", we are joined by Ciera Jaspan and Collin Green from the Developer Intelligence team at Google. This article is a faithful account of our conversation from August 13, 2026, which we edited for our column.

AI.tldr: 本文是 ACM SIGSOFT SEN-ESE 专栏"ESE in Practice"系列的第一篇，通过对 Google Developer Intelligence 团队的 Ciera Jaspan 和 Collin Green 的访谈，揭示了工业界（特别是大规模企业环境）中实证软件工程（ESE）的实践方法、研究方法论、混合方法研究的重要性以及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 学术界对 ESE 在工业界（尤其是大型科技公司）中的实际应用知之甚少。该系列文章旨在通过访谈不同公司的 ESE 实践者，了解工业界 ESE 流程的实施方式、研究方法的选择、研究成果的内部使用与外部发表策略，以及在工业环境中应用 ESE 方法面临的常见障碍。Google 作为拥有大规模工程团队和丰富数据资源的企业，其实践对学术界和工业界均具有重要参考价值。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈方法，由两位专栏主持人（Roberto Verdecchia 和 Justus Bogner）采访 Google Developer Intelligence 团队的两位成员。访谈内容涵盖团队职能、研究方法、研究问题来源、结果使用与发表策略、面临的挑战、工业界对学术研究的态度以及 ESE 未来发展方向等多个主题。文章以问答形式忠实呈现访谈内容（经编辑润色）。
AI.result:
1. **团队定位**：Google Developer Intelligence 团队是研究型团队，跨越多个工具团队，研究软件工程师的幸福感与生产力，通过反馈、指标设计和实验评估帮助工具团队做出决策。团队成员背景多元（包括软件工程、心理学、经济学、政治学等），体现跨学科特征。
