AI.motivation: 标准联邦学习依赖参数平均，要求客户端具有相同模型架构；在数据和架构同时异构时，权重形状和语义不兼容，非IID训练还会引发客户端漂移。现有知识蒸馏联邦方法通常通过公共数据集、合成传输集或中心服务器融合知识，又带来可用性、隐私和中心化问题。在无服务器、无公共数据、完全去中心化的设置中，核心难点是如何聚合不同架构、类别相关可靠性不同的多个教师预测。均匀平均或置信度加权无法同时反映教师准确性与有限样本支持。
AI.method: 在10个客户端上，将CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和PathMNIST按Dirichlet分布划分，α=0.3以产生严重非IID；客户端循环使用ResNet-18、ResNet-18-Half和CNN-6。每轮客户端冻结上一轮模型快照，将模型、架构标识及每类验证样本数和验证准确率发给其他客户端；学生在本地批次上运行各教师，并通过温度缩放softmax得到软预测。CRAD逐类执行两阶段聚合：先按支持样本过滤无证据教师，再计算每个教师预测相对初步均值的偏差，以类级中位偏差为阈值保留至少约一半的支持教师；最后采用Agresti–Coull校正类别准确率，以其Bernoulli方差的倒数作为精度权重，并逐类加权教师软预测后重新归一化。训练损失为本地交叉熵与温度缩放KL蒸馏损失的加权和。比较FedMD、FedGD、MSFKD、DFML、FedMKD、Uniform KD和Uncertainty KD，并进行支持过滤、权重规则、客户端数量及隐私噪声分析。
AI.result: CRAD在三个数据集上均取得最高全局准确率：CIFAR-10为78.60%，高于Uncertainty KD的77.41%和Uniform KD的77.19%；CIFAR-100为48.22%，高于DFML的47.29%、Uncertainty KD的42.06%和Uniform KD的41.53%；PathMNIST为89.49%，高于FedMKD的88.35%和Uniform KD的87.59%。其局部准确率分别为87.09%、59.87%和88.14%，在CIFAR-100与PathMNIST上也是最高。类级结果显示，方法间差异在稀有类别上更明显；CIFAR-10最稀有类别中CRAD约56%，其他聚合变体约47%。在每轮仅10个客户端参与、候选池为20/50/100的实验中，CRAD全局准确率为64.18%/29.94%/22.19%，均高于Uniform KD的53.77%/22.81%/11.01%。精度加权在所测权重规则中最佳。CRAD每轮单客户端发送194.3 MB模型载荷，额外统计量低于1 KB；整轮约21.3秒、峰值显存0.60 GB。作者另报告，对类别计数加入ε=1的拉普拉斯噪声后，CIFAR-100准确率为47.40%，仅下降0.82个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CRAD表明，在去中心化、异构架构和非IID数据的联邦学习中，模型快照可通过本地评估和共享类后验形成可兼容的知识接口。对不同类别分别进行共识过滤和精度加权，比统一平均或预测熵加权更能利用有限、类别相关的教师可靠性。主要结论得到三个图像分类基准的共同支持：CRAD在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和PathMNIST上分别取得78.60%、48.22%和89.44%的全局准确率，且在CIFAR-100、PathMNIST上局部准确率最高。方法的主要不足是交换完整模型快照的通信与计算开销较高，并依赖“低可靠教师在各类别中不占多数”的过滤假设；高支持、高准确率但偏离共识的专家仍可能被误删。作者将模型快照的端到端差分隐私保护、跨模态任务验证，以及让支持度影响而非仅先于共识过滤作为未来方向。

title: Can LLMs Use Relational Transformer Embeddings?
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Foundation Models for Structured Data Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. OpenReview: this https URL
summary: Injecting frozen relational-encoder embeddings as soft tokens into a large language model (LLM) is a conceptually appealing fusion strategy: the encoder handles multi-table structure, the LLM handles language and reasoning, and no lossy text serialization is required. We test this hypothesis concretely by injecting embeddings from a frozen Relational Transformer (RT) into Qwen3.5-4B via a learned MLP projection and LoRA adaptation, trained first with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on chain-of-thought reasoning traces and then with group-based reinforcement learning (GSPO). We evaluate across 10 binary classification tasks on 6 relational databases from RelBench, under four supervision regimes: single-task (ST), within-dataset (WD), cross-dataset (CD), and all-task (ALL). The hybrid model does not consistently outperform standalone RT: it is frequently below random, highly sensitive to serialization format and relational-token budget, and unstable under RL training. We report these negative results and analyze the failure modes, arguing that soft-token fusion requires stronger alignment objectives and schema-aware design before it can serve as a reliable route to relational prediction.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a negative/negative-leaning empirical study testing whether soft-token fusion of frozen Relational Transformer (RT) embeddings into a large language model (Qwen3.5-4B) can improve relational prediction on RelBench. Across 10 binary classification tasks, 6 databases, and 4 supervision regimes, the hybrid architecture consistently underperforms standalone RT, often performs below random, and is highly sensitive to design choices (serialization format, token budget, attention mask). The conclusion is that soft-token fusion is not a plug-and-play solution and requires better alignment and schema-aware design.
AI.motivation: Two dominant paradigms for relational prediction exist: structure-aware relational encoders (e.g., Relational Transformer) and LLMs prompted with serialized data. Each has complementary strengths—the former captures multi-table structure but lacks language reasoning; the latter reasons well but struggles with multi-table serialization. This motivates a fusion hypothesis: inject frozen RT embeddings as continuous soft tokens into an LLM, letting the RT handle structure and the LLM handle reasoning, bypassing lossy text serialization entirely. The paper explicitly tests whether this intuitive strategy actually works in practice.
AI.method: The proposed architecture fuses a frozen Relational Transformer (RT) with Qwen3.5-4B by: (1) encoding each target entity's relational ego-graph into L=256 embeddings of dimension 256 using the frozen RT; (2) projecting these via a learned two-layer MLP with Tanh activation into Qwen3.5-4B's 2560-dim hidden space; (3) inserting the projected embeddings into the prompt as continuous soft tokens interleaved with JSON-structured text tokens (field, entity, and punctuation tokens); (4) adapting only the MLP projection and LoRA adapters (r=16, α=32) on attention projections. Training follows a two-stage pipeline inspired by BioReason: (a) SFT warm-up on 7,869 chain-of-thought style-variation reasoning traces generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 across all 10 tasks; (b) GSPO (group-based reinforcement learning with mean-only normalization and DAPO-style asymmetric clipping) per task-regime with binary correctness + format rewards, G=4, 100 samples per task, LR=1e-6, 2 epochs. Ablations cover attention masking (causal vs. hybrid bidirectional on relational block), serialization (flat vs. JSON), and relational token count (L=64/256/1024). Evaluation covers 4 supervision regimes on 6 RelBench databases: ST (single-task), WD (within-dataset transfer), CD (cross-dataset), ALL (joint all-task).
AI.result: The hybrid architecture consistently fails to outperform standalone RT, with the following key findings: (1) Main AUROC: RT achieves 71.9 (ST) and 69.7 (CD), while hybrids range 48.2–61.4 across regimes; even the best hybrid (GSPO ALL = 61.4) is inflated by two outlier tasks (user-clicks 81.5, user-visits 68.9); (2) Hybrid performs below random (≤50 AUROC) on most individual tasks and configurations (e.g., SFT collapses to 48.3 in ST, SFT+GSPO = 48.2 in WD); (3) Ablations reveal high fragility: switching from flat to JSON serialization yields the largest effect (+0.632, +0.359 on two tasks), suggesting the LLM relies on textual scaffolding rather than soft tokens; attention mask choice helps one task but hurts another; (4) SFT warm-up provides no benefit—SFT+GSPO underperforms GSPO-only in WD (48.2 vs 53.5); (5) Diminishing returns above L=64 relational tokens suggest limited information extraction; (6) Only on RT's two weakest tasks (user-churn on rel-hm, study-outcome) does the hybrid marginally exceed RT, but these gains do not generalize to RT's strong tasks. All results are single-seed.
AI.conclusion: The paper concludes that soft-token fusion of frozen relational encoder embeddings into an LLMs is not a reliable route to relational prediction. The findings cast doubt on the assumed plug-and-play complementarity of structure-aware encoders and language models via continuous token injection. Key limitations acknowledged: only binary classification, single 4B LLM, 100 GSPO samples, single-seed runs. Future directions identified: (1) stronger alignment objectives beyond SFT+RL, (2) schema-aware projection layers conditioned on database metadata rather than a schema-agnostic MLP, (3) larger training budgets and larger LLMs. The negative results serve as a cautionary signal for the multimodal-fusion-of-foundation-models paradigm in relational learning, suggesting that effective soft-token fusion requires non-trivial architectural and training innovations rather than off-the-shelf composition.

title: Context Window Failures in Relational Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Foundation Models for Structured Data Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. OpenReview: this https URL
summary: Recent Relational Deep Learning architectures have been proposed as foundation models for multi-table relational data, yet they impose constrained neighborhood budgets that force row truncation when an entity has many related records. We introduce Animus, a synthetic financial dataset in which predicting customer income requires aggregating up to tens of thousands of transactions. On the raw representation, three recently proposed models (RT, Griffin, RelGT) achieve $R^2 \le 0.18$; a single, routine, temporal pre-aggregation step recovers $R^2$ up to $0.65$. This questions whether current relational foundation models are ready for high-cardinality real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Animus合成金融数据集，专门用于压力测试关系型深度学习（Relational Deep Learning）模型的"邻域预算"（neighborhood budget）瓶颈。在客户交易记录高达数万条的高基数场景下，三种最新的关系基础模型（RT、Griffin、RelGT）在原始数据上表现极差（R²≤0.18），仅需一个常规的时序预聚合步骤即可将性能大幅提升至R²=0.65，由此质疑当前关系基础模型对真实高基数数据的适用性。
AI.motivation: 近期被提出的关系基础模型（如Relational Transformer、Griffin、RelGT）均对每个实体可纳入的关联记录数量设有硬性上限（上下文窗口/子图采样预算/逐跳扇出），超出预算的记录将被截断丢弃。然而真实关系型数据库中，高频实体所累积的记录数量远超这些模型的设计上限，这一缺口此前未经严格压力测试。
AI.method:
1. **数据集构建（Animus）**：包含10万客户的合成金融数据库，三张关系表（Customers、Transactions、Payments），客户交易频率呈异质性分布——60%为单次/月，5%为高频（1000-10000次/月），最高可达88717条交易节点；任务为基于RelBench框架的客户月度收入回归。
2. **核心对抗性质**：目标变量等于当月所有信用交易金额之和，因此观测到k<K条记录将产生期望值为 y·k/K 的低估偏差，基数越高越严重。
3. **两种数据表示**：原始（Raw，每笔交易为单独节点）vs. 预聚合（Agg-Simple，按月按类别求和），二者编码相同聚合信息，仅基数不同。
4. **评估模型**：GraphSAGE、RT、Griffin、RelGT，分别在两种表示上进行超参数网格搜索，以测试集R²为主要评估指标。
AI.result:
1. **原始表示上**：RT R²=0.18，Griffin R²=0.11，RelGT因内存溢出（OM）未能构造图；GraphSAGE R²=0.69。
2. **预聚合表示上**：RT提升至R²=0.65（+0.47），Griffin提升至0.38（+0.27），RelGT为0.23；GraphSAGE仅由0.69提升至0.75（+0.06）。
3. **分箱分析**：GraphSAGE在低频客户（差额≤16笔交易）上原始表示略优，但在高频客户（差额≥16笔）上聚合表示以+0.44 R²显著胜出，证实失败定位于超过采样预算的客户。
4. **结论**：仅靠一个SQL常规聚合操作就能带来0.2-0.5的R²提升，这对标榜为"基础模型"的方法而言是脆弱的表现；基础模型应自主学会"聚合什么"，而非依赖人工预先聚合。
AI.conclusion: Animus数据集揭示了当前关系基础模型在高基数关系数据上的根本性瓶颈——硬性的上下文长度限制使其无法有效处理真实工业级关系数据库中的高频实体。三种最新架构在原始事件级表示上几乎失效（RelGT甚至无法构图），而GraphSAGE因采用更大采样预算相对稳健。作者呼吁未来工作探索可扩展的关系基础模型架构，并提出可进一步扩展为"大海捞针"变体（needle-in-a-haystack），测试模型在大量正常交易中选择性定位单个异常记录的能力。

title: AdaptNTK: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification and Active Learning for Neural Network Potentials
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials bridge the gap between quantum chemical precision and classical computational speed, enabling molecular dynamics simulations with first-principles accuracy. Their reliability is often improved through active learning, which iteratively expands the training set by identifying uncertain, out-of-distribution configurations. Existing uncertainty-quantification methods often involve a trade-off between computational cost and reliability, and generally cannot account for redundancy as an acquisition batch is assembled. Here, we introduce AdaptNTK, a single-model framework that measures uncertainty as a regularized Mahalanobis distance in empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) feature space. With the NTK features fixed during acquisition, the uncertainty depends on the acquired configurations but not their reference labels. This allows the uncertainty to be updated recursively after each selection without retraining, reducing redundancy within an acquisition batch. On held-out rMD17 data, AdaptNTK achieves the highest mean correlations with force errors (Spearman 0.68, Pearson 0.71) and matches a three-member ensemble in error retention. In active learning experiments, AdaptNTK achieves the lowest force errors across rMD17 and Transition-1X, with particularly strong performance on transition-state configurations in Transition-1X. AdaptNTK provides a 2.6-fold speedup per Transition-1X cycle relative to the ensemble, providing efficient single-model uncertainty estimation with sequential updates for data-efficient active learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaptNTK，一种基于经验神经正切核（NTK）特征空间中正则化马氏距离的单模型不确定性量化与主动学习框架，用于神经网络原子间势能。通过利用Sherman-Morrison恒等式进行秩一更新，实现无需重新训练或参考标签的批内顺序采集。在rMD17和Transition-1X数据集上表现优于或匹配三模型集成方法，并实现2.6倍加速。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）的可靠性依赖训练数据，但现有不确定性量化方法在计算成本与可靠性之间存在权衡，且批量采集时无法有效去除冗余。高斯过程虽能解析更新不确定性，但神经网络势能缺乏类似能力。开发可靠、高效的单模型不确定性估计仍是重要挑战。
AI.method: 1. 将每个构型表示为预测能量对模型参数的梯度（NTK特征），在NTK特征空间中计算正则化马氏距离作为不确定性度量：U(x)=λ·φ̃(x)⊤(F̃+λI)⁻¹φ̃(x)；2. 利用高斯随机投影将高维NTK特征降至低维空间，并给出保持不确定性的理论保证（受脊有效维度控制的草图定理）；3. 通过Sherman-Morrison恒等式实现秩一递归更新（Ck+1⁻¹=Ck⁻¹ - …），无需参考标签即可在每步选择后更新所有候选的不确定性分数，将批内选择成本从O(p³)降至O(p²)；4. 采用MACE架构（724,240参数）在rMD17和Transition-1X数据集上进行对比实验。
AI.result: 1. 不确定性质量：在rMD17上，NTK不确定性获得最高的力误差相关性（Spearman 0.683, Pearson 0.706），AURC_n（0.312）与三模型集成（0.310）相当；2. 主动学习：在四种rMD17分子和阿司匹林等系统上，AdaptNTK力RMSE最低，数据效率最高；在Transition-1X上仅需约450标注构型即可达到~4 kcal/mol/Å的力RMSE，而QBC需近1000；在过渡态分割上表现尤为突出；3. 计算成本：在Transition-1X上单周期总耗时2423秒，对比QBC集成6225秒实现2.57倍加速，与单模型方法（MCD、SWAG）耗时相当（差6%以内）；4. 消融实验：移除顺序更新后力RMSE从1.2升至约3 kcal/mol/Å；草图维度p≥128后无单调改善，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: AdaptNTK证明基于经验NTK的不确定性能够将训练后的神经网络势能转化为事后、逐点的单模型不确定性估计，无需委员会或学习的预测头。它实现了rMD17上最强误差相关性，匹配三模型集成的误差保留能力；在不需参考标签或额外模型拟合的情况下，相同不确定性可在采集批次内更新，并在rMD17和Transition-1X中达到最低误差。局限：仅在气相分子上评估；不确定性基于能量梯度特征，与力误差仅间接相关；未涵盖周期性体系或结合化学直觉的采集策略。

title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
comment: 5 pages. Submitted to the Congresso Brasileiro de Ciências e Tecnologias Quânticas (CBCTQ 2026)
summary: This work studies hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for learning routing heuristics. Specifically, this paper asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model while maintaining solution quality. For the capacitated vehicle routing problem, encoder feed-forward replacement emerges as the most promising design: it reduces the number of model parameters by 56.6% while keeping the hybrid model close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, although the gap grows for larger instances. This work also compares to classical routing algorithms, which remain highly competitive and often superior on the fixed Euclidean test sets. Our results therefore do not indicate quantum advantage or solver dominance, but identify encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP), proposing to replace the encoder feed-forward blocks of the Kool et al. (2018) attention model with a compact 4-qubit quantum neural network (QNN) bottleneck. The hybrid FF-QNN model reduces parameters by 56.6% while maintaining solution quality close to the classical baseline on small and medium instances, with a growing gap at larger sizes. Classical heuristics like LKH3, CW, and RCW remain competitive or superior on Euclidean test sets; the work does not demonstrate quantum advantage, but identifies encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.
AI.motivation: The motivation stems from the mismatch between the large parameter count of state-of-the-art neural solvers for combinatorial optimization (such as the attention-based routing model of Kool et al. 2018) and the limited circuit width/depth available on near-term quantum devices. The authors ask whether small, targeted QNN modules can replace specific parameter-heavy classical subcomponents—such as encoder feed-forward blocks—to compress the model while preserving solution quality, rather than attempting to fully replace the classical network.
AI.method: The method builds on the encoder-decoder attention architecture of Kool et al. (2018) for the CVRP. The encoder feed-forward layers (which hold over half of the parameters) are replaced by a hybrid quantum-classical module: a classical projection compresses the d_h=128-dimensional hidden state to q=4 qubits, a variational brickwall ansatz of 2 layers applies trainable R_X, R_Y, R_Z rotations and CNOT gates, and the measured output is up-projected back to d_h. The model has 1,156 classical and 24 quantum parameters per layer, trained end-to-end with REINFORCE and a greedy rollout baseline using Adam. Training uses random Euclidean instances with n∈{10,20,50,100} customers. Evaluation includes greedy decoding and sampling (1,280 samples) on 1,000 test instances, compared against classical attention model (AM), LKH3, Google OR-Tools, CW/RCW, and RSW.
AI.result: Across n=10–100, the FF-QNN model's objective is within ~2% of the classical AM under both greedy and sampling decoding, and is even slightly better at n=10 with sampling (gap 1.61% vs 1.83%). Parameter reduction is 56.6% (391,596 parameters removed, replaced by a 4-qubit bottleneck). Classical heuristics remain strong on the fixed Euclidean test set: RCW achieves the best mean objective at n=10, and LKH3 dominates from n=20 onward (with much higher runtime). CW/RCW are efficient quality-time baselines, outperforming their values reported by Nazari et al. (2018). Increasing training samples by 4× reduces AM and FF-QNN greedy gaps to ~9.3% and ~9.9% respectively at n=100. FF-QNN training time scales as ~8.4n minutes vs ~1.9n minutes for AM due to QNN simulation overhead.
AI.conclusion: The paper concludes that replacing encoder feed-forward blocks with a narrow QNN bottleneck is a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization, preserving most of the solution quality of the classical attention model while reducing parameters by more than 50%. However, the work does not establish quantum advantage or solver dominance: LKH3 produces the best solutions, CW/RCW offer strong efficient baselines, and the QNN's quality degrades on larger instances. Key limitations include the absence of ablation against size-matched classical bottlenecks, so it remains unclear whether the QNN is superior to an equivalent classical compression; future work should include such ablations, alternative QNN architectures, and exploration of sample-efficient regimes where QNNs may offer advantages.

title: VATO: A Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator for Unsteady Separated Aerofoil Flows
summary: Accurate prediction of unsteady separated flows is challenging because the aerodynamic loads depend on nonlinear separation and vortex-shedding dynamics. Although high-fidelity CFD resolves these mechanisms, its cost limits repeated use in design and control. Standard field-level surrogate training, however, does not distinguish the flow regions that contribute most strongly to the aerodynamic loads. We introduce VATO (Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator), which couples the Vortex Force Map (VFM) method to a geometry-aware neural operator through two complementary mechanisms. VATO-S adds training-only supervision of the local VFM force-contribution field, with no increase in model size or inference cost. VATO-A uses VFM contribution and sensitivity fields to prioritise force-relevant source locations for residual cross attention. The methods are evaluated on unsteady CFD data for double-edged-plate aerofoils over 54 trajectories from nine geometries. Over lead times of 1-20~ms, VATO-S reduces velocity, pressure, and vorticity errors by 10.4\%, 1.0\%, and 15.6\%, respectively, while VATO-A achieves reductions of 15.8\%, 7.5\%, and 31.2\%. VATO-S gives the lowest VFM-derived drag error, whereas VATO-A gives the lowest pressure-derived lift and drag errors. Over lead times extending 50\% beyond the training range, VATO-A retains a 26.9\% reduction in vorticity error and larger improvements in all four force readouts, despite reduced gains in velocity and pressure. These results show that force-aware operator learning can improve both flow-field prediction and aerodynamic functional accuracy in unsteady separated flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VATO（Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator），通过两种方式将涡力图（VFM）方法与几何感知Transformer算子结合，用于双缘板翼型的非定常分离流预测。VATO-S仅在训练阶段增加VFM贡献场监督，不改变推理成本；VATO-A利用VFM贡献和敏感度场通过源优先级排序和残差交叉注意力机制来增强预测。在54条轨迹、9种几何的测试集上，VATO-S和VATO-A在1-20ms领先时间内分别降低涡量误差15.6%和31.2%，并在超出训练范围50%的领先时间内保持优势。
AI.motivation: 非定常分离流的精确预测对气动载荷计算至关重要，但传统CFD成本高昂。现有场级代理模型在训练时对计算域内所有网格点施加同等权重，导致对载荷贡献小的尾流和远场区域主导目标函数，而真正决定气动载荷的近壁分离区被忽视。VFM方法虽然提供了基于力学的载荷贡献空间分布信息，但尚未被整合到神经算子的学习与信息路由机制中。
AI.method: 方法包括四个配置：GAOT参考（均匀采样）、GAOT匹配控制（流感知采样）、VATO-S（在GAOT基础上增加VFM贡献场监督损失）和VATO-A（通过VFM贡献与敏感度场对源位置进行优先级排序，插入三条零初始化的残差注意力路径：潜在patch交叉注意力、局部门控交叉注意力和输出查询交叉注意力）。VFM辅助势场基于几何和迎角预计算，无需额外流动求解。训练采用流感知采样器（按轨迹间流动变化程度加权）和AdamW优化器。
AI.result: 在54条测试轨迹、45360个源-目标组合的基准测试中（1-20ms领先时间）：VATO-S相对于GAOT参考降低速度、压力和涡量误差10.4%、1.0%和15.6%；VATO-A降低15.8%、7.5%和31.2%。VATO-S给出最低的VFM推导阻力误差，VATO-A给出最低的压力推导升力和阻力误差。在超出训练范围50%的21-30ms领先时间内，VATO-A保持26.9%的涡量误差降低，且四种力读数均有更大改善。VATO-S保持与骨干网络相同的19.09M参数和34.8ms推理时间，VATO-A为20.08M参数和56.9ms推理时间（增加约63%）。
AI.conclusion: VATO证明了力感知算子学习可同时改善非定常分离流的流场预测和气动函数精度。两种接口覆盖了不同部署条件：VATO-S是不改变推理成本的训练期干预，VATO-A是在推理时投入额外资源以获得更强场精度。在训练范围之外，力函数读数的优势比逐点场精度的优势更持久，因为升力和阻力由相干涡结构产生而非由场整体逐点精度决定。未来的工作包括分离优先级排序规则与额外注意力路径各自的贡献，以及在未见几何形状上的测试。

title: Learning Task-Specific Antibody Representations via Function-Aware Masking
summary: Antibody-specific language models pretrained via masked language modeling (MLM) learn representations that are critical for downstream sequence design and property prediction tasks. Yet, the corruption process itself is rarely leveraged as a source of inductive bias during pretraining. While preferentially masking complementarity-determining regions (CDRs) improves binding-related predictions, antibodies possess diverse biological priors over a variety of functions. Herein, we introduce function-aware masking, a family of pretraining algorithms that align mask placement with specific functional priors (e.g., from IMGT annotations or structure predictions) to shape the learned representation space. We show that these specialist masking strategies significantly improve performance on their respective objectives, yielding up to a 14% gain on structure-related tasks and up to a 5.9x improvement on CDR-related tasks. To further improve performance across multiple functional axes, we develop hybrid masking strategies that integrate multiple priors, balancing reconstruction over binding, structural, and biophysical objectives. Our results demonstrate that informed mask placement provides a parameter-free mechanism for imposing functional inductive biases in antibody language model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"功能感知掩码"（function-aware masking），通过将掩码放置与生物学先验对齐，在不增加推理参数成本的前提下，为抗体语言模型预训练引入任务特定的功能性归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 现有抗体MLM预训练中，随机掩码策略未利用掩码过程本身的归纳偏置。已有的CDR优先掩码仅针对结合功能，但抗体还涉及结构稳定性、可开发性等多维度功能需求，亟需一种通用框架将任意生物学先验编码到掩码策略中。
AI.method: 提出两类预训练策略：(1) 专家策略——利用预计算的残基级标签（如IMGT标注的CDR位置、AntiBERTa2教师模型预测的paratope概率、种系突变状态、IgFold预测结构邻域），通过加权伯努利采样将掩码偏向功能关键残基，共设计7种策略（cdr、span、interface、germline、intersection、structure、structure-lr）；(2) 混合策略——通过随机混合分布与训练课程将多个专家策略组合，共设计7种混合方案。使用38.1M参数的RoFormer在约50万条OAS VH序列上预训练，在7个下游任务上线性探测评估。
AI.result: 专家策略在与其先验对齐的任务上显著优于随机掩码：结构相关任务最高提升14%，CDR相关任务最高提升5.9倍。interface与germline掩码在多项任务上表现最佳。但专家策略在不对齐任务上出现性能退化。混合策略（尤其hybrid-reverse与hybrid-warmstart）在保持跨功能轴泛化能力的同时缓解了此权衡，平均任务排名更高且方差更低。
AI.conclusion: 功能感知掩码证明掩码位置本身可作为参数免费的功能性归纳偏置机制，有效塑造抗体语言模型的表征空间。专家策略适用于任务特化，混合策略适用于多目标平衡的通用表征。该方法为抗体语言模型训练提供了一种灵活且无需额外参数的改进路径。

title: Why Multi-Layer Message Passing Works: Completeness Theory for Graph Neural Network Interatomic Potentials
summary: We prove that the Hypergraph Neural Network, an invariant architecture with 3-body message passing, is a universal approximator for potential energy surfaces. Our main contribution is a multi-layer completeness theory. We show that $L$ layers of message passing on sparse, cutoff-based graphs achieve the same representational power as having access to the full $L$-hop neighborhood, provided the configurations are generic, satisfy an overlap condition and a connectivity condition. This provides the first rigorous justification for the common practice of using multi-layer message passing with a per-layer cutoff smaller than the physical interaction range, the setting used by virtually all practical graph neural network based machine-learned interatomic potentials. As immediate consequences, we show that both DPA3 and CHGNet architectures inherit universal approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了超图神经网络（HGNN，一种具有3体消息传递的不变架构）是势能面的通用逼近器。核心贡献是多层完备性理论：在满足泛型性、重叠条件和连通性条件的构型上，稀疏截断图上L层消息传递具有与完整L跳邻域相同的表示能力，为实践中"每层小截断+多层堆叠"的MLIP设计提供了首个严格理论证明，并推导出DPA3和CHGNet同样具备通用逼近能力。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）广泛使用图神经网络，其设计采用"每层小截断+多层消息传递"以扩展感受野至物理相互作用范围Rc。然而，现有完备性理论仅针对完全连接图或单截断情形，无法解释为何稀疏截断图上的多层消息传递能够实现通用逼近。这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟亟待填补。
AI.method: 1. 引入超图神经网络（HGNN）作为参考理论架构，使用3体消息传递（角度+距离特征），消息函数为MLP；2. 证明完备性⇔通用逼近定理（定理9）：完备表示加MLP读出即通用逼近；3. 通过Gram矩阵重构和Noether不变理论构造完备表示的存在性（命题13）；4. 利用DeepSets通用性（引理15）和MLP近似，将单层HGNN逼近转化为对标记数据的对称函数逼近（引理16，命题17）；5. 通过归纳法（定理24）扩展至多层，关键引理23证明重叠条件下邻居Gram矩阵集合𝓘_j可唯一连续确定扩展Gram矩阵；6. 通过层间模拟证明（补充材料），将DPA3和CHGNet归约到HGNN。
AI.result: 主要结果（定理26）：在泛型构型满足重叠条件和连通性条件下，当L足够大使L跳邻域覆盖物理范围Rc时，L层HGNN是ℱ⁰_Rc的通用逼近器。推论：DPA3和CHGNet继承通用逼近性质（推论27和29，需强泛型性）。关键发现：消息函数必须为MLP而非单线性层，ALIGNN因使用门控线性消息而无法直接应用此论证。理论解释了DPA3实践中K=2（3体）足够而K=3无提升的现象。
AI.conclusion: 本文为MLIP实践中多层消息传递的设计提供了首个严格的理论完备性证明，填补了完全连接图完备性理论与稀疏截断图实践之间的空白。HGNN作为参考架构，任何能模拟其单层的实用架构（DPA3、CHGNet）均继承通用逼近能力。开放问题包括：定量逼近率估计、C^k光滑逼近（力与Hessian）、ALIGNN的完备性、零温晶体的对称退化情形，以及缩小角特征维度da与邻居三元组数量之间的实际差距。

title: DeSyR: A Decoupled Symbolic Recovery Framework with PINN-Guided Structure Search and Physics-Informed Coefficient Refinement
summary: Recovering compact explicit solutions from neural approximations is challenging when imperfect teacher data guide symbolic topology search and coefficient estimation. We present DeSyR, a decoupled symbolic recovery framework for differential equations. A physics-informed neural network guides repeated searches to construct candidate topologies with provisional constants. Once a topology is fixed, its coefficients are refined solely from the governing equation and prescribed constraints, followed by gated selection and verification. For linear fixed-topology parameterizations, we characterize teacher-error inheritance and show that finite-weight mixed data--physics fitting retains an $O(\beta^{-1})$ teacher-dependent contribution when the teacher error projects onto the model space. Under well-posedness, representability, zero-residual attainment, and discrete determinacy, physics-only refinement conditionally recovers exact coefficients; for nonlinear parameterizations, the corresponding guarantees are local. DeSyR is evaluated on 15 differential-equation problems across 18 configurations covering high-order, space--time, multidimensional, nonlinear, and coupled systems. A candidate-level audit yields a 99.23% convergence rate among free-parameter refits, while every selected refinement involving free coefficients converges. Configuration-level median refined relative $L_2$ errors are $2.31\times10^{-14}$ or lower. In same-topology comparisons, refinement reduces error by eight to fourteen orders of magnitude. These results show that an approximate neural teacher can guide topology discovery without imposing its error scale on final recovered coefficients, provided a target-capable topology is retained and physics-only refinement converges.

AI.tldr: DeSyR是一个用于从PINN神经近似中恢复微分方程紧致显式解的解耦符号回归框架。它将PINN引导的拓扑搜索与基于物理的系数精化分离，在15个微分方程问题上实现了近机器精度的恢复，中位精化相对L2误差不超过2.31×10⁻¹⁴。
AI.motivation: 从神经近似中恢复紧致显式解时，不完美的教师数据会同时影响符号拓扑搜索和系数估计，导致恢复的表达可能具有正确的函数结构但系数不准确。需要解耦这两个任务以避免教师误差传播到最终系数。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：阶段A使用PINN样本引导符号搜索生成候选拓扑和临时系数；阶段B冻结拓扑后，仅使用控制方程和约束条件重新估计系数；阶段C通过收敛资格、教师兼容性、物理等价性和复杂度门控进行筛选。针对线性固定拓扑参数化，理论分析了教师误差继承和混合目标的O(β⁻¹)偏差；对非线性参数化给出局部收敛保证。
AI.result: 在18个配置上的评估显示：候选级审计中自由参数精化的收敛率为99.23%；所有选定精化均收敛；配置级中位精化相对L2误差不超过2.31×10⁻¹⁴；相同拓扑比较中精化将误差降低8到14个数量级。结果表明近似神经教师可以引导拓扑发现而不会将其误差尺度强加于最终系数，前提是保留目标能力拓扑且纯物理精化收敛。
AI.conclusion: DeSyR成功分离了符号拓扑发现与最终系数确定。在可表示设置下，近似神经教师可以引导结构发现而不会必然将其误差尺度施加于恢复的系数。操作符库错配实验表明精化无法消除表示错误，有限预算下库扩展可能需要更多搜索工作量来维持目标能力拓扑。

title: GenONet: A Generative operator Network for High-Resolution Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: High-resolution precipitation nowcasting is critical for reducing the impacts of severe weather but remains difficult because of rapid storm evolution. Deep learning models have shown great promise for this task, but their predictive skill often deteriorates over longer forecast horizons. This leads to increasingly blurry forecasts that fail to capture the complex, non-linear evolution of storm systems. In order to address these limitations, we introduce Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet (GenONet), a novel architecture for long-range precipitation forecasting up to 3 hours, specifically designed to produce sharp and physically consistent results. GenONet's architecture pioneers the use of a Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) as a generator within a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework for this task. The DeepONet learns the continuous-time dynamics of precipitation, ensuring stability over long forecast horizons. Adversial training against a spatio-temporal discriminator compels the model to produce sharp, coherent forecasts, while a physics-informed loss regularizer, derived from the Moisture Conservation Equation, improves physical plausibility in our ablation setting. Quantitative evaluations show that our model achieves consistently higher scores on most of the metrics, especially for highintensity events and at longer lead times. Qualitatively, GenONet produces structurally coherent forecasts that maintain their integrity, whereas baseline models degrade into indistinct patterns. Finally, an ablation study confirms the benefit of this physics-informed loss, highlighting the strength of combining operator learning with adversarial training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenONet（Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet），一种结合DeepONet与GAN的新型降水临近预报架构，可生成长达3小时的高分辨率、结构清晰且物理一致的降水预报，并通过物理信息损失函数提升物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率降水临近预报对减轻恶劣天气影响至关重要，但深度学习模型在较长预报时效上常出现预测模糊、无法捕捉风暴系统复杂非线性演化的问题，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出Spazio-Temporal U-DeepONet（GenONet）架构：将DeepONet作为GAN框架内的生成器，利用DeepONet学习降水的连续时间动力学以保证长时效稳定性；通过时空判别器进行对抗训练以生成锐利连贯预报；并采用基于水分守恒方程推导的物理信息损失作为正则化项。
AI.result: 在多项定量指标（尤其对高强度降水和长预报时效）上得分持续优于基线模型；定性上，GenONet能生成结构连贯、保持完整性的预报，而基线模型则退化为模糊图案；消融实验验证了物理信息损失项的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将算子学习（DeepONet）与对抗训练（GAN）相结合、并融入物理信息约束，可有效提升长时效高分辨率降水临近预报的清晰度与物理一致性，GenONet是一种有前景的解决方案。

title: Manifold-Aware General Coded Computing for Straggler-Resilient Distributed Computing
summary: Existing coded-computing designs do not explicitly exploit the intrinsic structure of the input data. In communication systems, statistical structure and redundancy are often removed through source coding (or compression) before channel coding is applied. This principle, however, does not transfer directly to coded computation. In many computational tasks, particularly in machine learning, the structure of the data is precisely what the computation seeks to exploit to infer outputs or learn meaningful patterns. Consequently, coded-computing schemes should preserve and leverage this structure in their code design, rather than ignoring or eliminating it through source coding. This observation motivates a different perspective on code construction. In many channel-coding schemes, such as Reed-Solomon codes, coded symbols are generated by evaluating a low-dimensional algebraic representation at selected points. In contrast, many high-dimensional datasets naturally concentrate near low-dimensional manifolds. In this paper, we exploit this intrinsic geometry by designing coded samples that follow the natural manifold of the data, rather than imposing an artificial low-dimensional structure unrelated to the data distribution. Inspired by graph-based manifold learning, we propose a manifold-aware encoding strategy for general coded computing (GCC). Experiments on neural network inference and high-dimensional polynomial evaluation demonstrate that the proposed strategy consistently and significantly reduces the mean squared recovery error under straggling compared with standard GCC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向通用编码计算（GCC）的流形感知编码策略，通过利用输入数据的内在低维几何结构（流形假设），优化输入样本到编码器设计点的分配顺序，从而在分布式计算中显著降低拖后腿（straggler）情况下的恢复误差。
AI.motivation: 现有编码计算方案通常忽视输入数据的内在结构，将其冗余当作源编码消除的对象。但在机器学习等任务中，数据结构正是计算需要利用的核心信息。与通信中信源-信道分离不同，编码计算应保留并利用数据的几何结构。流形假设表明高维数据通常集中在低维流形附近，这为代码设计提供了新的自由度。
AI.method: 1. 编码器分配优化：将输入样本到有序编码器设计点的分配视为新的设计变量；2. 构建距离加权完全图，节点为输入样本，边权重为欧氏距离；3. 通过求解最短Hamilton路径问题得到最优排列π*，使相邻设计点对应数据空间中相近的样本；4. 因精确求解TSP复杂度O(K²2^K)，采用2-opt局部搜索启发式算法近似求解；5. 后续沿用标准GCC框架：基于排列拟合二阶平滑样条编码器，采样生成编码输入，worker计算后用解码样条恢复。
AI.result: 在LeNet5推理任务（N=100, K=60）和高维8次多项式评估任务（N=31, K=12）上的实验表明：1. 流形感知GCC在所有拖后腿数量下均显著降低MSE恢复误差；2. 在高拖后腿场景下提升尤为明显；3. 相对分类准确率也有所提高；4. 2-opt启发式近似性能接近精确最优Hamilton路径解；5. 标准GCC误差随拖后腿数增加而恶化，提出的方法在测试范围内保持接近零的恢复误差。
AI.conclusion: 将输入顺序作为编码设计的额外变量，结合流形学习思想利用数据内在几何结构，能在不改变GCC整体流水线的情况下显著提升straggler恢复性能。该工作揭示了数据驱动的代码设计原则，为编码计算开辟了利用数据结构的新方向。

title: CRAFT: Fine-Tuning Pre-hoc Explainability in AI-native 6G RAN
summary: The next generation of mobile networks is envisioned as fully AI-native, with AI-RAN architectures embedding small language models (SLMs) to perform reasoning over real-time telemetry. The state-of-the-art training paradigms for telecom LLMs, exemplified by RANSTRUCT-style supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated instruction data, are limited to post hoc rationalization. Here, the explanations, when produced at all, are generated after or independently of the decision, leaving the decision process unauditable. Pre-hoc reasoning, where a causal reasoning trace is produced before the output label, is preferable, and the broader LLM reasoning literature has made real progress toward it via RL methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Here we observe that transplanting this recipe into the telecom setting runs into a cold-start barrier: SLMs either learn to output the desired format or learn to predict the label, but rarely both. We identify this barrier and propose CRAFT, which stands for Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning, a data-centric method to autonomously generate a verified dataset of (input, trace, label) triplets. CRAFT fine-tunes SLMs on this verified data using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), requiring substantially less compute and wall-clock time than GRPO-based methods. On the TRACTOR and IC xApp telecom datasets, CRAFT achieves up to 86.5% and 94.6% for accuracy and F1 with no parse failures, while direct GRPO and SFT+GRPO fail to exceed 28% and 53.5% F1 with multiple parse failures. We further show that CRAFT-initialized policies serve as a robust foundation for subsequent GRPO fine-tuning, as under diverse reward functions the performance remains consistent with no parse failures. Finally, we demonstrate that CRAFT consumes 59% less energy than GRPO-based baselines, making it a sustainable path to deployable, auditable AI in 6G RAN.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI原生6G RAN中电信小语言模型(SLM)无法生成可审计的预先因果推理(prehoc reasoning)的问题,提出CRAFT(Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning)方法。该方法通过Oracle Reasoner和Predictor双角色自举构建(input, trace, label)三元组验证数据集,再使用LoRA对目标SLM进行监督微调。在TRACTOR和IC xApp数据集上分别达到86.5%和94.6%的F1分数,零解析失败,且为后续GRPO微调提供稳定初始化,能耗比GRPO基线降低59%。
AI.motivation: 6G RAN要求AI模型不仅输出决策,还需提供可审计的预先因果推理trace。当前RANSTRUCT式SFT仅产生事后合理化(post-hoc rationalization),而GRPO类RL方法直接应用于电信SLM时陷入冷启动障碍(cold-start barrier):模型只能学会格式或标签之一,无法同时兼顾。需要一种数据驱动方法绕过RL探索难题。
AI.method: 1. 冷启动障碍诊断:SLM在GRPO复合奖励(格式+推理存在+标签准确率)下同时优化冲突目标导致探索失败。2. CRAFT三阶段流程:(a) Oracle Reasoner基于KPI输入和真实标签生成候选推理trace;(b) 三重过滤(最小长度τ_min、格式正确性、提取成功)剔除低质trace;(c) Predictor接收输入+trace必须能恢复真实标签,通过者作为最终验证数据集D'。3. 目标SLM(Qwen 3.5 2B/4B、Nemotron-3-Nano 4B)使用LoRA(rank=16, α=32)在D'上以标准语言模型损失监督微调。Oracle和Predictor均实例化为Gemma 4 31B离线运行。
AI.result: TRACTOR数据集:Qwen 3.5 4B达到83.1%准确率、86.5% F1、0%解析失败、100% Think率;三种SLM平均约81%准确率、0%解析失败,对比GRPO和SFT+GRPO不超过28%和53.5% F1且存在解析失败。IC xApp数据集:Qwen 3.5 4B达94.9%准确率、94.6% F1、0%解析失败,验证跨任务泛化性。奖励鲁棒性消融:CRAFT初始化后GRPO在平衡/准确性优先/随机动态三种奖励下保持85-86% F1且0%解析失败。能耗:CRAFT总能耗1.13 kWh(数据准备0.70 + 微调0.43),比GRPO基线(2.73 kWh)降低59%。壁钟时间5.82小时在12小时预算内。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过数据中心的离线trace验证绕过RL冷启动障碍,显著提升电信SLM的预先可审计推理能力,在准确率、格式合规性、训练效率和能耗方面全面优于GRPO基线,且为后续RL微调提供稳健初始化基础。局限在于仅评估分类任务(连续值回归与预测未涵盖)、模型家族仅覆盖Qwen和Nemotron两类。未来工作将扩展至更多电信决策场景及TeleMCP等协议下的硬件验证。

title: Topological Steering
summary: With the rapid rise of large language models (LLMs), controlling undesirable model behaviors has become increasingly important. Existing behavioral control methods typically intervene directly in activation or feature space, but such approaches can be sensitive to outliers, distributional shifts, noise, and other local perturbations. Motivated by Topological Data Analysis (TDA), which captures global rather than purely local structure, we propose Topological Steering, a new framework for steering LLM behavior through the topological representation of activation spaces. Using persistence diagrams, our method connects activation-based steering with TDA and enables more robust behavioral control. We show that Topological Steering consistently modifies LLM behavior across multiple model families and model sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"拓扑引导"(Topological Steering)，一种基于拓扑数据分析(TDA)的LLM推理时行为控制方法，通过持续同调从残差流激活中提取鲁棒的局部子结构构建引导向量，替代传统的全局均值差方向，以更稳健地控制LLM行为。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法(如CAA、Angular Steering)主要依赖全局均值差或低维子空间的线性/几何干预，对多模态、非线性分布的激活结构敏感，易受离群点和噪声影响，且可能稀释异质行为信号。行为概念在激活空间中往往是多模态和结构异质的，需要捕捉全局而非局部结构的方法。
AI.method: 方法核心是基于持久同调的拓扑引导：(1)在中间Transformer层提取有害/无害提示的残差流激活；(2)通过联合PCA降维(默认k=192)；(3)用Vietoris-Rips滤流计算两类激活云的持久同调，得到持久化图(Dgm+和Dgm-)；(4)用瓶颈匹配(bottleneck matching)识别同时满足高持久度(几何稳定性)和跨类高失配成本(行为特异性)的"拒绝唯一"拓扑特征；(5)为每个选中的H₀连通分量构建局部对比方向，按持久度×失配成本×Cohen's d效应量加权聚合为最终引导向量v_steer；(6)推理时注入残差流末token位置，强度α=1.0。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，激活分离度Δρ=+0.0127(均值+0.0092±0.0022)，Llama Guard 3越狱成功率从0.510升至0.692(Δ=+0.183)，HarmBench从0.010升至0.029，substring探针从0.029升至0.038。跨模型验证(gemma-2-9b-it、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B)六个模型Δρ均为正，证实机制一致性。最优注入层ℓ*因架构而异(Qwen-7B在ℓ=8，Gemma-2-9B在ℓ=13，Llama-3.1-8B在ℓ=15)。5个鲁棒性种子下所有Δρ>0，95% CI=[0.00652, 0.01192]不包含零。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑引导成功将TDA从训练时的计算瓶颈中解放出来，使其在推理时成为可操作的干预工具。该方法牺牲部分原始效率换取结构化和可检查的干预机制，为引导设计空间增加了"拓扑原语"，与几何引导方法互补。未来方向包括混合引导(拓扑定位+几何更新规则)、持久化图用于安全调试和表示审计。局限在于对预处理和超参数调优敏感、图表摘要需结合对比匹配验证语义、计算成本随点云规模和同调次数增长、目前仅在拒绝行为上验证。

title: DK-GBMKKM: Dynamic Kernel-Space Granular-Ball Multiple Kernel $k$-Means Clustering
summary: Multiple kernel $k$-means integrates complementary nonlinear similarities by learning a combination of base kernels. Its pointwise optimization, however, is sensitive to noisy and boundary samples and repeatedly operates on sample-scale kernel matrices. Granular-ball representations organize local sample groups into mesoscopic units, but granular balls generated once in the input space may be inconsistent with the fused-kernel geometry that evolves during multiple kernel learning. We propose dynamic kernel-space granular-ball multiple kernel $k$-means (DK-GBMKKM). The method generates granular balls in the current fused kernel space and alternates kernel-weight learning with granular-ball membership updates, allowing the representation to adapt to changes in the fused-kernel geometry. A sample-size-weighted granular-ball kernel is further constructed to preserve the contributions of balls of different sizes, and its positive semidefiniteness and related equivalence properties are established. Experiments on 12 public datasets demonstrate the strong overall clustering performance of DK-GBMKKM. The code has been open-sourced for reproducibility: this https URL .

AI.tldr: DK-GBMKKM提出在融合核空间内动态构建与更新粒球，并将粒球级多核k-均值与样本重分配交替优化，从而缓解输入空间粒球与演化中的核几何不匹配问题；在12个公开数据集上以四项指标综合排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有多核k-均值以样本为优化单元，对噪声/边界样本敏感，且反复操作样本级核矩阵；GB-MKKM虽引入粒球但粒球在输入空间生成，与多核学习演化中的融合核几何不一致，且固定划分无法适应核权重变化。
AI.method: 1) 在当前融合核空间内用核空间中心一致性度量(CCM)生成粒球；2) 构造样本量加权的粒球核 $\widehat{K}_B^{(p)}=D^{-1/2}G^{\top}K^{(p)}GD^{-1/2}$，并证明其半正定及与样本级优化的等价性；3) 交替执行：粒球级谱嵌入+核权重更新(凸QP闭式解)、固定球数M的核空间k-均值重分配；4) 收敛后将粒球嵌入 $H=GD^{-1/2}Z$ 提升回样本级做k-均值。
AI.result: 在12个数据集(基因、物体、语音、人脸)上与7个基线对比，DK-GBMKKM在ACC/NMI/Purity/ARI四项平均指标均第一(0.6717/0.5929/0.6848/0.4647)，较次优平均提升0.05–0.06；Friedman/Iman-Davenport检验p值均≤10⁻¹⁰，Nemenyi检验显示其平均秩最低(1.42/1.67/1.58/1.42)；warpPIE10P上ACC较次优提升0.2558；目标函数在前30次迭代后变化量降至5×10⁻¹⁴以下，无持续振荡。
AI.conclusion: 动态核空间粒球表示可与多核学习几何共同演化，提升鲁棒性与聚类质量；未来工作聚焦低秩核近似与自适应粒度以支持大规模聚类。

title: HarmoCore: Functional Latent Diffusion for Sparse Reconstruction of Oscillatory Wave Fields
summary: Reconstructing oscillatory wave fields from scattered sensors is a severely underdetermined inverse problem. Beyond the challenges of general physical-field reconstruction, wave responses are complex-valued, frequency-sensitive, and highly oscillatory, while costly simulation and sensing often leave only extreme-sparse observations. Existing low-rank, operator, and diffusion approaches are largely designed for real-valued, smoother fields; dense pixel-space diffusion is particularly inefficient for oscillatory complex fields and difficult to scale to 3D. We propose HarmoCore, which places a generative prior in a compact, continuous, and structured wave-field latent. HarmoCore represents joint real--imaginary channels with Functional Tucker cores over shared continuous spatial bases, learns a frequency-conditioned core diffusion prior, and performs Diffusion Posterior Sampling directly in core space. At fixed sensor coordinates, the multilinear decoder induces an explicit likelihood guidance operator, avoiding dense pixel-space correction. Optional target-equation residual guidance further promotes physical consistency. Experiments on 2D Helmholtz, 2D synthetic wave fields, and 3D Helmholtz show substantial gains under 1%--2% sensing while remaining practical in three dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarmoCore，一种针对稀疏传感器下振荡波场重建的功能潜空间扩散框架。核心思想是将复值波场的实虚部表示为共享连续空间基上的Functional Tucker核心，并在该紧凑核心空间中训练频率条件扩散先验并进行扩散后验采样，从而避免在密集像素空间中进行昂贵的修正。
AI.motivation: 时谐波场（如Helmholtz方程解）具有复值、频率敏感、高度振荡的特点，而在实际中仿真与传感成本高昂，仅能获得1%–2%极端稀疏的观测。现有低秩拟合、算子回归与像素空间扩散方法大多针对实值平滑场设计，难以处理复值振荡场且难以扩展到三维。需要一种与波场振荡结构及稀疏观测对齐的生成式先验。
AI.method: 1. 用一对（2D）或三元（3D）SIREN MLP作为共享连续空间基 ϕ，将每个(样本,频率)对的复值场编码为实虚联合通道的核心张量 G。2. 联合优化基网络与所有核心，最小化观测位置上的相对重建损失加频率加权平滑正则。3. 在归一化核心上训练频率条件（FiLM注入）的UNet扩散先验。4. 推理时将基网络在传感器坐标处求值得到显式观测算子 H_O，利用多线性解码器得到闭式观测似然梯度 ∇L_obs = H_O^T(H_O g_c - y_c)，在核心空间进行DPS后验采样；可选地加入Helmholtz方程残差梯度作为物理一致性引导。
AI.result: 在2D Helmholtz、2D合成波场、3D Helmholtz三个基准、1%/2%/5%/10%传感率下，HarmoCore在所有设置上均取得最低的Rel. L2误差和物理残差，1%–2%极端稀疏时优势最大。消融表明DPS观测引导是主要精度来源，方程残差为辅助正则；2D Synthetic的OOD测试（波速范围大幅外推）中误差几乎不变，扩散基线DiffusionPDE则退化超过3倍。频率条件编码的消融表明简单标量FiLM条件优于傅里叶/多项式编码。
AI.conclusion: HarmoCore通过Functional Tucker核心与核心空间扩散后验采样，为稀疏振荡波场重建提供了紧凑、连续、物理一致的生成式框架，在最欠定区域优势明显，并可自然扩展至三维。其依赖全局共享的空间参数化与足够表达力的FTM表示，主要贡献集中在稀疏重建而非频率外推或不确定性校准。

title: Verdict Instability of OOD Scores under Reference Resampling
summary: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detectors are fitted on a finite reference set, so every score they produce is an estimate. If we had chosen a different set, some verdicts would have moved. We measure that movement by resampling the reference set and recording the bootstrap standard deviation of the score, which we call verdict instability. It admits a closed form with no fitted parameters. The instability of a verdict is the within-class dispersion of the assigned class along the query's direction, divided by the square root of that class's reference count. That count is what separates verdict instability from the geometry of the score distribution, and it is identifiable only under class imbalance. Instability grows with the local dispersion. Far-OOD queries lie along the low-variance directions of an anisotropic embedding, so every distance-based score we test assigns its highest values to the verdicts that are most reproducible. Only estimators of local dispersion carry the sign a practitioner expects. We give a rule that predicts this sign for any score from a single label-free correlation, and abstention driven by a wrong-signed score turns out worse than abstention at random on every dataset we test.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了"判决不稳定性"(verdict instability)——通过对参考集进行自助重采样来度量OOD分数的估计不确定性。作者给出了无拟合参数的闭式表达，发现只有局部离散度估计量携带"正确符号"，而基于距离的分数在远-OOD查询上把最可复现的判决标记为最不可信的，导致基于错误符号的弃权比随机弃权更差。
AI.motivation: 后验OOD检测器的分数是基于有限参考集的估计量，但现有研究混淆了"查询距离训练数据有多远"与"在另一组参考集下判决会改变多少"这两个问题。本文旨在量化参考集有限性对分数的贡献，并揭示OOD分数作为不确定性代理的潜在危害。
AI.method: 1. 定义判决不稳定性T(x)为自助法下分数的标准差；2. 推导闭式表达：T≈sqrt(σ_t(u)²/n_c + λ²Var[pen])，其中σ_t(u)²=u⊤Σ_c u是类内离散度在查询方向上的投影；3. 验证1/√n_c依赖性（利用DermaMNIST自然类别不平衡58.7×）；4. 提出无标签规则sign[ρ(M,T)]=sign[ρ(M,T̂)]预测任何分数的符号；5. 通过AURC曲线评估弃权效果。
AI.result: 1. 闭式表达在CIFAR-100/10、DermaMNIST上R²=0.82-0.97；2. 11个常用分数中9个携带错误符号（与不稳定性负相关），仅knn_std和LID两个离散度估计量符号正确；3. 在DermaMNIST上类别不平衡导致logit族符号反转；4. 错误符号分数驱动的弃权在所有数据集上都比随机弃权更差（如Mahalanobis在DermaMNIST上+13.09%）；5. 规则在52/55和54/55的分数-设置对中正确预测。
AI.conclusion: 判决不稳定性是可解析的闭式量，参考计数n_c是其与分数几何性质分离的关键。嵌入的各向异性导致远-OOD查询沿低方差方向分布，使距离分数携带错误符号。检测性能与判决可复现性两个目标在实际嵌入上近乎反序，实践者应根据部署需求谨慎选择分数，并可利用无标签规则预先检测符号。

title: MUGEN: Generating Unlearnable Graph Examples for Multiple Learning Tasks
summary: Graph data across diverse domains can expose valuable relational information to unauthorized representation learning, creating a pressing need for protection against such misuse. Unlearnable examples offer a data-level defense by perturbing a training release so that models trained on it fail to generalize to clean data. Existing methods generate unlearnable graph examples for only a specified downstream task. Consequently, a release protected against one task may remain learnable for other plausible uses, including node classification, graph classification, and link prediction, which the data owner cannot anticipate. We introduce MUGEN, to our knowledge the first framework for generating unlearnable graph examples that jointly protect all enabled tasks. From one clean dataset, MUGEN produces a single feature-perturbed release that protects every enabled task through a shared GNN encoder and task-specific heads. We devise a Task-Aligned Separability Objective (TASO), which leverages task prediction and classwise separability to strengthen unlearnability and its transfer across GNN backbones and enabled tasks. We further introduce Type-Adaptive Perturbation (TAP), which tailors perturbation optimization to node-attribute type, with direct search over feasible hard flips that accept only loss-improving updates for discrete node attributes and customized gradient-based updates for continuous node features, thereby enabling strong unlearnability across both settings. Experiments across five benchmarks, four backends and three learning paradigms demonstrate that MUGEN generates transferable unlearnable graph examples across GNN backbones and all three tasks, and remains effective under adversarial training and data augmentation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MUGEN：从同一份干净图数据出发，仅扰动节点特征并进行一次优化，生成能够同时削弱节点分类、图分类和链接预测三种未经授权学习任务的不可学习图样本。核心设计是共享 GNN 编码器加任务专属预测头、TASO 多任务类间可分性目标，以及按连续/离散属性区分更新方式的 TAP。连续特征采用盒约束 PGD；离散特征采用预算约束的硬坐标搜索和精确候选评估。作者在 5 个数据集、4 种 GNN、3 类任务以及自监督、增广和对抗训练条件下验证了其有效性及跨骨干迁移能力。总体上，MUGEN 将图数据不可学习性从单任务扩展为统一多任务保护，但不同任务上的保护强度并不完全均衡。
AI.motivation: 现有图不可学习样本方法主要针对图分类等单一任务；数据发布者无法预知接收方究竟会执行节点分类、图分类还是链接预测。针对某一任务优化的扰动，对另一任务未必有效，因此需要一个只需发布一次、即可同时覆盖多种合理用途的图数据保护机制。论文还指出，仅最小化任务损失的 min–min 目标容易形成类间分离不足的扰动表征，且针对离散节点属性的 softmax 松弛和采样会产生许多不降低目标函数的无效更新。
AI.method: MUGEN 在保持图节点、边、标签不变的前提下，只修改节点特征。优化结构采用共享 GNN 编码器和面向节点、图、链接预测的专属输出头，并以交替方式更新模型参数与扰动。扰动损失为多任务预测损失与任务对齐的类间可分性损失之和；TASO 用各类别中心、类内离散度及类间距离构造 CSD 信号。连续特征使用特征相关的盒约束（ε_j=ρσ_j）及投影梯度下降；离散属性则通过直接搜索可行类别翻转和交换操作，并只接受使硬特征目标不增大的更新。实验覆盖 MUTAG、ENZYMES、PROTEINS_full、Cora、PubMed，评估 GCN、GAT、GIN、GraphSAGE，并进一步测试 GraphMAE、GRACE、特征遮罩、边丢弃和中等预算对抗训练。
AI.result: 同骨干实验中，优化扰动通常使干净测试性能明显低于干净训练及预算匹配的随机扰动。例如，图分类 Macro-F1 的降幅在 MUTAG、ENZYMES、PROTEINS_full 上分别约为 0.223–0.338、0.287–0.507、0.153–0.279；Cora 节点分类 F1 下降约 0.056–0.079，PubMed 下降约 0.195–0.253；Cora 链接预测 AUC 下降约 0.062–0.143。跨骨干结果总体保持负向迁移，但强度不均：MUTAG 和 ENZYMES 图分类较强，ENZYMES 节点分类的降幅较小，PubMed 链接预测仅下降约 0.004–0.029。消融实验表明 TASO 比纯分类目标产生更稳定、更强的迁移；节点扰动总体优于边扰动；TAP 的离散硬翻转优于 softmax PGD 投影。监督优化的扰动也可降低 GraphMAE/GRACE 下的下游性能，并在随机特征遮罩、边丢弃和适度对抗训练下继续存在。
AI.conclusion: MUGEN 是面向多任务图数据发布的统一不可学习样本框架。其主要意义在于：一套特征扰动即可同时面向节点分类、图分类和链接预测，且不必为未知用途分别生成保护版本。TASO 通过显式塑造任务相关的类间结构，提高跨骨干迁移；TAP 通过匹配属性类型，改善连续和离散特征下的优化效率与保护强度。实验支持该方法在多种骨干、自监督流程及常见训练干预下的有效性。不过，结果显示不同任务与数据集的收益并不完全一致，特别是部分节点或链接预测场景的降幅较温和；此外，论文仅验证有限图分类和二元链接预测，尚未覆盖多关系知识图谱链接预测等更广泛任务。

title: Patterning in Practice: Debiasing Reward Models with Susceptibilities
summary: Reward models trained on human preferences are known to suffer from length, formatting, and other stylistic biases. In this paper we use patterning, which reweights each preference pair according to its measured effect on posterior expectation values of benchmark losses (its susceptibility), to debias a Gemma 2 9B Instruct reward model trained on Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2. We obtain $+14.2 \pm 1.2$ pp on RM-Bench Hard, the split where style cues point against correctness (mean $\pm$ s.e.\ over 5 seeds), with overall RM-Bench accuracy preserved, comparable to the strongest Hard-split gain reported by the closest published comparator (SteerRM, $+13.2$ pp). We demonstrate in a simple case that the reweighting is interpretable by tracing a side effect of the intervention (a regression on a safety subset of RM-Bench) to a small class of training pairs, which we confirm by ablation. The weights also transfer: those computed on Gemma 2 9B debias Gemma 2 2B and 27B with no recomputation, and transfer partially to Llama 3.1 8B. This is the first application of patterning, a program grounded in singular learning theory, beyond small models and synthetic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文将"patterning"方法（基于奇异学习理论的敏感度重加权技术）首次应用于9B规模的奖励模型去偏任务。在Gemma 2 9B上对Skywork偏好数据进行重加权训练，在RM-Bench Hard子集（风格线索与正确性相反）上获得+14.2±1.2 pp的提升，匹配甚至略优于SteerRM基线；同时验证了重加权权重的可解释性（可追溯到特定训练子集）和跨模型可迁移性（同家族2B/27B无需重算，跨架构Llama 3.1 8B部分迁移）。
AI.motivation: RLHF中的奖励模型存在长度、格式等风格偏差，这些偏差源于偏好数据中的表面线索（如长响应被选中的概率为56%-63%）。业界主流通过人工/机器策划筛选偏好对来缓解偏差，但成本高且依赖人类直觉。本文希望以原则化、可扩展的方式通过基于敏感度的训练数据重加权来"雕刻"训练分布，从而控制模型泛化行为。
AI.method: 1) **诊断**：在已训练奖励模型 w* 周围用SGLD采样局部后验，构建敏感度矩阵 χ̂（k×n），行为是RM-Bench各split/域上的BT损失观测值，列为训练对；2) **纠正**：设定目标向量 dμ（如3维为(Easy, Normal, Hard)目标，15维按5域×3 split细分），用Moore-Penrose伪逆计算每对训练样本的重加权 ρ = 1 + α·χ̂†dμ；3) 负权重通过交换chosen/rejected标签实现；4) 在重加权数据上重新训练奖励模型。
AI.result:
**主结果（Gemma 2 9B，5 seed均值）**：
- dμ₃目标：RM-Bench Hard +14.2±1.2 pp，整体RM-Bench -0.4±0.4 pp，RewardBench 2 -1.4±0.4 pp；与SteerRM最强+13.2 pp相当。
- dμ₁₅目标：Hard +10.2±1.2 pp，整体 +1.7±0.4 pp，RewardBench 2 -4.3±0.5 pp（避免safety-response塌陷）。
- **可解释性**：dμ₃中safety-response Easy暴跌-44.1 pp追溯到2,112个"短拒绝被拒对"（SRR：拒绝为短拒绝、chosen远长于rejected，主要来自WildGuard子语料）；clamp这些对权重可恢复约2/3回归。
- **迁移性**：Gemma 9B计算的权重直接迁移至2B（+16.0 pp Hard）和27B（+13.6 pp Hard），无需重算敏感度；跨架构迁移到Llama 3.1 8B效果较弱（+2.8 pp）。
- 长度基线（仅用Δwords重加权）远差于patterning：Hard飙至72%超过E，RewardBench 2跌-9.4 pp。
AI.conclusion: Patterning首次在9B规模LLM奖励模型上实用化，效果与当前最优的SAE推理时干预方法SteerRM相当，并提供可解释的数据归因诊断（识别引发safety-response塌陷的训练子集）和跨模型迁移能力。线性响应理论虽然形式上给出方向，但实际工作在αβ≈1.0-1.4的强耦合区，权重方向的有效性是经验性发现而非理论保证。方法为"迭代规范"模型泛化行为提供了实用路径，可推广至reward hacking等更难规范的偏差。局限包括：RM-Bench同时充当目标和评估、RewardBench 2作为验证而非完全留置、SGLD后验估计的理论保证有限、计算成本约2,000 B200 GPU小时。

title: Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning
summary: Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) assigns the same explicit loss weight to every expert demonstration, regardless of the model's changing competence over training queries. Reinforcement learning (RL) based methods adapt update strength using model-generated rollouts, but often require substantially more sampling and can be unstable on hard tasks. We propose \textbf{Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning (OSW-FT)}, a simple method that augments SFT with online, trajectory-level weighting. For each query, OSW-FT estimates the model's current success rate using a small number of inference-only rollouts and rescales the standard SFT loss accordingly. The optimization direction remains anchored to the expert trajectory, while the update magnitude adapts online. For binary-verifiable reasoning, we connect this weighting to SFT and RL at the gradient level, inspired by variance-reduction principles. The resulting estimator is unbiased for the exact OSW-FT surrogate update for any finite rollout count, and we analyze convergence with respect to the corresponding surrogate objective. Evaluated across Qwen3 series ranging from 0.6B to 4B on multiple challenging benchmarks (e.g., AIME), OSW-FT consistently improves over SFT on small-to-medium scale models. OSW-FT offers a favorable compute-performance trade-off as a practical approach for fine-tuning small-to-medium LLMs on binary-verifiable reasoning tasks with only \textbf{2 online rollouts}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning (OSW-FT),一种在二值可验证推理任务上对标准监督微调(SFT)进行在线、轨迹级加权的简单方法。该方法通过少量推理-only rollout 估计模型当前成功率 p̂(q),并以 (1−p̂(q)) 对标准 SFT 损失进行重缩放,保持优化方向锚定于专家轨迹,同时在线自适应调节更新幅度。理论上,作者通过分数函数分解和控制变量法推导出 OSW-FT 梯度,证明有限 rollout 下估计器无偏,且收敛的二阶矩严格小于 SFT。在 Qwen3 (0.6B–4B) 上的 AIME、AMC、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond 等基准实验表明,OSW-FT 在中小规模模型上一致优于 SFT,且仅需 K=2 次 rollout 即可取得良好的性能-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准 SFT 对所有专家示范赋予同等显式损失权重,忽略了模型在不同训练查询上不断变化的胜任度;而基于强化学习(RL)的方法(如 GRPO)虽能依据模型自生轨迹自适应调整更新强度,但采样开销大且在困难任务上不稳定。作者试图在两者之间找到一种保留 SFT 专家锚定方向、又具备 RL 式自适应更新幅度的折中方案。
AI.method: OSW-FT 在每次迭代中,对批内每个查询用 K 次 inference-only rollout 估计当前成功率 p̂(q),然后按权重 w = 1−p̂(q) 对标准 SFT 对数似然损失进行加权。作者从分数函数估计出发,利用控制变量原理将最优基线识别为模型的当前成功率 p_s(q),从而推导出专家轨迹的优势 (1−p_s(q));再借助”oracle substitution”把难处理的生成分布替换为数据集确定性分布,得到 OSW-FT 梯度。其算法只需每批次一次 rollout,后续梯度步使用冻结权重,因此本质上只在 SFT 损失上做幅度调节。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Base 上,OSW-FT 相对 SFT 在 AIME24/25、AMC22/23/24、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond 等多个基准上一致或显著提升(例如 4B 模型在 AIME24/25 上 Pass@16 由 26.67% 提升至 36.67%)。AIME 等高难度任务上 OSW-FT 在 K=2 时即与 K=8 性能相当且远超 GRPO(K=2 时 GRPO 得 0%);不同加权策略消融显示硬阈值和随机加权均出现显著退化,验证了连续、平滑成功率加权的必要性;GRPO 对学习率敏感(1e-5 时奖励坍缩)。
AI.conclusion: OSW-FT 是一种简单且实用的后训练增强方法,把 SFT 的专家轨迹锚定与对模型能力前沿的在线自适应调节相结合,在二值可验证推理任务上以极低在线采样开销取得优于 SFT 的性能,与 GRPO 形成在受限 rollout 预算下的有力替代。但该方法依赖可靠的二值验证器和高质量专家轨迹,目前仅在 Qwen3 系列数学类多选题上验证,扩展到代码生成或连续奖励仍是未来工作。

title: Text Capability Loss in Vision-Language Adaptation: An Attention-Sink Diagnosis
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: this https URL . * Equal contribution. † Corresponding author
summary: Fine-tuning a pretrained LLM into a vision-language model (VLM) can erode the backbone's text capability, with the damage concentrated on tasks that require following exact output rules, such as instruction following, chain-of-thought reasoning graded on a strictly parsed final answer, and similar evaluations with strict graders. We trace this gap to attention-sink corruption: VL fine-tuning perturbs the early sink position that anchors a large fraction of attention probability, and how well the base LLM preserves its sink tracks how much of the affected capability survives adaptation. Building on this view, we introduce Sink Strength, a single scalar computed on the base LLM in a few seconds on a single GPU that predicts post-VL degradation without any VL training. It consistently tracks relative degradation across the six VLM-LLM pairs and multiple format-sensitive tasks. Complementing this diagnostic, we find that post-pretraining QK-RMSNorm injection fails to reproduce the protection of native QK-RMSNorm, while several off-the-shelf weight-merging settings fail to recover the lost capability after VL training. These negative results underscore the value of screening backbones with Sink Strength before VL training and narrow the intervention space toward head-selective training-time protection.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视觉-语言模型(VLM)微调会通过破坏LLM骨干网络的"注意力汇聚点"(attention sink)而侵蚀其文本能力,尤其影响指令遵循和链式思维等格式敏感任务;提出可基于基座LLM在数秒内预测VL适配后能力退化的"Sink Strength"指标,并验证头部级QK-RMSNorm是保护汇聚点的关键架构因素。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM微调方法普遍会损害预训练LLM的文本能力(尤其格式敏感任务如IFEval、CoT推理),且现有缓解措施(冻结、LoRA、文本数据重混、神经元合并)各有缺陷,缺乏对"为何发生能力损失"的机制性解释和"损失发生前"的预筛选工具。
AI.method: (1) 在6对VLM-LLM对上测量文本能力差距,聚焦"格式敏感"任务(IFEval/EQ-Bench/GSM8K-CoT/GPQA-CoT);(2) 提出Sink Strength S = median log(a_sink/(1-a_sink)),无需VL训练即可在基座LLM上15次前向传播(~8秒/7B/A6000)计算;(3) 建立单头logit-gap扰动界(Theorem 1)解释QK-RMSNorm通过RMS分母消除输入幅值敏感性;(4) 设置负面对照:QK-RMSNorm后注入实验和7种权重合并方法。
AI.result: Sink Strength在6对配对上与IFEval下降的Spearman ρ=0.97,17对扩展集ρ=0.88,跨4个格式敏感任务ρ≥0.82;理论分析显示头部级QK-RMSNorm消除‖ξ‖依赖,而层级QK-RMSNorm仅将弱头压缩(Molmo2-O验证);QK-RMSNorm后注入无法复现原生保护(11 vs 59.9),7种权重合并设置均无法恢复已损失的能力。
AI.conclusion: VL微调破坏基座LLM的早期注意力汇聚点,该破坏通过降低"汇聚点-其他位置"的logit裕度(G_base - B_gap)而损害依赖严格表面格式解析的格式敏感任务;Sink Strength可作为VL训练前的低成本预筛选工具,头部级QK-RMSNorm是当前样本中最强的架构保护因素,未来工作应聚焦头部选择性的训练时干预。

title: How Do Language Models Choose Between Context and Memory?
summary: When contextual information conflicts with the knowledge stored in model parameters, activation directions can be used to decode and steer which source the model follows. However, steering along a direction does not establish causality: whether the unedited model would naturally use that direction or whether the direction is reusable across tasks. We test these distinctions through counterfactual experiments in unambiguous settings. First, we estimate authority directions from agreement prompts, in which the context and parametric knowledge support the same answer. We then interchange naturally occurring coordinates along these directions between matched prompts that direct the model to prioritize either the supplied context or its parametric knowledge. Across Qwen, Llama, and OLMo models, this intervention reproduces 30-68% of the authority-induced shift in source choice, whereas matched controls reproduce almost none. To test cross-task reuse, we learn authority directions on two tasks separately and see that cross-task transferability closes only 9% of the authority gap while the local direction learned on the given task closes 57%. These results distinguish authority representation, causal use, and cross-task causal reuse, and suggest that authority computations may be task-dependent, rather than reusable across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型在上下文信息与参数化记忆冲突时如何选择信息源。作者通过反事实实验区分了"权威表征"、"因果使用"和"跨任务因果复用"三个概念，发现权威方向在任务内可因果影响源选择（闭合30%-68%的差距），但跨任务迁移性极弱（仅闭合9%的差距），表明权威计算可能是任务依赖的。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明语言模型中存在可解码和可操控的激活方向来控制上下文与参数化知识的优先级选择，但可操控性（steerability）和可解码性（decodability）并不等于内源性因果使用（endogenous causal use）。一个表征可能容易被读取或操控，却未必是未编辑模型实际用于做选择的计算的一部分。此外，这些方向是否可跨任务复用也是未知的。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 方法核心为因果中介分析：1）在上下文与记忆一致的"同意提示"上估计每层归一化的权威方向 s_ℓ；2）在上下文与记忆冲突的匹配提示对中，进行坐标互换干预——将一个提示在权威方向上的标量坐标 z_ℓ 替换为另一个提示的对应坐标，同时保留正交分量；3）在多个层（Qwen2.5-7B中为10,12,...,24）上重复执行此互换，下游激活正常重计算；4）设置随机方向和协方差匹配方向作为对照；5）通过"差距闭合率"量化中介效果。在跨任务测试中，将一个任务上学到的方向应用到另一个任务上评估迁移性。实验涵盖四个模型：Qwen2.5-3B/7B、Llama-3.1-8B、OLMo-2-7B，使用颜色任务、材料任务和州/国家事实任务。
AI.result: 主要结果：1）颜色任务中，权威坐标互换闭合了Qwen 68%、Llama 56%、OLMo 30%的自然权威差距，随机互换几乎无效果；2）跨任务迁移测试中，材料任务导入颜色方向仅闭合14.8%的自然差距，跨任务迁移性仅闭合9%差距而任务内方向闭合57%差距；3）州/国家事实实验中，权威方向在跨域中高度可解码（AUROC 0.995-1.000），但单层导入干预的最大因果效应仅0.014-0.038，几乎可忽略。Qwen中权威方向超过最佳协方差对照7.0倍，Llama为2.9倍，OLMo为2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了三个层次：表征（representation）、任务内因果使用（causal use within a task）和跨任务因果复用（causal reuse across tasks）。结论是：权威相关激活方向可在任务内因果影响源选择，但跨任务复用性显著弱于任务内效果。这表明权威计算可能是任务依赖的，而非可跨任务复用的通用机制。干预框架使这些问题可分别测试，为研究源选择如何跨任务、提示和模型族泛化提供了基础。

title: Frozen Cores Need Task Signal: Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource LLM Adaptation
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning is usually framed as a question of how many parameters to update. Under a severe trainable-state budget, however, where those coefficients act is equally consequential. We study this choice through frozen-core adaptation: a calibration pass fixes left and right bases for each weight matrix, and fine-tuning optimizes only an $r\times r$ core. This removes the ability of trainable factors to repair a poor initial span and makes subspace quality directly observable. We introduce FCCA, which estimates the signed input--error cross-covariance, whitens it with diagonal Fisher moments, truncates it in the resulting local metric, maps the selected directions back, and applies thin QR to obtain stable core coordinates. Under a matched $r^2$ budget, we compare eight basis constructors on 11 tasks, four model settings, and three seeds. On Qwen2.5-3B, FCCA reaches an 83.0 macro-average, 2.3 points above the next-best matched-budget constructor, and exceeds its unwhitened RawGrad control on all 11 tasks. It ranks first at all three Qwen scales and finishes within 0.13 points of the best method on Llama-3.2-1B. Controlled ablations show gains of 2.7--17.2 points from whitening and identify QR as necessary for stable core optimization in the tested regime. Finally, FCCA comes within 0.32 and 0.23 average points of LoRA and DoRA while optimizing 36.9K rather than roughly 7.4M parameters. These results show that a carefully selected fixed span can recover most of the benefit of movable low-rank factors at a much smaller trainable and optimizer-state cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大模型参数高效微调中极小可训练预算场景下的子空间选择问题，提出FCCA（Fisher白化交叉协方差）方法。该方法在标定阶段冻结预训练权重矩阵的左右基，只优化r×r的核心矩阵。FCCA通过估计输入与误差的有符号交叉协方差，用对角Fisher矩进行双侧白化，再在白化后的局部Fisher度量下进行秩截断，最后通过逆映射与thin QR获得稳定基。在Qwen2.5-3B上以仅36.9K可训练参数（约为LoRA的1/200）取得83.0的11任务宏平均，超过7种匹配预算基构造方法，并在三种Qwen规模上均排名第一。
AI.motivation: 在极小可训练状态预算下，低秩适配器的性能不仅取决于参数数量，更取决于参数所在子空间的质量。LoRA等方法的左右因子同时承担"发现有用子空间"和"在子空间内优化"两个任务，使得端任务精度将二者效果混在一起。当基固定、仅优化核心时，若初始子空间不佳，无法通过旋转修复，因此子空间质量变得直接可观测。这对数据、步数、优化器状态或通信受限场景尤为重要。
AI.method: 提出FCCA方法：(1)在标定阶段估计输入-误差的有符号交叉协方差G=E[δx^T]及其对角二阶矩A（输入侧）和D（误差侧）；(2)构造白化矩阵G̃=D^{-1/2}GA^{-1/2}；(3)对G̃做秩r截断SVD，通过Eckart-Young-Mirsky定理证明这是Fisher度量下秩约束线性目标的最优解；(4)逆映射得原始基P₀、D^{-1/2}U_r和Q₀=A^{-1/2}V_r；(5)thin QR正交化得到最终冻结基P、Q，仅训练r×r核心R。算法1给出了完整流程，附录A提供了投影梯度准则推导和定理1证明。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B和Llama-3.2-1B四个模型设置、11个任务、3个种子上系统比较了8种匹配r²预算的基构造方法。Qwen2.5-3B上FCCA达83.0宏平均，超过次优LoRA-XS-core 2.3点，超过RawGrad控制4.78点（Wilcoxon p=.001），在三种Qwen规模上均第一，Llama-3.2-1B上以0.13点之差位列第二。白化带来2.7-17.2点提升；QR不可缺少（去掉后训练发散）；秩r=8-16是sweet spot；FCCA与LoRA、DoRA分别仅差0.32和0.23点，可训练参数从~7.4M降至36.9K（约200倍缩减）。
AI.conclusion: FCCA将"低秩适配需要在丢弃信息的度量中选择方向"这一原则形式化：在Fisher局部度量下截断有符号交叉协方差，并配合QR提供可优化的核心坐标。冻结基既是子空间质量的诊断工具，也是状态受限场景下的实用方案。剩余与LoRA/DoRA的差距源于可训练因子具备旋转修复能力。实用建议：(1)在秩约束施加前保留有符号任务信号；(2)采用适中秩（如r=8-16）而非盲目扩大；(3)用thin QR将所选子空间表示为优化器可训练的核心坐标。

title: Subspace Levenberg Marquardt Algorithms in Training Neural Networks
summary: The Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is a well-known second-order method for rapid convergence and strong robustness when training small- to medium-sized neural networks (NNs). However, its computational and memory costs increase significantly as the number of parameters in an NN grows. To address this limitation, subspace methods have been proposed, such as the Krylov subspace LM (KSLM) and the hybrid subspace LM (HSLM), making second-order algorithms more efficient. In this work, we evaluate the subspace Levenberg-Marquardt algorithms for regression and classification tasks in neural networks. We compare the performance of subspace LM variants with the classical LM method, as well as other popular first-order algorithms, such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and Adam.

AI.tldr: 本文针对传统 Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) 算法在训练大规模神经网络时计算与内存开销过大的问题，评估了 Krylov 子空间 LM (KSLM) 和混合子空间 LM (HSLM) 两种子空间 LM 变体，并与经典 LM、SGD、Adam 在回归（阻尼振荡函数拟合）和分类（13-bit 奇偶问题）任务上进行对比。实验表明，HSLM 在收敛速度、计算效率和精度上取得了最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 经典 LM 算法在小到中等规模神经网络上表现出快速收敛和强鲁棒性，但其形成与求解 n 维线性系统的代价随参数量急剧增长，难以扩展到更大网络。子空间方法通过将搜索步限制在低维子空间中，有望在保留 LM 优势的同时显著降低开销。本文旨在系统评估 KSLM 和 HSLM 在回归与分类任务中的实际表现，探讨子空间策略是否能将 LM 的实用性扩展到更大规模问题。
AI.method: 方法层面包含三个核心算法：(1) 经典 LM：通过求解 (J^T J + μI)s = −g 的阻尼 Gauss-Newton 系统获得步方向，使用 delayed-gratification 策略调整 μ。(2) KSLM：将步限制在 Krylov 子空间 K_p(B_k, g_k) 中，利用 Lanczos 过程构造基底，在 p 维约简系统中求解；并利用 Krylov 子空间在阻尼参数标量平移下的不变性避免重复构造。(3) HSLM：自适应混合子空间，融合归一化梯度、最近优化步、Krylov/Lanczos 向量以及随机 Gauss-Newton 探针 (J^T J)w（w∼N(0,I)）作为候选方向池；用 η_k^sub = ‖V_k^T g_k‖²/‖g_k‖² 作为子空间充分性准则，必要时扩充子空间。在约简坐标系中用 SVD 求解，并将各向同性阻尼替换为依赖于奇异值的对角阻尼 D_{k,p} 以更好适应病态曲率。评估在两个 MLP 任务（1-70-40-1 回归网络、13-25-10-1 奇偶分类网络）上进行 100 次独立试验，对比 SGD、Adam、LM、KSLM、HSLM 的迭代/轮次、执行时间和精度。
AI.result: 在阻尼振荡回归任务中，HSLM 表现最优：平均 19.3 ± 5.2 次迭代、25.9 ± 7.4 秒即可达到噪声方差阈值 σ²_noise ≈ 0.0016，成功率 100%；LM/KSLM 迭代数相近（22.2 次）但耗时分别达 83.0 秒和 132.8 秒；SGD 需 155.0 ± 55.1 轮且仅 41% 达到噪声水平；Adam 完全未达标（0%）。在 13-bit 奇偶分类任务中，HSLM 迭代数最少（37.0 ± 27.2），执行时间最短（3.7 ± 3.8 秒），收敛率 100%，验证精度 99.6 ± 0.3%；Adam 验证精度最高（99.8 ± 0.1%）但需 333.3 ± 458.5 轮；SGD 需 1061.7 ± 530.1 轮；LM/KSLM 收敛率分别为 92% 和 89%。在 30/70 训练-验证划分的少数据场景中，HSLM 同样保持优势。
AI.conclusion: HSLM 在收敛速度、计算效率和求解精度之间取得了最有利的平衡，表明约简子空间方法能够在大幅降低计算成本的同时保留 LM 类方法的快速收敛特性，可将 LM 的实用优势扩展至更大规模的神经网络优化。但作者也指出，大型数据集可能增加形成与求解子问题的开销，从而限制可扩展性。未来工作将探索结合 mini-batch 和无矩阵实现、更广泛的子空间方法类别，以及不同子空间基底选择对效率与收敛的影响。

title: Conditional Flow Matching for ML-Based Inverse Design Problems
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for presentation at EngOpt 2026
summary: Engineering inverse design is often limited by the high computational cost of iterative solvers for optimization problems constrained by partial differential equations (PDEs) and by their sensitivity to initialization. Deep generative models can produce candidate designs without rerunning the simulator at inference time. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) sample in one forward pass, whereas diffusion models require iterative reverse-time integration. In this work, we add conditional flow matching (CFM) to EngiOpt and compare it with a conditional diffusion model and a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) on structural (beams2d) and thermal (heatconduction2d) benchmarks from EngiBench using the same downstream optimization protocol. We use cumulative optimality gap (COG) and final optimality gap (FOG) as the primary metrics for evaluating the generated designs as warm starts for gradient-based refinement. On the evaluated EngiOpt implementations and two EngiBench tasks, CFM achieves the lowest measured COG, FOG, maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and volume-fraction deviation on both tasks. CFM has mean volume-fraction deviations of 0.4% and 1.0% on beams2d and heatconduction2d, respectively, compared with 3.8% and 11.2% for diffusion. At Euler s = 16, CFM achieves 53.2 samples/s on beams2d, about 66 times the measured throughput of the evaluated diffusion baseline using 1000 network evaluations under the same timing protocol, with COG 1.182 +/- 3.126, compared with 1.173 +/- 3.100 for Euler s = 32. Across the two tasks, CFM produces warm starts with lower measured COG than both baselines and uses fewer network evaluations than diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文将条件流匹配(CFM)引入工程逆向设计框架EngiOpt,作为基于梯度的拓扑优化器的热启动先验。在结构(beams2d)和热传导(heatconduction2d)两个EngiBench基准上,与条件扩散模型和cGAN对比,结果表明CFM在累积最优性间隙(COG)、最终最优性间隙(FOG)、最大均值差异(MMD)和体积分数偏差四项指标上均最优,且采样吞吐量比扩散模型快32–66倍。
AI.motivation: 工程逆向设计受限于PDE约束优化求解器的高计算成本和对初始化的敏感性。现有深度生成模型(GAN单次前向但训练不稳定,扩散模型质量高但需数百次网络评估)中,缺乏一种兼顾生成质量与采样效率的方案。作者希望验证流匹配是否能以更少的网络评估次数生成高质量热启动初始设计。
AI.method: 1)将独立条件流匹配(ICFM)作为新的EngiOpt基线,采用线性插值路径 x_t=(1-t)x_0+t x_1 和恒定目标速度 v*=x_1-x_0,以MSE损失回归速度场;2)使用与扩散模型相同的条件U-Net骨干网络(通道深度32-64-128-256,交叉注意力注入条件),控制架构差异;3)推理阶段对比Euler、Midpoint、RK4三种ODE求解器在NFE=16/32/48下的表现;4)评估协议以COG(轨迹目标累积间隙)和FOG(最终目标间隙)为核心,通过下游梯度优化轨迹而非仅靠分布度量来衡量热启动质量;5)模型选择基于验证集MMD筛选+验证COG决选,测试集结果不参与早停。
AI.result: 在两个任务10个随机种子上:CFM均取得最低COG(beams2d: 1.173±3.100 vs 扩散1.603±1.794 vs cGAN 22.493±819.282;heatconduction2d: 8.88×10⁻⁵ vs 5.81×10⁻⁴ vs 5.50×10⁻⁴)和最低MMD与体积分数偏差(beams2d 0.4%、heatconduction2d 1.0%,扩散分别为3.8%和11.2%)。采样吞吐量方面,CFM (Euler s=32)比扩散快约33×(beams2d: 1.876s vs 61.903s);Euler s=16时吞吐量约65.8×于扩散,而COG仅从1.173微升至1.182。扩散模型DPP多样性最高但COG并非最低,cGAN吞吐量最高但种子间波动极大。Midpoint与RK4在匹配NFE下未优于Euler。
AI.conclusion: CFM作为逆向设计热启动先验,在保持与扩散模型相当的FOG性能的同时,显著降低了累积优化间隙并大幅提升采样速度(32×–66×),且对体积分数约束的遵守度最优。其优势在低NFE预算(Euler s=16)下尤为突出,表明流匹配是工程逆向设计中扩散模型的高效替代方案。局限性在于仅评估了两个2D EngiBench任务和单一U-Net族,且未能隔离扩散模型体积分数偏差的来源。

title: MemoryWalker: Stop Training Agents on Contexts They Never Saw
comment: Your Memory-Compressing Harness Makes Training and Inference Inconsistent
summary: Production agent harnesses such as Claude Code and Qwen-Agent compress context during rollout, but training under compression creates a conditioning problem: every eviction branches the effective history, so the learning object is a tree rather than a sequence. Existing linearizations either retain the rightmost path, causing time-travel leakage, or replay a depth-first traversal, causing train-inference mismatch. We introduce two exact, gradient-equivalent corrections: LogitTree, a segmented K-forward traversal, and a packed 4D attention mask. LogitTree requires K+1 backward passes; the 4D mask requires a custom kernel and white-box eviction records. We also propose SDCC (Self-Distillation for Conditioning Consistency), a single-backward-pass variational relaxation. At each eviction, it minimizes forward KL between the compressed student and a stop-gradient teacher on the reconstructed pre-eviction prefix. A residual per-junction KL of epsilon_KL gives an O(sqrt(epsilon_KL)) bound on the train-deployment total-variation gap. SDCC also applies to black-box harnesses. On seven web-search benchmarks with TC-RAG, AgentFold, MemexRL, Claude Code, and OpenCode, naive training inflates the train-rollout log-probability gap, especially on eviction-heavy batches. The exact methods stay at the no-compression floor, and SDCC substantially closes the gap, with lower logit drift and higher rollout rewards.

AI.tldr: MemoryWalker 提出了一个在带上下文压缩的智能体训练中未被注意到的条件不一致问题。带压缩的 rollout 产生一棵"条件树"而非单一序列，导致默认的两种训练线性化方式存在相反方向的失败模式。作者提出两种精确解法（LogitTree 和 4D attention mask）和一种近似解法（SDCC 自蒸馏），在三白盒+两黑盒 harness、七大检索问答基准上验证了其能恢复至无压缩基准并提升下游表现。
AI.motivation: 在长程智能体训练中，harness（如 Claude Code、Qwen-Agent、TC-RAG、AgentFold、MemexRL）在 rollout 过程中会压缩/驱逐上下文。但当前训练流程通常把压缩后的轨迹当作普通序列来处理，忽略了"token 生成时所处的条件上下文"与"训练时该 token 被重新打分所处的上下文"之间可能存在系统性偏差，从而产生训练-推理不一致。
AI.method:
1) 将带压缩的 rollout 形式化为"条件树"：每次驱逐事件将历史分叉为保留被驱逐内容的"生成支"与压缩后的"主干"。树有 K+1 条根到叶的分支。
2) 指出两种默认线性化的失败模式：Naive-Compressed 只走最右侧根-叶路径→"时间穿越泄漏"（未来创建的摘要被反向作用于先前生成的 token）；Naive-Full 按深度优先遍历全部物理序列→"陈旧上下文泄漏"（已驱逐的内容仍出现在训练前缀中）。
3) 提出两种精确、梯度等价的解法：
 • LogitTree：把 K+1 条分支分别走成独立 forward，每条分支用其 live view 训练，互不重叠的 token loss mask 防止重复计入梯度；
 • 4D attention mask：在物理并集上做单次 forward，通过 (B, H, T, T) 的 logical 注意力 mask 限制每个 query 只看到其生成时 live 的 key，并做行级位置 id 重排。
4) 提出 SDCC（Self-Distillation for Conditioning Consistency）：保留 Naive-Compressed 的单 backward pass，但在每个分歧叶位置加一项前向 KL 惩罚，让压缩条件下的 student 拟合 stop-gradient teacher（在重建的 eviction 前前缀上的策略分布）。基于 Pinsker 不等式给出 O(√ε_KL) 的 train-deployment 总变差差距上界；β-VAE 框架解释 λ 的角色并预测后验坍缩失败模式，给出 warm-up + EMA target 的解法。
5) 训练动力学收敛：Lyapunov 函数 (J - J*) + λ★K 在 PL 条件下给出 K 的 O(1/√T) 衰减。
AI.result:
在 Qwen3-4B + GRPO + 7 个 web-search 基准（NQ/TriviaQA/HotpotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue/Bamboogle/FRAMES）以及 Claude Code/Qwen3.7-Air 上：
• 无压缩 Search-R1 控制 logdiff 处于 0.014 的"数值地板"。
• Naive-Compressed 在驱逐密集的 AgentFold 上 logdiff 升至 0.366（≈26× 地板），Naive-Full 升至 0.203。
• LogitTree（0.012–0.013）与 4D mask（0.006–0.022）严格落在地板，说明两种精确解在 batch 内梯度等价。
• SDCC 把差距拉回 0.011–0.071，单 backward pass。
• Agentic EM：SDCC 在 TC-RAG/AgentFold/MemexRL 三个白盒 harness 上分别达到 46.0/42.4/43.1，胜过 Naive-Compressed 的 36.7/33.2/28.9 与 Naive-Full 的 34.9/27.7/32.1；在 Claude Code（37.5）和 OpenCode（36.9）上同样领先。
• WideSearch（200 题 ×4 trials，Qwen3.7-Air）：LogitTree 15 步使 Pass@4 从 7.0% 提升至 10.0%（+42.9%），Row-F1 由 38.99→45.27（+16.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 压缩型智能体 harness 的训练存在一类被忽视的条件不一致：把本应是"条件树"的对象当成序列序列化，会沿两个相反方向产生 train-inference 偏差。精确恢复条件需要走树本身（LogitTree）或在注意力 mask 中编码树（4D mask）；二者在 dense softmax 下梯度等价。SDCC 以单 backward 的代价换取 O(√ε_KL) 的逼近，对白盒/黑盒 harness 均适用。实验显示这两种条件一致的方案把 logit drift 拉回无压缩地板，同时在七个 QA 基准和两个黑盒商用 harness 上稳定提升 rollout 奖励。遗留方向：覆盖更激进的压缩策略（丢工具观察、隐式摘要）、跨更多 harness 验证、以及把精确恢复推广到稀疏/线性注意力架构。

title: iPINN for Broadband CARS Phase Retrieval: A Framework for Function Approximation and Inverse Modeling Problems in Nonlinear Spectroscopy
summary: Phase retrieval in broadband coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy (BCARS) is an ill-posed inverse problem. The Raman-like signal is encoded in the imaginary part of the resonant susceptibility, which mixes coherently with a non-resonant background (NRB) that varies across acquisitions. We introduce an inverse physics-informed neural network (iPINN) that predicts Lorentzian peak parameters from raw BCARS spectra and reconstructs the resonant susceptibility through a differentiable analytical forward model. A transformer encoder assigns spectral features to 24 learnable peak slots, and a multi-view consistency loss enforces invariance across NRB pattern, NRB strength, and noise. Unlike direct spectral regression approaches, the method retains accuracy under varying acquisition conditions. On a public benchmark, iPINN achieves the lowest error among the tested baselines (MAE 0.016 vs. next-best 0.046). On 28 zero-shot test spectra acquired across seven solvents and four focal positions, accuracy is depth-invariant in five of seven solvents. These results show that inverse parametric prediction with a differentiable physical decoder supports robust phase retrieval across measurement conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iPINN（inverse Physics-Informed Neural Network），通过Transformer编码器从BCARS光谱直接预测Lorentzian峰值参数（振幅、中心频率、线宽），并利用可微分解析物理前向模型重构共振信号，在公共数据集上MAE达到0.016（远优于次优的0.046），并在28个零样本测试光谱（7种溶剂×4个焦深）上表现出对非共振背景强度变化的高度鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 宽带相干反斯托克斯拉曼光谱（BCARS）中的相位检索是一个不适定逆问题：化学信息编码在共振极化率的虚部中，并与随采集条件变化的非共振背景（NRB）发生相干干涉。传统Kramers–Kronig（KK）和最大熵方法（MEM）需要参考NRB谱且对噪声敏感；现有深度学习方法虽然部分缓解了这些问题，但仍存在两个持续弱点：（1）对合成训练分布敏感，在谱边缘和弱特征处误差较大；（2）验证通常在狭窄的采集条件集上进行，泛化能力存疑。因此需要一个直接预测物理参数并对采集条件变化保持稳定的逆建模方法。
AI.method: 1. 逆问题形式化：将隐变量定义为Lorentzian峰参数集θ={A_k, ω_k, Γ_k}（振幅、波数中心、线宽），网络直接从光谱映射到θ，通过可微分Lorentz前向模型重构共振信号。2. 架构：3,000点输入谱被分为30个重叠窗口（Hann窗，68%重叠），经线性投影+RoPE旋转位置编码嵌入为token；24个可学习class token（无位置编码）作为查询，通过6层Transformer编码器（8头注意力，头维度64，FFN宽度1024）从谱token中聚合证据；最终仅读出24个class token，经四个不对称MLP头分别预测存在性logit和(A, ω₀, Γ)。3. 训练目标：四部分损失——存在性BCE损失、参数mask加权MAE损失（中心权重2.0、振幅1.5、线宽1.0）、Lorentz模型物理一致性损失（L1距离，对Imag[χ⁽³⁾]归一化后比较）、多视图溶剂一致性损失（对同一隐谱的不同NRB/噪声增强版本要求一致预测）。物理损失在15 epoch预热后线性升至0.25，一致性损失45 epoch预热后升至0.005。4. 数据生成：在线合成BCARS谱——固定溶剂峰参数，变化NRB形状（高斯/sigmoid/多项式三类）、NRB强度（对数均匀1–10）、异方差高斯噪声（SNR 2–60 dB）、30%概率随机裁剪谱覆盖；NRB函数族选择旨在避免依赖单一背景形态假设。5. 优化器：AdamW，基础学习率10⁻⁴（class token和预测头降低100倍），cyclic schedule，batch=512，混合精度（χ⁽³⁾路径强制单精度防止ω₀²溢出），梯度裁剪L2范数1.0，EMA衰减0.999，最多300 epoch。
AI.result: 1. 公共基准（5个实验谱）：iPINN平均MAE=0.0156，RMSE=0.0489，均为六种方法最优；次优VECTOR MAE=0.046（约为iPINN的三倍）；其他基线SpecNet 0.047、GAN 0.058、CNN-GRU 0.115、BiLSTM 0.298。甲苯2C配置MAE=0.019，3C配置=0.025；DMSO在高/中/低SNR下MAE分别为0.011/0.011/0.012，且谱中预期六个振动带（670、701、1043、1420、2912、2996 cm⁻¹）均被恢复，静默区干净。2. 焦深数据集（28个零样本谱）：7种溶剂在4个焦深（3–12 µm）下，5种溶剂（MeOH、EtOH、CyHex、Dodec、ACN）的MAE随焦深保持接近平坦；EtOH CV最低0.6%，CyHex绝对深度最不敏感（CV 2.6%）；甲苯和DMSO在12 µm处误差才明显降低（CV分别为18.6%和34.7%）。3. 消融实验：物理损失是强NRB下的主导因素，去除后3 µm处MeOH MAE从0.008升至0.030（CV从7.1%升至65.0%）；一致性损失控制相邻峰相对振幅，去除后EtOH CV从0.6%升至29.3%；两者互补，最佳CV需两者同时激活。
AI.conclusion: iPINN通过结构性的"逆问题优先"设计（直接输出物理参数而非谱本身），将Lorentz形状约束内置于架构而非仅作为损失项，结合Transformer的全局自注意力机制、可微分物理解码器以及多视图一致性正则化，在BCARS相位检索任务上实现了优于现有深度学习基线的精度（MAE 0.016 vs 0.046）和对NRB采集条件变化的深度不变性。该方法的局限性包括：固定24峰上限可能不足以应对生物样本中密集重叠的振动带；当前Lorentz前向模型无法完全捕捉每种溶剂在焦深变化下的精确NRB包络；ACN和DMSO上CV并非最优。未来方向包括：自适应峰预算、将可学习Lorentzian神经元引入输入tokenizer以缩小合成-真实差距、以及前向模型精炼模块以适应NRB形状变化。该框架可推广至更广泛的函数逼近与逆建模问题，为非理想采集条件下的鲁棒光谱分析提供通用范式。

title: Poisson-Gamma Dynamical Systems with Time-varying Transition Dynamics
summary: Bayesian methodologies for handling count-valued time series have gained prominence due to their ability to infer interpretable latent structures and to estimate uncertainties. Among these Bayesian models, Poisson-Gamma Dynamical Systems (PGDSs) are proven to be effective in capturing the evolving dynamics underlying observed count sequences. However, the state-of-the-art PGDS still falls short in capturing the transition dynamics that are commonly observed in real-world count time series. To mitigate this limitation, a PGDS with time-varying transition kernel (TV-PGDS), is proposed to allow the underlying transition matrices to evolve over time. Three specifically-designed Dirichlet Markov chains (Dir-Dir, Dir-Gam-Dir, PR-Gam-Dir) are constructed to accommodate heterogeneous structural mutations within these dependencies. Leveraging Dirichlet-Multinomial-Beta data augmentation techniques, a fully-conjugate and efficient Gibbs sampler is developed to perform posterior simulation. Experiments show that, in comparison with related models, the proposed PGDS achieves improved predictive performance due to its capacity to learn time-varying dependency structure captured by the time-evolving transition matrices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TV-PGDS模型，通过引入时变转移核解决传统PGDS在捕获非平稳计数时间序列动态方面的局限性，并基于Dirichlet-Multinomial-Beta数据增强技术设计了完全共轭的高效Gibbs采样器。
AI.motivation: 传统的Poisson-Gamma Dynamical Systems (PGDS) 使用静态（时不变）的转移矩阵Π来捕获潜在因子之间的交互。然而，现实世界中的计数时间序列（如COVID-19传染数据、国际事件互动等）往往表现出时变的转移动力学，即不同潜在维度之间的影响关系会随时间演化。静态转移核无法准确建模这类非平稳动态，因此需要引入时变转移机制。
AI.method:
1. 模型架构：将时间轴划分为I个等长子区间，每个子区间包含M个时间步。子区间内转移矩阵静态，子区间间动态演化。观测模型为 y_v^{(t)} ~ Pois(δ^{(t)} Σₖ φ_vk θₖ^{(t)})，潜在因子通过时变转移矩阵演化。
2. 三种Dirichlet Markov链构造：
- Dir-Dir：下一子区间的Dirichlet参数直接由前一区间的π按比例缩放（ηKπ），实现平滑演化
- Dir-Gam-Dir：引入突变因子ψ_kk₁k₂ 显式建模列内各组件间的交互，允许快速结构变化
- PR-Gam-Dir：通过Poisson随机化Gamma分布（RG1），利用Poisson潜变量g解耦分量比，进一步增强对稀疏性和突发性的建模能力
3. 推理：利用负二项-中国餐馆桌（NB-CRT）分解、Dirichlet-Multinomial-Beta数据增强等技巧，构建完全共轭的Gibbs采样器，包括反向解耦θ、Dir-Dir/Dir-Gam-Dir/PR-Gam-Dir三种构造的采样算法。
AI.result:
在ICEWS、NIPS、USEI和COVID-19四个真实数据集上的实验表明：
- 预测性能：在数据平滑（S）和预测（F）任务上，TV-PGDS的MAE和MRE均优于GP-DPFA、PGDS、GMC-RATE、GMC-HIER和BGAR等基线模型。例如在COVID-19数据集上，TV-PGDS的MRE比PGDS降低约15-30%
- 探索性分析：成功识别出ICEWS数据中的"伊拉克战争"和"六方会谈"等历史主题，并在NIPS数据中正确捕捉了神经网络研究的兴衰趋势
- 转移矩阵演化：可视化显示时变转移矩阵从接近单位矩阵逐渐演变为块对角结构，与领域知识吻合
- 三种构造对比：Dir-Dir产生平滑过渡，Dir-Gam-Dir捕捉复杂突变，PR-Gam-Dir产生更稀疏的模式
AI.conclusion: TV-PGDS通过引入时变转移核和三种Dirichlet Markov链构造，有效解决了传统PGDS在建模非平稳计数时间序列方面的局限。完全共轭的Gibbs采样器保证了推理效率。未来工作包括设计变点检测机制以自适应划分子区间，以及扩展到时变动态社交网络和不规则采样事件数据。

title: When Metropolis and Hastings Meet Bradley and Terry: Exact MCMC From Preference Voting
summary: Sampling from distributions conditioned on desired semantic properties is an emerging challenge in modern generative modeling. Metropolis-Hastings (MH) provides a principled route to conditional sampling, but requires access to exact pointwise target-density evaluations, which are not available in generative settings. Meanwhile, pairwise comparisons by humans or model "judge" are highly accessible and have proved valuable across diverse applications. We introduce Pref-MH, a general exact MH sampler for judge-induced conditional distributions using only stochastic binary pairwise comparisons. Our key observation is that the MH unnormalized density ratio matches the preference odds of the Bradley-Terry (BT) choice model. The central challenge is that while MH requires precise ratio computation, BT judges provide only sampled binary feedback. To this end, we develop a valid accept/reject rule whose resulting Markov chain provably converges to the target distribution. We further show that, for a fixed proposal kernel and budget, Pref-MH is optimal in the Peskun-Tierney sense among this class of exact reversible acceptance rules. Experiments on text generation and molecular design with LLM judges, as well as image generation with VLM judges, demonstrate that Pref-MH provides a practical and flexible approach to conditional sampling when comparative feedback is relatively easy to obtain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pref-MH，一种基于二元偏好比较的精确Metropolis-Hastings采样器，用于生成模型的条件采样。该方法通过Bradley-Terry选择模型将成对比较概率与MH接受率比值联系起来，设计了一种使用固定预算投票的接受/拒绝规则，从而保证马尔可夫链收敛到目标分布，并在Peskun-Tierney意义上达到最优。实验证明该方法在文本生成、分子设计和图像生成等任务中具有实用性。
AI.motivation: 现代生成模型（如LLM、VLM）的目标密度难以直接评估，使得传统Metropolis-Hastings方法无法应用于条件采样。然而，成对比较（如人类偏好或模型判断）易于获取且应用广泛。核心挑战在于：MH需要精确的点态密度比，而二元比较仅提供随机二进制反馈；如何在仅有二元比较的情况下实现精确的条件采样成为一个根本性问题。
AI.method: 核心观察是Gibbs分布下MH接受率比值与Bradley-Terry选择模型的偏好赔率相匹配。主要方法包括：(1) 建立MH与BT的理论等价性；(2) 证明任何固定预算程序都无法实现oracle接受规则（不可能定理）；(3) 设计N-vote接受规则 α_N(x,x';K) = min{1, r₀(x,x')·K/(N-K+1)}，使用K个有利投票；(4) 证明该规则满足关于目标分布π的详细平衡，保证收敛性；(5) 证明在Peskun-Tierney意义上，N-vote规则在所有使用相同预算的精确接受规则中最优；(6) 扩展到多评判者设置，将多个独立比较条件相乘。
AI.result: 综合实验验证了Pref-MH的有效性：(1) 合成验证实验中，Pref-MH收敛到真实目标分布，而插件式MH基线即使使用N=4也无法收敛；(2) 多条件文本生成中，Pref-MH(sep.)在所有属性上表现最优，优于点态评分基线；(3) 图像生成中，Pref-MH达到63.6%的成功率（包含所有三个目标对象），显著优于Pointwise-MH(7.4%)和基础模型(4.5%)；(4) 分子设计中，Pref-MH在MolSkill指标上取得最佳均值和中位数；(5) 机器翻译中，Pref-MH在BLEU、chrF、TER等指标上显著优于QUEST和Pointwise-MH基线。
AI.conclusion: Pref-MH是首个使用仅二元成对偏好比较、在一般状态空间和任意提议核上的精确MH采样器。该方法建立了MH与Bradley-Terry模型之间的深层联系，并通过N-vote构造解决了固定预算约束下的精确性问题。在Peskun-Tierney意义上的最优性保证了理论保证。实验表明，将比较反馈视为定义采样分布的直接接口而非仅仅是评估信号，为在高风险设计任务中整合生成模型和专家比较反馈开辟了新途径。未来的研究方向包括分析BT假设违反对稳定分布一致性的影响，以及开发针对人类评判者的高效版本。
