title: The Multiple Timescales of Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability: A Perturbative Derivation of the Central Flow
summary: The central flow of Cohen et al. (2025) is an empirically accurate continuous-time model of gradient descent at the edge of stability in deep learning, However, its derivation is heuristic. We propose a perturbative regime in which the central flow is the limit of gradient descent: we assume that the loss decomposes as $f = g + \varepsilon h$; in the limit $\varepsilon \to 0$, the dynamics of gradient descent with learning rate $\eta$ converge to the gradient flow of $h$ constrained to the minimizers of $g$ of sharpness at most $2/\eta$. Our approach is formal rather than rigorous; it treats gradient descent as a singularly perturbed dynamical system in $\varepsilon$. Three timescales emerge: a fast timescale of oscillations along the sharpest direction, an intermediate timescale of the self-stabilization mechanism, and a slow timescale of the dynamics along the minimizers of $g$-the central flow. Using the method of multiple scales, a classical formal method from singular perturbation theory, we derive the expansion of the dynamics in $\varepsilon$: the central flow emerges as the leading-order term in the expansion, while the self-stabilization mechanism appears in the next-order term. We study this mechanism beyond previous analyses: with a single eigenvalue at the edge of stability, we compute the slow drift of the energy of the fluctuations; with several eigenvalues at the edge of stability, we derive the self-stabilization system and explain why fluctuations persist.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将梯度下降视为关于小参数 ε 的奇异摄动动力系统，在损失函数分解 f = g + εh（g 定义"尖谷"）的框架下，利用多重尺度方法形式化地推导出 Cohen et al. (2025) 提出的中心流，并揭示了边缘稳定性下三个时间尺度的层次结构。
AI.motivation: 中心流虽被实验验证为边缘稳定性下梯度下降平均轨迹的精确近似，但其推导过程依赖启发式近似步骤，缺乏严格的极限理论支撑。本文旨在构造一个可严格分析（形式化推导）的摄动机制，使中心流自然成为梯度下降的极限，从而为其提供理论基础。
AI.method: 提出"尖谷假设"：损失函数分解为 f = g + εh，其中 g 沿最小化子集（线性子空间 V）取最小值，ε ≪ 1 为小参数，可解释为谷地锐度的倒数。中心流对应 ε → 0 时梯度下降的极限。采用奇异摄动理论中的多重尺度方法（method of multiple scales），将离散时间梯度下降视为在三个时间尺度上演化：快尺度 t₁ = k（最速方向振荡）、中间尺度 t₂ = ε^(1/2)k（自稳定机制）、慢尺度 t₃ = εk（沿谷地演化的中心流）。通过在 ε 各阶展开并消除长期项（secular terms），逐阶导出中心流方程（作为 σ² 或 Σ 的拉格朗日乘子形式）和自稳定系统。
AI.result: 1. 证明在 ε → 0 极限下，梯度下降的慢流（leading order）恰为中心流：受限于 g 的稳定谷（sharpness ≤ 2/η）上 h 的梯度流。2. 下一阶项（order ε^(1/2)）捕获了自稳定振荡，并给出振荡幅度 a₁ 与 y₁ 在 t₂ 上的耦合 ODE 系统（codimension 1 和任意 codimension 两种情形）。3. 单特征值情形：自稳定系统保持能量 E = y₁²/2 + a₁⁴/4 - (1/2)log a₁²，能量随 t₃ 缓慢变化 ∂ₜ₃E = η²(2 - 9ζ²)⟨y₁²⟩。4. 多特征值情形：自稳定系统一般无不动点，a₁a₁ᵀ 持续演化以匹配拉格朗日乘子的平均值 Σ = ι_C⟨a₁a₁ᵀ⟩ₜ₂ P_C，从而解释了深度学习中观察到的持续大振幅振荡现象。5. 揭示中心流作为最粗粒化近似（仅依赖 t₃），而 Rod flow、edge gradient descent 等近似额外保留 t₂ 尺度信息。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过"尖谷结构"假设和多重尺度方法，为中心流的合理性提供了概念框架与分析工具。形式化推导确认了：中心流是 ε → 0 时梯度下降的极限，自稳定机制是下一阶修正；多特征值在边缘稳定性时缺乏不动点解释了振荡持续存在的现象。框架具有系统性，可推广到含惯性项与自适应优化器的分析，仍有待解决的形式化（严谨化）、弯曲谷地 V、流形结构等问题。

title: SAGE: Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement for Mitigating Spurious Correlations
summary: Spurious correlations pose a significant challenge to the robustness of modern machine learning. The inherent imbalance in dataset distributions often leads traditional Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) models to rely on majority spurious attributes for classification, resulting in poor performance on minority groups. This problem becomes particularly challenging when the spurious attributes are unavailable. Existing group-label-free methods often upsample minority groups or misclassified real training examples; repeating the same instances can reduce effective diversity and encourage overfitting. To mitigate these spurious correlations from a data-centric perspective in the absence of prior knowledge, we introduce Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement (SAGE), a two-stage generative augmentation framework. Using cluster-derived sub-labels and class labels, we fine-tune a conditional generative model and text encoder, generating targeted synthetic data to fill underrepresented regions in the training set and construct a balanced validation set for last-layer reweighting. We experimentally show that SAGE achieves 89.5%, 85.7%, and 79.1% worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds, CelebA, and MetaShift, respectively, outperforming the best group-label-free baselines by up to 7.7 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE（Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement），一种两阶段生成式数据增强框架，用于在缺乏虚假属性标签和人工平衡验证集的实际场景下缓解虚假相关性。通过语义聚类生成子标签、微调条件扩散模型，并结合逆密度采样生成目标合成数据及子标签平衡的合成验证集用于Deep Feature Reweighting，在Waterbirds、CelebA和MetaShift上分别达到89.5%、85.7%和79.1%的最差组准确率。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习模型常依赖数据中的虚假相关性（如背景与类别共现的捷径特征），导致最差组准确率低下。现有方法要么依赖群组标签（如gDRO、DFR），要么通过上采样或重用误分类样本导致多样性降低和过拟合。更现实但更困难的场景是：虚假属性未知且无人工平衡验证集，传统方法在此设定下竞争力不足。生成式增强虽有潜力，但常需LLM、分割工具或群组标注等外部机制。
AI.method: SAGE采用两阶段数据为中心的框架：(1) 使用CLIP提取语义特征，通过Affinity Propagation (AP) 聚类获得子标签（不预设聚类数），为每个聚类注册可学习的子标签token，用LoRA微调Stable Diffusion v1.5的UNet（联合优化LoRA参数和新token嵌入）；(2) 通过token嵌入余弦相似度合并冗余子标签后，使用逆密度采样（全局归一化）为欠表示区域生成合成训练数据D_syn，使用均匀采样（确定性samples-per-token）构建子标签平衡的合成验证集D_val。下游采用标准ERM训练ResNet-50，再用合成验证集进行Deep Feature Reweighting (DFR)。CelebA因样本量大，采用FPS预采样+K²规模AP聚类+Faiss近邻分配的三阶段策略解决AP的N²内存瓶颈。
AI.result: 在Waterbirds、CelebA、MetaShift三个基准上，无群组标签设定下SAGE分别取得89.5%、85.7%、79.1%的最差组准确率，超越最佳无标签基线（DISC/MaskTune等）0.8/7.7/5.6个百分点；在MetaShift上同时超越所有含标签方法（gDRO、DFR等）。消融实验证明：仅用通用Stable Diffusion增强（D_sg）几乎无增益甚至有害（Waterbirds 73.2→70.5），而针对性增强D_mix带来显著提升（+4.3/+5.2/+6.1）。合成验证集在CelebA上大幅超越手工验证集（82.6% vs 62.8%），归因于更细粒度的子标签平衡避免了手工验证集的随机下采样方差；在Waterbirds上手工验证集略优（89.7% vs 88.6%），因该数据集虚假属性结构清晰。聚类纯度后验分析显示Waterbirds/CelebA纯度>90%，MetaShift为72.49%。可视化证实子标签token捕获了类别特定的视觉因素（如水鸟/陆地、性别等）。
AI.conclusion: SAGE是首个在虚假属性未知且无平衡验证集的严格设定下实现高性能虚假相关性缓解的生成式增强框架。其数据中心的哲学（主动扩充少数群体样本+合成平衡验证集）不依赖外部工具或先验知识，对子群体偏移甚至通用数据集具有推广潜力。核心限制在于：子标签仅代理虚假相关子群体而非真实群组，对齐程度取决于视觉显著性虚假线索是否结构化特征空间；逆密度采样可能上采样非虚假变异（如姿态、光照）。未来工作可探索子标签与真实虚假属性的对齐机制。

title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration
summary: Post-hoc calibration corrects reported confidence, yet a multiclass calibrator can also change the associated top-1 prediction. Accuracy captures only the net effect of these changes on correctness, not how often predictions change; the Top-1 Prediction Change Rate (TPCR) instead measures this frequency. We propose Calibrator-Output Repair for Top-1 Decision Preservation (CORD), the first post-fit adapter to impose exact prediction preservation by repairing the full calibrated probability vector. From the original and calibrated outputs alone, CORD determines the mass assigned to the original top-1. The calibrated conditional distribution allocates the remaining mass over the other classes, yielding a repaired vector whose own argmax recovers the original prediction. On the calibration split, CORD coordinates the repaired masses to retain the calibrated outputs' mean mass on original predictions whenever attainable. The adapter alters neither the fitted calibrator nor its direct output, fits no additional supervised map, and requires no user- or validation-tuned hyperparameter. Across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1K, CORD attains zero TPCR by construction and lowers mean ECE, NLL, and Brier relative to the corresponding direct outputs in every dataset; paired gains persist under distribution shift and across calibration-set sizes. CORD thus removes the preservation constraint from calibrator fitting and assigns exact recovery of the original decision to subsequent output repair. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CORD（Calibrator-Output Repair for Top-1 Decision Preservation），是首个后拟合适配器，通过修复完整校准概率向量来实现精确的 top-1 预测保留。它将预测保留约束从校准器拟合阶段移除，转而在输出修复阶段施加，在 CIFAR-10/100 和 ImageNet-1K 上以构造性方式达到零 TPCR，并降低 ECE、NLL 和 Brier。
AI.motivation: 后处理多类校准可能在修正置信度的同时改变 top-1 预测。准确率仅反映预测变化对正确性的净影响，无法捕捉预测改变的频率；传统上预测保留约束被嵌入校准器拟合过程，但以限制校准映射表达力为代价。作者提出将保留约束从事后拟合中分离出来，仅在输出修复阶段施加，以同时获得高表达力和精确预测保留。
AI.method: 给定原始分类器输出 p^0 和已拟合校准器直接输出 q，CORD 在原始 top-1 类 a 与其余类的条件分布之间重新分配概率质量。具体而言：1）保持 q 在 j≠a 上的条件分布 α；2）确定每个样本可修复的标量 s_i（分配给 a 的质量）的预测保留区间 I_i = [ρ/(1+ρ)+ε, 1-ε]；3）通过校准切片的局部参考 g_i（保持预测时取 b_i，否则取 (b_i + p^0_{a_i})/2）；4）在校准切片上协调 s_i 以保留校准输出在原始预测上的均值 μ（通过投影校准器均值到可达均值区间得到）；5）通过最小化 Σ d_B(g_i || s_i) 并满足 s_i∈I_i 和均值约束，使用单一共享拉格朗日乘子 η* 协调所有修复；6）通过二分法求解闭式响应；7）部署时仅存储标量 η*，每个新样本的修复成本为 O(K)。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 和 ImageNet-1K 上跨多种分类器（VGG、ResNet、WRN、DenseNet、MobileNetV2、ShuffleNetV2、RepVGG、ViT-B/16、Swin-T、ConvNeXt-T）和多种校准器族（VS、SVS、MS、SMS、Dir-ODIR、IROvA、IROvA-TS）进行评估：CORD 以构造性方式实现零 TPCR；在每个数据集上平均降低 ECE、NLL 和 Brier；在 CIFAR-C 分布偏移下增益持续；增益在 10%–100% 校准集规模下持续；ImageNet-1K 上修复时间仅约 25.64 μs/样本；与最小逐点修复和多种均值目标变体相比，CORD 在 ECE、NLL 和 Brier 上均显著更优；在低 TPCR 的 CIFAR-10 上与拟合时预测保留基线（TS、IRM、AdaTS、TS–TvA、MCCT-I）相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CORD 将精确 top-1 预测保留从校准器拟合转移到后拟合输出修复，开辟了后拟合保留作为一个独立的校准设计空间。保留成为一种部署选择：直接输出可用于可接受预测变化时，修复输出可用于必须保留原始 top-1 时。作者质疑将预测修正视为更大表达力的代价是否合理，并指出更丰富的后拟合目标、替代选择原则和超出 top-1 保留的扩展仍是开放方向。

title: Modelpedia: A Catalog of Model Findings for the Meta-Science of AI
comment: For the website, see: this https URL For the codebase, see: this https URL
summary: Scientific knowledge about AI models is produced faster than the community can organize it. Every few months a new foundation model reshapes the field and hundreds of papers, blogs, and technical reports document how each behaves or fails. Yet, these findings remain scattered and effectively unretrievable. To address this gap we present Modelpedia, an automated, LLM-assisted framework that extracts findings about models from published papers, links it to the model, dataset, method, and concept it concerns, and aggregates the result into a searchable public catalog. Applying the prototype to accepted ICLR 2024 and 2025 papers, we extract over a thousand findings and, treating the catalog itself as an object of study, run a meta-analysis of how the community investigates models. Now, we invite the community to explore, contribute to, and build on the open catalog, and to help establish model findings as a shared foundation for the meta-science of AI.

AI.tldr: Modelpedia 提出了一种基于 LLM 的自动化框架，从已发表的论文中提取关于 AI 模型（尤其是基础模型）的第三方发现（findings），并将其整合为可检索的公共知识目录。该原型已应用于 ICLR 2024 与 2025 的论文，提取超千条发现，并通过对目录本身的元分析揭示了社区在模型研究中的偏好与盲点。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI 领域关于模型行为的知识产出速度远超社区组织能力，导致发现分散、难以检索与复用。现有元分析方法（如综述、基准测试）要么聚焦于研究领域而非单一模型，要么只追踪性能指标，未深入模型内部行为，造成"进步错觉"——产生大量知识却无法有效整合。论文主张借鉴 Model Cards、Datasheets 的思路，将关于模型的发现（findings）作为一等公民，提出"Model Science"框架下的统一结构化表征。
AI.method: 架构设计：每条发现由六个核心字段构成——(1) model variant, (2) dataset, (3) method, (4) concept（如 failure mode、shortcut）, (5) source, (6) 相关工作（relationships）。辅助字段包括 title、short summary、caveat、key metric、evidence type。证据类型分为 observational（观察性）、interventional（介入性）、correlational（相关性）三类。提取流程分三步：(Step I) 用 LLM（Qwen3.8-27B-FP8）从论文全文中提取关于已发布模型的第三方 claim，并强制要求引用支持；(Step II) 对实体名进行注册表去重匹配；(Step III) 分配概念标签并补全模型属性（modality、task、domain）。另设有轻量级关键词打分系统（基于摘要与评审，涵盖 XAI、Model、Behavior、Finding 等七类词汇）对论文预筛选，保留 top 15%。最后用 Claude Opus 4.5（Opus 5 with extra thinking）进行发现验证。
AI.result: 原型部署于 ICLR 2024 与 2025 共 972 篇高评分论文（451 + 521），共提取 1026 条 findings，验证器确认所有发现的合理性（仅约 20% 在 key metric 字段存在小分歧）。元分析揭示：(a) 大多数发现基于相关性证据（correlational），观察性与介入性证据占少数；(b) 语言与视觉语言模型最受关注，集中在 Llama、GPT、Mistral 系列；(c) 视觉评估高度集中于 ImageNet 与 COCO，语言模型评估则更分散；(d) 闭源模型（如 GPT）几乎无法获得介入性证据；(e) 约 45% 筛选论文未产出明确发现，单篇最多 5 条。已开源在线目录与 GitHub 代码库。
AI.conclusion: Modelpedia 是模型科学（Model Science）基础设施的起点，验证了将 findings 作为可引用、可版本化、可归属的一等知识单元的可行性。该目录将随更多会议覆盖成长为元分析工具，能够识别研究盲点（如对相关性证据的过度依赖、对闭源模型研究的局限性），并有望引导社区开展更具因果力的实验。作者承认本系统仅记录论文声明，不验证方法学正确性，并将此留给社区后续解决。

title: Subliminal Learning as Trait-Direction Drift: A Mechanism and Targeted Control under SFT Distillation
summary: Beyond intended capabilities, model distillation can transfer hidden traits from a teacher. A teacher biased by a system prompt can generate semantically clean training data, such as numeric sequences, that still causes a downstream student to inherit the hidden preference, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Prior work has identified several parts of this process. How the signal builds up during training and produces behavioral transfer remains unclear, making targeted mitigation difficult. We propose and validate trait-direction drift as a mechanism for subliminal learning: biased generation creates measurable preference gaps in teacher data, and student-recognizable gaps induce trait-aligned updates during supervised fine-tuning that accumulate into behavioral transfer. Guided by this mechanism, we propose probe-space corridor regularization, a targeted defense that constrains drift along a calibrated trait direction during distillation. The method substantially reduces hidden-trait transfer, preserving task performance: for example, it lowers malicious-response transfer from 29.55% to 6.45% with low main-task accuracy cost, and consistently suppresses animal-preference transfer across the main Qwen setting. The preference-gap, training-trajectory, and intervention evidence links subliminal learning to trait-direction drift and motivates corridor regularization as a targeted control during distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"特征方向漂移"(trait-direction drift)机制来解释蒸馏中的潜意识学习现象，并设计"探针空间走廊正则化"(probe-space corridor regularization)作为针对性的防御方法。
AI.motivation: 模型蒸馏可通过语义上"干净"的训练数据（如数字序列）传递教师的隐藏偏好（潜意识学习），但信号如何在训练中积累并产生行为转移尚不明确，导致难以进行针对性防御。
AI.method: 两阶段机制：(1) 有偏教师采样产生正的教师端偏好差距(preference gap)期望值；(2) 学生可识别的差距在SFT中沿特征方向累积漂移。防御方法：构建探针空间的一维特征方向，对训练过程中的漂移施加双向铰链正则化，使其限制在校准的走廊内。
AI.result: 在Qwen设置中，将恶意响应转移从29.55%降至6.45%，主任务准确率几乎无损；五个动物偏好均被有效抑制。跨模型转移在Qwen/Llama/Gemma间显著弱于同模型设置，即使经过目标学生排序也持续衰减。
AI.conclusion: 偏好差距、训练轨迹和干预证据共同将潜意识学习与特征方向漂移联系起来；探针空间走廊正则化提供了一种在蒸馏过程中控制隐藏特征转移的针对性手段。

title: Neural Symbollic Regression Using Deep Learning and Sparse Modelling
comment: 11 pages, 5 tables, 5 figures, contains detailed mathematics behind the algorithm
summary: Symbolic Regression (SR) seeks to find succinct mathematical expressions that represent the fundamental relationships within data, providing interpretability and scientific understanding that exceeds that of black-box models. Nevertheless, traditional methods like Genetic Programming face challenges with scalability and are highly sensitive to noise, while sparse regression techniques such as SINDy rely significantly on predetermined feature libraries. In this work, we present a Neural Symbolic Regression (NSR) framework that treats neural networks as functional preconditioners for symbolic discovery. Our approach uses a decoupled pipeline: a neural network first learns a smooth, noise-robust approximation of the target function in an interaction- aware nonlinear feature space. LASSO is then applied to extract sparse, interpretable closed-form expressions. To improve predictive accuracy and symbolic fidelity by integrating distributed hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune and ASHA scheduling. Experiments on the Nguyen benchmark suite show that our approach consistently outperforms SINDy and non-tuned neural baselines in RMSE, noise robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization. Ablation studies confirm the significance of feature interactions, neural depth, and tuning strategies. In general, this study presents a scalable and understandable neural-symbolic framework, creating a solid link between neural approximation and the discovery of sparse equations for scientific machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Neural Symbolic Regression (NSR)的神经-符号回归框架,将神经网络作为"函数预处理器"进行平滑去噪近似,再利用LASSO稀疏回归提取可解释的闭式数学表达式。该方法结合GPU加速的MLP近似、交互感知的非线性特征库、Ray Tune+ASHA分布式超参数优化,在Nguyen基准测试集上优于SINDy和非调优的神经基线,具有更好的噪声鲁棒性和分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统符号回归方法存在显著缺陷:遗传编程(GP)可扩展性差且对噪声敏感;稀疏回归方法(如SINDy)严重依赖人工预定义的特征库;现有神经-符号方法(如DSR)将函数逼近与符号发现耦合在单一优化过程中,导致不稳定、计算开销大且难以保持可解释性。因此需要一个将神经逼近与符号提取解耦的框架,既能利用神经网络的表达能力增强噪声鲁棒性,又能保持符号回归的可解释性。
AI.method: NSR框架采用四阶段解耦流水线:(1)构建交互感知的非线性特征库Φ_full(X)=Φ(X)∪Φ⁽²⁾(X),包含8种基础函数(id, sin, cos, exp, log(1+x), x², x³, tanh)及其二阶交互项,使用Joblib并行构建;(2)用MLP在扩展特征空间上进行噪声鲁棒的平滑函数逼近,采用GELU/ReLU激活、dropout、weight decay和AdamW优化器,支持GPU/CUDA/MPS加速;(3)通过LASSO稀疏回归提取活跃符号项,利用SymPy重构解析表达式;(4)使用Ray Tune配合ASHA调度器进行分布式超参数优化(学习率、深度、宽度、批大小、LASSO正则化系数λ)。整体计算复杂度为O(Nk + EN(kH+H²) + Nk²)。
AI.result: 在Nguyen基准测试集上:RMSE方面,NSR在Nguyen-1/2/3上达到最低(0.0087/0.0099/0.0122),显著优于SINDy(约0.042)和PySR;噪声鲁棒性测试(σ∈{0,0.01,0.05,0.1})中NSR退化更平缓;OOD泛化(训练域[-1,1]测试域[-2,2])显著优于SINDy;符号恢复方面,在Nguyen-3上精确恢复出f(x)=1.002x⁵+0.998x⁴+1.001x³+1.000x²+0.999x;消融实验验证了特征交互、神经网络深度(1-3层)和超参数调优的必要性,完整NSR的RMSE为0.004(5个活跃项),而移除任何组件都会显著降低性能;运行时间上,NSR调优版为42.7s,SINDy仅1.2s,体现了精度与计算成本的权衡。
AI.conclusion: NSR框架通过将神经网络视为符号发现的"函数预处理器",成功建立了神经逼近与稀疏方程发现之间的桥梁,实现了高准确性、强噪声鲁棒性和良好OOD泛化能力的可解释科学机器学习模型。主要局限在于特征库随输入维度组合爆炸增长(限制高维可扩展性)、对非光滑/分段函数建模困难以及LASSO的系数收缩偏差。未来方向包括自适应特征库学习、Transformer符号解码、稀疏交互识别、低秩分层特征构建以及与科学模拟器的集成,以推动该方法从受控基准走向复杂实际应用。

title: Replicating TRACE: A Practitioner's Guide to Its Threshold and Particle Budget
summary: TRACE (Math & Lienhart, arXiv:2602.01135 ) reads causal graphs over event types out of a pretrained autoregressive sequence model by thresholding a per-position conditional-mutual-information estimate at a fixed tau. We independently replicate its headline synthetic result: with tau selected on a validation split, mean per-sequence F1 against exact interventional truth reaches 0.90-0.91 at vocabulary size 1000 (paper: 0.91) and 0.86-0.91 from 100 to 2000. First, the optimal threshold is pinned to the truth margin, not to any constant: at every size the errors at tau* straddle the delta = 0.05 margin defining ground truth (missed true edges lie just above it, accepted false ones just below), and the blind optimum lands near delta/2 times the estimator's calibration, confirmed out of sample at 5000. Second, at a single global threshold TRACE mostly recovers a direct, adjacent-influence graph: lag-1 true edges are recalled at 0.97-0.99, while true edges at lag 2 or more read orders of magnitude lower---the reading-scale price of randomizing mediating positions, which an exact test of direct causal effect requires when the truth is unknown. A per-lag threshold family recovers a third to a half of lag-2 truth; on lag-uniform data one validated threshold recalls every lag at 0.40-0.87, 8-26 pp below an atomic-intervention control at lags 3-6. Third, the default lag decay of the paper's synthetic benchmark concentrates about 85% of interventional truth at lag 1 and pushes the rest below the estimator's noise floor, so headline F1 there certifies lag-1 recovery only and conflates the benchmark's skew with the algorithm's own limit; a flatter decay separates the two. Fourth, F1 saturates from N = 2 particles at the selected threshold---a property of the threshold's margin over the noise floor, not of the estimator, which converges as N^(-1/2). We distill five practitioner rules.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇对 TRACE 算法（Math & Lienhart, 2026）的独立复制研究，从预训练自回归序列模型中通过阈值化逐位置条件互信息（CMI）估计来读取事件类型间的因果图。研究成功复制了论文的合成基准结果（词汇表大小 1000 时 F1 ≈ 0.90-0.91），并提出了关于阈值选择、粒子的预算和滞后期（lag）召回限制的四项关键实践指南。
AI.motivation: 尽管 TRACE 论文报告了令人印象深刻的合成结果（F1 ≈ 0.91），但其两个主要自由参数——阈值 τ 和粒子数 N——在不同规模下的行为尚未得到充分表征。此外，该论文默认的合成基准具有偏斜的滞后期衰减（e^{-(k-1)}），约 85% 的真实边集中在 lag-1，这可能掩盖了算法在更长程依赖上的真实能力。动机是：（1）独立验证论文的核心声明；（2）理解阈值和粒子预算的跨规模行为；（3）揭示算法的真实能力边界；（4）为实际应用提供可操作的指导。
AI.method: 方法采用完全独立的重新实现，包括生成器、分词器、预训练、阶梯式 CMI 估计、阈值化和图投影。设置两类合成场景：（1）冗余匹配场景（R ≈ 0.59，词汇表 1000，序列长度 64，h=6，δ=0.05）作为复制目标；（2）高冗余场景（R = 0.93）作为超域探测。词汇表扫描涵盖 |X| ∈ {100, 500, 1000, 2000}，外加 5000 的样本外测试和 10⁴-2×10⁴ 的后续世界。还引入了一个广义化生成器族，滞后衰减为 e^{-r(k-1)}（r ∈ {0.3, 0.1, 0, 1}）。阈值通过验证集上的 F1 最大值盲选，再应用于测试集。评估使用每序列平均 F1（针对精确的逐序列干预真相），每个种子至少 1024 个测试序列，跨种子间隙 ≤ 0.03。粒子扫描覆盖 N ∈ {2, 4, ..., 512}。
AI.result: 四个核心发现：（1）阈值被锁定在真相边缘 δ=0.05 处——在 τ* 处的错误跨骑在 δ 上，盲选最优点落在 δ/2 乘以估计器的校准处（已在 |X|=5000 样本外确认）。在 |X| ∈ {100, 500, 1000, 2000} 中复制了 F1=0.86-0.91 的结果，但任何固定常数仅达到 0.25-0.48。（2）在单一全局阈值下，TRACE 恢复的是直接相邻影响图：lag-1 真实边的召回率为 0.97-0.99，而 lag≥2 边的召回率近乎为零（|X|=2000 时为 0.000），因为阶梯式结构对中介位置的均匀重绘导致效果标记在事实分布外的概率崩溃。每滞后阈值族恢复了 1/3 至 1/2 的 lag-2 真相，在平坦衰减数据上每个滞后期召回 0.40-0.87（但比原子干预控制低 8-26 pp）。（3）论文默认基准的双重偏斜——约 85% 的真相在 lag-1，深层真相落在估计器噪声底线以下——意味着标题 F1 仅认证 lag-1 恢复，将基准偏斜与算法极限混为一谈。（4）粒子预算从 N=2 就饱和，因为 τ* 距噪声底线有 1.6 个十进制，但当阈值接近底线时 N_sat > 256；估计器本身以 N^{-0.46} 收敛（教科书蒙特卡洛行为），存在 0.7-0.9 nats 的 N 独立误差底线。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：按论文自己的标准评分并在其自身规模下，TRACE 确实兑现了论文的声明（F1=0.90-0.91）。然而，可转移的实践对象是协议而非参数：（1）通过验证盲选阈值 τ，引用时相对于真相边缘 δ 和估计器的测量校准；（2）粒子预算由所选阈值距噪声底线的距离决定，而非固定 N；（3）TRACE 的每观察指标是逐序列的——不要将其外推到语料级图；（4）在滞后衰减数据上，单一全局阈值恢复的是直接相邻影响图，需要报告逐滞后召回率才能看到不可见的类；（5）在长程声明下，应在减缓或平坦的衰减生成器上验证，因为默认基准认证的仅是相邻影响恢复。阈值、预算和召回上限是规模属性，协议是方法属性。

title: When Does Online Adaptation Pay on the Edge? A Leakage-Free Evaluation of Warmup, Learning-Rate Selection, and Resource Trade-offs for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Online adaptation can help edge time-series forecasting under distribution drift, but its measured benefit is sensitive to evaluation choices. We study six public multivariate streams, including building-sensor and smart-meter data, under a leakage-free streaming protocol. We identify two additional sources of comparison bias. First, the warmup budget of the static baseline has a two-sided effect: insufficient warmup undertrains the baseline, whereas excessive warmup can degrade its pre-drift generalization. Across six dataset-backbone settings, the estimated adaptation benefit changes by 3.0 to 18.8 percentage points (pp) over the 1,000-20,000-step warmup range. Second, comparing SGD with momentum (SGD+m) and Adam at a shared default learning rate conflates optimizer quality with rate sensitivity. We select both the warmup budget and each optimizer's online rate using a held-out pre-drift validation slice without accessing test data. Under this validation-only procedure, Adam outperforms SGD+m in 310 of 360 evaluated cells, while 4 Adam cells remain below the static baseline. We further characterize accuracy against adaptation-state memory and A100-measured per-update latency for full, head-only, and calibration-based adaptation. In the evaluated PatchTST frontier settings, several parameter-efficient variants are nondominated on the adaptation-state-memory axis. Smart-meter analyses also show that reported gains depend on meter-selection rules. These findings support a validation-only commissioning procedure, while target-device latency and energy remain to be measured. Code, data, and all reported numbers: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究边缘设备时间序列预测中在线适应的评估方法学问题。作者提出了一种无信息泄露的流式评估协议，并识别出两种此前未被充分关注的比较偏差来源：基线模型的预热预算（warmup budget）和共享学习率默认值。通过在六个公开多变量数据集（包含建筑传感器和智能电表数据）上的实验，作者证明仅改变这些评估选择就能使估计的适应收益变化3.0至18.8个百分点，并提出了基于预漂移验证切片的"仅验证"（validation-only）调参程序作为解决方案。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的时间序列预测常面临分布漂移问题，在线适应（online adaptation）被广泛认为是解决方案。然而，作者指出当前对在线适应收益的测量对评估选择高度敏感，特别是基线静态模型的预热预算和优化器的学习率设置可能引入显著偏差。这些评估偏差可能导致关于"适应是否有效"的结论不可靠。论文旨在系统性地识别、表征并缓解这些评估层面的偏差来源。
AI.method: 1. 无泄露流式协议：采用非重叠预测窗口（步幅等于预测长度H），每个目标在被任何梯度使用前先评分，确保信息不泄露。2. 验证切片选择程序：在预漂移数据最近的20%切片上做早停（warmup early-stop）和学习率排练（rehearsal），全程不触碰测试数据。3. 评估网格：6数据集 × 2骨干网络（DLinear、PatchTST）× 3预测长度（24/48/96）× 2回看长度（96/192）× 5种子 = 360单元。4. 适应策略：static、full·SGD+m、full·Adam、head·SGD+m、calib·SGD+m。5. 调度策略：每步更新、周期更新（k∈{1,2,4,8,16}）、漂移触发更新（τ∈{1.1,1.3,1.5,2.0,3.0}）。6. 资源度量：优化器状态字节数、A100每次更新延迟、每更新5W假设下的能耗。7. BDG2电表子集分析：包含最少缺失15电表、最多缺失15电表（反选择）、全280电表站点、240电表跨18站点集群。
AI.result: C1（预热敏感性）：预热预算对适应收益的影响是双向且非单调的。预热不足使基线欠拟合，预热过度则损害预漂移泛化能力。在1,000-20,000步实用范围内，六个数据集-骨干设置中估计的适应收益变化3.0至18.8 pp。验证早停与测试选择oracle的差异在+0.0至+3.4 pp之间。C2（学习率偏差）：在默认10⁻³下，Adam在360单元中有174个（48%）低于静态基线，最差达-46.5%；而SGD+m仅29个低于基线。使用验证排练的逐单元学习率后，Adam在310/360单元中胜出，低于基线的单元降至4个。C3（精度-内存-计算前沿）：在PatchTST前沿设置中，几种参数高效变体（head-only、calibration-based）在适应状态内存轴上是非被支配的。智能电表分析显示，报告的收益依赖于电表选择规则——反选择的最缺失15电表报告+42.8%，而最少缺失的15电表仅+13.5%。漂移触发调度在Appliances和ETTm2上优于周期调度，但在ETTh2上落后。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：关于设备端时间序列适应的结论严重依赖评估协议。即使在无信息泄露协议下，基线预热预算和共享在线学习率默认值这两个评估选择也会显著影响估计收益。在预漂移验证切片上选择预热预算和每个优化器的学习率，可减轻（但不能消除）这些敏感性，且不接触测试数据。在这种仅验证程序下，作者在六个公开多变量系列（包括集群规模的智能电表语料库）上刻画了精度与适应状态内存和A100测量的更新延迟的关系。在评估的前沿设置中，几种参数高效变体在低于全模型替代方案的适应状态内存下是非被支配的。这些测量提供了有条件的部署指导；但目标设备的内存、延迟和能耗仍有待验证。论文明确不提出新的适配器或优化器，贡献在于测量、协议和配方。

title: Scaled Idempotence in Transformer Attention: Paired OV Geometry and Shared-Value Algebras
summary: We identify a recurrent algebraic regularity in Transformer attention: a sparse subset of effective OV operators $T=OV^\top$ nearly closes under composition, $T^2\approx\alpha T$. Across six pretrained endpoints spanning 2.8B--235B parameters, 3.98--8.00% of heads reach squared closure alignment $\mathcal{P}\geq0.9$, while no matched within-layer O/V mismatch does. An exact principal-coordinate factorization, $T=Q_OKQ_V^\top$ and $T^2=Q_O(KDK)Q_V^\top$, separates within-support transport from read--write return geometry. Across all 7,304 heads in nine MHA/GQA models, scrambling only the orientation of $K$ while preserving singular values, norms, factor spans, and principal angles reduces median closure from 0.336 to $1.04\times10^{-4}$; trained orientation wins for 98.64% of heads and in every layer. Constructive searches show that high closure is feasible in every surveyed layer, but usually not attained. Retrospective trajectories in three independently trained lineages further separate broadly available capacity from the orientations attained by final strong heads. Under exact value sharing, headwise closure extends to a right-action algebra, $T_iT_j=\alpha_jT_i$. Seven-model experiments verify the approximate law and reveal distinct oblique projections with a shared value-defined kernel. These results characterize scaled idempotence as a sparse trained orientation within broadly available geometric capacity and show how value sharing extends a headwise relation into a local operator algebra.

AI.tldr: 本文发现 Transformer 注意力头中一类稀疏存在的"标度幂等"（scaled idempotence）现象：有效 OV 算子 T=OV⊤ 在合成下近似闭合 T²≈αT。通过主坐标分解得到精确的 KDK 返回几何，并通过保谱/保支撑的方向干预证明闭合依赖的是训练所得的"传输核心取向"而非低秩本身。在共享 V 的 GQA 架构下，这一头内关系推广为跨头的定增益右作用代数 T_iT_j≈α_jT_i。
AI.motivation: 先前对注意力头 OV 算子的研究多关注其与 QK 路由的组合或具体任务电路，但少有工作系统地问：一个低秩 OV 算子单独作用两次是否近似回到自身的方向？这种"幂等性"是低秩的偶然产物、近似投影/复制规则，还是 O 与 V 两组独立参数之间学到的配对关系？本文旨在用可分几何度量和严格的匹配控制，区分这三种可能。
AI.method: 1) 定义标度幂等度量 P(T) 为算子空间中 T² 与 T 的夹角余弦平方；2) 在 QR+SVD 主坐标下推导恒等分解 T=Q̃_O K Q̃_V⊤，T²=Q̃_O (KDK) Q̃_V⊤，将支撑子空间几何 D 与子空间内传输核心 K 分离；3) 设计三类干预：循环错配 V 控制、保留奇异谱/支撑/主角的符号置换重定向 K、Haar 正交基不变零；4) 在 6 个端点（2.8B–235B）、9 个模型共 7,304 个头上做穷举再分配与构造性搜索；5) 7 个 GQA 模型上测试共享 V 的定增益兄弟乘积律及仿射正规形。
AI.result: 六个端点中 3.98–8.00% 的头达到 P≥0.9，错配 V 控制无一达到。保谱保支撑的方向置换将全 7,304 头的中位闭合从 0.336 降到 1.04×10⁻⁴，98.64% 的头训练方向更优，且覆盖全部 268 层。等倾支撑归一化后 1,088/1,180 强头仍 P_I≥0.9，揭示潜变量核 K²≈βK。三条独立训练回溯轨迹显示几何能力广泛可达，但端点实现的取向稀疏。共享 V 下，右头 α_j 不重拟合即可解释 91.3–93.6% 的兄弟乘积能量，控制仅保留 1.3–5.3%；归一化强头两两余弦仅 0.315–0.486，但共享定值核 P_V。
AI.conclusion: 标度幂等性是训练所得 OV 配对关系产生的稀疏方向签名，而非低秩或主角的普遍后果。KDK 分解将支撑子空间与子空间内传输取向严格分离，表明"闭合"由训练取向而非几何容量承载。在 GQA 共享值下，闭合扩展为定增益右作用代数 T_iT_j≈α_jT_i，不同斜投影共享值定义核。这些结果把 Transformer 注意力中反复出现的代数规律定位在权重空间的结构层面，并将头内自关系连接到局部算子代数。

title: CopyShield: A Cross-Level Benchmark of Copyright Defenses in LLMs
summary: Large language models can reproduce memorized text verbatim, yet copyright defenses are usually evaluated under incompatible protocols. We introduce CopyShield, a controlled benchmark comparing three representative defenses at distinct intervention levels: contrastive decoding (output), Direct Preference Optimization (behavioral), and activation intervention (representation). We evaluate CopyShield on two model families, LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, using controlled memorization over five public-domain books and a shared protocol measuring literal leakage, calibrated non-literal leakage, utility, and degeneracy. Across these methods, intervention level is associated with distinct compliance-utility trade-offs. On LLaMA-3.1-8B, contrastive decoding remains near-degeneracy-free (0-2%) but reaches a literal-suppression floor at NV-Recall 0.192-0.203. DPO nearly eliminates literal leakage (0.263 to 0.002) but induces paraphrase-loop degeneracy in 58% of QA outputs, with no utility gain over the SFT baseline. Activation intervention attains the lowest non-literal flagging rate (1/200) by blocking 84% of non-literal queries before generation. Human evaluation confirms that DPO has low coherence, whereas activation lowers perceived copyright risk through broad refusal. On Mistral-7B-v0.3, the output- and representation-level patterns persist, while DPO degeneracy falls to 10-14%, showing that its severity is model-dependent. Together, CopyShield provides cross-level reference baselines and identifies targeted non-literal suppression as an open challenge. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CopyShield 是一个针对大语言模型版权防御的跨层级（output/behavioral/representation）受控基准，统一协议对比三种代表性防御方法（对比解码、DPO、激活干预）在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上的合规性–效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有版权防御方法（推理时 logit 操作、训练时遗忘、表征干预）在不同数据集、指标和实验条件下评估，难以直接比较真正的权衡；缺乏统一的、含校准非字面（语义）泄露阈值的基准，且人类评估维度不足。
AI.method: 1) 采用五本公有领域小说作为受保护语料 D，对 LLaMA-3.1-8B / Mistral-7B-v0.3 进行 SFT 诱导受控记忆化；2) 在三个层级实例化一种代表性方法：对比解码（输出层，减去版权专用模型的 logits）、DPO（行为层，用 800 对偏好数据，含 400 对任务感知 QA 对以保留事实回答能力）、激活干预（表示层，第 20 层隐藏状态上训练逻辑回归分类器，预先拒绝）；3) 共享评估协议测量字面泄露（NV-Recall、相位-1 LCS、ROUGE-L）、校准非字面泄露（MiniLM 嵌入相似度，α=0.001 校准阈值 0.625）、效用（QA 得分）和退化率；4) 对 Mistral 进行两随机种子实验，并在非字面轨迹上补充人类评估（3 名标注者、750 条评分）。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上：对比解码近乎无退化（0–2%），但受自适应合理性约束限制存在字面抑制地板 NV-Recall 0.192–0.203；DPO 字面泄露从 0.263 降至 0.002，但 58% QA 输出出现释义循环退化，效用与 SFT 基线无显著差异（Δ 95% CI [-0.11, +0.08]）；激活干预非字面标记率最低（1/200），但通过预生成时阻断 84% 非字面查询（QA 误拒率 16%）实现。人类评估：DPO 非字面一致性仅 2.0；激活感知版权风险最低（8%）但伴随 96% 拒绝。在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上：输出与表示层级模式复现；DPO 退化仅 10–14%，达到最高效用 1.87，表明 DPO 退化严重程度具有模型依赖性而非层级不变特性。
AI.conclusion: 干预层级与合规性–效用权衡的类型相关：输出层有"抑制地板"，行为层有"释义循环退化"，表示层有"过度阻断"。无单一防御在所有维度占优；针对性的非字面（语义）抑制仍是开放挑战，需要更细粒度的表示分类器或显式惩罚语义复现的损失函数。CopyShield 提供跨层级参考基线，代码已开源。

title: Pre-carved Niches: The Formation Dynamics of Modular Task Partitions in Early LLM Training
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Step-by-step training-dynamics study of modular task partitions in a from-scratch Pythia-410M model
summary: Large language models exhibit a modular internal organization that mirrors well-studied functional networks of the human brain, but how this organization forms during training is unknown: prior work has characterized finished models, not the formation process. We track formation step by step: we train a Pythia-410M model from scratch (two trajectories, bf16 and fp32) and run attribution patching at every step, alongside probes for gradient norms, effective updates, weight norms, and first-order loss decomposition across 14 tasks in four cognitive domains. Three findings. First, the modular map is pre-carved: before any learning, the dominant task pair already overlaps at ~3.6x the attribution substrate (a task-independent baseline), and its layer-0 concentration is an architecture-level constant on this model family. Second, the partition locks in through two sharp jumps whose amplitudes do not track the learning-rate schedule (the second reaching 20.4 sigma quiet-window / 6.2 sigma global), accompanied by gradient-level relative deprivation--winners receive 2.25->2.73x the loser's gradient supply, 9.5-11.5 standard deviations below a random control--that does not propagate to updates or weights. Third, deviation from the substrate appears only in the domain being learned, consistent with the hypothesis that modularity tracks learning. We close by separating the feature-level account we can defend from the mechanistic questions we cannot, and we pre-register the scale-threshold hypothesis behind our ongoing 2.8B experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型训练早期模块化任务分区是如何形成的。通过在每一步进行归因补丁分析（attribution patching），作者训练了一个Pythia-410M模型并在14个任务、4个认知域上观察其模块化结构的发展过程。核心发现包括：(1) 模块化地图是"预先雕刻"的——在训练开始前就已经存在；(2) 分区通过两次显著跳跃锁定，与学习率调度无关；(3) 梯度层存在相对剥夺现象但不传递到权重更新。
AI.motivation: 先前的研究主要观察训练完成后的LLM内部模块化结构（如Han等人2026年的工作），但模块化组织是如何在训练过程中形成的仍然未知。这就像研究人脑功能网络时只观察成年人而不观察发育过程一样。论文试图填补这一空白，通过逐步观察训练过程来理解模块化形成的动态机制，从而回答"模块化是功能性必然还是历史偶然"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 论文采用了多探针综合测量方法：(1) 从零训练Pythia-410M模型，两条轨迹（bf16和fp32）；(2) 每步运行归因补丁分析；(3) 同时记录五个每神经元探针数组（梯度范数、有效更新、权重范数、激活频率、二阶矩）；(4) 14个任务的任务条件梯度；(5) 一阶损失分解。提出了"基质校准偏差"测量方法（deviation = raw overlap / substrate），使用双校准显著性检验（quiet-window σ和global σ）。通过对照实验（合成模板、随机字符串体等）来分离不同因素的影响。
AI.result: 三项核心发现：(1) 预雕刻地图：训练前主导任务对的重叠已经是基质的3.6倍，第0层集中度（约40%）在不同语料变体间保持稳定，暗示这是架构级常数。(2) 两次跳跃锁定：分区通过两次显著跳跃形成（步18-19和步79-80），第二次幅度达20.4σ（quiet-window）/6.2σ（global），与学习率调度无相关性。(3) 梯度层剥夺：赢家神经元获得输家2.25-2.73倍的梯度供应，比随机对照低9.5-11.5个标准差，但这种剥夺不传播到有效更新或权重。还有8个量化反驳结果否定了多种候选机制（如周转、迁移、绝对梯度饥饿等）。模块化偏差仅出现在正在被学习的领域中。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三层结论：(1) 在特征层面，step-0地图由构造级结构分离、输出词形作为身份调制器、架构级第0层集中带三个因素塑造。(2) 在动态层面，分区通过两次幅度不跟踪学习率调度的尖锐跳跃锁定，在高更新率下维持，由稳定的核心骨架和外围组成。(3) 在机制层面——为什么结构分离会重塑随机网络中的归因对齐——论文明确表示没有答案，避免使用暗示机制的词汇。论文预注册了2.8B实验的规模阈值假设，预测物理域模块化将在更大规模时首次出现。论文诚实地区分了可以辩护的发现和不能辩护的推测。

authors: et al. (12 additional authors not shown)
title: Births are difficult to predict even with rich survey and full-population register data
summary: Major life events have proven difficult to predict. Does this reflect limits of theory, data, and algorithms, or the large role of chance? We examine one outcome - having a child within three years - through a near-ideal setting for prediction: a data challenge where 147 researchers predicted births for Dutch residents aged 18-45, using survey data and full-population registers. Methods ranged from logistic regression to a large language model and transformers. Predictions were moderately accurate (best F1: register 0.59, survey 0.76); advanced models did not outperform classical ones; and the larger registers did not beat the survey. Simulating the stochastic biology of conception and pregnancy, we estimated a predictive ceiling (survey F1 ~ 0.86-0.94, register 0.88-0.96). Observed performance falls short of this ceiling, implicating imperfect data, methods, and unmodelled chance, while the ceiling itself shows that chance in reproduction alone sets a non-trivial limit on predicting individual lives.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates whether major life events can be predicted by examining one outcome—having a child within three years—through a large-scale data challenge with 147 researchers predicting births for Dutch residents. The study finds moderate accuracy (best F1: 0.59 for registers, 0.76 for survey), with advanced ML models not outperforming classical ones, and estimates a predictive ceiling showing that chance in reproduction alone imposes non-trivial limits on predicting individual lives.
AI.motivation: The motivation is to understand why major life events are difficult to predict—whether this reflects limitations in theory, data, and algorithms, or the inherent role of chance. The authors use fertility prediction as a test case to disentangle these factors, as conception and pregnancy involve substantial biological stochasticity.
AI.method: The study organized a data challenge where 147 researchers predicted whether Dutch residents aged 18-45 would have a child within three years. Participants used two data sources: survey data and full-population registers. Methods ranged from classical approaches (logistic regression) to advanced models including large language models and transformers. The authors also simulated the stochastic biology of conception and pregnancy to estimate a theoretical predictive ceiling, comparing observed model performance against this upper bound.
AI.result: Predictions were moderately accurate, with the best F1 score reaching 0.59 for register data and 0.76 for survey data. Key findings include: (1) advanced machine learning models did not outperform classical statistical methods; (2) the larger full-population registers did not beat the smaller survey data; and (3) the simulated predictive ceiling was substantially higher (survey F1 ~ 0.86-0.94, register F1 ~ 0.88-0.96), indicating that observed performance falls short of what is theoretically achievable.
AI.conclusion: The study concludes that the gap between observed performance and the predictive ceiling implicates imperfect data, methods, and unmodeled sources of variation. More fundamentally, the ceiling itself demonstrates that chance in reproduction alone sets a non-trivial limit on predicting individual lives, suggesting that inherent stochasticity—not just methodological limitations—constrains the predictability of major life events.

title: Recent Developments in Transformer Inference Deployment on FPGA Platforms: A Survey
summary: With the rapid and continuous growth in the incorporation of machine learning models based on the Transformer architecture, capable deployment is in high demand. In this context, capable deployment refers to operational performance aspects, e.g., throughput and latency, as well as efficiency aspects, e.g., energy consumption. When it comes to the task of inference using such models, purpose-built hardware accelerators provide a lucrative alternative to common deployment choices, such as Central Processing Units (CPUs) and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). The Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platforms category is an example of such alternative accelerators, promising implementation flexibility, energy efficiency, improved latency and suitability for on-site deployment. We investigate the most recent advances, trends, and design choices for Transformer inference on FPGA platforms. We perform a systematic literature review, extracting and delving into preferred techniques for implementation and optimisation. This study and the provided taxonomy of topics could act as a guide for researchers from the academia and industry alike.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于Transformer模型在FPGA平台上进行推理部署的系统性文献综述，聚焦2024年至2025年5月期间的研究进展。作者通过对多个文献库的检索和系统性筛选，从153+51篇文章中最终选定57篇高相关性文章进行分析，并提出了涵盖实现与优化两大维度的分类法。综述详细讨论了权重存储、片上/片外存储策略、综合工具（RTL vs HLS）、模型压缩（量化和剪枝）以及IP设计优化（SoftMax计算、PE架构、流水线、ISA）。性能比较基于吞吐量（GOPS）和能效（GOPS/W）两大指标，并指出该领域缺乏统一的基准测试标准。
AI.motivation: 随着基于Transformer架构的机器学习模型在各个领域广泛应用，其推理部署面临高吞吐量、低延迟和能效方面的挑战。虽然GPU和CPU是常见选择，但FPGA凭借其可重构性、能效优势、灵活性和现场部署能力，成为推理加速器的一个有吸引力的替代方案。鉴于Transformer相比传统ML架构（如CNN）具有更高的计算和内存需求，加之该领域研究在2024–2025年间激增，作者认为有必要对当前FPGA上Transformer推理的最新实现进行系统性梳理，以指导后续研究和实践。
AI.method: 作者采用系统性文献综述方法，从IEEE Xplore、Scopus和arXiv三个文献库中检索关键词"transformer AND fpga AND (inference OR ai OR acceleration)"，共获得411篇文献。经过多重筛选（去重、日期筛选2024–2025年5月、聚焦Transformer主题、移除综述类文章、移除聚焦训练的文章），得到96篇候选文章。随后基于关键词频率进行相关性评分排序，选取得分≥25的前57篇文章作为主要分析对象。综述提出了一个包含"实现"与"优化"两大维度的分类法，深入分析了存储策略、综合工具、模型压缩和IP设计优化，并通过吞吐量（GOPS）和能效（GOPS/W）两个指标进行性能对比。
AI.result: 综述得出多个关键发现：(1) 在存储方式上，纯片上存储方案平均吞吐量为4688.79 GOPS、延迟5.64 ms，显著优于片外存储的1453.66 GOPS和49.92 ms；(2) RTL与HLS工具使用相对均衡，但RTL设计在能效方面表现更优（平均13W vs 26.885W）；(3) 8位量化是最常见的压缩方式，但混合精度量化、二值化等方法也在积极探索，HG-PIPE使用3位量化结合LUT-based MAC单元达到最高吞吐量17795 GOPS；(4) 近似68%的设计采用了流水线技术，至少25篇使用脉动阵列作为PE架构；(5) SoftMax计算的优化（如核融合技术）成为性能提升的关键；(6) Top 10能效设计中5篇采用RTL设计、能效最高者（Du等）达到679.76 GOPS/W（采用1位二值化权重）；(7) Pareto前沿分析表明高性能与高能效难以兼得，且部分高性能设计也能保持较好能效。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为学术界和工业界研究人员提供了Transformer在FPGA平台上推理部署的全面指南。研究表明该领域不存在绝对最优的设计维度选择，无论是设计抽象级别、存储组织、流水线策略还是量化方案都高度依赖于具体应用场景。虽然这种多样性体现了FPGA平台的灵活性，但也凸显了不同研究成果之间直接对比的困难。文章特别强调了量化技术作为"双刃剑"的角色——既能显著提升性能和能效，但也可能损害模型精度。最后，作者指出未来工作应聚焦于解决三个核心挑战：(1) 缺乏标准化的基准测试方法和统一的模型评估标准；(2) 架构详细信息的报告不完整；(3) 架构灵活性与峰值性能之间固有的权衡。

title: Multi-Head Self Attention is a Parameter Identification Mechanism
summary: We prove that a multi-head scaled dot product attention can be viewed as a parameter identification strategy. The ratio of unidentified parameters to the total number of parameters scales like the reciprocal of the number of heads ($1/2 \to 1/(2H)$), meaning models with more heads are structurally more identified. A subtle side effect of the mathematics observation that attention can never be fully identified. Similarly we also show that some bias terms can have no effect on softmax-based attention layers in both the single- and multiple-head settings, though this is mostly a curiosity that should have a marginal effect on model size and model training/prediction efficiency. We also touch on modern improvements to transformers including RoPE and GQA from this perspective, illustrating how those as well can improve the ratio of ``meaningful'' parameters to all parameters. Simple numerical examples demonstrate that training can indeed involve updates that overlap model-invariant subspaces that arise from a lack of identification. As part of our experiments we use a ``rebalancing'' approach that can ``fix'' updates that overlap unindentified subspaces but do not try to present evidence this should actually be adopted. Instead we simply view our numerical results as exploring and confirming the theoretical results. As a whole we discuss a purely mathematical/statistical explanation, identification, for why specific architectural choices in transformers may have improved performance.

AI.tldr: 本文从参数可识别性（identification）的理论视角证明多头自注意力（Multi-Head Self-Attention）本质上是一种参数可识别性机制。作者证明query-key矩阵乘积中存在D²个不可识别自由度，使用多头机制可将不可识别参数比例从1/2降至1/(2H)，并分析了RoPE、GQA等架构改进如何进一步提升可识别性，同时通过nanoGPT的数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: Transformer架构的成功通常被归因于多头注意力能够"关注不同表示子空间"，但本文从纯数学/统计的角度提出：多头注意力的引入同时显著提升了参数的统计可识别性（identification），这是一个被忽视的性能改善混杂因素（confound）。理解架构设计与参数效率之间的关系对深度学习理论具有基础意义。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：通过严格的线性代数证明，在query-key乘积 W_K^T W_Q 中存在 D²个不可识别自由度（对应GL_D(R)群的对称不变性），并推广到方向导数层面证明存在零梯度子空间。2) 多头分析：证明H个头每个有D²个不可识别参数，当D=E/H时整体可识别比例为1-1/(2H)。3) 扩展分析：分析RoPE（通过交换约束将D²维降至D维）、GQA（通过组共享将H·D²降至G·D）、以及value/output权重乘积（OV-Circuit）的类似结构。4) 数值验证：在nanoGPT上使用tiny shakespeare数据集，分别测试SGD、SGD+weight decay、AdamW、AdamW+重平衡化四种训练策略，测量ρ（更新与不变子空间重叠比例）、β（守恒量Frobenius范数）、τ（迹差）、μ（秩亏指标）等度量。5) 提出"重平衡化"方法通过QR+SVD分解将权重投影回规范化形式以消除不变性影响。
AI.result: 1) 理论结果：任何D×E的query-key权重对中存在D²个不可识别自由度，整体可识别分数为1-D/(2E)；多头注意力(H个头，D=E/H)使可识别分数提升至1-1/(2H)（如6头83%，8头94%）。2) RoPE将不变性从D²维降至D维。3) GQA使不可识别参数从H·D²降至G·D（如Llama-2-70B从1,048,576降至131,072，8倍改善）。4) 等价性证明：参数可识别性匹配的单头注意力需要更大的嵌入维度（嵌入膨胀约60% for H=12），否则不存在等价单头设计。5) 数值实验确认：纯SGD基本保持守恒量β恒定（仅数值漂移），AdamW显著偏离守恒量，说明自适应优化器的更新确实会覆盖不变子空间；重平衡化不影响训练损失但可正则化守恒量。6) 偏置确认：key偏置的梯度数值上严格为零，与softmax平移不变性理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文从参数可识别性这一纯数学/统计视角，为Transformer中多头注意力、RoPE、GQA等架构选择的有效性提供了新的理论解释。核心结论是：多头注意力将不可识别参数比例从1/2降至1/(2H)，这与"表示子空间"的原始动机无关，而是统计意义上的副作用。RoPE和GQA分别通过交换约束和参数共享进一步改善可识别性。同时证明不存在嵌入维度匹配的单头注意力替代方案。这些结果表明Transformer架构创新在提升表达能力的同时也改变了参数的统计意义，存在一个此前未被充分认识的混杂因素。未来的工作方向包括更严格地分析自适应优化器（如AdamW）与不可识别子空间的交互，以及探索是否应在实际训练中采用类似"重平衡化"的规范化技术。

title: Post-Training Science for Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Every supervised fine-tuning run forces the same chain of decisions, such as learning rate, batch size, LoRA or full fine-tuning, how many epochs, which optimiser, and what data to feed the model. Each of these is typically rediscovered from scratch for every new model and dataset. Here we measure them under one instrument: a sweep that varies one lever at a time, and spans dense and mixture-of-experts models in two families (Qwen3 and Llama), on four real-world customer SFT datasets, for both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These datasets give a controlled testbed: each task carries an evaluation built with the customer, and its training data is produced by iterative supervised fine-tuning that refines model outputs until they pass that evaluation, so the supervised target is internally consistent and the task judge we report against is the criterion the data was built to satisfy. We ask how the optimal learning rate and batch size move with model scale, family, and data, and whether one selection rule transfers across them; what LoRA trades against full fine-tuning, and how its rank and alpha set what the adapter can learn; whether validation loss (or other metrics, such as loss landscape flatness) faithfully ranks downstream quality; whether post-training gains scale with model size and data volume, on a model ladder extended through mixtures-of-experts to 235B parameters; how many epochs to train before general instruction-following erodes; and whether a geometry-aware optimiser improves on AdamW. Each recommendation is paired with a measure of its uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于监督微调（SFT）后训练系统性研究的论文。作者通过控制变量法，对Qwen3和Llama两大家族、涵盖稠密模型和混合专家（MoE）模型（最大至235B参数）、在四个真实客户SFT数据集上，同时针对LoRA和全参数微调，系统地测量了学习率、批量大小、LoRA超参数、模型规模、数据量、优化器和训练轮数等关键决策因素的影响。每项建议都附带了不确定性度量。
AI.motivation: 当前监督微调中的关键决策（如学习率、批量大小、LoRA配置、训练轮数等）仍然依赖启发式方法或每个新模型/数据集的临时调参，缺乏系统性指导。研究动机是用受控实验取代这些临时决策，基于真实客户任务提供可量化的建议。
AI.method: 采用单变量扫描法（one lever at a time），在两大家族（Qwen3和Llama）的稠密模型和MoE模型上，使用四个通过迭代监督微调（iSFT）生成的客户SFT数据集，对LoRA和全参数微调进行系统性实验。使用验证NLL作为选择标准，跨数据集比较时使用相对于预训练基线的改进率。引入Fisher信息矩阵迹作为损失景观平坦度的度量。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) LoRA最优学习率在0.6B至32B范围内恒为10^-3，约为全参数微调最优值的33倍；(2) 规则可迁移至MoE架构，MoE在密集模型规模趋势中位于其活跃参数和总参数的几何平均值附近；(3) LoRA在rank=64后趋于饱和，α=32是最佳缩放因子；(4) 验证损失在固定（模型、数据集、配方）单元内可有效排序下游质量（Spearman -0.38至-0.88），但不能跨模型家族迁移；(5) 损失景观平坦度在匹配损失下不提供额外排序信息，但可追踪泛化能力保留情况；(6) 损失随模型规模呈饱和幂律下降，全参数微调斜率更陡；(7) Muon优化器在SFT中带来轻微优势，学习率约为AdamW的1/3，验证NLL略低且最小值更平坦，任务质量相当但保留更多泛化指令跟随能力；(8) 超过约2个epoch后验证损失过拟合，任务评分不提升且指令跟随能力下降；(9) 新增样本优于重复训练。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将SFT中的临时决策转变为基于受控实验的量化建议。主要结论：LoRA学习率10^-3、全参数微调约3×10^-5是可靠默认设置；rank=64、α=32是推荐的LoRA配置；验证损失在固定配方内是有效的选择指标；模型规模呈饱和幂律趋势；约2个epoch是最佳训练轮数；新鲜数据优于重复训练。这些发现均附带不确定性度量，且规则可跨模型家族和架构迁移。

title: Solving In-Table Prediction Problems by Deep Neural Networks with Performance Evaluation Using Synthetic Data
summary: Tabular deep learning (TDL) leverages neural networks (NN) to extract patterns from tabular data. Traditional TDL methods follow a supervised learning paradigm, where a target feature is explicitly given. In this work, however, we explore a different approach by employing deep NNs to learn relationships among individual columns within a given table. We investigate whether NNs can predict the values of arbitrarily selected columns in a given table based on the remaining known columns. We call this problem In-Table Prediction (ITB), which is slightly different from table imputation methods and the pretraining task of TDL. Three potential usage scenarios are identified, which, to our best knowledge, have not been extensively studied in the literature. A self-supervised learning approach is applied to address this problem by randomly selecting columns to be masked out and used as learning targets. This work focuses on tabular datasets containing only continuous features. To handle missing values in continuous features, a novel neural layer is proposed to embed both numerical and empty values. Synthetic data is generated based on predefined column relationships, with empty values inserted using two distinct mechanisms. Additionally, an adapted masking strategy is employed to create test data. Performances of three NN architectures, namely MLP, Resnet and Transformer, are evaluated using the generated synthetic data. We conclude that, the attention-based structure outperforms the other two networks, when a sufficiently large number of training examples is available and a relatively large embedding length is chosen. We stress that these findings are obtained under controlled, synthetic conditions with a small number of columns and it should therefore be regarded as an initial, narrowly-scoped investigation rather than a general characterization of ITP on real-world tabular data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的表格数据学习问题"表内预测"（In-Table Prediction, ITP），即根据已知的列预测表中任意被遮蔽的列值，并提出了一种新的嵌入层来同时处理数值与缺失值。在合成数据上对比了MLP、ResNet和Transformer三种架构，发现基于注意力机制的网络在数据量充足且嵌入维度较大时表现最优。
AI.motivation: 传统的表格深度学习（TDL）采用监督学习范式，需要预先指定目标特征。然而，对于给定表中任意列的预测（ITP问题）在文献中研究不足。本文旨在探索深度神经网络能否仅基于表中其他已知列来预测被任意遮蔽的列值，包括数值预测和缺失状态判断，并填补此问题的研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 定义ITP问题：有别于缺失值填补（MVI），ITP的目标是预测任意被遮蔽位置的真实值（数值或缺失），而非仅填补NaN；2) 提出新的嵌入层（Eq.1）：为每个列设置三个可学习的嵌入向量，分别处理数值（乘以可训练向量）、缺失值（NaN）和遮蔽标记（ζ）；3) 采用三种主网络架构：MLP、ResNet和Transformer（无位置编码）；4) 借鉴BERT的自监督训练策略，随机遮蔽列作为预测目标，损失函数包含交叉熵（判断缺失状态）和MSE（数值回归）；6) 使用合成数据：通过预定义的线性关系（Eq.4）和指数关系（Eq.5）生成表格，并按MAR和MNAR两种机制插入缺失值；7) 采用两种掩码策略——MBMN用于训练/验证、MFDR用于测试，确保测试时遮蔽位置可由已知位置完全确定。
AI.result: 基于网格搜索的实验结果（固定噪声τ=0.01）：1) 模型选择：当训练规模N≥10,000时，基于注意力的网络在大多数情况下优于MLP和ResNet；2) 训练规模：性能随N增大而提升，线性数据集在N=10,000时趋于饱和，而指数数据集未观察到明显饱和；3) 掩码策略：n_max=1优于n_max=2，尤其在较大数据集上；4) 缺失机制：在线性数据集上，MNAR/MAR/NoNaN无显著差异；在指数数据集上，MNAR导致准确率显著低于MAR（因需两步决策）；5) 嵌入维度D：MLP和ResNet对D不敏感，但基于注意力的网络随D增大而改善，线性数据集在D≥128饱和，指数数据集（MNAR）在D≤512时未明显饱和。
AI.conclusion: 本文是对ITP问题的初步、受控范围的研究。主要结论是：在数据量充足且嵌入维度较大的条件下，基于注意力机制的网络在ITP任务上表现优于MLP和ResNet。作者明确强调该结论仅适用于两个三列的合成关系数据集，不能直接推广至真实世界的大规模表格数据。ITP不同于MVI，具有三种实际应用场景（输入补全、数据恢复、数据校验），并已被定义为一种新的机器学习问题。今后可扩展至分类特征、更多列数和真实数据。

title: Position: Privacy Is a Claim, Not a Property of Synthetic Data
summary: Synthetic data has become a common component of machine learning research. While widely adopted, its use in privacy-sensitive contexts has quietly shifted from a claim of residual inference risk under stated assumptions to an appearance-based property inferred from data generation itself. In this position paper, we argue that this shift reflects an implicit change in community standards for what counts as sufficient privacy evidence, rather than a misunderstanding of well-established privacy principles. Drawing on an empirical analysis of recent publications across major ML venues, we show that synthetic data is frequently used in privacy-sensitive settings without explicit articulation of threat models, inference risks, or falsifiable privacy claims. As a result, privacy assurance often remains implicit, difficult to verify, and unevenly distributed, with heightened exposure for rare and minority records. We argue for treating privacy as an explicit, evidence-based scientific claim and recommend that ML venues adopt norms requiring privacy-relevant assertions to be clearly scoped, testable, and contestable.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（Position Paper），核心论点为：隐私是一项需要明确提出的科学主张（claim），而非合成数据（synthetic data）所天然具备的内在属性（property）。论文指出，ML社区在隐私敏感场景中使用合成数据时，普遍缺乏对威胁模型、推理风险或可证伪隐私主张的明确阐述，导致隐私保障沦为依赖数据生成方式本身外观的隐性假设。文章通过实证审计ICML、NeurIPS、ACL 2024–2025的论文，揭示了这一系统性偏差，并提出"最低隐私主张标准"（Minimum Privacy Claim Standard），呼吁会议层面建立规范，要求隐私相关论断必须明确范围、可测试且可争议。
AI.motivation: 动机源于ML领域中一个隐性的范式漂移：隐私正从"对抗性推理风险下的残余风险主张"转变为"从合成数据生成方式本身推断出的外观属性"。这种转变虽非源于对隐私原则的误解，却反映了社区对"何为充分的隐私证据"标准的隐性变化——合成数据常被默认为"隐私安全的"，而无需明确威胁模型或形式化保证。论文旨在揭示这一结构性问题的严重性，包括虚假阴性常态化、对少数记录的隐私风险非均匀放大，以及机构层面隐私主张变得不可证伪和不可问责。
AI.method: 论文采用立场论证与描述性实证审计相结合的方法：1) 概念分析：对比传统"隐私即对抗性风险"与新兴"隐私即数据外观属性"两种范式；2) 实证审计：对ICML、NeurIPS、ACL 2024–2025接受论文（约16,000篇）执行基于规则的保守筛选流水线，分层检测合成数据使用情况（S2/S3级）、隐私相关语言、以及是否伴随形式化隐私机制（如DP、隐私审计、访问控制），采用关键词正则匹配与上下文窗口约束以避免过度计数；3) 行业调查：评估7款商业合成数据工具（Tonic.ai、Hazy、YData、Gretel、Syntho、MOSTLY AI、DataCebo/SDV）的隐私声明与验证机制；4) 文献综合：整合近期关于成员推理、属性推理、密度估计、相关性推理等攻击的研究证据；5) 对替代立场（合成数据作为务实风险降低手段、负面证据即充分、仅依赖披露规范）进行回应。
AI.result: 实证审计结果显示：在合成数据使用者中，相当比例论文以"隐私相关动机"（如减少暴露、更安全的数据共享）为名使用合成数据，但极少配对正式保证或对抗性评估。ICML 2025的细分分析表明，仅少数合成数据使用论文将隐私声明与形式化保证或对抗性评估相结合。商业工具调查显示，多数厂商仅提及差分隐私（DP）或根本不涉及形式化隐私机制，验证多为内部测试或仅依赖SOC 2/ISO 27001等组织级认证而非推理风险评估。文献综合表明：基于外观的隐私评估系统性遗漏了通过重建误差、密度结构、局部过拟合等渠道泄漏的成员信号；合成数据将风险从典型记录重新分配到罕见/少数记录，对尾部记录的成员推理成功率显著更高；隐私主张因无可比性、不可证伪性而变得不可问责。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：在合成数据的语境下，隐私必须被重新定位为一项明确的、可验证的、基于证据的科学主张，而非数据生成的隐性属性。论文提出"最低隐私主张标准"（Minimum Privacy Claim Standard）：当作者以合成数据为依据提出隐私主张时，必须明确（1）威胁模型——具体说明防御的威胁与边界推理；（2）范围——说明哪些风险被处理、哪些未处理；（3）证据——提供至少一种证据机制（如带ε的DP保证、基于推理的审计、或分层的风险报告）。论文呼吁在研究、会议评审、机构部署三个层面进行轻量但协调的转变：研究者应明确区分合成数据是作为风险降低启发式还是作为隐私主张证据；会议评审应不接受单纯合成数据生成作为隐私成立的依据；机构与监管应抵制将合成数据类别化为"隐私安全"的解读。核心原则：生成过程可降低暴露，但不能替代验证。

title: One-Layer Transformer Provably Learns Multiclass One-Nearest Neighbor in Context
summary: We extend recent work establishing an equivalence between one-layer transformers and nearest-neighbor classifiers in the binary setting to the multiclass case. By leveraging the simplex encoding, we show that one-layer transformers with an argmax classification head behave identically to a one-nearest-neighbor classifier in the multiclass setting. This closes a gap left by prior work, whose multiclass result relied on a non-standard rounding-based approach rather than the typical argmax head used in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将单层Transformer与最近邻分类器等价的理论结果从二分类推广到多分类场景。通过引入单纯形编码(simplex encoding)，证明带有argmax分类头的单层Transformer在多分类设置下行为完全等价于1-最近邻分类器，弥补了先前工作依赖非标准取整方法的缺陷。
AI.motivation: Li等人(2024)已证明单层Transformer在二分类设置下等价于1-最近邻分类器，但其多分类结果(Corollary 1)依赖非标准的取整方法而非实践中常用的argmax分类头。鉴于Transformer的核心应用（如下一token预测）本质上是多分类问题，缩小这一理论与实践间的差距具有重要意义。
AI.method: 1. 使用单纯形编码（中心化的one-hot向量）将K个类标签表示为正单纯形的顶点；2. 构建单层softmax注意力模型，标签块使用K维单纯形编码；3. 证明在特殊对角初始化下，梯度下降将权重矩阵约束在二参数族 diag{ξ₁I_d, 0_{K×K}, -ξ₂} 内；4. 建立多类损失与二类损失间的缩放恒等式 L_MC = (K-1)/K · L_bin；5. 利用球面几何工具（旋转不变性、内积密度、近邻对齐的集中性）完成收敛性证明。
AI.result: 1. 证明了关键引理——二参数降维(Lemma 1)：多类设置中绝大多数权重块的梯度恒为零，有效参数空间与二分类相同；2. 缩放恒等式(Lemma 2)精确刻画了多类与二类损失的定量关系；3. 收敛定理(Theorem 1)：训练损失以O((K-1)/K · poly(N,d)/log t)的速率趋于零，与K无关；4. 分布迁移定理(Theorem 2)和argmax分类推论(Corollary 1)：在具有正margin的测试分布上，argmax预测与1-NN标签的误差以多项式速率衰减；5. 六组实验验证了理论预测，包括不同K值、扰动初始化、不同损失函数下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文严格证明了带有argmax头的单层Transformer与多类1-最近邻规则的等价性。收敛速率、对σ和N的条件、以及分布迁移保证均不依赖于类别数K。理论结果在二分类(2024年Li等人)的基础上完成了多分类的自然推广，弥补了使用argmax头的关键理论缺口。实验表明该现象对不同损失函数（包括交叉熵和squentropy）均具有鲁棒性，为未来分析多类Transformer的in-context learning提供了理论基础。局限在于分析依赖单层架构和特殊对角初始化，且缩放恒等式仅适用于平方损失。

title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matching the unlooped Baseline on all three budgets. We scale SMELT across four sizes up to 54B non-embedding parameters and fit a separate Chinchilla-style scaling law for each architecture. SMELT's loss drops faster with compute, saving 6.8--18.0\% of training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier. The advantage transfers to downstream benchmarks beyond what validation loss predicts, is largest on Code, and grows with sample length and the number of in-context examples. Mechanistic analysis shows that the second visit reduces the attention sink and redirects mass toward content-relevant tokens, an inductive bias that may underlie the observed performance gains. These results show that looping can improve Transformers even under budget matching, offering a practical recipe that turns depth reuse into measurable gains.

AI.tldr: SMELT提出了一种在MoE Transformer中循环使用中间层两次的架构方案，在严格匹配FLOPs、参数量和KV缓存的预算下，通过Chinchilla风格的扩展定律证明其可在计算最优前沿节省6.8–18.0%的训练计算，并在代码、长样本和上下文学习任务上获得超出验证损失预测的下游增益。
AI.motivation: 已有的循环Transformer研究多在固定参数量下评估，无法区分架构优势与额外计算开销（FLOPs）。本文旨在通过同时匹配每token FLOPs、总参数量和KV缓存这三项预算，严格验证循环架构本身是否带来收益。
AI.method: 采用MoE Transformer架构，通过三项消融确定SMELT配方：(1)循环中间50%层优于全栈循环；(2)循环模型偏好更大的有效深度-宽度比；(3)循环两次优于三次或四次。在4个规模(100M–1.6B激活参数，最大54B非嵌入参数)×3个稀疏度水平(~85%、95%、97%)的网格上训练匹配的Baseline与SMELT对，每对共享token序列和优化流程。为每种架构拟合独立的Chinchilla风格扩展定律ℒ(F,S,D)=E+A(1−S)^b/F^a+K/D^c，并进行机制层面的探针分析（专家路由、残差流更新、注意力模式）。
AI.result: SMELT在所有16个网格单元上的验证损失均低于Baseline。扩展定律拟合显示其前沿指数γ=0.250高于Baseline的0.237，在C=10²¹ FLOPs时计算效率增益(CE Gain)达14.7–18.0%。下游基准上，DCLM Completion赢96/96对，DCLM Core赢83/96对，MMLU赢29/30对，增益超出验证损失预测；代码领域增益最大(20.4%)，长样本和更多上下文示例下增益扩大。机制分析发现第二次访问保留了Q/K检索坐标但V变化更大，残差写入更大且方向对齐，注意力sink从BOS显著转移到内容相关token。
AI.conclusion: 在严格预算匹配下，深度权重共享是MoE Transformer的净收益架构选择。SMELT将深度复用转化为可测量的训练计算节省，且在结构化数据和上下文学习上具有特定优势。第二次访问充当精炼步骤而非简单增加容量，通过减少注意力sink并放大首次访问的信号来实现增益。

title: Predicting Subsurface Abnormalities Growth using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: The research explores the pioneering integration of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) into the domain of Ground-Penetrating Radar (GPR) data prediction. This research presents a detailed development framework for a specialized PINN model, proficient at interpreting and forecasting GPR data, much like how medical imaging models predict tumor behavior. By harnessing the synergy between deep learning algorithms and the physical laws governing subsurface structures or in medical terms, human tissues the model effectively embeds the physics of electromagnetic wave propagation into its architecture. This ensures that predictions not only align with fundamental physical principles but also mirror the precision needed in medical diagnostics for detecting and monitoring tumors. The suggested deep learning structure comprises three components: a CNN, a spatial feature channel attention (SFCA) mechanism, and ConvLSTM, along with temporal feature frame attention (TFFA) modules. The attention mechanism computes channel attention and temporal attention weights using self-adaptation, thereby fine tuning the visual and temporal feature responses to extract the most pertinent and significant visual and temporal features. By integrating physics directly into the neural network, our model has shown enhanced accuracy in forecasting GPR data. This improvement is vital for conducting effective assessments of bridge deck conditions and other evaluations related to civil infrastructure. The use of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) has demonstrated the potential to transform the field of Non-Destructive Evaluation (NDE) by enhancing the precision of infrastructure deterioration predictions. Moreover, it offers a deeper insight into the fundamental mechanisms of deterioration, viewed through the prism of physics-based models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将物理信息神经网络（PINNs）应用于探地雷达（GPR）数据预测领域，提出了一种融合CNN、SFCA注意力机制、ConvLSTM和TFFA注意力模块的深度学习框架，用于桥面状况评估及无损检测，显著提高了GPR数据预测精度。
AI.motivation: 探地雷达数据预测在桥面状况评估等土木基础设施检测中至关重要，传统深度学习模型缺乏物理约束，导致预测结果可能违反电磁波传播等物理规律。为提升预测精度并确保物理一致性，本文将物理信息神经网络引入GPR领域。
AI.method: 提出一种专用PINN模型，将电磁波传播物理定律嵌入神经网络架构。具体结构包含三个组件：CNN提取空间特征、空间特征通道注意力（SFCA）机制、以及ConvLSTM结合时间特征帧注意力（TFFA）模块，通过自适应的通道注意力与时间注意力权重，细调视觉与时间特征响应。
AI.result: 通过将物理信息直接整合到神经网络中，模型在GPR数据预测上表现出增强的准确性，有助于桥面状况评估及土木基础设施的有效评估，展示了PINN在提升基础设施劣化预测精度方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: PINN有潜力通过提高基础设施劣化预测精度，并结合物理模型提供对劣化机制更深入的洞察，从而变革无损检测（NDE）领域。

title: CATeye: Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning for Voucher Abuse Detection
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, Accepted by CIKM 2026 Applied Research Track
summary: Voucher abuse poses a major challenge in e-commerce, where malicious users exploit promotional vouchers for profit. Unfortunately, fraud patterns evolve rapidly over time and across regions, causing distribution shifts that degrade existing detection models unless retrained frequently. To tackle this, we propose the Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning framework (CATeye). The key challenge arises from coupled attribute-topology shift, where edges built from attribute proximity cause environment-driven attribute shift to induce shifted topology, thereby amplifying variant signals through GNN message passing. CATeye sees through such coupled shifts with two learnable selectors. First, an Attribute Invariance Selector (AIS) learns node-adaptive masks to filter out non-invariant attributes. Then, conditioned on retained invariant attributes, an Edge Invariance Selector (EIS) samples an invariant subgraph and isolates non-invariant edges. Using the resulting invariant and non-invariant components, CATeye constructs multiple views and applies view-specific objectives to emphasize domain-invariant representations while suppressing domain-specific variations. Experiments on both a proprietary dataset from Lazada, a major Southeast Asian e-commerce platform, and a public benchmark show that CATeye consistently outperforms nine strong domain generalization and graph anomaly detection baselines, achieving up to an 8.61% improvement in average F1 score over the strongest baseline. Source code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出CATeye框架，用于解决电子商务平台中优惠券滥用检测面临的跨时间、跨区域分布偏移问题。核心贡献在于识别并处理"耦合属性-拓扑漂移"现象，即环境中属性变化会通过基于属性构建的边结构影响图结构，进而通过GNN消息传递放大变异信号。CATeye包含属性不变选择器(AIS)和边不变选择器(EIS)，分别学习节点自适应属性掩码和不变子图，并结合四种视图的对比学习、交叉熵损失和熵最大化损失来强化域不变表示。在Lazada真实数据集和Elliptic公开数据集上，CATeye平均F1分数比最强基线提升达8.61%。
AI.motivation: 优惠券滥用行为随时间快速演变且因地区而异，传统检测模型需频繁重训才能应对分布偏移。然而现有图域泛化方法假设属性与结构变化相互独立，或仅在嵌入空间中强制不变性，无法应对属性变化诱发结构变化进而通过GNN消息传递放大变异信号的耦合漂移场景。
AI.method: CATeye框架包含两个核心模块：(1)自动耦合不变性选择——AIS利用Gumbel-Softmax学习节点自适应二值掩码筛选不变属性，EIS基于筛选后的不变属性通过GNN+MLP对每条边评分并采样不变子图；(2)多视图不变表示学习——组合属性和结构的"不变/非不变"分量构建四种视图（完全不变视图、部分不变视图、两种非不变视图），分别施加跨域对比损失、选择性交叉熵损失和熵最大化损失，推理时仅使用完全不变视图实现零样本泛化。
AI.result: 在Lazada真实优惠券滥用数据集(覆盖印尼和越南市场、4个月时间跨度、16个目标域)和Elliptic比特币交易数据集(8个时间测试折)上的实验表明：CATeye在两个数据集上平均F1分别达到81.37%和76.84%，比最强基线(EERM/CaNet)分别提升2.81%和8.61%；消融实验显示不变属性选择贡献最大(随机化AIS导致性能下降6.50%)，部分不变视图约束损失贡献5.46%；模型对超参数和掩码比例ρ_a、ρ_e具有较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CATeye通过显式解耦节点属性和图结构中的不变/非不变成分，有效缓解了优惠券滥用图中属性与拓扑耦合漂移问题。该框架在零样本跨域泛化场景中表现优异，可直接部署到新市场和新的促销周期，无需重训，为图异常检测中的分布偏移问题提供了通用且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: TRIAGE: Three-level Routing and Intelligent Agent Guidance for Efficient Execution
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents based on the ReAct paradigm have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tool use and task execution. However, ReAct suffers from a fundamental efficiency problem: every query triggers a complete reasoning loop from scratch, and similar queries repeat identical steps without leveraging historical experience. We propose TRIAGE,a three-level routing framework that reduces token consumption by reusing historical execution trajectories. Its core innovation is TaaS (Trajectory-as-a-Skill), which abstracts historical execution trajectories into reusable skills, realizing 'experience as a service'. TRIAGE classifies queries into three levels: (1) Direct Reuse-identical queries, 0 tokens; (2) Skill Substitution-similar queries, 0 tokens via deterministic parameter substitution; (3) Full ReAct-novel queries, automatically stored for future reuse. In large-scale experiments on 1,007 security monitoring queries, TRIAGE achieves 62.3% token savings, with 56.0% of queries at Level 2 and 5.5% at Level 1, both executing at zero cost. Cross-domain validation on ToolBench (15 domains, 345 queries) achieves 76.3% token reduction, confirming the generalizability of semantic routing. An online learning experiment demonstrates cold-start-to-mature evolution: the L2 hit rate rises from 0% to 57% within the first 100 queries, and the average token cost drops from 198 to 74.7. We also propose an automatic Skill extraction mechanism that distills high-frequency trajectory patterns into deterministic Skills, creating a positive feedback loop of 'the more you use it, the more efficient it becomes'.

AI.tldr: TRIAGE是一个三级别路由框架，通过将历史执行轨迹抽象为可复用的"TaaS"（Trajectory-as-a-Skill）技能，显著降低基于ReAct范式的LLM Agent的token消耗。在1,007个安全监控查询上实现62.3%的token节省（199,782→75,238），在ToolBench跨域验证的345个查询中实现76.3%的token降低（424,792→100,875）。系统通过语义检索（all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384维）和阈值路由（≥0.98为L1直接复用，≥0.90为L2技能替换，<0.90为L3完整ReAct）自动将查询分类，并设计从冷启动到成熟的渐进式自我强化循环，具有"用得越多越高效"的正反馈特性。
AI.motivation: 基于ReAct范式的LLM Agent每个查询都从头执行完整推理循环，存在严重的效率冗余问题——相似查询重复相同的推理步骤而无法利用历史经验。现有方法（缓存系统仅支持精确字符串匹配，提示压缩不消除推理循环，投机解码不解决重复推理）均无法从根本解决此问题。作者认为应让智能体像人类一样积累经验，而非每次从零开始推理。
AI.method: TRIAGE框架包含四个核心模块：①语义编码器（all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384维）；②相似度阈值路由器（L1≥0.98, L2≥0.90）；③轨迹检索器；④技能提取器。核心创新是TaaS（Trajectory-as-a-Skill）：将成功执行的历史轨迹作为潜在技能存储到语义检索库中。查询分三级处理：L1精确匹配直接复用（0 token）；L2相似查询通过提取的确定性技能进行参数替换执行（0 token）；L3新颖查询执行完整ReAct循环并自动存储新轨迹。技能提取流程包含四阶段：模式归一化（将具体值替换为类型化通配符）、频率累积、参数归纳（通过成对差异发现变量槽位）、确定性注册。支持FAISS加速检索。设计了基于LLM反馈的参数提取自改进机制。
AI.result: 主实验：1,007个安全监控查询，61.5%的查询通过L1+L2零token执行（55个L1占5.5%，564个L2占56.0%），38.5%为L3（388个），整体实现62.3%的token节省（199,782→75,238），API调用减少58.2%（从1,007降至421）。路由策略消融：阈值路由（0开销）达到62.3%节省，LLM路由因225,628 token的路由开销反而导致净增37.3%开销。组件消融：去除L2机制后节省率降至55%。在线学习动态：L2命中率在前100个查询内从0%升至57%，平均token从198降至74.7，最终达到稳定期。跨域验证：ToolBench 15个领域345个查询（涵盖笑话、金融、位置服务等），平均76.3%的token降低（424,792→100,875），L1+L2复用率达96.2%（其中L1占84.6%，L2占11.6%，因域内查询多样性高）。所有路由级别均达100%成功率。
AI.conclusion: TRIAGE通过三级别路由架构与TaaS理念，证明了经验驱动执行是降低LLM Agent成本的有效方法，而无需牺牲能力。核心贡献包括：三级别路由框架、TaaS语义编码检索、自动冷启动、自动技能提取机制、跨域泛化验证以及路由策略分析。设计原则是"效率提升必须来自消除LLM调用"，而非增加更多复杂调用。阈值路由与LLM路由的选择不绝对——取决于路由开销与执行成本的比值，激励了按场景自适应选择的混合路由架构设计。局限包括冷启动成本（前10-50查询无法受益）、领域特异性（轨迹无法跨域复用）、首次查询效率低、错误传播风险。未来方向：程序合成、可组合技能库、多模态工具统一、终身技能学习、技能正确性验证、对比经验提取的跨智能体轨迹共享。

title: Edge-Girth as a Structural Edge Feature for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNN) based on message passing are provably no more powerful than the one-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman colour-refinement test (1-WL): two graphs it cannot tell apart receive identical representations, however deep or wide the network. A common remedy augments node or edge features with precomputed structural descriptors, most often counts of a fixed small subgraph such as triangles or longer cycles, but such counts require committing in advance to the size of the substructure counted, a choice usually made blind to the data. We study a descriptor that avoids this choice. The edge-girth of an edge is the length of a shortest cycle through it, and its multiplicity is the number of such shortest cycles; together they form a per-edge invariant that reports cycles of arbitrary length, computable exactly by a single breadth-first search per edge. Injected into a gated message-passing architecture, EGAGNN, it reaches a test MAE a factor three below the closest gated comparator on the ZINC-12k regression benchmark at 104k parameters; against bounded cycle-counting descriptors under the same architecture, it matches only a dictionary counting cycles up to length eight, using twice as many channels, while a dictionary capped at length four performs no better than no structural information at all. On graph discrimination we prove a matching limitation: on graphs where every edge sees the same number of shortest cycles of the same length, the descriptor becomes constant and any model built on it collapses back to the 1-WL bound. This holds without exception across all 400 pairs of the BREC benchmark: not one of the 90 such pairs is distinguished.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于边围长(edge-girth)的图结构描述符，并设计了一个门控消息传递网络EGAGNN。该描述符记录每条边上最短环的长度及其数量，无需预设环的大小上限。在ZINC-12k上以约104k参数达到0.0932的测试MAE，约为最佳门控基线的三分之一。但文章同时证明了在边围长正则图上该描述符退化为常数，模型表达力回退至1-WL上界，这一预测在BREC基准的400对图上无一例外地成立（90对满足条件，全部未区分）。
AI.motivation: 1. MPNN的表达力受限于1-WL测试，常用预计算的结构描述符（如子图计数）需要事先固定子结构的大小k，而k的选择通常是盲目的——k=4在分子数据上毫无用处，k=8才能获得大部分增益。2. 需要一种无需预设大小上限的结构描述符，能自动报告任意长度的环结构。3. 同时需要严格刻画该描述符的局限性。
AI.method: 1. 边围长描述符：对每条边e=(u,v)，定义g_e为通过e的最短环长度（桥边g_e=∞），λ_e为该长度环的数量。通过对G\{e}做单次BFS即可精确计算（等价于替换路径问题），时间复杂度O(|E|(|V|+|E|))。2. EGAGNN架构：边特征初始化为[标准化g_e, 标准化λ_e, 桥指示符]拼接边属性；消息传递中用sigmoid门控（边状态经MLP后与邻居节点MLP输出做Hadamard积）；边状态在每层吸收两端点表示并重新注入初始描述符。3. 表达力分析：证明在边围长正则图（所有边具有相同(g_e,λ_e)）上，模型退化为1-WL。4. 实验在ZINC-12k（回归）和BREC（图同构判别）上进行，参数预算匹配至约100k。
AI.result: 1. ZINC-12k：EGAGNN以104,113参数达到测试MAE 0.0932±0.0035，约为最接近的门控基线GatedGCN（0.2778）的三分之一，比GSN(k=6)的0.1725低约1.9倍。2. 描述符对比实验（固定架构与化学输入）：无结构描述符MAE=0.2044；三角形计数=0.2154；环长度3-4=0.2021；环长度3-6=0.1150；环长度3-8=0.1005；(g_e,λ_e)+桥指示符(3通道)=0.0932。长度4以下的字典与无描述符无差异。3. BREC（400对，RPC协议）：EGAGNN整体区分率0.485，略低于2-FWL的0.675和PPGN的0.518，但高于GSN的0.443。Edge-girth multiset直接哈希达到0.483，与EGAGNN仅差1对。4. 命题1验证：400对中有90对为边围长正则且参数匹配，全部未被区分（无一例外）；同时证明仅要求g_e恒定则该命题不成立（额外13对中有12对被区分），说明λ_e的必要性。5. 在Regular类别中，50对边围长正则与50对强正则完全重合，仅有1对（#71）两种性质都不满足且仅2-FWL能区分。
AI.conclusion: 1. 边围长描述符以3通道/边的代价在ZINC-12k上达到了仅与6通道长度8环计数字典相当的效果，避免了预设大小上限的盲目选择。2. 该描述符存在精确可刻画的盲点：在边围长正则图上退化为常数，模型表达力回退至1-WL上界，这一保证在BREC全部400对上无一例外地成立。3. 描述符本身（而非架构）在BREC上完成了几乎全部区分工作（直接哈希仅差1对），说明特征而非网络是主要贡献来源。4. 局限：监督证据仅来自单一回归任务的单一数据集；描述符在CFI类别上表现差（仅3%对比2-FWL的60%）的原因未被理论解释；是否能在长环主导的图族（如LDPC Tanner图）上展现优势尚待验证。

title: Diffusion as a Training Curriculum for Timestep-Free Iterative Reasoning
summary: Diffusion models and recursive reasoners are both iterative, but they carry information across iterations differently. We add a persistent hidden state to a diffusion denoiser and remove its timestep conditioning, leaving a single shared update that can be run to arbitrary depth. The result is an anytime solver: accuracy keeps improving with inference depth far beyond the rollout lengths and backpropagation window used in training, reaching 99.90% exact solve on Sudoku-Extreme. We also obtain 98.93% solve rate on Maze-Unique. Surprisingly, progressive denoising is unnecessary at inference: holding corruption at its maximum by replacing every non-clue variable with fresh Gaussian noise at each step retains near-perfect solving and converges to stable solutions. This simple noise-injection mechanism enables a single trajectory to efficiently explore the solution space and settle on the correct answer without parallel rollouts, candidate selection, or external verifiers required by prior reasoning models. Nonetheless, ordered annealed corruption remains critical during training, which suggests that diffusion's primary contribution to our anytime solver is not a sampling procedure at inference, but a denoising training curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种时间步无关的循环扩散去噪器，通过在扩散模型中加入持久隐藏状态并移除时间步条件，构建了一个可任意推理深度的"任意时刻求解器"（anytime solver）。在Sudoku-Extreme上达到99.90%的精确求解率，在Maze-Unique上达到98.93%。关键发现是推理时不需要渐进去噪——每步用最大高斯噪声替换非提示变量仍能近乎完美求解——但训练时必须使用有序的退火噪声课程。扩散的主要贡献不是采样过程，而是提供了一种去噪训练课程。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型通过演化采样状态x_t传递迭代信息，而递归推理模型通过隐藏状态传递计算。作者探索一个核心问题：当扩散状态是连续的时，给去噪器添加持久隐藏状态后，扩散训练本身是否能将其转化为迭代推理器？这弥合了扩散模型与递归推理模型之间的架构差距。
AI.method: 方法核心是在扩散去噪器（Sudoku用循环Transformer，Maze用循环局部卷积）中加入持久隐藏状态，同时移除时间步和迭代索引的条件信号。模型从同一潜在表示通过两个独立LayerNorm产生两个视图：一个作为下一隐藏状态（无监督），另一个投影到数据空间。训练采用交错短回滚（K∈[20,160]），使用L=4步截断BPTT，仅对非提示变量施加MSE损失。推理时可选择退火调度或固定噪声水平，后者效果更佳。内部循环J=8次。
AI.result: 1) Sudoku-Extreme上：K=10,000步达99.90%精确求解率（最大恒定噪声），退火推理为99.56%；K=100时Maze-Unique达98.93%。2) 推理深度可自由扩展至远超训练时的回滚长度，且无时间步条件性能不降。3) 隐藏状态探针实验显示其携带位置结构化的实例特定信息（随机打乱隐藏状态性能降至0.27%）。4) 训练课程消融：固定噪声训练降至82.73%，无噪声降至0%，证明有序退火噪声课程至关重要。5) 在Maze-Hard上，最优解率86.43%与TRM的85.3%相当。6) BPTT深度L=4最优，过浅或过深均退化。7) 完全确定的谜题99.24%的轨迹稳定收敛且持续保持。
AI.conclusion: 向时间步无关的扩散去噪器添加持久隐藏状态可将其转化为任意时刻的迭代求解器。隐藏状态虽无直接监督，却学会在采样步骤间传递结构化的、实例特定的计算。求解过程即使在每步对非提示变量施加最大噪声时仍成功，且找到解后输出在随机扰动下保持稳定。性能强烈依赖于训练阶段的有序退火噪声课程，但推理时不需要时间步或退火。在该系统中，扩散提供随机训练课程，递归则承载推理的迭代计算。

title: Quantum Sparse Autoencoders for Q-Matrix Estimation in Cognitive Diagnosis
summary: Q-matrices play a central role in cognitive diagnosis within educational data mining (EDM), specifying which latent skills each assessment item requires. Data-driven Q-matrix estimation remains challenging when assessments involve many correlated skills and when real response patterns depart from idealized generative assumptions. We introduce a novel quantum sparse autoencoder (QSAE) for Q-matrix estimation, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first application of quantum machine learning (QML) to cognitive diagnosis. Overall, the QSAE embeds each student's binary response vector into a quantum circuit using an encoder, compresses it into a sparse latent representation, and maps that representation to the Q-matrix. We benchmark the QSAE against a classical autoencoder (CAE) across 60 simulated datasets and 9 real-world assessment datasets. The results reveal complementary strengths. Although the CAE partially achieves higher average accuracy under several simulation conditions, the QSAE is substantially more stable across replications, exhibiting lower variance in 49 of the 60 conditions. Moreover, on real assessment data, the QSAE outperforms the CAE on 6 of the 9 datasets. These findings suggest that the principal advancement of QML in this setting is not universal accuracy improvement, but enhanced robustness and capability to explore latent-structure complexity in real datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出首个用于Q矩阵估计的量子稀疏自编码器（QSAE），在教育认知诊断中，量子方法在模拟数据上稳定性优于经典自编码器（CAE），并在多数真实评估数据上表现更好。
AI.motivation: 传统Q矩阵依赖专家手动标注，成本高且主观（如TIMSS数据中专家一致性仅约89%）；现有数据驱动方法在技能数量多、技能相关、样本偏离理想模型假设时表现下降。需要探索量子表征学习在认知诊断中的潜力。
AI.method: 构建量子稀疏自编码器（QSAE）：（1）将学生二元反应向量通过仿射平滑（r̃=0.9r+0.05）编码为八量子比特电路的旋转角；（2）参数化量子编码电路将响应压缩到K维稀疏潜变量；（3）通过L1惩罚的LASSO回归将潜变量映射为Q矩阵。基线为带共享权重矩阵的稀疏经典自编码器（CAE）。评估采用OE、OTP、OTN三种标准指标及匈牙利算法列对齐。
AI.result: 在60个DINA模拟条件下，CAE平均OE更低（0.133 vs 0.235），但QSAE稳定性显著更优——在49/60条件下标准差更低，平均约为CAE的一半。技能数量增大时QSAE误差单调下降，技能相关性增大时QSAE几乎不受影响而CAE误差翻倍。在9个真实评估数据集上，QSAE在6/9的数据集上OE更低，三个指标平均均优于CAE。
AI.conclusion: QML在认知诊断中的主要优势不在于通用精度的提升，而在于对采样变异和现实复杂潜结构的鲁棒性；QSAE为Q矩阵估计提供了一种在真实数据条件下更稳健的替代方案。

title: NashDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable results in single-agent domains, yet its extension to competitive imperfect information games (IIGs) remains underexplored. In multi-agent settings, opponent-induced non-stationarity complicates the learning process, and decentralized model learning faces severe identifiability barriers, which we argue make centralized model learning a mathematical necessity. Building on this analysis, we propose NashDreamer, a principled MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum IIGs. It introduces a centralized Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from the effect of players' strategies on their individual observations. NashDreamer is designed to use arbitrary policy gradient algorithms and inherits their convergence guarantees towards Nash equilibria under an idealized model. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark games demonstrate that NashDreamer substantially improves sample efficiency over model-free baselines early in the training. Finally, we theoretically analyze the architecture's optimization landscape, identifying the vulnerability of the Dreamer family of algorithms to posterior collapse in stochastic environments. We leave it as an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NashDreamer，一种基于模型的强化学习框架，用于两人零和不完美信息博弈（IIG）。其核心是集中式多智能体循环状态空间模型（MARSSM），通过将联合动作和观测作为输入，解耦环境动力学与对手策略，从而解决分散式学习中的可识别性障碍。实验表明，NashDreamer在多个基准博弈中显著提高了样本效率。然而，理论分析揭示了Dreamer家族算法在随机环境中的后验崩塌（posterior collapse）脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）方法在单智能体领域取得显著成功，但其在竞争性不完美信息博弈（IIG）中的扩展仍未被充分探索。多智能体场景中对手引发的非平稳性以及分散式模型学习面临的严重可识别性障碍，亟需一种原则性的MBRL框架。
AI.method: 1. 提出集中式MARSSM，将联合动作作为输入，解耦环境物理与对手策略；2. 设计分离的循环网络处理每个玩家的信息聚合；3. 与博弈论上合理的策略梯度方法（如RNaD和MMD）兼容；4. 从根状态开始展开完整轨迹进行世界模型训练；5. 在想象阶段使用集中式评论家和分散式执行者。
AI.result: 在四个基准博弈（不完美信息Goofspiel-5、Leduc扑克、幻影井字棋、Battleship）上的实证评估表明，NashDreamer在训练早期和中期显著改善了样本效率，且NashDreamer[RNaD]在30k梯度步后在Goofspiel-13上的近似NashConv（0.168）远低于无模型RNaD（0.356）。在BattleShip上NashDreamer[MMD]在30k步后达到0.817的最佳近似NashConv。但Leduc扑克出现后期性能下降，原因是模型在公共机会节点出现结构性错误。
AI.conclusion: NashDreamer通过集中式训练和分散式执行的原则性MBRL框架，有效克服了不完美信息博弈中的可识别性障碍，显著改善了早期到中期的训练收敛速度。但高机会随机性的环境仍是挑战，源于稳定性与后验崩塌之间的权衡。如何在不引入退化最小值的情况下解决这一紧张关系是未来工作的关键方向。

title: Gradient-Update Mismatch: Rethinking Conflict-Free Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) requires jointly optimizing physics residual and initial/boundary condition loss terms, which often induce conflicting gradients. Gradient surgery methods mitigate this issue by constructing directions from loss-specific gradients to reduce conflict before optimizer transformation. However, even when the constructed direction is conflict-free, this property may not be preserved after optimizer transformation. Let $a_t$ denote the direction constructed by gradient surgery, $u_t$ the optimizer proposal, and $\mathcal{C}_t$ the conflict-free cone induced by the loss-specific gradients. We show that modern optimizers can transform $a_t$ through mechanisms such as historical state, adaptive scaling, preconditioning, or decoupled weight decay, so $a_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$ does not generally imply $u_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$. We refer to this optimizer-induced discrepancy in conflict-freeness between $a_t$ and $u_t$ as Gradient-Update Mismatch (GUM). Accordingly, we propose Gradient-Update Alignment (GUA), which projects $u_t$ onto $\mathcal{C}_t$ to obtain the aligned update $p_t$ and applies $p_t$ to the parameters. When the optimizer maintains internal state, GUA further adjusts this state toward targets reconstructed from the applied update. We conduct extensive experiments and find that GUM is widespread across momentum, adaptive, and curvature-based optimizers, with conflict rates reaching up to 86.3%. Across all PINN settings, GUA achieves conflict-free applied updates and consistently improves various gradient surgery methods, reducing the relative $L_2$ error by up to 98.2% in individual settings. Data and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文指出物理信息神经网络(PINN)训练中梯度手术方法(如PCGrad、CAGrad、ConFIG等)在优化器变换前构造的无冲突方向,经优化器(动量、自适应缩放、预条件化、权重衰减等)变换后可能重新产生冲突,作者将此现象命名为梯度-更新失配(GUM)。为此提出梯度-更新对齐(GUA),将优化器提议方向投影回无冲突锥,并对优化器内部状态进行软对齐,以在更新层面保证无冲突。
AI.motivation: PINN需要联合优化物理残差损失与初始/边界条件损失,各损失梯度常存在方向冲突。现有梯度手术方法虽能在优化器变换前构造无冲突方向,但实际参数更新由优化器变换后的提议方向决定,这一步骤可能破坏无冲突性,导致训练困难。已有方法均忽略了优化器在塑造实际更新中的作用,亟需在更新层面解决冲突。
AI.method: 1)形式化定义GUM:优化器变换a_t→u_t后,a_t∈C_t不一定蕴含u_t∈C_t;给出四阶段冲突率诊断序列R_g→R_a→R_u→R_p。2)理论分析:在固定状态仿射变换下给出冲突保持的充要条件,并推广至一般非线性优化器映射(Proposition 1、Proposition 3)。3)提出GUA:将优化器提议u_t在正定度量M_t下投影到无冲突锥C_t得到对齐更新p_t;当优化器维持内部状态时,通过伪梯度重建目标状态并按系数ρ_m、ρ_v进行软对齐(Proposition 2保证局部安全性与最小改变性)。投影在m维对偶空间中通过活动集枚举精确求解。
AI.result: 在六个PINN基准(Schrödinger、Burgers、Kovasznay、Heat-MS、Beltrami、Poisson-5D)的二损失和三损失设置下,使用六种梯度手术方法(PCGrad、CAGrad、IMTL-G、A-MTL、UPGrad、ConFIG)与多种优化器(SGD、M-SGD、RMSProp、Adam、AdamW、SophiaG、AdaHessian、SOAP)进行实验。GUM在动量、自适应和曲率优化器中普遍存在,冲突率最高达86.3%(M-SGD在Burgers三损失)。GUA使所有设置的R_p=0,相对L2误差在各设置均下降,单配置最高降幅98.2%,中位降幅在二损失和三损失设置分别为42.2%和61.9%;Adam+GUA无需梯度手术即可在4/10设置超越所有独立梯度手术基线。Q3消融证实方向对齐而非范数变化主导性能提升(配对胜率93.4%–95.1%);Q4表明软状态对齐优于硬对齐;Q5显示额外峰值显存开销极小但训练时间增加;Q6在CelebA 2–40任务的实验表明GUA随任务数增加仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: GUM揭示了一个被广泛忽视的现象:梯度手术构造的无冲突方向经优化器变换后可能失去无冲突性。GUA通过在更新层面进行方向投影和状态软对齐,有效恢复无冲突性,并在各种PINN基准、梯度手术方法和优化器上一致提升性能。该工作将冲突处理从优化器变换前的方向层面扩展到优化器提议层面,为多损失优化提供了新视角。局限性在于当前基于局部一阶梯度几何,未显式考虑曲率、有限步长和长时域效应,且硬无冲突准则可能排除有潜在益处的方向。

title: The Structure of Quantization Damage in LLMs: Why the Next Bit Should Be Spent Globally
comment: Preprint. Under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 11 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the cost of serving large language models (LLMs), but its accuracy cost is uneven and is often tuned per model. We study where quantization damage occurs and how to allocate a small additional precision budget. Using causal mixed-precision intervention as ground truth (raise each layer to 8-bit in turn and measure the accuracy it recovers) across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families, we test 3 intuitive hypotheses: that quantization damage lives in task circuits, where the model computes, or in weight statistics. None of them predicts which layers benefit from restored precision. Recovery is instead diffuse: for 8 of 9 models, recovering 75% of the gap takes roughly half the layers; the lone exception, Qwen3-8B, is sharply concentrated. At a matched precision budget, spending it globally on finer quantization granularity beats locally repairing the most recoverable layers for all 8 group-128-compatible models (all but OpenLLaMA, whose width rules out group-128), by 21-52 points, including the concentrated Qwen3-8B. We report 2 secondary findings: the residual is budget-limited (8-bit is near-lossless in our evaluation across RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ), and the location of peak recovery correlates with architecture within a family, though not across families. Within this budget setting, global granularity is a better default than selectively protecting critical layers. More broadly, cheap signals that correlate with quantization damage do not necessarily identify where restoring precision improves accuracy; this must be tested with causal intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型后训练量化中精度损失的定位与预算分配问题。通过在9个开源模型上进行因果混合精度干预实验，发现3种基于直观假设的"廉价定位器"（任务电路漂移、因果激活定位、权重统计）均无法可靠预测哪些层恢复精度能带来准确率提升。量化损伤在多数模型中呈弥散分布，回收75%的精度损失约需恢复一半的层（Qwen3-8B例外，呈集中分布）。在等精度预算下（+0.146有效比特/权重），全局使用更细的量化粒度（group-128）比局部修复最具恢复潜力的层效果更好，所有8个兼容模型均如此，优势达21-52个点。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化(PTQ)虽广泛用于降低LLM推理成本，但其精度代价不均匀且常需逐模型调优。自然的想法是定位损伤位置以选择性保护，但实践中缺乏对"损伤在哪里"以及"有限精度预算应如何分配"的系统回答。三种主流直觉——损伤位于任务电路、计算发生处或权重本身——各有廉价定位器，但从未被因果验证。本文旨在通过因果混合精度干预检验这些假设并给出精度分配规则。
AI.method: 使用因果混合精度干预作为基准真值：依次将每一层单独升至8-bit（其余保持4-bit），测量恢复的准确率（精度的边际价值）。在9个开源权重模型（LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/8B、Mistral-7B、OpenLLaMA-3B）跨4个架构族上，对比3种假设对应的廉价定位器：H1电路漂移（任务头偏离剖面与跨任务均值的余弦距离）、H2因果激活补丁定位的计算位点、H3权重统计（标准差与重构误差）。评估使用CORE基准在22个任务×200样本上进行。预算实验对比"全局粒度提升（per-row→group-128 RTN）"与"局部恢复最具修复潜力层至8-bit"在匹配有效比特/权重下的表现。
