AI.result: 三种廉价定位器均无法可靠预测精度边际价值。H1电路漂移与损伤的原始相关r=+0.377，但联合控制模型和任务类别后降至+0.05（n.s.，等价于零）；H2边界层对仅在6/9模型中回收≤13%缺口；H3权重标准差仅在LLaMA族内有效。损伤总体弥散：回收50/75/90%缺口平均需20/49/73%的层，单层最大仅占~44%损伤。Qwen3-8B例外：其top-3可回收层恢复几乎全部缺口。在+0.146有效比特/权重预算下，全局group-128粒度在所有8个group-128兼容模型上优于oracle层修复21-52个点，包括最集中的Qwen3-8B（76.6% vs 54.9%）。粒度贡献（+0.095 CORE）远大于算法（GPTQ +0.020，AWQ +0.017）。8-bit在所有RTN/GPTQ/AWQ方法下接近无损。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的预算范围内，全局精度粒度是比选择性保护关键层更好的默认方案；廉价信号与量化损伤相关但未必能识别恢复精度改善准确率的位置——后者必须用因果干预验证。峰值回收位置在同一架构族内相关（LLaMA-3.x在L1峰值，留一法3/3预测成立），但跨族不可迁移。损伤呈弥散分布，残差由预算限制（8-bit近无损）。局限：实验限于≤8B参数；定位分析在最大损伤探针（per-row RTN）下进行；顶部k曲线为oracle排序而非可部署选择器；位预算计算为一阶权重级。

title: Dense Weak Hiding: Closing Complexity Gaps in Nonconvex and PL Finite-Sum Optimization under Individual Smoothness
summary: Under individual smoothness, the optimal incremental first-order oracle (IFO) complexity of nonconvex finite-sum optimization has remained open. Known algorithms use $O(n+\sqrt{n}\,\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$ calls, while prior lower bounds miss a factor of $\sqrt{n}$. We prove the matching lower bound for randomized IFO algorithms whose component indices and query points may depend on the complete preceding transcript and private randomness. This determines the minimax IFO complexity up to universal constants under both individual and mean-squared smoothness. Under the global Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition, the standard PAGE guarantee is not tight when $\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}<\sqrt{n}$. Restarted PAGE attains $O(n+n\log(\Delta/\varepsilon)/(1+\log(\sqrt{n}/\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}})))$ for $1\leq\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\leq\sqrt{n}$, and $O(n+\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\sqrt{n}\log(\Delta/\varepsilon))$ for $\kappa_{\mathrm{ms}}\geq\sqrt{n}$. We prove matching lower bounds under individual smoothness for every $\kappa_{\max}\geq 3$; the same hard instances also give the mean-squared lower bounds. In the small-$\kappa_{\max}$ range, their average objective is globally strongly convex. Our lower bounds use dense weak hiding. A fixed sign table spreads each hidden direction across the components. Each queried row carries little information, while the exact row average preserves the full signal after rescaling. A bounded radial map handles arbitrary query points, and a smooth gate makes unopened links invisible to both function values and gradients. Balancing the rows needed to reveal one stage with the number of stages allowed by individual smoothness yields the missing $\sqrt{n}$ factor.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非凸有限和优化在个体光滑性（individual smoothness）下的最优增量一阶预言机（IFO）复杂度以及全局Polyak-Lojasiewicz（PL）条件下的复杂度，给出了精确的匹配下界，并提出了"密集弱隐藏"（dense weak hiding）构造方法。在非凸情形下，证明了匹配上界 $O(n+\sqrt{n}\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$ 的 $\Omega(n+\sqrt{n}\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$ 下界；在PL条件下，证明了两段条件数下的紧复杂度界，并设计了Restarted PAGE算法达到匹配上界。
AI.motivation: 在个体光滑性假设下，已知非凸有限和优化的IFO复杂度上界为 $O(n+\sqrt{n}\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$，但现有下界缺失了 $\sqrt{n}$ 因子。在全局PL条件下，标准PAGE保证在 $\kappa_{\rm ms}<\sqrt{n}$ 时不紧，且缺乏匹配的小条件数下界。本文旨在闭合这些复杂度间隙。
AI.method: 核心技术为"密集弱隐藏"（dense weak hiding），包含三个组件：(1) 固定符号编码表，将隐藏方向分散到各分量中，但精确保持行平均的完整信号；(2) 有界径向映射，将任意查询点转化为单位球内的对齐向量；(3) 平滑阈值门函数，满足 $G=G'=0$ 在阈值以下，使得未激活链接对函数值和梯度均不可见。通过平衡揭示一个阶段所需的行数与个体光滑性所允许的阶段数，得到 $\sqrt{n}$ 因子的来源。非凸情形使用恒定尺度的径向链；PL情形分别使用（i）大 $\kappa_{\max}$ 的几何加权链，（ii）小 $\kappa_{\max}$ 的双尺度链（门尺度与贡献尺度分离）。上界方面，提出Restarted PAGE算法。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 非凸stationarity的紧IFO复杂度为 $\Theta(n+\sqrt{n}\Delta L_{\max}/\varepsilon^2)$（Theorem 3.1和Corollary 3.2）；(2) 全局PL条件下，对所有 $\kappa_{\max}\geq 3$，复杂度在两段分别为 $\Theta(n+n\log(\Delta/\varepsilon)/[1+\log(\sqrt{n}/\kappa_{\max})])$ 和 $\Theta(n+\kappa_{\max}\sqrt{n}\log(\Delta/\varepsilon))$（Theorem 3.3）；(3) 小 $\kappa_{\max}$ 构造的平均目标函数是全局强凸的；(4) Restarted PAGE在均值平方光滑性下达到匹配上界。硬实例同时满足个体光滑和均值平方光滑。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了非凸优化和全局PL条件下有限和在个体光滑性下的紧复杂度下界，闭合了 $\sqrt{n}$ 因子间隙。密集弱隐藏是一种新的下界构造技术，通过固定编码表、有界径向映射和平滑门的组合克服了现有构造的局限性。Restarted PAGE算法通过自适应选择epoch长度达到匹配上界。开放方向包括固定环境维度下界、含噪有限和预言机模型，以及 $\kappa<3$ 范围的下界。

title: Synthetic Worlds for Temporal Evaluation and Knowledge Updating in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on static pretraining corpora, causing their knowledge to become outdated over time. Existing approaches for evaluating knowledge edits either suffer from rapid contamination or rely on counterfactual edits that conflict with rigid existing knowledge. In this work, we propose a synthetic, simulation-driven framework for studying knowledge insertion in LLMs. We introduce {\sc ParallelEvents}, a benchmark of fictional yet realistic future worlds that generates coherent event trajectories for controlled evaluation, avoiding contamination while preserving consistency. Building on this dataset, we develop {\sc Synapse}, a training framework that uses model-generated data to update model parameters via mid-training and instruction tuning. This synthetic pipeline enables scalable knowledge integration without costly human-curated data. Empirically, {\sc Synapse} outperforms existing methods by 14.23\%, demonstrating that simulation-based synthetic training leads to robust and coherent knowledge insertions.

AI.tldr: 提出ParallelEvents基准和Synapse框架，通过合成虚构未来世界数据实现LLM时间知识更新的无污染评估与参数级注入。
AI.motivation: LLM基于静态预训练语料，面临知识过时问题；现有评估方法受数据污染或反事实编辑与现有知识冲突的困扰，且缺乏对复杂多事件、因果推理链的更新能力评估。
AI.method: 构建ParallelEvents基准（41个虚构事件的知识图谱，含24,530实体和15,885关系，涵盖体育、灾害等），保证局部与全局一致性；设计Synapse训练框架，通过教师模型生成合成长文本用于中间训练，再用DPO偏好学习（含编辑集和未知集）结合通用偏好数据（TULU-3）实现知识注入与行为对齐。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1、OLMo-3、Gemma-3上，Synapse以10个检索事实增强后整体准确率超越最佳ICL基线14.23%以上，因果推理准确率提升尤为显著（53.73%绝对增益）；在1,536事实大规模插入下性能退化远小于基线；在MQuAKE-Remastered反事实编辑任务上达到85.02%训练/75.00%测试准确率；结合TULU-3可恢复甚至提升通用知识与指令跟随能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于模拟的合成世界是评估与更新LLM时间知识的有效路径，ParallelEvents提供抗污染的细粒度评测环境，Synapse以可扩展的合成训练实现鲁棒且连贯的知识插入，对持续学习与自适应系统具有重要价值。

title: Are Near-Tied LLM Rankings Robust to Family-DIF-Guided Benchmark Recomposition?
comment: Code and data artifacts will be released
summary: Small leaderboard gaps are often interpreted as evidence that one language model is better than another, but their sign may depend on which benchmark items are included. We test this using item-level responses from five benchmarks and a family-label-free spectral approximation to multidimensional item-response theory (MIRT). In owner-disjoint folds, one owner half identifies items with low residual differential item functioning across model families (low-DIF); the resulting frozen, source- and easiness-balanced weights score models in the other half, while equally short matched-random subtests control for generic subtest variation. Full-benchmark and low-DIF rankings remain strongly correlated ($\tau_b=.900$--$.948$). Yet in four of five benchmarks, 30.9--47.1\% of cross-family pairs initially within one percentage point reverse order, exceeding their matched-random medians by 16.9--28.6 percentage points (all $p=.001$). The fifth benchmark shows no reliable excess ($-0.9$ points, $p=.689$). The pattern survives all pre-specified population perturbations, and residual item--family signatures replicate across owner halves; however, no family shows a consistent advantage across benchmarks. Thus, globally stable rankings can still leave individual near-tie orderings sensitive to benchmark composition, and sub-one-point leaderboard gaps should be accompanied by evidence that the implied ordering is composition-robust.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了大型语言模型排行榜中差距小于一个百分点的"近并列"排名是否对基准题目构成稳健。作者使用五个基准的逐题回答数据，通过无家族标签的谱近似多维项目反应理论(MIRT)估计残差家族差异项目功能(family-DIF)，在所有者不相交的双折交叉拟合中，用一半所有者识别低DIF锚题并冻结权重给另一半打分。结果表明：尽管全基准与低DIF排名的Kendall τ_b高达.900–.948（全局稳定），但在五个基准中的四个，初始差距≤1个百分点的跨家族对中有30.9–47.1%发生顺序反转，超出蓝图匹配随机子测16.9–28.6个百分点（p=.001）；WinoGrande无显著差异。残差项目-家族签名可在所有者之间复现，但无任何家族在所有基准中保持一致优势。双盲语义审计未发现可确认的内容轴富集。
AI.motivation: 公开排行榜将数千道题目压缩为单一分数，常以不足一个百分点区分模型。研究者关心：这种细微差距所暗示的排序是否真的对基准题目组成稳健？题目加权、提示组合、评估协议的变化已被证实可改变排名，因此需要对"近并列"排序的组成稳健性进行严格审计。
AI.method: 1. 数据：MMLU-Pro、BBH、MMLU、HellaSwag、WinoGrande五个基准的逐题二元回答矩阵（来自RouterEval）。2. 模型家族通过唯一模型名匹配分为Qwen、Llama、Gemma、Mistral/Mixtral、Phi；每位上传者限5个检查点，按所有者不相交两折交叉拟合。3. 使用无家族标签的谱近似MIRT（响应矩阵的随机化SVD）估计多维能力方向η^(K)，再拟合项目简易度b_i和残差家族效应δ_{if}（L2正则化λ=1，约束∑_f δ_{if}=0）。4. 锚题构建：在每个源-简易度单元内保留D_i最小的α=50%项目作为低DIF锚，三轮迭代纯化，权重w_i=n_c/k_c保持单元总质量。5. 排名估计量：不同所有者不同家族、初始差距≤1pp的对(m,n)，若(A_m−A_n)(Ã_m−Ã_n)<0则为严格反转；用R=1000个蓝图匹配随机子测作为对照，计算过剩反转率Δ_pp和单侧随机化p值。6. 用2,000次源块自助法评估组成敏感性；通过500次单元内置换检验项目签名跨半复现；用两位盲法LLM标注者做内容审计。
AI.result: 主要结果（50%低DIF锚，1pp阈值）：MMLU-Pro反转率47.1%（随机对照18.5%，Δ=+28.6pp，p=.001，n=308对）；BBH 42.1% vs 25.2%（+16.9pp，p=.001，n=2,226）；MMLU 40.7% vs 16.3%（+24.4pp，p=.001，n=3,235）；HellaSwag 30.9% vs 11.4%（+19.5pp，p=.001，n=4,533）；WinoGrande 33.8% vs 34.7%（−0.9pp，p=.689，n=5,574）。全基准与低DIF排名Kendall τ_b=.900–.948。所有9个人口扰动（owner cap=1/3、分数盲检查点选择、保守谱系过滤、五种留一家族）中四个阳性基准全部保持p≤.05。跨所有者复现：五个基准的家族Spearman相关ρ=.308–.589，top-20%重叠31.5–38.5%（独立基线20%），所有15个置换p=.002（Bonferroni后p=.030）。双盲内容审计：无任何预设二元内容轴通过双重标注者确认标准（最大效应为标注者A的空间/时间−9.6pp，q=.106，标注者B仅−0.8pp）。无家族在所有基准中保持一致方向优势。
AI.conclusion: 虽然全局排名高度稳定（τ_b≥.900），但不足一个百分点的"近并列"跨家族顺序对基准题目组成高度敏感：四个基准中30.9–47.1%的此类对在低DIF锚评分下发生反转，且过剩反转率超出蓝图匹配随机子测16.9–28.6个百分点。该效应在所有预指定人口扰动下保持稳健，残差项目-家族签名可跨所有者半复现，但语义审计未发现可解释的内容差异，且无家族在所有基准中具内在优势。因此，排行榜上小于一点的差距不应被解读为模型优越性的自证证据，而应配套提供组成稳健性检验。

title: Prediction-Assisted Pricing and Admission for LLM APIs with Stochastic Token Consumption
summary: An LLM application often sells or internally allocates several service products: a small or premium model, a short or long token cap, and possibly multiple posted prices. The operational decision is not merely which model answers a prompt. A price changes purchase probability, a token cap changes both user value and the tail of resource consumption, and accepted requests compete for shared compute and premium-model capacity. Demand and output length are initially uncertain, while an offline model may provide useful but imperfect predictions. We formulate sequential pricing and admission with stochastic resource consumption. Each arriving request belongs to an observable segment. The platform chooses a product--price pair or makes no offer; purchase, revenue, and resource use are then random. An offline predictor supplies a uniform, validated error radius for every segment--product cell. We propose Prediction-Clipped UCB (PCUCB), which intersects the offline prediction interval with an online confidence interval, evaluates products using resource shadow prices, and reserves a sample-path envelope before commitment. The prior gives a fast start when accurate, while online learning protects the platform when predictions are coarse. The analysis is modular. On a simultaneous confidence event, regret against a buffered fluid benchmark is bounded by a pacing term plus the cumulative diameter of the intersected intervals. For $J$ segment-product cells and prediction radius $\varepsilon$, this yields \[ \widetilde O\left( \sqrt{T}+(1+\bar\Lambda) \min\{T\varepsilon,\sqrt{JT}\} \right), \] where $\bar\Lambda$ bounds operational shadow prices. Thus the algorithm smoothly interpolates between an almost full-information regime and learning from scratch. Hard feasibility holds on every sample path through reservation envelopes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM API服务中的联合定价、产品选择与准入控制问题，提出了一种结合离线预测与在线学习的PC-UCB算法，在理论保证与合成实验两方面均取得良好表现。
AI.motivation: LLM服务平台通常提供多档产品（不同模型层、token上限与价格），需在购买概率未知、token消耗随机的条件下进行动态定价与资源分配；同时平台常拥有带验证误差范围的离线预测器，需要一种既利用先验又能在线纠错的控制器。
AI.method: 1) 将问题建模为顺序定价-准入问题，每请求属于可观测片段，平台选择"产品-价格"对或不出价；2) 提出Prediction-Clipped UCB (PC-UCB)：将离线预测区间与在线置信区间求交集，使用资源影子价格评估产品，并在承诺前预留资源包络；3) 影子价格采用在线投影梯度更新，资源消耗使用上置信界以保证保守性；4) 理论分析在同时置信事件上分解遗憾界。
AI.result: 主要遗憾界为Õ(√T + (1+Λ̄)min{Tε, √(JT)})，随预测半径ε在"近乎全信息"与"从零学习"之间平滑插值；合成实验（ε=0.18）下PC-UCB达到oracle收入的94.8%，优于纯预测90.8%与纯在线UCB 82.5%，近视策略仅41.2%；且通过预留包络实现路径级硬可行性；论文还给出了真实LLM API日志的识别与测量协议。
AI.conclusion: PC-UCB框架将LLM服务视为联合定价与资源分配系统，能在预测准确时快速启动、在预测粗糙时通过在线学习保护收益，且不论预测质量如何都能保证容量硬约束；建议未来工作通过随机化面板、同步预测区间校准与工作负载层面评估来验证该框架。

title: Dense Process Supervision for Search Agents via Fact Utility Estimation
comment: Accepted in the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents typically relies on outcome rewards. However, it often fails to achieve effective credit assignment, due to the unclear value of intermediate steps. It is hard to separate their contributions from the final result. In this paper, we propose a dense process supervision method based on fact utility estimation, which models the reasoning process as the accumulation of discrete evidence facts. We first extract structured facts from raw observations and organize them into an explicit fact store. To support credit assignment, we then cluster semantically equivalent facts and infer the posterior utility of each fact cluster using Bayesian estimation over group rollouts. Finally, we convert the estimated fact utilities into dense step-level rewards to guide RL training. Experiments on seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines. Ablation studies validate clear relative improvements on multi-hop QA compared to outcome reward-only training.

AI.tldr: 提出FactAgent框架，通过事实存储+贝叶斯事实效用估计，为搜索智能体提供密集过程级奖励，解决RL中稀疏结果奖励的信用分配难题。
AI.motivation: 基于结果奖励的RL训练存在稀疏性和信用分配困难问题：正确的最终答案不能保证每一步检索都必要，失败的最终答案也不能否定所有中间步骤，导致难以识别真正有价值的中间行为。
AI.method: 1. FactAgent框架——维护显式结构化事实存储替代原始交互历史，引入Search/Assert/Answer三种动作；2. 贝叶斯事实效用估计——对语义等价事实聚类后，通过Beta先验+组级rollout统计估计后验效用；3. 基于势能的奖励塑形(PBRS)将聚类效用转化为密集步骤级奖励，并通过奖励重分配将效用信号回传到对应的搜索动作。
AI.result: 在7个QA基准上以Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct为骨干，FactAgent 7B平均EM达51.2，超过最强基线+3.2 EM；多跳QA提升尤为显著。消融证实密集过程监督是关键组件（去除后多跳性能从45.8降至31.4），事实聚类、奖励重分配均贡献明显。训练成本接近标准GRPO，推理上下文长度比ReAct减少近4倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推理过程建模为离散事实的累积，并基于贝叶斯估计从稀疏结果信号中提取密集过程奖励，FactAgent有效解决了搜索智能体的信用分配问题，在多跳推理任务上表现突出，同时保持计算高效和上下文紧凑，为未来在更丰富事实表示和连续效用信号上的扩展奠定了基础。

title: Web Price Extraction: State of the Art and an Adaptive Browserless Implementation
summary: Price extraction from websites is a key task for market monitoring, price comparison, and business analytics in e-commerce. Existing approaches can be broadly divided into four groups, and understanding their trade-offs in accuracy and scalability is essential for selecting suitable extraction strategies. Classical methods rely on manually written wrappers and rule induction from labeled pages, offering high accuracy but adapting poorly to structural changes and requiring considerable maintenance effort. Browser-based methods, using tools such as Selenium and Puppeteer, handle dynamic JavaScript content but consume large computational resources and scale poorly. Browserless approaches retrieve HTML directly via HTTP requests, offering significant gains in speed and cost, but rely on rules calibrated for specific sites. Methods based on machine learning and large language models offer adaptability but require training data and substantial computation. Our main contribution is an adaptive browserless price extraction system that improves robustness to structural differences between websites. We implemented a baseline architecture combining HTML page fragmentation with syntactic, semantic, and frequency rules, and extended it in two ways: a Bayesian approach that dynamically updates rule weights, and a genetic algorithm that optimizes the system's global parameters. This hybrid scheme increased precision from 77.2% to 87.3% and reduced average per-page processing time by approximately 14% relative to the baseline, confirming it as a competitive alternative to manually tuned browserless solutions and to more resource-intensive browser- or LLM-based methods, offering high extraction accuracy at low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于浏览器无关（browserless）的网页价格提取系统，结合贝叶斯规则权重更新和遗传算法优化全局参数，以提高对异构电商网站结构差异的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 价格提取是电商竞争监控与市场分析的核心任务。现有四类方法（经典规则、浏览器模拟、浏览器无关、AI/ML）各有局限：经典方法精度高但脆弱，浏览器方法资源消耗大，AI/ML方法计算成本高。亟需一种兼具高精度与低计算开销、且能适应异构网站结构的轻量级方案。
AI.method:
1. 构建浏览器无关基线系统：通过HTTP请求直接获取HTML，使用两级片段提取（包含价格线索的level-1片段及其父级level-2片段），应用三类规则——句法规则（基于HTML标签结构）、语义规则（基于关键词如"shipping"、"save"等）、频率规则（惩罚重复出现的数值）。
2. 贝叶斯规则权重更新：为每条规则分配独立的置信度系数，基于Beta后验分布（带Laplace平滑）根据训练集中正确丢弃与错误丢弃的计数动态调整规则权重。
3. 遗传算法优化全局参数：对两个全局参数（频率规则激活的最小片段数p_limit_freq∈[2,10]与片段丢弃阈值discard_threshold∈[0.3,1.5]）进行优化，种群规模10，迭代8代，锦标赛选择，精英保留2个。
4. 评估指标：精度（Precision）、覆盖率（Coverage）、平均处理时间，并测试顺序与并行执行模式下的资源消耗。
AI.result:
在约200条记录的测试集上，三种配置结果如下：
- 基线系统：精度77.2%，覆盖率98.75%，平均处理时间0.620秒
- 贝叶斯优化：精度83.5%（+8.2%），覆盖率98.75%，平均处理时间0.546秒
- 贝叶斯+遗传算法：精度87.3%（+13.1%相对基线），覆盖率98.75%，平均处理时间0.533秒（-14%相对基线）
遗传算法找到的最优参数：p_limit_freq=9（默认3），discard_threshold=0.404（默认0.500）。负载测试显示处理时间随URL数量线性增长，峰值内存稳定在430-470MB，与执行模式几乎无关。
AI.conclusion: 该混合方案是手工调优浏览器无关方案的可行替代品，在保持低计算成本（0.533秒/页）的同时提供了具有竞争力的精度（87.3%），优于纯基线和纯贝叶斯配置。未来工作包括：扩大测试集至2000条记录、引入按产品类别的评估与权重分离、实现贝叶斯权重的在线更新，以及与Scrapy、RoadRunner、LLM解析器等进行对比。

title: Exploring Sparse Autoencoders in Text-Based Causal Confounding Adjustment
comment: Long paper accepted at EMNLP 2026 main conference, 25 pages, 16 figures
summary: In many settings, studying causal questions based on text data requires adjusting for confounding information within texts. Yet there is a tradeoff in constructing text representations for adjustment: they must be sufficiently large and/or dense to preserve the confounding variables necessary for unbiased effect estimation, but sufficiently small and/or sparse to satisfy finite-sample overlap and yield low-variance estimates. To address this tradeoff, we turn to sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and propose a novel causal adjustment pipeline that iteratively selects a minimal set of SAE features via conditional independence tests. We find that SAE representations achieve better adjustments (lower bias and and higher coverage) than alternative representations in standard semi-synthetic evaluations with binary confounders, and their interpretability offers opportunities for falsification. We also introduce a more realistic semi-synthetic evaluation that uses multi-label data as the unobserved confounders and find off-the-shelf adjustment methods require increased investigation for these more complex settings. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行文本因果混淆调整的新颖流水线，通过条件独立性测试迭代选择最小化的SAE特征子集，以平衡表征的充分性与稀疏性之间的权衡，并在标准二元/多类及新提出的多标签半合成评估中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在基于观察性文本数据的因果推断中，文本常作为混淆变量需要进行调整。然而文本表征存在两难权衡：表征需足够大/密集以保留无偏估计所需的混淆信息，但又需足够小/稀疏以满足有限样本下的重叠性并降低估计方差。现有方法（如主题模型+匹配、双重机器学习）难以同时兼顾充分性、稀疏性与可解释性，因此需要一种新的表征方法。
AI.method: 作者提出四步流水线：(1) 使用预训练文本嵌入（如OpenAI text-embedding-3-small）训练top-K稀疏自编码器得到SAE表征；(2) 通过Lasso逻辑回归迭代选择与处理变量相关的SAE特征；(3) 利用似然比检验（卡方检验）在测试集上验证所选子集是否满足条件独立性T⊥X\X⋆|X⋆，若不满足则返回扩大子集；(4) 将最终子集特征代入下游因果估计器（粗略精确匹配CEM或双重机器学习DoubleML），估计ATT。此外提供两种可解释性诊断：(a) 若几乎所有SAE维度都被选中则提示M太小；(b) 通过LLM为被激活神经元打标签以人工核验混淆因素的面效度。实验采用半合成数据生成过程（DGP），在20NG数据集上构建二元/多类混淆，在EURLEX数据集上首次构建多标签混淆评估。
AI.result: 在20NG的二元（computer、relion）和多类（computer vs relion vs other）设置下，SAE-based方法（CEM和DoubleML）相比TIRM（STM）和预训练嵌入+DoubleML均取得最低偏差（最低0.0055）、最低RMSE和最高覆盖率（最高98%）；selection步骤在匹配中显著提高有效样本量（ESS）并改善重叠性（如religion设置下处理保留率从0.41%升至82.29%），同时保持对真实混淆变量U的|SMD|较低。在EURLEX多标签设置下，SAE+CEM的偏差（0.0306）优于DoubleML（0.1324），但所有DoubleML方法存在结果变量估计不收敛、覆盖率为零的"缺乏共同支持"问题，揭示了现成调整方法在更复杂场景下的不足。SAE神经元经LLM标注后显示出与真实混淆高度相关（如"包含《圣经》经文引用"对应religion，"X窗口系统工具"对应computer等），证实了可解释性诊断的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SAE表征能在保持充分性的同时实现稀疏性，其原子化与可解释特征有助于因果调整及人机协同验证。在标准半合成设置中SAE优于TIRM和嵌入基线，并在多标签设置中揭示了现成调整方法的局限。本文贡献包括：(1) 结合SAE与条件独立性检验的因果调整流水线及其可解释诊断；(2) 首个基于多标签oracle混淆的半合成因果评估设置，推动更接近真实场景的文本因果推断研究。未来需探索联合学习表征与估计器、调整多标签设置性能及超参数系统调优。

title: Where the Verifier Fails: A Category-Level Audit of Reward Signals in RLVR
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code, transform suite, contract matrix, and per-sample verdict records at this https URL
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and standard benchmark evaluation both rely on an automatic verifier that turns a free text answer into a binary reward. Prior work reports that one evaluation harness accepts only about 94% of its own ground truth answers, blaming LaTeX parsing. That is an aggregate: it does not say which answer forms consume the error budget. We supply the decomposition. We apply metamorphic testing to the verifier rather than the model, generating certified equivalent answer variants, that is, rewrites that preserve mathematical meaning by construction, so that any rejection is a provable false negative needing no human adjudication. We then measure rejection per answer category across four widely used verifiers over 307,420 verdicts. We find three things. (1) Self validation ranges from 53.8% to 95.2% on identical inputs, a spread of 41.3 points. The published figure describes one implementation, not the task; two configurations of the same library disagree on 49.9% of pairs. (2) The residual is not spread across parsing categories but concentrated in whitespace and punctuation, which account for 93.0% of in contract failures for the default LaTeX configuration. A trailing period or newline dominates the budget. (3) Separating rejection from execution failure shows that verifiers with similar aggregate error fail for opposite reasons, and that a reference numeric cascade accepts off by one wrong answers as a step function of magnitude, from 0% below 10^4 to 100% at or above, because its relative tolerance is scale invariant.

AI.tldr: 本文对RLVR及基准评测中广泛使用的四种自动验证器进行分类级别的审计，通过元变形测试在307,420次裁决中发现：自验证率差异高达41.3个百分点、错误预算主要由空白与标点（占93.0%）主导、且存在依赖答案量级的确定性假阳性阈值机制。
AI.motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）依赖自动验证器将自由文本答案转化为二元奖励，但验证器的可靠性常被假设而鲜少被审视。已有文献仅报告聚合准确率（约94%），既未揭示误差具体源自哪类答案形式，也未区分拒绝与执行失败，且可能掩盖系统性的、可被利用的错误模式。本文旨在弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 将通常用于测试模型的元变形测试方法转向测试验证器：基于"通过构造保持数学等价"的变换生成认证等价答案变体，任何拒绝即为可证明的假阴性，无需人工仲裁；针对语义改变的变换则检测假阳性。在四个广泛使用的验证器（mv-latex、mv-expr、strip-string、sympy-cascade）上应用43种变换、覆盖14个层级，共产生307,420次裁决。引入"契约矩阵"区分实现缺陷与规约模糊性，并显式分离"拒绝"与"执行失败"以计算覆盖率。所有结果均附Wilson置信区间。
AI.result: 1. 自验证率在53.8%–95.2%之间，同一库的两种配置在49.9%的认证等价对上结果不一致；2. 错误并非分散于各类语法层，而是集中在空白与标点——在mv-latex默认LaTeX配置中占合约内失败的93.0%（mv-expr为74.1%），尾部句点或换行主导错误预算；3. 聚合错误相近的验证器失败原因截然相反（如sympy-cascade仅在87.3%输入上返回裁决但所判皆对，strip-string则对全部输入裁决但通过拒绝出错）；4. sympy-cascade的相对容差10⁻⁴具有尺度不变性，导致其对off-by-one对抗性答案的接受率在≥10⁴时阶跃至100%，而<10⁴时为0%，构成确定性的、依赖量级的假阳性机制。
AI.conclusion: 验证器可靠性是可测量的属性，在广泛使用的实现间差异达41点；其错误由空白处理主导而非数学解析；至少存在一种由答案量级触发的确定性假阳性机制。聚合残差相似的实现失败原因可能完全相反。建议报告验证器身份、版本、抽取配置与运行时，并将覆盖率作为一等指标与准确率分开报告。

title: Investigating Linear Probe Robustness to Linguistic Register, Medical Specialty, and Corpus Shifts in Medical QA
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 9 pages, 4 figures (main text); 28 pages total, including appendix. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Linear classifiers trained on hidden states of a large language model (LLM), linear probes, can flag factual errors from a single forward pass. Geometrically, that implies that true and false statements separate along a stable direction in hidden state space, i.e., the truth direction. Prior work disagrees on whether this generalises across input shifts, but the disagreement is hard to interpret because cross-dataset probe transfer experiments confound several kinds of input change at once. We isolate three such variables in medical question-answering (QA): writing style (register), domain (medical specialty), and corpus (dataset). We build a benchmark using 500 MedQA entries, each rewritten into four styles (textbook, patient, clinical note, colloquial), annotated with clinical specialty, and grouped with two other exam corpora, MedMCQA and MMLU-medical, for cross-dataset evaluation. Probing four open-weight LLMs (2--8B), we find that the truth direction is largely robust to writing style (mean $\Delta_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC on held-out facts) and to medical specialty ($\Delta_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$), but degrades unevenly across corpora: by $0.12$ AUROC on MMLU-medical and by $0.21$ on MedMCQA, roughly twice the register gap. The register result replicates with a second generator and carries over to human-written patient questions. The truth direction is therefore largely stable within the medical domain but breaks under some corpus shifts, and question format does not explain the break, which suggests that the signal a linear probe recovers is partly bound to dataset structure rather than to medical knowledge alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医疗QA中线性探针（linear probe）在三类输入偏移（语言语域register、医学专科specialty、语料库corpus）下的鲁棒性进行了系统隔离研究。基于MedQA构建了500条目×4种语域×2极性的4000变体基准，探测了4个2-8B开源LLM，发现"真值方向"（truth direction）对写作风格和医学子领域基本稳健，但对部分语料库迁移会显著退化。
AI.motivation: 医疗LLM的事实性错误检测是临床NLP安全的核心问题。现有研究表明线性探针能通过单次前向传播标记事实错误，但先前跨数据集探针迁移实验同时混淆了多种输入变化因素，无法解释分歧。本研究旨在隔离三类变量（语域、专科、语料库），以判断"真值方向"是LLM表示空间的稳定几何属性还是对训练分布的脆弱伪影。
AI.method: （1）构建受控重写基准：500条MedQA条目由Claude Sonnet 4.5改写为四种语域（教科书textbook、患者patient、临床记录note、口语colloquial），每条保留正确/错误双极性，共4000变体；（2）采用S-MedQA的15个临床专科标注隔离专科偏移；（3）通过MedMCQA和MMLU-medical评估跨语料库迁移；（4）采用L2正则化逻辑回归探针，在每个偶数层的最后一个问题token位置训练，评估AUROC及转移差值Δ；（5）额外对比差均值探针（diff-means）、MLP探针、输出基线（P(True)、自一致性、熵）及校准分析。模型包括Gemma-2-2B-it、Gemma-3-4B-it、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3-8B-Instruct。
AI.result: 在held-out事实上的主要发现：（1）语域鲁棒：教科书训练的探针迁移到其他三种语域时，AUROC平均仅下降约0.10（Δ_register≈0.095），临床记录语域最难迁移；（2）专科稳健：跨7训练专科→8保留专科的迁移仅下降约0.03 AUROC（Δ_specialty≈0.031）；（3）语料库不稳定：MedQA→MedMCQA迁移下降0.21 AUROC（Δ_dataset），约为语域差距的两倍；MedQA→MMLU-medical下降0.12；该差距非源于问题格式（将MedMCQA改写为MedQA风格后AUROC仍为0.559 vs 原生0.561），亦非语域或主题的简单叠加；（4）线性主导：差均值探针匹配逻辑回归探针，MLP仅+0.037增益；（5）优于输出基线：比自一致性和熵高6-31 AUROC点，与较大LLM的P(True)基线相当；（6）罕见病探针性能不低于常见病；（7）原始探针严重失校准（ECE≈0.34），Platt缩放可减半至0.135但仍超过0.05阈值；（8）结果在Gemini重写器上复现（Δ_register=0.079）。
AI.conclusion: 医疗LLM中的线性真值方向在语域和医学专科层面基本稳健，但在跨语料库迁移时出现不可忽略的退化（尤其在MedMCQA上），且该退化无法由问题格式、主题或语域的叠加效应解释，表明探针恢复的信号部分绑定于语料库结构而非纯医学知识。这统一了探针文献中的分歧：支持几何真值假说的证据在同分布内成立，而跨数据集脆弱性确实存在。临床部署建议：线性探针应视为同分布安全监测工具而非零样本跨语料库事实性检测器，必须配套事后校准，并按专科报告AUROC。

title: Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation
summary: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的摘要质量评分机制进行了系统机制解释。研究发现，两个 7B–8B 评估器并非简单依赖表面特征到评分 token 的捷径，而是采用一致的两阶段计算：第 15 层以下，早期 MLP 在扰动 token 处编码错误，注意力头完成比较与信息路由；第 15 层以上，MLP 级联整合信号并在深层写入评分。评分决策在 Themis 第 26 层、Prometheus 第 25 层突然固化。对 Llama-3-8B 基座的控制实验进一步表明，基座已有路由架构和深层固化能力；评估器微调主要强化了 L15 以下 MLP 的抑制，并将固化层从第 28 层提前到第 26 层。研究还通过 XSum 跨域实验、logit lens 和注意力头敲除验证了这一机制。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评估器研究主要关注其与人工评分的相关性、偏差和失败模式，即“模型评了什么分”，却较少解释“模型如何得到该分数”。理解内部评分流程有助于判断评估器是否真正定位了摘要缺陷、识别潜在失效模式，并设计更鲁棒、可解释的 NLG 评估器。
AI.method: 研究构建了覆盖 Readability 与 Adequacy 两类质量的八类局部扰动：Preposition Mismatch、Tense Mismatch、Spelling、Sequential Reordering、Entity Swap、Numerical/Date Swap、Coreference Mismatch、Antonym & Negation。作者使用 GPT-4o 生成配对的干净/受损 CNN/DailyMail 摘要，并记录 token 级修改映射；通过 XSum 检验跨域泛化。实验包括：窗口模式和最后 token 模式的激活替换因果追踪；将中间残差流投影到 1–5 评分 token 的 logit lens；对全部 1,024 个注意力头逐一敲除。以未微调 Llama-3-8B 为控制组，区分基座架构属性与评估器微调带来的变化。
AI.result: 两种评估器都表现出稳定的“两阶段评估管线”。第 0–5 层的 MLP 主要在受损 token 位置局部编码扰动；低层注意力根据错误类型执行局部比较：Readability 错误通常扩展到邻近句法位置，而 Entity Swap 和 Numerical/Date Swap 更集中于扰动 token。最后输入位置的注意力在约第 13–15 层把比较结果路由到输出位置，上层 MLP 再进行整合并写入评分。注意力头敲除显示，Themis 的关键头集中于 L10–L11，Prometheus 分布于 L10–L15；没有单个头承担全部决定，评分来自正负作用头的交互。Logit lens 显示评分在 Themis L=26、Prometheus L=25 突然固化，跨 CNN/DailyMail 和 XSum 均保持。基座 Llama-3-8B 已有 L13 路由和 L28 固化，但 L15 以下 MLP 影响较强、两阶段分离较弱；Themis 微调将其降至 0.010，约为基座 0.056 的 1/5.5，并将固化层提前两层至 L=26。微调主要是在既有 Transformer 子结构上雕刻评估机制，而不是从零建立管线。
AI.conclusion: LLM 评估器采用可分解的内部计算结构：错误局部编码、注意力比较与路由、上层 MLP 整合及最终评分固化。注意力主要负责低层比较和信号传输，MLP 负责高层的语义整合与评分写入，因此“注意力=判断、MLP=记忆”的简单分工并不成立。微调通过抑制早期 MLP 在最终位置的作用、增强阶段分离，并将决策提前压缩来适配评估任务。由于样本仅来自两个 7B–8B 英文摘要评估器，且只研究单次、强度 k=1 的攻击，结论尚不能直接推广到多轮对话、故事生成、多语言模型或复杂混合错误；logit lens 的绝对概率也应视为定性近似。

title: Classic AI Scaffolding for LLM Social Agents
summary: Large language models can produce locally plausible social turns, but fluent next-turn generation is not enough for social simulation. Human encounters such as restaurant lunches and hotel check-ins are bounded social episodes with roles, scripts, material state, obligations, commitments, timing, and closure conditions. We present EpisodeSim, a hybrid LLM-agent architecture that represents classic-AI structures as natural-language control state interpreted by LLM calls. A World Master maintains shared reality, constructs scenes, adjudicates proposed actions, tracks effects and obligations, and controls closure. Experiments with small qualitative ablations on two held-out settings support a design claim: LLM fluency supplies local texture, but coherent social simulation benefits from persistent classic-AI-style scaffolding that organizes behavior over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EpisodeSim，一种混合LLM智能体架构，将经典AI的脚本、框架、目标、计划和效果等概念重新诠释为由LLM调用解释的自然语言控制状态，用于模拟有界的社交场景（如餐厅午餐、酒店入住），并通过小型消融实验证明：仅靠LLM的局部流畅性不足以维持场景连贯性，需要持久的经典AI式脚手架来组织跨时间的行为。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能产生局部合理的社交对话回合，但仅凭流畅的下一轮生成并不足以实现社交模拟。人类社交遭遇（如餐厅午餐、酒店入住）是有界的社会场景，包含角色、脚本、物质状态、义务、承诺、时间和结束条件。当缺乏显式的场景级控制层时，智能体可能流畅地讨论商业条款却从未点餐，或讨论入住问题却从未完成验证、付款和离店——这是社会过程层面的失败，而非语言层面的失败。
AI.method: EpisodeSim采用分层架构：（1）场景级World Master负责维护共享现实、构建场景、裁定提议动作、追踪效果与义务、控制结束；（2）智能体级参与者接收紧凑的动作上下文，自主提议动作。其核心持久化控制组件包括：Canon（权威背景事实）、智能体主观状态、场景契约（目的、终端要求、结束条件）、脚本栈、事件/效果分类账、观察、结束控制。系统从简短的种子设定出发，由LLM推断相关角色、脚本、必要元素和结束条件，生成场景特定的控制状态并在整个场景执行中持续追踪。该架构是"后符号化"的实现，但保留了经典AI的表征清单。
AI.result: 在两个保留评估设置（商业午餐谈判和深夜酒店入住）上对比了三个条件：（A）完整EpisodeSim，（B）最小适当性基线，（C）有基础的真值基础智能体基线。每个条件每个设置运行3次，共18个场景。结果显示：（A）条件0/6出现主要场景级脚本/议程/结束失败；（B）和（C）均为6/6。B条件产生流畅但常常省略餐厅或入住序列；C条件在事实/动作一致性上有所改善，但仍无法维持脚本完成或结束。三层成功分别为：局部流畅性（所有条件常能达到）、基础任务进展（C优于B）、场景连贯性（A显著更优但并非完美）。然而，该评估样本量小、评分部分由作者裁定，并非基准规模的实证验证。
AI.conclusion: LLM在缺乏时间结构、角色、物质和信息状态、义务和结束条件的显式脚手架时，可能产生局部合理但场景失败的对话。经典AI的脚本、框架、目标和计划结构仍可被有意义地重新诠释为LLM社交智能体的持久化自然语言控制面，而非僵化的符号程序。贡献是设计层面的主张而非基准分数，强调连贯社交模拟需要经典AI式的脚手架来在长时间跨度上组织行为。

title: Uncovering and Mitigating Aggregation-Induced Reward Hacking in Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of large language models increasingly adopts multiple reward dimensions, including verifiable rules, task-specific evaluators, and learned reward models, to provide richer supervision across diverse capabilities. These dimensions are commonly scalarized with fixed aggregation weights. We identify a failure mode in which aggregation itself induces reward hacking: static projection aliases qualitatively different reward profiles into a single scalar, steering optimization toward whichever dimensions are easiest, densest, or systematically favored by the reward signal. Over training, this traps the policy in suboptimal profiles and prevents convergence to better-balanced ones that would yield higher task performance. To address this, we propose Adaptive Multi-Reward Projection (AMRP), a lightweight online method that reallocates aggregation weights using three signals, relative shortfall, reward volatility, and recent progress, increasing pressure on lagging, unstable, or stagnant dimensions while relieving saturated ones. Across structured reasoning, citation-grounded generation, and open-ended alignment under GRPO, AMRP consistently improves reward-profile balance and downstream performance over fixed and dynamic weighting baselines; it also remains effective with GDPO and PPO, supporting compatibility across RL algorithms. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多奖励强化学习中静态标量化导致的"聚合诱导的奖励黑客"问题，提出了一种轻量级的在线自适应聚合方法 AMRP，通过三个动态信号自适应重分配奖励投影权重，在三类任务上一致提升了奖励均衡与下游性能。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型后训练的多奖励 RL 中，常用固定权重将多个奖励维度聚合成标量。该静态投影会产生"奖励画像坍缩"（profile aliasing + shortcut lock-in），使优化偏向容易/密集/已饱和的维度，抑制困难维度，从而引发聚合诱导的奖励黑客问题，导致策略陷入次优画像。
AI.method: 论文系统化分析静态聚合作为从多维奖励画像到标量的投影如何造成 aliasing 与 shortcut lock-in；提出 AMRP（Adaptive Multi-Reward Projection），按 N 步间隔用 EMA 维护每个维度的均值/方差/近期进展 μ_i、σ_i、Δ_i，并基于三个门控信号自适应更新权重：1) 相对差距 S_i=softplus(k_s(μ̄−μ_i)) 提升落后维度；2) 奖励波动率 V_i=1+λ·σ_i/(μ_i+ε) 提升不稳定维度；3) 近期进展 P_i=softplus(−k_p·Δ_i) 提升停滞/回退维度。三信号相乘形成软合取，按 U_i=S_i·V_i·P_i 与可选先验 a_i 归一化得到权重。AMRP 是一个与算法无关的奖励聚合层，可直接用于 GRPO/PPO 的标量化前，也可用于 GDPO 的逐维优势加权聚合。
AI.result: 在结构化推理（MATH/AMC/AIME，Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 DeepSeek-Math-7B）、引用支撑生成（ASQA/ELI5，Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B）和开放式对齐（HelpSteer2 + ArmoRM，Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B）三类设置下，AMRP 一致优于静态聚合和 DRBO（delta/inverse）基线：在 Qwen3-4B 数学推理上平均准确率从静态的 37.53 与 DRBO-delta 的 51.15 提升到 60.72；在 ASQA+ELI5 上 Qwen3-4B 总体分从 51.03 提升到 59.13、Llama-3.1-8B 从 59.21 提升到 75.56；开放式对齐各维度也稳定上涨；与 GRPO/GDPO/PPO 兼容；机制分析显示 AMRP 显著降低 (0,1,1) 捷径画像占比并保留更长响应；对超参 λ、k_s、k_p、N 在较大范围内都保持稳定，消融实验确认三个信号和乘法组合均不可缺。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示并形式化了多奖励 RL 中由静态聚合诱发的奖励画像坍缩问题，并通过 AMRP 利用相对差距、波动率与近期进展三个在线信号自适应重分配投影权重，有效抑制捷径锁定、提升奖励均衡与下游任务表现；其方法轻量、可与 GRPO/GDPO/PPO 等多种算法结合，并支持非均匀先验偏好，为多维奖励优化提供了一种通用、即插即用的解决方案。

title: LLM-as-a-Demographic: Whom Sociodemographic Prompting Helps, and Whom It Hurts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for subjective tasks, where annotators disagree and the relevant question is not only how accurate a judge is, but whose judgments it reproduces. Sociodemographic prompting conditions the judge on an annotator's demographic profile to align its judgments with the corresponding group's. We test whether this alignment emerges distributionally, comparing the predicted label distributions of 23 open-weight LLMs on three subjective tasks against those of real annotator groups, under three conditions: no demographic information, single-attribute profiles, and intersectional profiles over gender, age, race, and education. Three findings emerge. First, a judge prompted with no demographics is not perspective-neutral: models best reproduce the judgments of White, college-educated annotators. Second, demographic conditioning is asymmetric: it moves the judge toward majority groups and away from minority groups, most strongly on offensiveness, where intersectional profiles amplify the harm. Third, by comparing base and instruct models we identify instruction-tuning as a possible source of the asymmetry. Demographic conditioning should therefore be used with caution to estimate group judgments: conditioning moves predictions away from the reference distributions of the minority groups the method is often invoked to serve.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了23个开源大语言模型在三个主观任务（礼貌、亲密、冒犯）上使用人口统计学条件提示（sociodemographic prompting）模拟不同人群判断的效果，发现该方法在分布层面评估下存在严重的不对称偏见：它实际上帮助了模型本就偏向的主流群体（白人、大学学历者），却伤害了少数群体（黑人、亚裔、研究生学历者），且指令微调是这种不对称性的来源。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用作主观任务的自动评判者，社会人口学提示被提议用来模拟不同人群的判断以实现"多元对齐"。然而现有研究多以聚合标签（如均值或多数票）评估，且未检验条件化是否真的将模型推向目标群体的真实判断分布，还是仅仅激活了关于该群体的刻板印象。这在主观任务中尤为关键——标注者之间的分歧应被视为信号而非噪声。
AI.method: 采用"视角主义"（perspectivist）视角，将评判视为对每个人口学群体的标签分布的估计而非聚合黄金标签。使用DeMo数据集，在三个五点量表主观任务上测试23个开源模型（5个系列，4B–70B，含base与instruct配对），通过前向传播读取模型对五个选项token的对数概率并softmax归一化为预测分布。使用Earth Mover's Distance（EMD）的有界相似度分数s评估对齐，并通过密度匹配（density matching）和众数准确率（mode accuracy）两个独立控制实验排除分布扩散的伪影。比较无人口学信息、单一属性（性别、年龄、种族、教育）和交叉性（两属性交叉）三种条件下的预测分布。
AI.result: 三项核心发现：（1）无条件的LLM评判者并非视角中立的——所有模型与白人、大学学历标注者的判断最为接近，与黑人和亚裔差距最大（base模型平均White-Black差距0.089）；（2）人口学条件化效应不对称：对指令调优模型，它将评判者推向多数群体（白人、男性、大学学历）而拉离少数群体（黑人减少0.033，亚裔、女性、研究生学历也为负），最显著的是冒犯性任务上的Woman×Black交叉剖面（-0.087），并且这种伤害不随模型规模改善；（3）通过base-instruct配对比较发现，指令微调是不对称性的可能来源——base模型对所有群体均有正向增益，而指令调优模型则激活了对该群体的刻板印象而非其真实视角，条件化引发的评分偏移方向与该群体实际的偏差方向常常不一致甚至相反。
AI.conclusion: 人口学条件化不应被视为模拟少数群体判断的有效工具：它实际上将模型推离了该方法本欲服务的群体的参考分布。在指令调优模型上分配人口学画像通常激活的是关于该群体的刻板印象，而非该群体的真实视角。因此，人口学提示应谨慎使用，不应替代真正从目标群体中招募标注者。实践中的关键问题不仅是人口学条件化是否有用，更是对谁有用。

title: Bridging Lexical Divergence: LLM-Assisted, Cost-Efficient, Zero-shot Scientific Entity Linking
summary: Scientific domain entity linking (EL) differs from general domain EL because mentions and entity names often lack lexical overlap. Another challenge is that specialized terminology is used in the scientific domain, which is rarely encountered in models pretrained on general domains. Therefore, models trained on general domains transfer poorly to scientific domains. To address this, in-domain fine-tuning is the natural remedy. However, many scientific domains lack expert-annotated data, motivating the need for a zero-human-annotation approach. Existing zero-shot methods heavily rely on LLMs to generate aliases across entire mention corpora, which incurs substantial computational cost, and those methods provide no mechanism to filter out noise from LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose Sci-ZSEL, a framework that selectively generates entity aliases with an LLM to control computational cost, and applies an ontology-aware filter to remove aliases that semantically drift toward ontology neighbors. Then, filtered aliases are used to construct pseudo-labeled mention-entity pairs for fine-tuning. To enable evaluation of EL under low lexical overlap, we also release a new animal science EL benchmark linked to three livestock trait ontologies, where mentions and entities exhibit substantially lower lexical overlap than in existing benchmarks. Across five benchmarks, Sci-ZSEL outperforms the non-fine-tuned baseline, is most useful on nonoverlapping mentions, and combining it with curated synonyms gives the best performance in most settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sci-ZSEL框架，通过在精选实体上调用LLM生成别名并采用本体感知过滤策略，构建伪标签对进行零样本科学领域实体链接，无需人工标注。同时发布了首个高词形差异的动物科学EL基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 科学领域实体链接面临两大核心难题：一是提及与实体名称之间缺乏词形重叠（如"lambing potential"对应"goat fertility"），二是通用域预训练模型难以处理专业术语。此外，科学领域知识库以本体（ontology）形式组织，现有ZSEL方法忽略了本体层次结构。现有LLM数据增强方法对每个提及调用LLM，成本高且生成的监督信号与具体语料绑定、不可复用，缺少过滤LLM噪声的机制。
AI.method: Sci-ZSEL采用三阶段方法：(1) 实体选择——结合精确匹配实体集和BLINK双编码器top-1实体集，仅对小子集调用LLM；(2) 伪标签构造——通过表面匹配和LLM生成别名构建mention-entity对；(3) 本体感知过滤——利用BioLORD嵌入计算别名与目标实体及其邻居的语义相似度，丢弃语义更接近邻居或偏离过大的别名。检索器采用PC-POS本体感知负采样策略（将父/子实体作为正例），重排序器在BLINK和ReS两种骨干上进行微调。
AI.result: 在5个基准（NCBI Disease、BC5CDR以及新发布的QTL_CMO、QTL_VT、QTL_LPT）上：Sci-ZSEL + Synonym组合在多数场景取得最优；NO（无词形重叠）类别提升最大，最高可达+49.12个百分点；本体感知过滤将伪标签准确率从72%提升至90%以上；在大型本体上LLM调用次数和输入token均显著低于逐提及增强方法；新发布的动物科学基准具有更高NO率和更稀疏的同义词覆盖。
AI.conclusion: Sci-ZSEL为低资源科学领域的零样本实体链接提供了可扩展、可复用的解决方案，通过控制成本地生成LLM别名和本体感知过滤有效缓解了词形发散问题。本体感知过滤对于防止LLM噪声导致性能下降至关重要，与人工策划同义词结合使用效果最佳。该工作还揭示了领域LLM依赖性、多语言支持、NIL实体处理等未来研究方向。

title: LOOMSUM:Weaving Quantitative and Narrative Evidence for Faithful Long Text-Table Summarization
comment: Preprint, code will be available soon
summary: Long documents often distribute important information across extensive narrative passages and multiple tables, making faithful summarization particularly challenging. Existing methods may generate individually supported quantitative facts and analytical statements yet associate them incorrectly, producing quantitatively plausible yet analytically unfaithful summaries. In this work, we propose LOOMSUM, a training-free framework that extracts source-grounded atomic evidence, explicitly links table-derived facts with supporting narrative analyses, and plans the discourse structure before generation. We also introduce Table-Grounded Faithfulness (TGF), a claim-level metric that separately evaluates Numeric Grounding, Analysis Support, and Relation Consistency. Experiments on the text--table summarization benchmarks FINDSum and USTT show that LOOMSUM improves analytical faithfulness while maintaining strong summarization quality. Human evaluation finds positive component-level associations with the corresponding human judgments. Our Relation Consistency metric further shows stronger agreement with human relation judgments than generic factuality metrics, indicating that explicit cross-modal linking helps reduce errors in which supported quantities are paired with incorrect narrative interpretations. Together, these findings show that faithful long text--table summarization requires not only grounding individual facts, but also preserving the relations between them.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练框架LoomSum，通过抽取原子声明、跨模态对齐量化事实与叙事解读、话语规划三步生成摘要；并提出TGF评估指标（数值支撑、分析支持、关系一致性）衡量表格-文本摘要的忠实性，在FINDSum和USTT上验证可减少"量化-叙事错位"错误。
AI.motivation: 长文档中量化事实（表格）与叙事解读（文本）分散在不同区域，现有方法容易将各自有依据的量化事实和分析陈述错误关联，产生"数量合理但分析不忠实"的摘要（如收入增长被错误归因）。需要同时保留事实及其间关系。
AI.method: 三阶段无训练框架：(1) 用LLM从文本和表格中抽取源支持的原子声明（保留实体、量、单位、期间）；(2) 跨模态对齐表声明与解释/比较/限定它的文本声明，形成保留来源的链接声明；(3) 合并冗余后通过话语规划器排序并组织，由LLM结合上下文学习示例生成摘要。TGF指标将声明分解为独立单元，由LLM评判器在数值支撑（NG）、分析支持（AS）、关系一致性（RC）三维五点制评分，跨模态声明用min()聚合。
AI.result: 在FINDSum（ROO/Liquidity）和USTT上，LoomSum在ROUGE、BERTScore、数值选择和TGF上多数指标取得最佳，TGF提升主要来自RC维度；消融显示对齐、规划、ICL逐步贡献。人评验证TGF-RC与人工相关性最强（ρ=0.598），且优于AlignScore和SummaC。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的长文-表摘要不仅需锚定单个事实，还需保留量化事实与叙事解读之间的关系；显式跨模态链接与话语规划能有效减少量化-叙事错位，TGF的关系一致性维度对现有通用事实性指标构成补充。

title: NSIDDx: A Design Framework for Neuro-Symbolic, Practitioner-First Differential Diagnosis in Low-Resource Settings
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, Github: this https URL
summary: LLM-based diagnostic systems achieve high semantic accuracy on benchmarks, but open-ended evaluation on clinically uncommon presentations reveals a systematic gap between headline accuracy and verifiable clinical reliability. We evaluate an LLM+rare-disease-RAG pipeline across two cohorts and show that the paradigm produces confident outputs that are frequently unverifiable and systematically resistant to clinician interrogation. We present NSIDDx (Neuro-Symbolic Integrated Differential Diagnosis System), a design framework arguing that DDx systems in low-resource settings must treat the clinician as an active reasoning agent. We instantiate this through a neuro-symbolic pipeline with ternary symptom encoding, contradiction detection, audit strings, and practitioner override - running offline on consumer hardware. We distill five design principles for clinician-in-the-loop clinical NLP and invite the prospective studies needed to validate the claim at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出 NSIDDx 神经符号差分诊断系统，强调"以临床医生为主、tractability of disagreement 可被质疑和修改的设计理念"，通过三元症状编码、矛盾检测、审计字符串和医生覆盖机制，实现可在消费级硬件上离线运行的差分诊断流程，并提炼五条人机协同设计原则。
AI.motivation: 当前基于 LLM 的诊断系统在基准上表现出色，但在临床罕见病例开放评估下，语义准确率与可验证的临床可靠性之间存在系统性差距，且输出对医生质询具有抵抗力，无法满足低资源环境下全科医生需要可信赖推理支持的需求。
AI.method: 采用神经符号混合架构：(1) LLM 进行病史采集与摘要；(2) 两步法将自由文本症状映射至 HPO 术语，分别构建显式存在集与显式缺席集；(3) LLM 生成带证据-推理-诊断结构化输出的差分诊断并产出命题逻辑 (PL) 审计字符串；(4) 双公式评分引擎——矩阵分数（基于三元症状向量点积，可捕捉矛盾）与混合分数（结合 inclusion 与 Jaccard）；(5) 保留否定的表型图谱 (NetworkX 多重有向图) 与基于 ZebraMap 的罕见病 RAG 扫描器作为补充；(6) 临床医生可在任意阶段添加/移除症状或候选疾病并重新评分。
AI.result: 在 750 例 CUPCase 基准（CUP 500 例 + WELL 250 例）上使用 Qwen3.5-9B IQ4_XS 量化模型在消费级硬件上评估（每例中位 87.6 秒）：DDx@5 语义准确率在两队列分别为 75.2% 与 73.6% (p=0.700)，但精确匹配仅 6.6%/14.0%，83.5% 的罕见病扫描器输出与真实诊断无语义可验证关系；MONDO 与 PrimeKG 符号评分仅达 5–8% 语义准确率，反映 HPO 注释稀疏而非公式失败；稀有扫描器对 96.8%/93.2% 病例需要医生干预；分类出词汇错配、缺乏依据的自信、否定反转等四类失败模式；通过一个结节病案例研究表明：医生通过移除 6 个错误推断的缺席症状并添加脾大，可将 Sarcoidosis 矩阵分数从 -0.024 提升至 0.098，升至榜首。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出"分歧可处理性"作为低资源临床环境下诊断 AI 的核心设计约束，NSIDDx 的神经符号透明层被定位为架构层面的回应；提炼五条临床 NLP 设计原则：(1) 暴露矛盾 (2) 结构化保留否定 (3) 启用可审计的医生覆盖 (4) 提供多层次解释 (5) 支持离线部署；作者明确未进行用户研究或临床验证，邀请开展前瞻性研究以大规模验证该主张。

title: Slow to See, Slow to Suppress: Understanding the Effects of Modality in Context-Memory Conflicts
comment: Accepted to EMNLP Findings 2026. Code and dataset are available at this https URL
summary: We investigate how vision-language models (VLMs) handle context-memory conflicts; that is, situations in which the model is given information in context that differs from what was stored parametrically during training. We document asymmetric biases: models tend to prefer in-context information about entities which appear in text, but prefer parametric information about entities which appear in images. We relate this asymmetry to the late representational alignment across modalities, showing that the longer processing time associated with resolving visual entities prevents the suppression of the model's usual factual recall mechanism, thus resulting in more parametric answers. Chain-of-thought reasoning does not appear to resolve the gap, but increasing the amount of visual information in the context does show an effect. These results illustrate the complexity of ensuring consistent behavior as models become increasingly multimodal and retrieval-augmented.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLMs）在上下文与参数化记忆冲突中的行为不对称性：模型对文本形式的实体倾向于采信上下文，对图像形式的实体则倾向于依赖参数化记忆。原因在于视觉实体在模型中解析较慢，导致早期注意力无法及时抑制下游负责参数化事实检索的MLP层。链式推理提示无法弥合该差距，而增加上下文中的视觉信息量则能有效降低视觉实体的参数化偏好。
AI.motivation: 多模态检索增强生成（RAG）日益普及，但VLM在跨模态的上下文-记忆冲突中如何消解冲突尚未明晰。已有工作集中于纯文本LLM的机制分析，缺乏对图文混合上下文的系统性研究，尤其缺乏对实体以视觉形式呈现时的行为差异及其内部机制的解释。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含37,970对反事实上下文-记忆冲突实例的基准数据集，涵盖名人、建筑、艺术作品三个领域，并经模型视觉识别与参数化事实回忆双阶段过滤。2. 在Gemma-3-12B/27B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B/72B、Ministral-3-8B/14B上比较文本实体与视觉实体的参数化回答率。3. 通过因果干预剖析机制：(a) 对实体token位置的MLP进行滑动窗口消融；(b) 掩蔽实体token到上下文的注意力，并对照干净MLP输出的中介分析；(c) 回填（back-patching）将视觉token的深层激活补至第一层，模拟更早的表征对齐。4. 评估链式推理（CoT）和视觉化上下文两种提示干预的缓解效果。
AI.result: 1. 视觉实体条件下参数化回答率系统性高于文本实体，差距在核心属性（名人职业、建筑位置、艺术作品作者）上最为显著，部分模型/关系下差距可达80%以上。2. MLP消融大幅降低视觉实体的参数化偏好，但对文本实体影响有限；注意力掩蔽则使文本实体向参数化端强烈偏移，且该偏移由下游MLP中介。3. 视觉token深层激活回填至第一层可有效缩小模态差距，接近文本基线。4. CoT提示未能稳定缩小模态差距；将上下文中的实体引用替换为图像（尤其使用同一图像）可显著降低视觉实体的参数化偏好，但使用不同图像时效果减弱。
AI.conclusion: VLM在上下文-记忆冲突中存在跨模态的不对称消解机制：文本实体通过早期注意力抑制MLP参数化检索，使上下文信息胜出；视觉实体因解析较慢、对齐延迟，无法及时触发该抑制，导致参数化信息主导。模态间的表征对齐时机是冲突解决一致性的关键瓶颈。多模态RAG与工具增强系统的可靠性设计需显式考虑早期跨模态对齐问题。

title: Toward Workflow-Aware Benchmarking for Healthcare NLP Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation, evidence retrieval, patient messaging, and care coordination. Yet many evaluations remain limited to static medical question answering or one-shot generation, under-representing longitudinal state, interruptions, and human handoffs. We introduce an episode-level evaluation protocol for healthcare NLP agents. The protocol separates evidence across model, agent, and simulated-workflow behavior; specifies a five-field episode schema; and defines annotation and scoring for state continuity, evidence traceability, and escalation decisions. It is instantiated as four task templates: documentation update, evidence retrieval, patient messaging, and triage handoff. The protocol does not claim to measure clinical outcomes or deployment value. Instead, it supplies a reproducible intermediate evaluation layer between static benchmarks and prospective workflow studies, with an explicit cost-sensitive treatment of missed versus unnecessary escalation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向医疗NLP智能体的"工作流感知"评测协议，主张在静态基准测试与前瞻性临床工作流研究之间构建一个可复现的中间评测层。该协议区分模型层、Agent层和模拟工作流层三级证据，定义五字段的episode schema，并对状态连续性、证据可追溯性和升级决策进行可审计的标注与评分，以四个任务模板（文档更新、证据检索、患者消息、分诊交接）实例化。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗AI评测多依赖静态医学问答或一次性生成测试，无法反映临床工作流的多步骤、有状态、中断与人机交接特征；一个在单轮表现流畅的系统仍可能因状态管理失败、证据错配或不恰当升级而在真实工作流中失效。作者认为需要一种介于静态基准与前瞻性临床研究之间的可复现评测层。
AI.method: 作者提出一个三层证据协议：模型层（事实性、校准、鲁棒性）、Agent层（多步任务执行、工具使用、记忆与检索一致性）、模拟工作流层（路由、升级、交接完整性）。评测单位为"episode"，需包含初始上下文包、状态变更事件、允许动作空间、参考决策档案和裁定规则书五个字段；采用两名标注员独立标注加第三方裁决的标注流程。评分维度包括状态连续性、证据可追溯性、交接完整性，并以预声明代价矩阵计算升级效用U = u_TP·TP + u_TN·TN - c_FN·FN - c_FP·FP。协议实例化为四个任务模板，每个模板聚焦不同的主要风险与评分目标。
AI.result: 协议层面提出了一套结构化设计：三证据分层、episode五字段schema、四任务模板（文档更新——更新保真度；证据检索——基于证据的决策分；患者消息——升级效用；分诊交接——交接完整性），以及将升级作为成本敏感决策对待的效用函数。文中以"患者报告药物调整后呼吸困难加重"为例说明静态基准可能奖励详细答复而错失升级信号，episode协议则显式测试警示信号识别、上下文保留与交接字段完整性。作者明确声明本工作不测量临床结局或部署价值。
AI.conclusion: 医疗NLP智能体应作为工作流绑定系统而非孤立响应生成器进行评估；静态医学基准不足以支撑部署就绪性主张。该episode级协议通过分层证据与可复现评分使状态连续性、可追溯性、升级和交接行为变得可审计。下一步是开展由临床治理委员会监督的小规模试点，发布episode指南、裁决决策、分数分布和失败分析；在此之前，本文应被视为一种可检验的测量协议，而非医疗工作质量改善的实证。

title: Emotional Labor Strategy Preferences in LLM Personas
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Emotional labor is the effortful management of emotional displays to meet social or professional expectations. Personality traits have been correlated with emotional labor strategies, yet research on this link relies almost exclusively on self-report scales administered only in occupational settings. We investigate whether large language models injected with psychometrically grounded personas reproduce these personality-driven selection patterns across everyday social scenarios. We construct the first emotional labor strategy dataset of 500 socially situated events, each offering three behavioral choices corresponding to surface acting, deep acting, and genuine expression. We source 50 fictional characters from a large-scale personality repository and profile each through two parallel tracks: observer-rated bipolar adjective composites and in-character self-report items. Five LLMs evaluate all scenarios under both persona conditions. We find that models align more towards deep acting, and that Conscientiousness and Emotional Stability consistently predict this preference. Entropy analysis confirms that persona reliably influences the output and varies across models and emotions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将情感劳动策略（表层扮演、深层扮演、真诚表达）选择构建为一项人格条件化任务，通过给LLM注入基于OCEAN五大人格特质的角色画像，检验其是否再现人类心理学中已确立的人格-情感劳动关联。研究构建了首个涵盖500个日常社会情境的情感劳动数据集，并采用双轨人格设计（观察者评定的双极形容词vs.角色内自陈IPIP-50），在5个LLM上进行评估。主要发现：模型普遍倾向于深层扮演，尽责性和情绪稳定性是跨模型、跨人格轨道一致显著的特质预测因子；熵分析证实人格确实影响了策略选择。
AI.motivation: 现有情感劳动与人格关联研究几乎完全依赖职业场景中的自陈量表，且从未与LLM人格注入研究交汇。随着LLM广泛应用于情绪支持、客服等情感敏感场景，理解人格特质如何系统性影响情感调节策略选择变得至关重要，因为不当回应可能损害用户福祉和沟通效果。
AI.method: 1）构建ELS数据集：在Troiano等人的情绪评价格料库基础上，为500个情境增添社交语境，并由GPT-5.4生成对应表层扮演（SA）、深层扮演（DA）、真诚表达（GE）的三种行为选项，严格限制使用情绪形容词。2）双轨人格注入：从Open Psychometrics项目选取50个虚构角色，采用最大极远点采样在40维BAP空间中最大化人格多样性；BAP轨道使用40个验证过的双极形容词对（1-100分），IPIP轨道让模型以角色身份完成IPIP-50自陈量表（1-5分）。3）使用Qwen-3-8B/32B、GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Gemma-4-31B五个LLM进行三选一评估。4）分析包括：聚合策略分布、OCEAN-策略Spearman相关、Shannon熵分析（衡量人格影响）、三条件消融（vanilla/仅名字/仅BAP）、三选一vs.李克特格式验证。
AI.result: 1）深层扮演（DA）是跨10个模型-轨道组合中8个的众数策略，比例从39%（GPT-5.4 IPIP轨道）到61%（Qwen-3-32B）不等；表层扮演（SA）始终占比最低。2）尽责性（C）和情绪稳定性（ES）跨双轨一致预测更多DA和更少SA/GE，与人类心理学既有发现方向一致；但尽责性与真诚表达呈负相关，这与人类研究中的正相关相悖（论文将此解读为模型将尽责性编码为主动的自我调节而非内在角色对齐）。3）IPIP轨道仅在自陈条件下揭示宜人性的显著效应，BAP轨道未能捕捉；外倾性和开放性效应较弱。4）熵分析显示大多数模型在多数情绪类别上保持高熵（0.82-0.92），证实人格确实分化了策略选择；但Qwen-32B熵较低（0.42-0.70），说明情境本身对部分模型影响更大。5）消融：无人物时DA占68%，加入任何人格信号都会重新分配比例，仅名字提示即将DA降至36.6%。6）模型间一致性中等（最高GPT-5.4与Gemma-4-31B，κ=0.545），SA是模型间最难达成共识的类别。
AI.conclusion: 人格注入的LLM角色在日常社交情境中产生了可靠的情感劳动策略选择差异。研究贡献：1）首次将情感劳动策略选择构建为人格条件化任务；2）发布了首个涵盖500个非职业情境的情感劳动数据集；3）证实尽责性和情绪稳定性跨模型一致驱动策略偏好，而宜人性仅通过自陈诱导显现。LLM整体倾向于深层扮演，反映训练语料将该策略编码为规范性调节反应。尽责性抑制真诚表达的"反转"现象值得未来通过开源模型的机制可解释性研究加以验证。局限性包括角色人格基于众包感知而非真实测量、数据增强为合成、仅英语文化背景、结果为相关性而非因果。

title: Latent Mechanisms of Language Control in Multilingual Language Models
comment: 23 pages, accepted for presentation at EMNLP 2026 main track
summary: Multilingual large language models can exhibit unintended code-switching -- unnecessarily alternating between languages during generation. We present a comparative study of three methods that identify language-controlling latents in cross-layer transcoders: activation value-based selection (ValSel), activation frequency-based selection (FreqSel), and LLM-generated latent annotation-based selection (AnnSel). To evaluate the efficacy of these methods in identifying language-controlling latents, we introduce two multilingual benchmarks that exhibit code-switching for fine-grained analysis of language steering across seven languages. Through targeted intervention experiments on Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B, we find that all three methods effectively manipulate generation language, with FreqSel achieving the strongest overall performance, while AnnSel offering interpretable latent selection through explicit language annotations. A knock-out analysis suggests the methods select non-overlapping but each-functional latent subsets, indicating redundancy rather than a single canonical language direction. Code and data can be found at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种在跨层转码器（CLT）中识别语言控制潜在特征的方法（ValSel/FreqSel/AnnSel），通过在Gemma-2-2B和Qwen3-4B上对七种语言进行干预实验，发现所有方法均有效，FreqSel整体性能最强，AnnSel提供可解释性，且各方法选择的潜在子集存在冗余而非单一规范语言方向。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型在生成过程中常出现非预期的代码切换（code-switching）现象，现有机制可解释性研究虽已识别语言控制的神经元或潜在特征，但缺乏对不同发现方法的系统比较，且不同方法是否揭示同一底层表征尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1) 三种潜在特征选择方法：ValSel（基于激活值差异）、FreqSel（基于激活频率的语言特异性）、AnnSel（基于电路追踪和LLM生成注释的关键词匹配）；2) 四种干预策略：目标放大、干扰零化消融、干扰方向消融及其组合；3) 两个新颖评估基准（Antonyms和Enumerations），覆盖七种语言的42种上下文-目标语言对；4) 在Gemma-2-2B和Qwen3-4B的CLT上进行目标干预实验及跨方法敲除分析。
AI.result: 所有三种方法均能有效操控生成语言。FreqSel在Antonyms（平均14.15）和Enumerations（平均2.06）上整体表现最佳，尤其在亚洲语言（中、韩）上优势显著；AnnSel提供可解释的语言注释但因韩语潜在特征数量仅7个而表现受限；最有效的干预策略是Zero+Amp（干扰语言零化消融+目标语言放大）。敲除实验表明三种方法选择的功能性潜在子集互不重叠，表明语言表征存在冗余而非单一规范方向。
AI.conclusion: 三种语言控制潜在特征选择方法各有优劣：FreqSel性能最强，AnnSel可解释性最佳，ValSel则提供了有竞争力的基线。语言表征在CLT中以冗余方式组织，不同方法发现的潜在子集功能上等价但几何上不同。未来工作应推广至更大模型和更多语言，并深入理解不同方法识别潜在特征的相似性。

title: Two locked tests of phase-structure features for transition prediction
comment: 7 pages. Empirical follow-up to arXiv:2607.25507 . Both pre-specified tests are null
summary: A published theoretical account of phase structure in rotary attention was subjected to two pre-specified empirical tests of whether phase-derived features improve prediction of a commitment or contradiction endpoint over a baseline that does not receive those features. Study 1 froze a contradiction-category pipeline and scored a sealed primary comparison of PC-2 against baseline. On 1,136 eligible cases the paired AUROC difference was +0.00087. The 99% interval included zero, and the difference did not reach the pre-specified threshold of +0.05. Advancement was not passed. Study 2 developed fifteen layer treatments on open blocks b0-b4 only (1,415 transitions, 20x5 grouped folds). A locked conjunctive rule required a positive PC-2 mean-repeat increment, a positive increment on at least four of five seed blocks, and a positive mean of those five differences. No treatment advanced. The official selection is null. The theoretical paper is not withdrawn. The extra ranking lift was not found under the rules locked in advance.

AI.tldr: 对旋转注意力中相位结构的理论进行了两项预先指定的实证检验，测试相位衍生特征是否能比基线更好地预测承诺或矛盾终点。两项研究均未达到预先设定的提升阈值，因此官方选择为零结果，但理论论文未被撤回。
AI.motivation: 验证一个已发表的理论——即旋转注意力中的相位结构特征（特别是PC-2）是否能在承诺/矛盾终点预测任务上比基线模型提供显著改进。这是对理论可检验性的严格实证检验。
AI.method: 研究1：冻结矛盾类别流水线，对PC-2与基线进行密封的主要比较，使用1,136个合格案例，评估AUROC配对差异，阈值为+0.05。研究2：在开放块b0-b4上开发15个层处理方案（1,415次跃迁，20×5分组折叠），采用锁定的联合规则要求PC-2平均重复增量、至少5个种子块中4个为正、这5个差异的平均值为正。
AI.result: 研究1：配对AUROC差异为+0.00087，99%置信区间包含零，未达到+0.05阈值。研究2：无处理方案通过。
AI.conclusion: 官方选择为零结果（null）。在预先锁定的规则下，未发现额外的排序提升。理论论文未被撤回。

title: From Tool Use to Technological Agency: LoopCAT as a Local-First, Open-Source Tool for Translation Technology Education
summary: Translation students need to learn both how to use translation technologies and how to judge the choices those technologies make available. This article presents LoopCAT, an Apache-2.0-licensed, local-first computer-assisted translation environment co-created with OpenAI Codex using GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6, and proposes a framework connecting workflow competence, evaluative judgement, and technological agency. The account draws on repository history, implementation inspection, and the verification records of an identified development build. LoopCAT combines local project storage, translation memories, terminology, quality assurance, document exchange, and optional connections to local or hosted AI services. Its English, Catalan, and Turkish interface catalogs also make the application itself available as teaching material: students can translate English UI strings into another language, review the existing automatically generated target drafts, import their revisions, and test the interface. We organize these opportunities around four forms of participation: operating a workflow, evaluating outputs, inspecting and configuring mechanisms, and making or defending a bounded intervention. A six-session sequence, a UI-localization assignment, a placeholder example, and an assessment rubric specify how teachers could use the framework. The paper separates implemented capabilities from proposed educational benefits; it reports no new student-learning outcomes. It distinguishes the latest package checks from earlier regression evidence and sets out a protocol for classroom evaluation. LoopCAT provides an inspectable setting for teaching how translation decisions interact with data, interfaces, and software rules. Whether these activities improve judgement, transfer, or participation remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为 LoopCAT 的本地优先计算机辅助翻译（CAT）环境，采用 Apache-2.0 开源许可，通过 OpenAI Codex（使用 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6）与作者共同开发。文章提出一个连接工作流能力、评价判断和技术能动性的教学框架，并通过四类参与形式（操作工作流、评估输出、检查配置机制、进行有边界的干预）来组织教学机会。文章还提供了六节课的教学序列、UI 本地化作业、占位符示例和评估量表，但明确报告无新的学生学习成果数据。
AI.motivation: 翻译学生不仅需要学习使用翻译技术，还需要学会判断这些技术所提供的选项。然而，现有的 CAT 工具往往缺乏可检查性和教学透明性，难以支持学生深入理解翻译决策与数据、界面和软件规则之间的交互。
AI.method: 采用设计研究方法，与 OpenAI Codex（GPT-5.5/5.6）协同开发 LoopCAT，集成本地项目存储、翻译记忆库、术语管理、质量保证、文档交换和可选的 AI 服务连接。通过仓库历史、代码检查和特定开发构建的验证记录进行报告。提出四类参与框架，并设计六节课序列、UI 本地化作业和评估量表作为教学实施方案。
AI.result: 开发出 LoopCAT 应用程序及其英语、加泰罗尼亚语和土耳其语界面目录。界面字符串本身可作为教学材料，学生可翻译 UI 字符串、审阅自动生成的译稿、导入修订并测试界面。文章区分了已实现功能与拟议的教育收益，区分了最新包检查与早期回归证据，并提出了课堂评估协议。
AI.conclusion: LoopCAT 提供了一个可检查的环境，用于教授翻译决策如何与数据、界面和软件规则交互。但这些活动是否能改善学生的判断力、迁移能力或参与度仍是一个有待实证检验的问题。文章明确未报告新的学生学习成果。

title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Code + one-command reproduction: this https URL
summary: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable. Framing the token layer as source coding -- transformer compute is monotone in sequence length, whose per-atom floor is the Shannon rate $H/\log_2 V$, an object already applied to tokenizers in prior work -- we assemble a token-cost ledger that splits each language's cost, at fixed parallel content, into a removable coding redundancy, a residual coding slack, an intrinsic-content term, and an orthogonal, irreducible grapheme-to-phoneme term that governs the multimodal rather than the text cost. On FLORES-200 across eight languages, a production tokenizer costs up to $8.9\times$ more tokens for Indic scripts than for English; a script-matched code trained on $1,012$ sentences removes a median $64\%$ of that excess (bootstrap 95\% CI $[0.638, 0.647]$), and a script-fair information floor shows the intrinsic content differs by under $6\%$ -- the tax is representational, not informational. A constructed code removes $98\%$ of a controlled source's redundancy, and the token tax implies up to $79\times$ attention cost. We are explicit about scope and failure: this is compute-and-memory accounting, not a model-quality claim; we neither measure nor claim the cross-lingual direction of the orthographic term; and our matched code is a conservative small-data demonstration. We contribute the unifying ledger, the removable-versus-intrinsic attribution, and an open one-command harness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个统一的token成本账本（token-cost ledger），将多语言token化税（multilingual tokenization tax）分解为可移除的编码冗余、残余编码松弛、本征内容项，以及一个正交的、不可约的字素到音素项。核心发现在FLORES-200的八种语言上，生产级tokenizer对Indic脚本产生高达8.9×的token膨胀，其中约64%可被脚本匹配编码器移除；脚本公平的信息下限显示本征内容差异不足6%，表明该税是表征性的而非信息性的。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在非英文文本上存在显著的token膨胀税（同一内容需要多倍token），且由于注意力机制的二次方复杂度，导致计算成本呈二次放大。现有文献虽记录了这一现象，但未定量回答：多少比例的税可通过更好的编码移除，多少是语言本身固有的？本文旨在构建一个计算与内存层面的统一成本分解框架，给出"可移除vs本征"的归因。
AI.method: 方法核心是构建token成本账本：将归一化序列长度（NSL）分解为三个可加项——(1) 可移除编码冗余R（vocab mismatch产生的KL散度项）；(2) 残余编码松弛（匹配编码器与信息下限的差距）；(3) 本征内容项（由脚本公平的LZMA压缩器测量）。正交轴上还有一个不可约的字素-音素项G(L)=H(phoneme|grapheme)。实验在FLORES-200的8种语言（3种拉丁语控制、5种Indic语）的1012句devtest上进行，使用cl100k_base等生产级BPE tokenizers和每语言脚本匹配BPE（仅用约1k句训练），并使用Zipf(s=1.1)构造源验证理论下限。还进行了预注册的4个负控实验（含校准、内容不变性等）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 在cl100k_base下，Indic语言的NSL_prod达到4.76×–8.86×，GPT-2下更高（16–20×/词）；(2) 脚本匹配编码器（仅1k句训练）将Indic NSL降至2.54×–3.39×，中位可移除分数ρ=0.64（bootstrap 95% CI [0.638, 0.647]）；(3) 脚本公平信息下限显示Indic语言本征内容仅1.02×–1.06×（差异<6%）；(4) 构造的Huffman码在Zipf源上移除98%冗余，距熵下限仅0.036 bit；(5) 由于注意力Θ(N²)，token税在计算上被二次放大，最高达79×（Kannada）；(6) 负控NC4（字素-音素跨语言方向）未确立，如实报告为负结果。
AI.conclusion: 多语言token税在计算账本中主要是可移除的：脚本匹配编码器可消除约2/3，剩余部分也大多是编码松弛而非本征内容（Indic间本征内容差异<6%）。不可约部分——深度正字法的字素-音素成本——真实存在但位于不同（多模态）轴上。论文贡献：统一的成本账本框架、可移除vs本征的实证归因、逼近熵下限的构造码、开源一键复现工具。明确声明：本文仅做计算与内存核算，非模型质量声明，且不主张新的定理（熵下限及冗余分解均为引用前人工作）。

title: Late Transformer Layers Recode Syntax Canonically: Evidence from Greek Scrambling and Cross-Layer Generalisation
comment: 10 pages, 3 main figures, 2 appendices. Code and stimuli: this https URL
summary: Probing studies have established that syntactic information is decodable in early and middle transformer layers, but what happens to that information in later layers remains poorly understood. We apply a cross-layer generalisation analysis to three Greek-tuned large language models evaluated on tightly controlled minimal pairs: object-relative constructions in Modern Greek, where canonical (Subject-Verb-Object; SVO) and non-canonical (Verb-Subject-Object; VSO) orders differ only in within-clause word order, while preserving propositional meaning. When a probe trained on late layers (20-31) is tested on each early layer individually, it produces below-chance transfer (cluster-corrected, p<0.01), classifying 99.3% of non-canonical sentences as canonical. Probe coefficients reverse sign around layer 22, indicating a directional recoding toward the canonical form rather than simple information loss. These findings characterise a representational format change in late transformer layers that goes beyond the well-established decline in syntactic decodability, and they generate a directly testable prediction for human EEG and MEG decoding studies using the same stimuli. Code and stimuli are publicly available on OSF.

AI.tldr: 本文使用跨层泛化分析方法，研究希腊语微调的三个大语言模型（Llama-Krikri-8B-Base/Instruct、Plutus-8B-Instruct）在处理现代希腊语宾语关系从句中SVO与VSO词序时的内部表征变化。研究发现，在晚期层（20-31层）训练的线性探针在早期层测试时出现系统性低于随机水平的迁移（将99.3%的非典型句误判为典型句），且探针系数在第22层附近发生符号翻转，表明晚期层并非简单丢失句法信息，而是将其方向性重编码为典型形式。
AI.motivation: 先前的probing研究已确立句法信息在transformer中-早期层中可被解码，但对晚期层中句法信息的去向（是简单衰减还是发生了表征格式的定向变化）缺乏清晰认识。标准逐层probing方法独立处理各层，无法区分信息丢失与表征重组。本文借用认知神经科学中时间解码的跨层泛化分析范式来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用希腊语微调的Llama-Krikri-8B-Base（主模型）及两个变体模型。以受控最小对形式构造宾语关系从句中SVO/VSO词序对比的刺激集（主实验128句，敏感性分析1024句）。提取每层每个句子的隐藏状态，以补足词που为时间锚点划分前-从句与后-从句区域，对token维度计算均值、方差、偏度、峰度四个分布统计量作为特征向量。使用L2正则化逻辑回归（ROC-AUC，分层10折交叉验证）进行分类，并采用GAT式设计：在第20-31层训练探针后在各早期层测试；用基于聚类的非参数置换检验（p<0.01）识别连续显著区域。
AI.result: 1. 后-从句激活从早期层即出现高于随机的解码能力，在中层达到峰值，晚期层性能下降至接近随机；前-从句激活始终处于随机水平。2. 中层（约5-19层）存在广泛的跨层泛化区域，表明该范围内表征格式共享；晚期层跨层泛化减弱。3. 在20-31层训练的探针在早期层测试时出现连续显著低于随机的迁移，将99.3%的非典型VSO句误判为典型SVO句，总准确率49.3%。4. 探针系数在第22层附近符号翻转，四个分布特征中同一统计量从预测非典型类变为预测典型类，解释了方向性反转现象。该定性模式在1024句扩展集和两个比较模型中均得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 晚期transformer层并非简单丢失句法敏感性，而是将句法信息方向性地重编码为典型词序（SVO）形式。这种表征格式变化超越了"句法可解码性下降"的传统认识，为人脑-语言模型对齐研究提供了新的预测：可使用相同希腊语刺激在EEG/MEG时间泛化分析中检验相应的方向性不对称。局限包括：线性探针仅捕捉线性可解码信息；SVO与典型性在本设计中重合；模板生成刺激可能存在微弱词汇规律性；仅考察单一语言和单一构式。

title: Location-Aware Language Models via Secondary Embeddings
comment: Accepted for publication at the 29th International Conference on Text, Speech and Dialogue (TSD 2026)
summary: Pretrained transformer-based language models achieve strong performance across a wide range of NLP tasks but remain limited in encoding geo-locational semantics, leading to suboptimal representations of place names and spatial entities. In this work, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic approach for injecting geo-spatial awareness into pretrained embeddings without modifying the tokenizer or requiring costly retraining. Our method augments input representations with structured geographic signals by combining location names with their corresponding latitude and longitude, and employs a location-focused masking to better align textual representations with real-world spatial relationships. This design allows the model to incorporate geo-spatial context while preserving existing semantic and syntactic knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate substantial improvements in geo-spatial alignment while maintaining comparable performance on standard NLP benchmarks such as GLUE. The method is computationally efficient, requiring only minutes of additional training, and generalizes across multiple model architectures and scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级、模型无关的方法，通过将地理位置信息（经纬度）以辅助嵌入（secondary embeddings）形式注入预训练语言模型的输入中，无需修改分词器或大规模重训练，即可使模型具备地理空间感知能力。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练语言模型（如BERT、RoBERTa）对地理空间语义编码不足，导致地名（如Saarbrücken与Salzburg）在嵌入空间中距离失真，无法反映真实地理关系；且现有引入地理信息的方法（SpaBERT、GeoLM、MGeo）需修改架构或大量重训练，成本高昂。
AI.method: 1）构建合成数据集：基于德国GTFS列车时刻表提取820个站点，利用Mistral和LLaMA 3生成5965条旅程描述文本；2）引入特殊标记<loc>、</loc>、<l_sep>将站点名与其经纬度结构化编码注入输入；3）采用MLM目标进行持续预训练，比较随机掩码（ℛ）与位置掩码（𝕃）两种策略；4）仅需约15分钟在单张H100上完成训练。
AI.result: 1）GLUE基准性能保持或略有提升（如BERT-base从81.16→81.96，ALBERT从81.44→82.07）；2）地理对齐显著改善：BERT-large的Pearson相关性从0.297提升至0.550，RoBERTa从0.2665提升至0.4296；3）较大模型受益更明显，位置掩码优于随机掩码；4）多语言模型（mBERT、XLM-R）和小模型（BERT-tiny）改善有限；5）均值池化比[CLS]更能捕捉地理信号；6）WordPiece分词模型效果优于BPE/SentencePiece。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以极低成本为预训练语言模型注入地理空间感知能力，在不牺牲通用NLP性能的前提下显著改善地理对齐，是一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。未来工作包括在预训练阶段直接融入地理信息、扩展至生成式模型，以及深入理解地理信息在嵌入空间中的编码机制。

title: Toppling the Hierarchy in Byte-level Language Modeling
summary: This work examines recent byte-level models and their failure to perfectly manipulate characters. State-of-the-art byte-level models use a hierarchical structure, starting at the byte level, downsampling to the word level, and then upsampling back to bytes. While this improves training and inference efficiency, we find that the hierarchical design itself limits character-level understanding, with pure byte-level models consistently outperforming hierarchical variants on character manipulation tasks. Ablating transformer layers into attention and feed-forward components further reveals that byte-level attention is the primary mechanism driving this behavior. Together, our results provide an explanation for the character-level failures of hierarchical byte models and establish a clear trade-off between computational efficiency and fine-grained character understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了字节级语言模型中的层级架构设计，发现纯字节级模型在字符级操作任务上始终优于层级化变体，并揭示了字节级注意力机制是字符理解的关键。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的字节级语言模型（如Byte Latent Transformer、Bolmo）采用层级架构（字节→词→字节），以提高训练和推理效率，但其在字符级任务（如CUTE）上的表现仍不完美。作者旨在探究：层级结构是否本身限制了字符级理解能力，以及如何在效率和性能之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.method: 1. 设计了一套统一的层级架构符号系统，区分字符级/词级注意力模块（C_a/W_a）和前馈模块（C_f/W_f）；2. 测试了多种层级策略，包括Top（字符层在前）、Middle、Bottom（字符层在后）和Interleaved（交替）策略；3. 通过消融实验分别验证注意力模块和前馈模块对字符级理解的重要性（如C_a W_f 混合层和 W_a C_f 混合层）；4. 训练12层（~100M参数，1B词）和24层（~400M参数，4B词）两种规模模型，使用ClimbMix数据集；5. 在CUTE、Pure和Diluted数据集以及ARC-E、Lambada、PIQA等通用基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 1. 纯字节级模型（Byte）在字符级任务上表现最佳，CUTE平均分达到76.6%，比最好的层级变体高出约5%；2. 层级结构会显著降低字符级理解能力，且词级层数越多性能下降越明显（如Mid_10几乎完全失败）；3. 字符级注意力比字符级前馈模块更关键——保留字符级注意力的C_a W_f混合架构性能接近纯字节模型，而保留字符级前馈但用词级注意力的W_a C_f架构性能极差；4. Interleaved（交替）策略提供了最佳的效率-性能折中，可实现2倍训练加速和不到一半的内存使用；5. 在4B规模下，Interleaved_18相对Interleaved_6提升了55.4分，显示出良好的扩展行为，而类似Bolmo的Bot_18仅提升4.1分。
AI.conclusion: 字节级语言模型中的层级架构本身是字符级理解能力不足的原因；纯字节级模型在字符级操作任务上表现最优。若必须使用层级模型以获得效率优势，建议采用字符层与词层交替的Interleaved策略。字节级注意力是字符理解的主要驱动机制，而非前馈模块。本研究明确了计算效率与细粒度字符理解之间存在明确的权衡关系。

title: TRIS: A Tri-Layer Retrieval Integrity Sieve Against Knowledge Poisoning
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external corpora, but implicit trust in retrieved documents creates a critical attack surface: PoisonedRAG shows that a handful of crafted passages can dominate dense retrieval and steer generation toward attacker-chosen answers. We present the Tri-Layer Sieve, a middleware defense that sanitizes retrieved evidence through cross-embedding-space clustering with an independent judge model, structural filtering of trigger-payload artifacts, and LLM consistency verification. The design exploits a key weakness of retrieval-stage poisoning: a single document must satisfy one embedding geometry, one internal Trigger-Payload structure, and one generation objective - rarely all three simultaneously, a fragility that persists even against an adaptive attacker who paraphrases around it. On Natural Questions, HotpotQA, and MS-MARCO with Contriever retrieval (k=50), the Sieve reduces black-box Attack Success Rate from 67.0/87.0/64.0% to 3.0/14.0/4.0%, mitigates white-box HotFlip attacks from ~74% to 27.8% on NQ with Layer 3 enabled, and drives poisoned-document MRR to 0.000, while restoring clean accuracy from 13-33% under attack to 58-76%. Under an architecture-aware adversary who paraphrases triggers to evade the structural filter, enabling the consistency layer halves adaptive ASR (32.0% to 15.0% on NQ) while raising clean accuracy by 18 points, at an added latency of ~16-19 s/query under live retrieval.

AI.tldr: TRIS（Tri-Layer Retrieval Integrity Sieve）是一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统知识投毒攻击的中间件防御方法。它通过三层正交过滤器来净化检索到的证据，显著降低了黑盒和白盒攻击成功率，同时恢复受攻击后的干净准确率。
AI.motivation: RAG系统隐式信任检索文档，构成关键攻击面。PoisonedRAG等研究表明，少量精心构造的投毒文档即可主导密集检索并引导生成朝向攻击者选择的答案。现有防御方法存在两个不足：(1) 大多数方法作用于生成输出而非检索证据的完整性；(2) 针对投毒检索的防御各自仅解决投毒文档必须满足的一个约束，在复杂查询上会以效用为代价。因此需要一种利用多目标脆弱性的防御方法。
AI.method: TRIS作为检索器与生成器之间的中间件，设计三个正交过滤器：(1) 第一层（语义聚类）：使用架构独立的Sentence-BERT MiniLM作为判断模型，对检索文档进行L2归一化后K-Means聚类（C=3），保留多数簇文档；(2) 第二层（结构过滤）：基于Split-and-Merge构造中触发器-载荷共存的特征，检测查询前缀的Jaccard相似度（阈值0.8）和n-gram重叠，过滤重叠文档；(3) 第三层（LLM一致性验证）：通过LLM在隔离状态下判断查询的参数化信念y_int，并验证每个文档是否与之矛盾或兼容（采用fail-open策略）。默认配置为L1+L2自适应L3。三层过滤器分别针对投毒文档必须同时满足的三个约束：检索端嵌入相似度、内部触发-载荷共存、事实合理性。
AI.result: 在Natural Questions、HotpotQA和MS-MARCO数据集上使用Contriever检索（k=50），TRIS将黑盒攻击成功率（ASR）从67.0%/87.0%/64.0%降至3.0%/14.0%/4.0%，将NQ上的白盒HotFlip攻击从约74%降至27.8%，并将投毒文档的MRR降至0.000，同时将干净准确率从受攻击时的13-33%恢复至58-76%。在自适应攻击下，启用第三层使NQ的自适应ASR减半（32.0%降至15.0%）并提升干净准确率18个点。额外延迟约16-19秒/查询。在与TrustRAG和RobustRAG的公平比较中，TRIS在MS-MARCO上显著优于两者，在其他数据集上具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TRIS是一种有效的RAG系统知识投毒防御方法，通过利用投毒文档必须同时满足多个约束的脆弱性，在黑盒和白盒攻击下均取得显著防御效果。该方法在架构上具有模块化、模型无关、可作为drop-in中间件部署的优势。然而存在局限性：对法官感知（Level 2）和白盒（Level 3）自适应攻击者仅有概念分析，缺乏实证评估；第三层依赖验证器的参数化知识；评估规模限于100查询子集；缺乏形式化鲁棒性保证。未来工作应包括自适应攻击基准测试、多法官集成、缩小验证器规模以及与认证聚合解码的结合。

title: MemeBridge: A Dataset for Benchmarking and Mitigating the Bidirectional Cultural Gap in Meme Interpretation
summary: Communicating across cultures is inherently challenging, especially through culturally dense and ambiguous formats like memes. While people expect large language models (LLMs) to hold promise for bridging such gaps, existing benchmark datasets often fail to capture the cultural context necessary for accurate interpretation. To address this, we introduce MemeBridge, a curated dataset centered on U.S.-originated memes, designed to capture two complementary perspectives: (1) how Chinese participants interpret these memes, and (2) how U.S. participants anticipate how people from other cultures might misunderstand them. Here, context refers to implicit cultural knowledge, including background beliefs, norms, and shared assumptions that shape meme comprehension. The dataset was constructed via a multi-stage crowdsourcing pipeline with rigorous validation, including human agreement checks and GPT-based classification verification. Each meme is annotated with sentiment, emotion, cultural significance, and knowledge type, providing rich supervision for downstream tasks. Notably, we observe that the anticipated misunderstandings from U.S. participants are often inaccurate, highlighting the asymmetries in cultural understanding and the challenges of adopting perspectives beyond one's own. This bidirectional framing, which focuses on both expression and perception, enables more nuanced benchmarking of cross-cultural comprehension. Our probing of multiple LLMs reveals that while models developed in different cultural contexts exhibit partial cross-cultural understanding, they often struggle with sophisticated interpretations. By contrast, fine-tuning with MemeBridge improves model performance, underscoring the value of culturally grounded resources for training and evaluating LLMs in globally diverse settings.

AI.tldr: MemeBridge 是一个以美国网络迷因为中心的多模态数据集，通过双向框架（中方解读+美方预测误解）刻画跨文化理解差距，并用于评估和微调多模态大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有迷因数据集缺乏跨文化语境，尤其是未能同时捕捉表达者与接收者的双向视角；西方中心化的训练数据使大模型难以为非西方用户解读文化密集型内容。
AI.method: 三阶段众包流水线：Stage 1 收集 1000 条美国众包数据并用 BERT+GPT-4 清洗；Stage 2 由 180 名美国参与者做五点 Likert 验证以过滤至 621 条；Stage 3 由 63 名中国参与者完成选择题、情感与情绪标注。评估四种多模态 LLM（Qwen2.5-VL、GLM-4V、LLaMA-3.2-Vision、GPT-4o）在默认、美方角色扮演、中方角色扮演三种设定下的表现，并对前三者及 GPT-4o 进行微调。
AI.result: 中国参与者在选择题、情感、情绪任务上准确率分别仅 58.8%、45.0%、48.9%，且更易被 LLM 生成的干扰项误导（24.0% vs. 17.1%，p<0.001），表明美方假设的误解与中方实际误解存在偏差。所有四个 LLM 在 US-RP 下表现最佳，性能排序为 US-RP > CN-RP > DEF；模型表现与其开发国别无显著关联。微调后多数任务性能提升，但 GPT-4o 在情绪分类上因过拟合从 87.1% 降至 61.1%。
AI.conclusion: 文化差距在迷因理解中呈双向性，且难以通过单方视角预测；显式的角色扮演提示能有效激发模型的文化适应性；MemeBridge 作为文化基础资源对训练和评估 LLM 具有实用价值，但仍受限于数据规模、双向验证仅在中→美方向、文化范围限于中美两国。

title: Human-Anchored Factuality Evaluation with Strategic Annotation
comment: Accepted as a conference paper for Industrial Track of EMNLP 2026
summary: LLM-based factuality judges provide scalable evaluation signals, but their metrics are often systematically biased relative to human judgments. We study human-anchored factuality evaluation under limited annotation budgets, where judge predictions on the full dataset are combined with human labels on a small selectively sampled subset to obtain statistically valid estimates. The efficiency of this approach depends critically on which examples receive human annotation: in factuality evaluation, judge-human misalignment is not driven solely by low confidence, but also by structured failure modes such as incomplete evidence, temporal mismatch, unverifiable claims, and rubric misalignment. To exploit this structure, we introduce a factuality-specific annotation policy design pipeline that uses failure-space analysis (FSA) to derive diverse predictive signals for modeling human-judge misalignment. On an internal reference-based factuality evaluation system (AutoFA) and RAGTruth, where judge-predicted estimates substantially underestimate human-annotated factual accuracy, our FSA-guided policy improves annotation efficiency over uniform sampling and uncertainty-driven baselines, achieving effective-sample-size gains of 40.3% on AutoFA and 27.1% on RAGTruth.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM作为评判器（LLMaaJ）在事实性评估中系统性地低估人类标注准确性、且其与人类判断的偏差具有结构化失败模式的问题，提出了一种基于"失败空间分析"（Failure-Space Analysis, FSA）的预算化人工标注策略设计流程，并将其嵌入到主动统计推断（Active Statistical Inference, ASI）框架中，以在有限标注预算下高效恢复以人类标注为锚点的事实性准确率（FAR）。在内部AutoFA和公开RAGTruth基准上的实验表明，FSA引导的策略在保持有效覆盖率的同时，相较均匀采样和纯置信度采样方法，在有效样本量（ESS）上分别获得了40.3%和27.1%的提升。
AI.motivation: 在生产环境中部署LLM系统时，事实性评估面临核心矛盾：人工标注虽然可靠但成本高昂、延迟严重；LLM作为评判器（LLMaaJ）虽可扩展，但其评估结果常因证据不完整、时序不一致、过度字面化的验证规则等原因系统性偏离人类判断。将评判器预测当作真值会产生偏倚的"事实性准确率"（FAR）估计。因此，研究如何在有限人工标注预算下，将大规模评判器预测与少量人工标签结合，以获得统计有效且方差更低的人类锚点估计，具有重要的实践价值。该问题的关键在于设计标注分配策略——现有基于置信度的方法仅关注评判器的不确定性，但事实性评估中的偏差往往源于结构化的失败模式，仅靠置信度无法有效识别。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种名为"失败空间分析"（FSA）的事实性特定标注策略设计流程，具体方法包括：（1）将参考型事实性评估形式化为预算化的主动统计推断（ASI）问题，利用ASI结合评判器对全部N个样本的预测与人类对按策略π采样得到的n_bgt≪N个样本的标签，以恢复人类定义的FAR；（2）设计FSA策略设计层，从四个信号家族中提取标注前即可获得的预标注特征：F1 评判器输出产物（如声明/片段结构、验证或幻觉比例、不可验证输出、自反思置信度）、F2 证据与参考质量（如参考支持强度、参考冲突、时效性、直接与间接支持）、F3 任务与输入分层（如任务或领域类型、查询类别、时敏或地域上下文）以及F4 答案-评分标准对齐（如声明重要性、完整性与正确性、过度精确或辅助细节、释义/推理容忍度）；（3）在历史标注数据上计算残差目标|Δ|=|ϕ^h−ϕ^f|，基于上述结构化特征训练XGBoost回归模型预测残差风险，通过平方根变换、水位填充和均匀混合（uniform mixing）转换为采样概率，并采用幂调谐（power-tuning）方法调整ASI估计器中评判器贡献的强度λ；（4）通过交叉验证的Spearman相关性进行特征选择，遵循"高相关性+简约性"原则，避免有限校准数据下的过拟合。
AI.result: 在AutoFA（内部语音助手事实性评估系统，N=2338）和RAGTruth（公开幻觉基准，N=2937）两个数据集上进行了系统性评估：（1）偏差量化：评判器在AutoFA上将人类FAR低估了13.3个百分点，在RAGTruth上评判器FAR为55.6%而人类FAR为86.2%，确认了系统性的低估偏差；（2）失败模式分析：AutoFA上90%的不一致源于评判器将人类认为正确的回答标记为false（43%）或unknown（46%），主要原因为证据缺口和过度严格的验证；RAGTruth上94%的不一致源于评判器过度字面化的语义对齐；（3）残差结构化：残差集中在可观察的分层中——AutoFA上"部分验证"分层的lift为2.58×，"时敏查询"为1.29×；RAGTruth上"低自置信度"lift为2.24×，"评判器标记输出"为2.02×；（4）特征相关性：AutoFA上ref-support-strength与|Δ|的Spearman相关性最强（0.57），RAGTruth上自置信度最强（0.66），flag-reliability在标记子集上提供额外信号（0.25）；（5）主实验结果：在α=0.05、预算n_bgt∈{50,100,…,1000}、每预算300次蒙特卡洛模拟下，所有ASI变体维持近名义覆盖率（0.94-0.95），FSA ASI在AutoFA上获得+40.3%±9.1的ESS增益，在RAGTruth上获得+27.1%±2.7的ESS增益，显著优于纯人工（classical，ESS增益为0）、评判器预测（覆盖率0）、均匀ASI（AutoFA +13.3%、RAGTruth +11.3%）和置信度ASI（AutoFA +17.0%、RAGTruth +22.6%）；（6）特征选择验证：在AutoFA上单特征ref-support-strength获得+40.5% ESS增益优于全部候选特征的+24.7%，证实简约特征集在有限校准数据下更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地将参考型事实性评估形式化为人类锚点的评判器辅助推断问题，并在预算约束下通过主动统计推断（ASI）框架得到了统计有效的FAR估计。核心贡献在于提出了失败空间分析（FSA），这是一种事实性特定的策略设计层，能够从评判器产物、证据质量、任务分层和评分标准对齐四个家族中提取结构化信号以建模评判器-人类残差风险。基于此设计的FSA引导标注策略在内部AutoFA和公开RAGTruth两个异质数据集上均显著优于均匀采样和置信度驱动的基线，在保持有效覆盖率的同时实现了显著的方差缩减（ESS增益达40.3%和27.1%）。该方法为生产环境中事实性评估提供了一种可扩展、成本可控且以人类判断为锚点的实用方案。局限在于：策略效率依赖于残差结构在校准集与评估集之间保持稳定，分布漂移会降低策略效果并需要周期性重校准；FSA的四类失败家族并非穷尽，复杂多跳推理失败等罕见情形可能未被覆盖；当前框架将人类标注视为无噪声的单一标注者，未建模多标注者场景下的异质可靠性问题。

title: Skill Following: Evaluating Actual Skill Use in Retrieval-Enabled LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, yet standard evaluations obscure whether retrieving these skills actually helps. Aggregate metrics often compare retrieved versus non-retrieved tasks, introducing severe selection bias and failing to isolate the true effect of skill use. To measure this actual-use capability-which we formalize as Skill Following (SF)-we introduce the Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect (RAE). RAE computes the same-task outcome difference between matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled executions, conditioned exclusively on tasks where the agent actively retrieved a skill. Evaluating 17 LLMs across coding and mathematical domains, we uncover a stark evaluation paradox: models frequently show positive aggregate retrieval lift but negative RAE. On MBPP+, multiple models that appear to benefit system-wide actually harm their own performance on the exact tasks where retrieval occurred. These findings demonstrate that aggregate averages can create a misleading illusion of tool-use proficiency, whereas RAE directly measures whether the retrieval-to-answer pipeline genuinely rescues more outcomes than it harms.

AI.tldr: 针对具备外部技能检索能力的大语言模型智能体，提出一种名为RAE（Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect）的配对评估指标，以纠正传统聚合指标在衡量技能实际效用时存在的选择偏差问题，并通过17个LLM在编程与数学领域的实验揭示了"聚合提升为正、实际效用为负"的评估悖论。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体越来越依赖外部技能库进行检索增强推理，现有的聚合评估指标（如整体基准准确率提升、检索任务集与非检索任务集的对比）存在严重的选择偏差，无法隔离出检索到的技能对具体任务真实效用的因果性测量，导致对智能体工具使用能力的误判。
AI.method: 形式化定义"技能遵循"（Skill Following, SF）为从检索到答案的完整认知链条；提出严格配对的执行协议（SE启用技能 vs. SD禁用技能），确保同一任务共享随机种子与解码配置；引入核心指标RAE，仅在智能体主动发起检索并成功返回技能的任务子集上计算配对同任务结果差异；同时引入"技能禁用选择差"Δ_select量化任务选择偏差；通过技能内容控制实验（Normal/Schema-Empty/Filler-Dummy/Random-skills/Corrupted）以及GPT-5.5标注的有害迁移分类诊断机制性失败原因。
AI.result: 在17个LLM、4个基准（MBPP+三个分区+HumanEval+）以及跨域Math500上的实验表明，聚合检索提升与RAE之间存在普遍且显著的符号反转现象（例如MBPP+ s42中5/13模型出现符号分歧）；Llama-3.3-70B在Math500上呈现+14.2pp聚合提升但-39.4pp RAE的极端反差；诊断显示智能体高检索覆盖率并不转化为正RAE，最主要失败模式为"忽略/独立使用"（DeepSeek-V3.2占64.4%，Gemini-2.5-Flash-lite占72.5%）；技能内容控制证明负RAE并非源于技能文本质量问题，而是源于整个检索-注入-整合-格式化链条的系统性失败。
AI.conclusion: 聚合指标会制造工具使用能力的虚假幻象，RAE通过严格配对的同任务对比消除了任务选择偏差，是衡量检索增强智能体技能真实效用的必要方法论工具；仅仅将检索内容注入上下文并不等同于有效的技能遵循，需要将评估从"暴露"层面推进到"实际整合"层面，从而推动智能体工具使用机制的严谨审计。

title: Same Semantics, Different Outcome: On the Modality Robustness of Multimodal LLMs under Knowledge Conflict
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly provided with contextual evidence in heterogeneous forms: as a text passage, as a rendered image of the same passage, or as both together.
